papers.title: Excitation of Collective Modes in a Chiral Superfluid by Thermal Quench
papers.abstract: Based on time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau field theory we show that rapid cooling through the second-order phase transition into superfluid \Hea\ excites collective modes of newly formed chiral domains, in addition to topological defects that are formed via the Kibble-Zurek mechanism. Simulations of temperature quenches in the presence of Gaussian space-time white noise generate a highly excited inhomogeneous condensate. Large-scale simulations exhibit a complex network of domain walls and vortices. We report results for the excitation of bosonic collective modes by thermal noise as well as nonequilibrium temperature quenches, followed by coarsening dynamics tracked in terms of the Fourier components of the order parameter amplitudes. For thermal states, the spectrum of bosonic excitations is defined by a power spectral density (PSD) for each mode, which is sensitive to the Langevin damping. For weak damping the PSD onsets sharply at the frequency corresponding to the mass of the bosonic mode, then decays as $1/ω$. We also track the dynamics of the order parameter following a temperature quench. We report results for the scaling exponents of Kibble-Zurek freeze-out time and correlation length as a function of quench rate for several damping rates. The dynamical exponent $z$ is shown to transition smoothly from $z=1$ to $z=2$ as the damping is increased, while the correlation length exponent, $ν\approx 1/2$, is independent of damping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（基于时间依赖Ginzburg-Landau场论和数值模拟，关键词：time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau field theory, simulations）；研究对象：手性超流体（chiral superfluid）中的集体模式激发，具体涉及超流体³He-A（\Hea）在热淬火过程中的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过快速冷却进入手性超流体的二级相变，除了通过Kibble-Zurek机制形成拓扑缺陷外，还会激发新形成的手性畴的集体模式；阻尼增加时动力学指数z从1平滑过渡到2，而关联长度指数ν≈1/2与阻尼无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过快速冷却进入手性超流体的二级相变，除了通过Kibble-Zurek机制形成拓扑缺陷外，还会激发新形成的手性畴的集体模式；阻尼增加时动力学指数z从1平滑过渡到2，而关联长度指数ν≈1/2与阻尼无关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时Ginzburg-Landau场论，在存在高斯时空白噪声的情况下模拟温度淬火过程，通过序参量振幅的傅里叶分量追踪粗化动力学，并分析功率谱密度（PSD）和标度指数。

papers.title: Stationary point complexity via minimal supersymmetry breaking
papers.abstract: The statistics of stationary points are a powerful way to understand mean-field random landscapes, and the Kac--Rice formula is a general way to compute them. A longstanding technical barrier to these calculations is the presence of the absolute value of the determinant of the Hessian. Neglecting the absolute value produces an elegant 2-index supersymmetric representation of the problem, but is often incorrect. We develop an expanded 4-index supersymmetric representation of the complexity problem which incorporates the absolute value naturally via spontaneous supersymmetry breaking along a particular superspace direction. Positing that no additional symmetry breaking occurs implies the reduction to five order parameters corresponding to elements of a superspace operator algebra generated by the spontaneously SUSY-breaking operator. We relate the order parameters to the geometry and spectra of stationary points, showing that the SUSY-breaking order parameter corresponds to the spectral density of the Hessian at zero eigenvalue. We give examples of this formalism applied to calculate the annealed complexity of several models, including the perceptron and the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick model. The framework is naturally extended to quenched complexity, where each order parameter corresponds to a replica matrix.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Kac–Rice formula、supersymmetric representation、order parameters、annealed complexity、quenched complexity。；研究对象：平均场随机势能面（mean-field random landscapes）中驻点（stationary points）的统计复杂性（complexity），具体应用于感知机（perceptron）和Sherrington–Kirkpatrick模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入4指标超对称表示，将Hessian矩阵行列式的绝对值自然纳入复杂性计算，并指出该绝对值对应沿特定超空间方向的自发超对称破缺；破缺序参量等价于Hessian在零特征值处的谱密度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入4指标超对称表示，将Hessian矩阵行列式的绝对值自然纳入复杂性计算，并指出该绝对值对应沿特定超空间方向的自发超对称破缺；破缺序参量等价于Hessian在零特征值处的谱密度。；创新点：首次通过自发超对称破缺自然处理Kac–Rice公式中长期存在的Hessian行列式绝对值问题，并建立了序参量与驻点几何/谱之间的明确对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于Kac–Rice公式的复杂性计算，发展4指标超对称表示（取代传统的2指标表示），通过自发超对称破缺机制处理行列式绝对值；引入超空间算子代数，将复杂性约化为五个序参量；分别计算退火复杂性（annealed complexity）和淬火复杂性（quenched complexity），后者中每个序参量对应一个副本矩阵。

papers.title: Optimal parameterization of nonequilibrium generalized master equations from discrete-time experimental data
papers.abstract: Kinetic analyses of experiments often require coarse-grained descriptions, but complex systems rarely conform to the widely used modeling assumptions of Markovianity and thermodynamic equilibrium. Memory is indeed a general and often inevitable consequence of coarse-graining. Markov state models (MSMs) are a popular choice of coarse-grained description, but require microstate assignments -- which are rarely experimentally tunable -- to macrostates that minimize memory. Generalized master equations (GMEs) circumvent this limitation of MSMs by explicitly capturing memory. However, GMEs are difficult to parameterize and usually formally approximate in the experimentally relevant discrete-time setting. Here we introduce a maximum-likelihood-based procedure to parameterize formally exact, physically feasible, discrete-time generalized master equations from experiments and simulations in and out of equilibrium. By adapting algorithms typically used in optimal transport, we construct physical-constraint-satisfying conditional-maximum-likelihood estimators of both exact Nakajima-Zwanzig memory kernels and time-convolutionless GME propagators in discrete time. Applying these estimators to three examples -- experimental recordings of Förster-resonance energy-transfer in an ion channel, experimental nanoparticle tracking of a processive molecular motor, and simulated folding of a benchmark protein domain -- we recover kinetic parameters including relaxation rates, irreversibilities, dwell times, and first-passage times. These results establish discrete-time GMEs as a physically and statistically principled alternative to MSMs for kinetic analyses of experimental and simulated biomolecular systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算与实验数据分析）。判断依据：提出最大似然估计方法，并应用于实验数据（FRET记录、纳米粒子追踪）和模拟数据（蛋白质折叠模拟）。；研究对象：非平衡广义主方程（GME）的参数化方法，应用于生物分子系统的动力学分析，包括离子通道中的Förster共振能量转移、过程性分子马达的纳米粒子追踪、以及基准蛋白质结构域的折叠模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于最大似然的程序，能够从离散时间实验数据中参数化形式精确、物理可行的非平衡广义主方程，恢复弛豫速率、不可逆性、驻留时间和首次通过时间等动力学参数，从而建立离散时间GME作为马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）的物理与统计上更严谨的替代方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于最大似然的程序，能够从离散时间实验数据中参数化形式精确、物理可行的非平衡广义主方程，恢复弛豫速率、不可逆性、驻留时间和首次通过时间等动力学参数，从而建立离散时间GME作为马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）的物理与统计上更严谨的替代方案。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用最大似然估计方法，结合最优传输算法，构建满足物理约束的条件最大似然估计器，用于估计离散时间下的精确Nakajima-Zwanzig记忆核和时间卷积无关GME传播子。方法适用于平衡与非平衡条件。

papers.title: Classical versus quantum Anderson localization in disordered systems
papers.abstract: We investigate Anderson localization in three-dimensional disordered systems by comparing scalar classical waves with mass and force-constant disorder to electronic tight-binding models with diagonal and off-diagonal disorder. We show that the commonly employed mapping between classical-wave localization and the electronic Anderson model with diagonal disorder is not mathematically justified. Instead, the correct modulus-type formulation reveals that classical-wave systems constitute a distinct constrained disorder class, in which the acoustic sum rule correlates diagonal and off-diagonal matrix elements and prevents any direct correspondence with the standard electronic disorder models. Within a unified eigenvalue framework, we determine localization phase diagrams for all four disorder classes using complementary spectral, eigenvector, and level-statistics diagnostics. We find that classical-wave systems share a key qualitative feature with electronic off-diagonal disorder: localized states occur only near a band edge, while extended states persist in the central part of the spectrum even at strong disorder. At the same time, the acoustic sum rule produces localization topologies that differ fundamentally from both diagonal- and off-diagonal-disorder electronic systems. In particular, for mass disorder we obtain a phase diagram that differs qualitatively from previous results based on the conventional potential-type approach and reveals an extended localized regime near the upper band edge. Our results establish a unified perspective on localization in quantum and classical wave systems and provide new insight into the conditions under which Anderson localization may occur in three-dimensional photonic and acoustic media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“investigate”“show”“determine”等理论分析词汇，并基于“eigenvalue framework”“spectral, eigenvector, and level-statistics diagnostics”等理论方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：三维无序系统中的安德森局域化现象，具体比较标量经典波（含质量无序和力常数无序）与电子紧束缚模型（含对角无序和非对角无序）的局域化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典波系统构成一种独特的约束无序类，其声学求和规则关联了对角与非对角矩阵元，导致经典波局域化与标准电子安德森模型之间不存在直接的数学对应关系。经典波系统与非对角无序电子系统共享一个关键定性特征：局域态仅出现在能带边缘，而谱中心区域即使在强无序下仍保持扩展态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典波系统构成一种独特的约束无序类，其声学求和规则关联了对角与非对角矩阵元，导致经典波局域化与标准电子安德森模型之间不存在直接的数学对应关系。经典波系统与非对角无序电子系统共享一个关键定性特征：局域态仅出现在能带边缘，而谱中心区域即使在强无序下仍保持扩展态。；创新点：揭示了经典波系统与电子无序模型之间映射的数学不成立性，并指出经典波系统因声学求和规则而具有独特的局域化拓扑结构。特别地，对于质量无序，获得了与以往基于势型方法定性不同的相图，在上能带边缘附近发现了扩展局域化区域。
papers.method_zh: 采用统一的特征值框架，通过互补的谱分析、本征向量分析和能级统计诊断，对四种无序类（经典波质量无序、经典波力常数无序、电子对角无序、电子非对角无序）的局域化相图进行确定。

papers.title: Entropy density functional theory for inhomogeneous fluids
papers.abstract: We present an exact variational scheme for the physics of inhomogeneous classical fluids in thermal equilibrium. A joint metadensity minimization principle is proven for the one-body density and the global interparticle distance distribution. The theory bypasses the inhomogeneous two-body density and thus remains computationally simple. A universal excess entropy functional accounts for all many-body correlations in arbitrary pairwise interacting systems. The framework is relevant for neural functional machine learning, for soft matter design, and for predicting structural correlation functions via entropic test-particle and meta-Ornstein-Zernike routes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“exact variational scheme”（精确变分方案）、“principle”（原理）、“functional”（泛函）、“framework”（框架）。；研究对象：非均匀经典流体的热平衡态物理。具体指在空间上密度分布不均匀的经典粒子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个精确的变分原理，该原理同时以单体密度和全局粒子间距离分布为变分变量，从而绕过了对非均匀两体密度函数的直接计算，在保持计算简单性的同时，精确描述了任意成对相互作用系统中的多体关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个精确的变分原理，该原理同时以单体密度和全局粒子间距离分布为变分变量，从而绕过了对非均匀两体密度函数的直接计算，在保持计算简单性的同时，精确描述了任意成对相互作用系统中的多体关联。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：1）提出了一个绕过两体密度函数的精确变分方案，降低了计算复杂度；2）建立了基于熵（而非传统自由能）的密度泛函理论框架，并证明了其精确性；3）为通过熵的测试粒子路径和元-Ornstein-Zernike路径预测结构关联函数提供了新方法。
papers.method_zh: 熵密度泛函理论。具体而言，作者构建了一个普适的过剩熵泛函，该泛函包含了所有多体关联效应，并通过“元密度”（metadensity）最小化原理来求解平衡态性质。

papers.title: Coexisting Regular and Chaotic Dynamics in the Dysprosium Feshbach Spectrum
papers.abstract: Strongly dipolar gases, such as dysprosium, erbium and thulium, exhibit dense Feshbach spectra whose level statistics have been associated with quantum chaos arising from couplings among many molecular channels. Here, we combine a precise calibration of the Feshbach spectrum of $^{162}$Dy with spectroscopic measurements of the differential magnetic moments of bound states associated with more than 80 resonances between 0 and 30 G. These magnetic moments provide an eigenstate-sensitive probe of the molecular states underlying the resonance spectrum. We find that the level statistics are not uniform: resonances associated with states near the center of the magnetic-moment distribution display enhanced level repulsion, whereas those near the lower edge remain close to Poisson statistics. Our results reveal hidden structure within the chaotic dysprosium Feshbach spectrum and identify molecular-state composition as a key ingredient in the emergence of quantum chaos in strongly dipolar scattering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：precise calibration、spectroscopic measurements、experimental probe。；研究对象：强偶极气体中的镝（$^{162}$Dy）Feshbach谱，具体研究其共振态能级统计与分子态磁矩的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 镝Feshbach谱的能级统计并非均匀：靠近磁矩分布中心的共振态表现出增强的能级排斥（混沌特征），而靠近磁矩分布低能边缘的共振态则接近泊松统计（规则特征）。这表明分子态组成是强偶极散射中量子混沌涌现的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：镝Feshbach谱的能级统计并非均匀：靠近磁矩分布中心的共振态表现出增强的能级排斥（混沌特征），而靠近磁矩分布低能边缘的共振态则接近泊松统计（规则特征）。这表明分子态组成是强偶极散射中量子混沌涌现的关键因素。；创新点：通过测量每个共振态对应的束缚态磁矩（本征态敏感探针），揭示了看似混沌的镝Feshbach谱中隐藏的规则与混沌共存的结构，并首次将分子态组成与量子混沌的涌现直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 精确标定$^{162}$Dy在0-30 G磁场范围内的Feshbach谱，并对超过80个共振对应的束缚态进行差分磁矩的谱学测量。

papers.title: Interlayer electric multipole Hall effect in twisted multilayers
papers.abstract: Electrons in layered van der Waals materials possess a layer pseudospin characterizing their wave-function distribution among layers. In twisted structures, this pseudospin forms nontrivial textures, leading to intriguing phenomena such as the layer Hall effect (LHE), where distinct layer Hall currents flow despite the presence of time-reversal symmetry. In chiral bilayers, LHE manifests as an interlayer electric dipole Hall effect with Hall counterflows and a concomitant in-plane magnetic dipole. Multilayers host richer layer-dependent Hall currents, generating interlayer electric multipole Hall effects and in-plane magnetic multipoles. We start from exploring the interlayer electric quadrupole Hall effect in mirror-symmetric twisted trilayers. At small twist angles, interlayer translation efficiently tunes layer Hall current magnitudes. At large angles and low doping, the currents can be well accounted for by adding the contributions from the two individual twisted interfaces. This decomposition allows obtaining layer-resolved Hall currents in large-angle twisted multilayers even without well-defined periodicity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exploring、accounted for、decomposition、obtaining（理论分析与模型构建）。；研究对象：扭曲多层范德华材料中的层霍尔效应，特别是扭曲三层体系中的层分辨霍尔电流与层间电多极矩（如电四极矩）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在镜面对称的扭曲三层体系中，存在层间电四极霍尔效应，且层霍尔电流的大小可通过层间平移有效调控；在大扭转角及低掺杂条件下，多层体系的层分辨霍尔电流可分解为各独立扭曲界面的贡献之和。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在镜面对称的扭曲三层体系中，存在层间电四极霍尔效应，且层霍尔电流的大小可通过层间平移有效调控；在大扭转角及低掺杂条件下，多层体系的层分辨霍尔电流可分解为各独立扭曲界面的贡献之和。；创新点：首次提出并分析了扭曲多层体系中的层间电多极霍尔效应（从电偶极扩展到电四极），并揭示了在大扭转角下多层体系层霍尔电流可分解为独立界面贡献的规律，为无明确周期性的扭曲多层结构提供了层分辨电流分析方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于层赝自旋纹理与扭曲界面耦合的模型，通过分解不同扭转界面的贡献来解析层分辨霍尔电流，未使用具体数值计算或实验手段。

papers.title: Role of the Casimir force in the capacitive radio-frequency microelectromechanical switches
papers.abstract: We determine the role of the fluctuation-induced Casimir force acting between a membrane of cylindrical shape and a bottom electrode in microelectromechanical capacitive switches. For this purpose, the Casimir force is computed taking into account the real properties of both a membrane and a bottom electrode materials with account of surface roughness. The obtained results are compared with those found for the smooth surfaces using the idealization of ideal metal. It is shown that an account of both the real material properties and surface roughness is crucial for obtaining the correct values of the Casimir force. According to our results, at the shortest separations, when the switch membrane is in contact with the transmission line, the magnitudes of the Casimir force may exceed the magnitudes of the electric one depending on the value of the operating voltage. The obtained values of the Casimir force can be used for determining the thickness of the switch membrane, which ensures the necessary magnitude of the restoring elastic force required for a stable cyclic functioning of the micromechanical switch with no pull-in.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“计算了Casimir力”、“考虑了真实材料性质”等理论建模与数值计算关键词。；研究对象：微机电系统（MEMS）电容式射频开关中，圆柱形膜片与底部电极之间的Casimir力（量子涨落诱导的力）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在最短间距（膜片与传输线接触时），Casimir力的大小可能超过静电力，具体取决于工作电压值。同时，考虑真实材料性质和表面粗糙度对正确计算Casimir力至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在最短间距（膜片与传输线接触时），Casimir力的大小可能超过静电力，具体取决于工作电压值。同时，考虑真实材料性质和表面粗糙度对正确计算Casimir力至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过理论计算Casimir力，考虑了膜片和底部电极的真实材料性质（非理想金属）以及表面粗糙度，并与理想金属光滑表面的理想化结果进行了对比。

papers.title: Imaging geometry- and phase-controlled spectra in a surface-state Andreev cavity
papers.abstract: Andreev cavities provide a setting in which superconducting proximity spectra are shaped by phase-coherent electron-hole motion along extended trajectories. While such Andreev physics is well established in transport, local spectra in two-dimensional cavities remain largely unexplored in real space. Here we use scanning tunnelling spectroscopy to study confined Cu(111) surface states coupled to superconducting Nb(110). The in-plane magnetic-field scale for the collapse of the resolved low-energy spectrum is controlled by the transverse extent available to Andreev trajectories, while the zero-field excitation energy evolves with the characteristic trajectory length. These trends, together with spatial variations within individual islands and the response to vortex phase textures, are captured by a minimal semiclassical phase-accumulation picture. Our results identify geometry-defined Andreev trajectories as a design principle for phase-coherent superconducting cavities accessible by local spectroscopy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了扫描隧道谱学（scanning tunnelling spectroscopy）作为主要研究手段。；研究对象：表面态安德烈夫腔（surface-state Andreev cavity）。具体体系为受限的Cu(111)表面态与超导Nb(110)耦合形成的二维空腔。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过扫描隧道谱学，发现安德烈夫腔中的局域谱由几何定义的安德烈夫轨迹（Andreev trajectories）控制：零场激发能由轨迹特征长度决定，而低能谱塌缩的面内磁场尺度则由轨迹的横向展宽决定。这些趋势以及空间变化和涡旋相位响应均可由半经典相位累积模型描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过扫描隧道谱学，发现安德烈夫腔中的局域谱由几何定义的安德烈夫轨迹（Andreev trajectories）控制：零场激发能由轨迹特征长度决定，而低能谱塌缩的面内磁场尺度则由轨迹的横向展宽决定。这些趋势以及空间变化和涡旋相位响应均可由半经典相位累积模型描述。；创新点：首次在实空间中对二维空腔中的局域安德烈夫谱进行成像研究，揭示了空腔几何形状（而非仅通过输运测量）可作为设计相位相干超导腔的关键原则。摘要未突出说明与之前工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：扫描隧道谱学（Scanning Tunnelling Spectroscopy, STS）。理论框架：半经典相位累积模型（semiclassical phase-accumulation picture）。

papers.title: Moiré Phonons and Emergent Exciton-Phonon Coupling in a Moiré Heterobilayer
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices have emerged as a new platform for engineering electronic and optical properties in van der Waals heterostructures, enabling control over correlated and excitonic phenomena. Yet the impact of moiré superlattices on exciton-phonon coupling remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate emergent, layer-selective coupling between moiré phonons and moiré excitons in angle-aligned WS2/WSe2 heterobilayers. Using a broadband terahertz phonon transducer, we coherently launch moiré phonons that resonantly perturb the excitonic states. We show that the exciton-phonon coupling is intrinsically modified by the moiré superlattice in a layer-selective manner. A driven oscillator model captures the dynamics, revealing three moiré phonon resonances with distinct coupling to the moiré excitons. First principles calculations show that many moiré phonon modes can arise with distinct strongly hybridized in-plane and out-of-plane vibrations in the moiré unit cells. The calculations further identify the three experimentally observed moiré phonons and their emergent characteristic coupling to the moiré excitons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“coherently launch moiré phonons”等实验手段，以及“First principles calculations”等理论计算。；研究对象：WS2/WSe2转角对齐异质双层中的莫尔超晶格，具体研究莫尔声子与莫尔激子之间的耦合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在WS2/WSe2异质双层中，莫尔超晶格以层选择性的方式内在修饰了激子-声子耦合，并观测到三种与莫尔激子具有不同耦合特征的莫尔声子共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在WS2/WSe2异质双层中，莫尔超晶格以层选择性的方式内在修饰了激子-声子耦合，并观测到三种与莫尔激子具有不同耦合特征的莫尔声子共振。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用宽带太赫兹声子换能器相干激发莫尔声子，并探测其对激子态的共振扰动；理论上采用第一性原理计算（First principles calculations）分析莫尔声子模式及其与激子的耦合特性，并用驱动振荡器模型（driven oscillator model）拟合动力学过程。

papers.title: Universality of Bubble Coalescence in Electrolytic Media
papers.abstract: Bubble coalescence phenomenon in electrolytic media finds applications in technologies from mineral flotation to electrochemical energy conversion. However, the underlying governing physics still remains unresolved, with longstanding disagreement over the extent to which Marangoni stresses affect the coalescence time by modulating the interfacial mobility. Here, we show that the thin film morphology governs drainage more strongly than the interfacial boundary conditions. We demonstrate experimentally that thin film drainage during bubble coalescence proceeds through three distinct regimes. An initial visco-capillary stage that exhibits a power-law thinning, followed by an exponential decrease in film thickness with time induced by rim stabilisation. The final regime is governed by disjoining pressure and is marked by an exponential relaxation of the film to the equilibrium thickness. We show that, irrespective of the electrolyte type and concentration, film evolution exhibits universal behavior by collapsing onto a single curve when rescaled with the characteristic film thickness and time scale, demonstrating that electrolyte effects act only to renormalize timescales rather than alter the underlying dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimentally demonstrate、thin film drainage、bubble coalescence。；研究对象：电解液中气泡聚并现象，具体研究气泡间液膜排液动力学及其受电解质影响的普适行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 气泡聚并过程中液膜形态对排液的控制作用强于界面边界条件（如Marangoni应力），且不同电解质类型和浓度下的液膜演化在重新标度后表现出普适性，电解质仅改变时间尺度而不改变底层动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：气泡聚并过程中液膜形态对排液的控制作用强于界面边界条件（如Marangoni应力），且不同电解质类型和浓度下的液膜演化在重新标度后表现出普适性，电解质仅改变时间尺度而不改变底层动力学。；创新点：首次揭示电解液中气泡聚并的液膜排液存在三个普适动力学阶段，并证明电解质效应仅重新归一化时间尺度，而非改变动力学机制，解决了关于Marangoni应力影响聚并时间的长期争议。
papers.method_zh: 实验观测气泡聚并过程中的液膜厚度随时间演化，通过分析不同电解质类型和浓度下的排液曲线，识别出三个不同动力学阶段（粘-毛细阶段、边缘稳定化导致的指数减薄阶段、分离压主导的指数松弛阶段），并采用特征厚度和时间尺度对数据进行重新标度。

papers.title: Uniaxial compression of crystalline HCP titanium: an atomistic modelling study of size effects
papers.abstract: Understanding the deformation behaviour of titanium is important not only for technological advances associated with industrially-relevant applications, but also essential to achieve a fundamental understanding of the mechanical properties of the relevant alloys. In this computational study, molecular-dynamics simulations are employed to ascertain the impact of model size on the mechanical response of alpha-titanium under compression. The deformation behaviour of the crystalline models is investigated as a function of different system sizes (varied by four orders of magnitude, up to 32 million atoms), and strain rates (down to 10^8 s^-1). The results show that the elastic properties remain independent of both system size and strain rate, whereas marked size effects emerge during plastic deformation. Increasing the system size of the titanium model reduces stress fluctuations, results in more homogeneous structural evolution, and stabilizes dislocation activity. Decreasing the applied strain rate requires correspondingly a larger system size to achieve equilibration and to ensure a stable behaviour for the simulated structure. The modelling results demonstrate that system size and strain rate are strongly coupled, and their combined effect governs the simulated deformation behaviour of the compressed crystalline material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computational study、molecular-dynamics simulations、atomistic modelling。；研究对象：α-钛（alpha-titanium）晶体在单轴压缩下的变形行为，重点研究模型尺寸（系统大小）对力学响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弹性性质与系统尺寸和应变率无关，但塑性变形阶段表现出显著的尺寸效应：增大系统尺寸可降低应力波动、使结构演化更均匀、稳定位错活动；系统尺寸与应变率强耦合，共同决定压缩晶体的模拟变形行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弹性性质与系统尺寸和应变率无关，但塑性变形阶段表现出显著的尺寸效应：增大系统尺寸可降低应力波动、使结构演化更均匀、稳定位错活动；系统尺寸与应变率强耦合，共同决定压缩晶体的模拟变形行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（molecular-dynamics）模拟，系统尺寸变化达四个数量级（最大3200万原子），应变率低至10^8 s^-1。

papers.title: Scaling limit of the Random Language Model
papers.abstract: We develop a quantitative theory of the Random Language Model (RLM), an ensemble of stochastic context-free grammars, in a scaling limit where the number of hidden symbols $N \to \infty$ while the grammar temperature $\tildeε_d \to 0$ at fixed $x = {\tildeε}_d \log N$. In this limit, the model admits a controlled description based on a large-deviation principle over rule-usage patterns. A semi-annealed approximation maps the problem to a class of Random Energy Models with nontrivial combinatorics. We show that the RLM exhibits a condensation transition at a critical value $x_c=1/8$, below which rule usage concentrates and language statistics acquire a nontrivial dependence on corpus length. A second characteristic scale at $x=1/2$ marks the onset of entropy reduction from its maximal value. Across these regimes, we derive explicit scaling laws for the number of distinct rules, entropy, and related observables, identifying distinct scaling, saturation, and critical regimes controlled by the interplay of grammar size, corpus length, and temperature. The theory resolves previous ambiguities regarding the existence of a thermodynamic transition and explains the slow approach to the large-$N$ limit as a consequence of the dependence on $\log N$. It further provides a unified framework in which universal statistical properties of language emerge from typical realizations of generative grammars, with implications for both natural language statistics and the behavior of large language models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：scaling limit, large-deviation principle, Random Energy Models。；研究对象：随机语言模型（Random Language Model, RLM），一种随机上下文无关文法的系综，在隐藏符号数N→∞且语法温度趋于0的标度极限下的统计行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RLM在临界值x_c=1/8处发生凝聚相变，低于该值时规则使用集中且语言统计对语料长度产生非平凡依赖；在x=1/2处出现熵从最大值开始降低的第二特征标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RLM在临界值x_c=1/8处发生凝聚相变，低于该值时规则使用集中且语言统计对语料长度产生非平凡依赖；在x=1/2处出现熵从最大值开始降低的第二特征标度。；创新点：解决了此前关于热力学相变存在性的歧义，揭示了向大N极限缓慢趋近的原因在于对log N的依赖，并建立了从典型生成文法实现中涌现语言普适统计性质的统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于大偏差原理对规则使用模式进行半退火近似，将问题映射到具有非平凡组合结构的随机能量模型（Random Energy Models），并推导出不同标度区间的标度律。

papers.title: Phase structure of the Random Language Model
papers.abstract: Context-free grammars are minimal models of hierarchical structure in human language, generating structured text from recursive production rules. The Random Language Model (RLM) [De Giuli, PRL 2019], an ensemble of such grammars with random rule weights, exhibits a cross-over from gibberish-like output to structured text as a function of a "temperature", but the location and nature of this transition remained unclear. Here, we show that the RLM exhibits a hierarchy of phase transitions in a double-scaling limit where the grammar temperature $\tildeε_d \to 0$ and the number of hidden symbols $N \to \infty$ at fixed $x = \tildeε_d \log N$. By identifying the relation between RLM and the Random Energy Model, we identify a series of transitions where correlations between symbols emerge, single-symbol marginals become non-uniform, and rule use freezes in a glassy phase. A semi-annealed approximation yields nontrivial scaling laws for rule usage, entropy, and energy, consistent with Heaps' law and context-length scaling observed in large language models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“ensemble of such grammars”、“double-scaling limit”、“Random Energy Model”等理论模型与统计物理方法。；研究对象：随机语言模型（Random Language Model, RLM）的相结构，即由随机规则权重定义的上下文无关文法集合在“温度”参数下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双标度极限下，随机语言模型展现出层级相变序列：符号间关联出现、单符号边缘分布非均匀化、以及规则使用在玻璃相中冻结。半退火近似给出了与大型语言模型中Heaps定律和上下文长度标度一致的标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双标度极限下，随机语言模型展现出层级相变序列：符号间关联出现、单符号边缘分布非均匀化、以及规则使用在玻璃相中冻结。半退火近似给出了与大型语言模型中Heaps定律和上下文长度标度一致的标度律。；创新点：首次明确了随机语言模型中从无意义输出到结构化文本的交叉行为本质上是层级相变，并建立了与随机能量模型的精确对应关系，揭示了玻璃相冻结行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用统计物理中的随机能量模型（Random Energy Model）类比，结合双标度极限（语法温度趋于零、隐藏符号数趋于无穷，固定x = ̃ε_d log N）分析，并运用半退火近似推导熵、能量和规则使用的标度律。

papers.title: Tuning the optoelectronic properties of wide bandgap perovskites: Data-driven insights from combinatorial synthesis and high-throughput experimentation
papers.abstract: The discovery and optimization of wide-bandgap lead halide perovskites (LHPs) is hindered by solution-based workflows with limited scalability. Large compositional parameter spaces present an additional challenge for materials optimization. Here, we establish an integrated, combinatorial workflow based on sequential physical vapor deposition that enables independent tuning of cation (Cs/Pb) and anion (Br/Cl) compositions. Applying automated structural, compositional, and optical characterizations across >500 samples regions of interest are rapidly screened in the quaternary Cs-Pb-Br-Cl space. From the screening, we establish a practical Cs/Pb window of 1.05-1.20 for wide bandgap perovskites, within which elevated PL yields were observed. Through in-depth analysis of the data set, we uncover a high-energy optical transition as a robust determinant for high PL yields. By combining mechanistic insight into the compositional origins of high PL efficiency with a fully integrated, high-throughput screening framework, and by openly releasing the complete multi-modal dataset, this work provides a broadly accessible benchmark to accelerate data-driven discovery of wide-bandgap perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：combinatorial synthesis, high-throughput experimentation, physical vapor deposition, automated characterizations）；研究对象：宽禁带铅卤钙钛矿（wide-bandgap lead halide perovskites, LHPs），具体为Cs-Pb-Br-Cl四元体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Cs-Pb-Br-Cl四元体系中，确定了实现高光致发光（PL）产率的实用Cs/Pb比例窗口（1.05-1.20），并发现一个高能光学跃迁是预测高PL产率的稳健判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Cs-Pb-Br-Cl四元体系中，确定了实现高光致发光（PL）产率的实用Cs/Pb比例窗口（1.05-1.20），并发现一个高能光学跃迁是预测高PL产率的稳健判据。；创新点：建立了一个完全集成的、基于物理气相沉积的高通量筛选框架，能够独立调控阳离子（Cs/Pb）和阴离子（Br/Cl）组分，并公开了完整的多模态数据集，为数据驱动的宽禁带钙钛矿发现提供了可广泛访问的基准。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于顺序物理气相沉积（sequential physical vapor deposition）的组合合成方法，结合自动化结构、成分和光学表征（automated structural, compositional, and optical characterizations），对超过500个样品区域进行高通量筛选。

papers.title: Population-Dominated Ergotropy in a Capacitively Coupled Double-Quantum-Dot Battery under 1/f Charge Noise
papers.abstract: We investigate extractable work storage in a capacitively coupled double quantum dot (DQD) quantum battery (QB) subjected to experimentally motivated detuning charge noise. The battery is modeled as two interacting charge qubits with an Ising-type capacitive coupling and is charged by resonant microwave modulation of the tunnel coupling channel. Detuning fluctuations are introduced as classical stochastic processes generated from a band-limited 1/f noise spectrum. For each noise realization, the evolution remains unitary, whereas decoherence and loss of contrast emerge after ensemble averaging. We analyze the total ergotropy, its population and coherent contributions, the energy basis populations, a passive ordering violation diagnostic, and the Jensen-Shannon coherence of the noise-averaged state. The results show that resonant tunnel coupling driving selects a dominant E0 <-> E3 population transfer channel in the interacting DQD spectrum. The dominant extractable work is stored in non-passive population distributions, in agreement with recent population ordering interpretations of ergotropy in QBs, while coherence accompanies and supports the resonant transfer as a transient dynamical resource. Detuning noise reduces the energy basis coherence amplitude and also weakens the population transfer pathway responsible for the dominant population ergotropy. This framework provides a noise-aware description of semiconductor QB charging based on extractable work rather than on injected energy alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：modeled as、classical stochastic processes、unitary evolution、ensemble averaging）；研究对象：电容耦合双量子点（DQD）量子电池，受1/f电荷噪声影响的充电与可提取功存储过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共振隧穿耦合驱动下，系统主要通过E0↔E3布居转移通道存储可提取功，且可提取功主要来源于非被动布居分布，而非相干性；1/f电荷噪声会同时削弱相干振幅和主导布居转移通道，从而降低布居厄格特罗比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共振隧穿耦合驱动下，系统主要通过E0↔E3布居转移通道存储可提取功，且可提取功主要来源于非被动布居分布，而非相干性；1/f电荷噪声会同时削弱相干振幅和主导布居转移通道，从而降低布居厄格特罗比。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将双量子点建模为两个具有伊辛型电容耦合的电荷量子比特，通过共振微波调制隧穿耦合通道充电；引入带限1/f噪声谱生成的经典随机过程模拟失谐电荷噪声，对噪声实现进行系综平均后分析厄格特罗比、布居与相干贡献、能量基布居、被动序违反诊断及Jensen-Shannon相干性。

papers.title: Room-temperature magnon-phonon transduction in high-damping Co/Pt structures
papers.abstract: Quantum communication and information processing strongly benefit from the coupling between different quasi-particles, offering complementary advantages. Magnetoelastic materials inherently allow for direct coupling between magnetization dynamics and quantized lattice vibrations, called phonons. Near the ferromagnetic resonances, phonons may thus trade energy and angular momentum with uniformly precessing magnetization, called magnons, and enable transduction of information from magnetic to phononic modes, thereby paving the way for long-range transport of magnetic information without the need of magnetic material. Here, we employ tailored magnetic-nonmagnetic heterostructures, which simultaneously act as cavities for standing shear waves, to bring selective phonons and magnons into resonance. These Co films with Pt seed layers show extended linewidth and reduced amplitude of the phonon-resonant FMR lines, providing a hallmark of energy and angular momentum exchange. Complementarily, by theoretical modeling and ultra-fast coherent phonon spectroscopy, we identify the responsible transverse acoustic phonons as standing shear waves in the combined Co and Pt structure. We find a high crystal quality in conjunction with a large magnetoelastic coupling constant as a prerequisite for efficient magnon-phonon coupling of this type. Such resonant enhancement of magnon-phonon coupling in CMOS-compatible material provides an ideal material platform for future quantum transducers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：employ、theoretical modeling、ultra-fast coherent phonon spectroscopy、experimental hallmark）；研究对象：高阻尼Co/Pt异质结构中的磁振子-声子耦合与能量/角动量转换现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，通过设计Co/Pt磁性-非磁性异质结构作为剪切驻波腔，实现了选择性声子与磁振子的共振耦合，并观察到声子共振铁磁共振（FMR）线宽展宽和振幅降低，标志着能量与角动量的交换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，通过设计Co/Pt磁性-非磁性异质结构作为剪切驻波腔，实现了选择性声子与磁振子的共振耦合，并观察到声子共振铁磁共振（FMR）线宽展宽和振幅降低，标志着能量与角动量的交换。；创新点：在CMOS兼容的高阻尼Co/Pt材料体系中实现了室温下磁振子-声子共振增强耦合，为未来量子换能器提供了理想材料平台。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快相干声子光谱学（ultra-fast coherent phonon spectroscopy）和铁磁共振（FMR）测量；理论上通过建模识别出Co/Pt复合结构中的横向声学声子为剪切驻波模式。

papers.title: In situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction study of flash austenitization and process design insights in medium-Manganese steels for energy applications
papers.abstract: Medium Mn steels (MMnSs) are promising candidates for energy-related infrastructure because their multiphase microstructures and austenite stability can be tailored to improve failure resistance under demanding service conditions. Flash austenitization (FA) provides a rapid route to form austenite while limiting prior austenite grain coarsening and substitutional solute homogenization, but the related short-time transformation kinetics remain insufficiently quantified. In the present work, the effects of FA temperature and initial microstructure on austenitization kinetics were investigated in an Fe-6Mn-1.5Si-1Cr-0.3Mo-0.05Nb-0.2C (wt.%) MMnS using dilatometry-integrated in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction. Two initial microstructures produced by austenite reversion treatment (ART) were heated at 100 degrees C/s to 850 degrees C, 900 degrees C, or 950 degrees C and then held isothermally. Rapid heating alone is insufficient for full austenitization, even above the reference Ac3 temperature determined under slow heating. Full austenitization, defined by bcc fraction (f_alpha) <= 1 wt.%, requires short holding, decreasing from about 8 s at 850 degrees C to about 2 s at 950 degrees C. The final stage of austenitization is less sensitive to FA temperature than the early holding stage. The initial ART state mainly shifts the starting austenite fraction, whereas both states show comparable kinetic trends at higher FA temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction”（原位同步辐射X射线衍射）、“dilatometry-integrated”（膨胀仪集成）以及具体的加热和保温实验参数。；研究对象：Fe-6Mn-1.5Si-1Cr-0.3Mo-0.05Nb-0.2C (wt.%) 中锰钢（MMnS）的闪速奥氏体化（flash austenitization）动力学过程，具体涉及奥氏体相变及其对初始微观结构的依赖性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 快速加热（100°C/s）即使超过慢速加热测得的Ac3温度，也不足以实现完全奥氏体化；完全奥氏体化（bcc相分数≤1 wt.%）需要短时间等温保温，且所需时间随温度升高从约8秒（850°C）缩短至约2秒（950°C）。奥氏体化后期阶段对温度敏感性低于早期阶段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：快速加热（100°C/s）即使超过慢速加热测得的Ac3温度，也不足以实现完全奥氏体化；完全奥氏体化（bcc相分数≤1 wt.%）需要短时间等温保温，且所需时间随温度升高从约8秒（850°C）缩短至约2秒（950°C）。奥氏体化后期阶段对温度敏感性低于早期阶段。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用膨胀仪集成的原位同步辐射X射线衍射（in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction），结合两种不同初始微观结构（由奥氏体逆转变处理ART获得），以100°C/s的加热速率升温至850°C、900°C或950°C后进行等温保温，实时追踪相变动力学。

papers.title: Determining Electron Beam Lateral Coherence in a Scanning Electron Microscope Using Electron Diffraction
papers.abstract: We develop and characterize scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) capabilities within a scanning electron microscope (SEM) to investigate the effective lateral coherence of the electron beam (e-beam) in the specimen plane. Using single-crystalline Au flakes and a sample composed of a monolayer of graphene, we obtain high-quality selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) maps and convergent-beam electron diffraction (CBED) patterns, validating the systems ability to probe crystallographic information at an acceleration voltage of 30 keV. Building on these capabilities, we implement a method, which is adapted from techniques traditionally used in transmission electron microscopy, to measure the degree of lateral coherence of the e-beam in the specimen plane of the SEM. By analyzing interference between electrons with two different wave vectors separated by 0.031 per angstrom, we extract a lower limit for the degree of lateral coherence over 5% of the e-beam diameter of approximately 60%. These coherence values are sufficient to enable quantum-coherent electron-light-matter interaction experiments in the SEM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：develop and characterize、obtain high-quality SAED maps and CBED patterns、implement a method to measure。；研究对象：扫描电子显微镜（SEM）中电子束在样品平面上的有效横向相干性。具体材料包括单晶金（Au）薄片和单层石墨烯样品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在30 keV加速电压下，通过分析波矢差为0.031/Å的两束电子的干涉，测得电子束直径5%范围内的横向相干度下限约为60%，该相干度足以在SEM中实现量子相干的电子-光-物质相互作用实验。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在30 keV加速电压下，通过分析波矢差为0.031/Å的两束电子的干涉，测得电子束直径5%范围内的横向相干度下限约为60%，该相干度足以在SEM中实现量子相干的电子-光-物质相互作用实验。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 在扫描电子显微镜（SEM）中开发并表征了扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）功能；利用单晶Au薄片和单层石墨烯获取选区电子衍射（SAED）图和会聚束电子衍射（CBED）花样；采用从传统透射电子显微镜（TEM）技术改编的方法测量横向相干度。

papers.title: Porosity Effects on Cyclic Gas Invasion and Trapping in Deformable Porous Media
papers.abstract: Fluid transport in deformable porous media is central to many biophysical and geophysical processes. While extensive studies exist, how porosity governs fluid behaviour in deformable systems during cyclic injection remains elusive. Here, we investigate gas-liquid multiphase flow in a quasi-2D Hele-Shaw cell packed with soft hydrogel particles at different initial porosities. Alternative gas and water injection experiments, combined with high-resolution imaging and continuous pressure monitoring, are used to quantify gas dynamics and pressure evolution. Results show that the gas entry pressure increases as porosity decreases, consistent with a Young-Laplace estimation based on effective pore-throat width. After entry, invasion shifts from cavity-dominated expansion in high porosity packings to localised pore invasion in low porosity packings, with a mixed cavity-fingering regime at intermediate porosity. Pressure fluctuations are linked to pore-scale gas escape and internal gas redistribution. Low porosity packings produce frequent small-amplitude pressure drops, whereas higher porosity packings produce more discrete pressure relaxations. Across cycles, the decreasing mean pressure suggests preferential-pathway reuse and reduced local capillary constraints. Residual gas saturation increases systematically with injection cycles and reaches higher terminal values as porosity decreases. Specific interfacial length increases as available pore space decreases and follows a power-law relationship with gas cluster size, with scaling exponent decreases as porosity decreases and cycling progresses. Together, these results demonstrate that gas trapping in deformable porous media depends on both initial packing structure and cyclically evolving gas-solid interactions. This study provides insights for interpreting porosity-dependent trapping and reinvasion during repeated gas injection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了“gas-liquid multiphase flow in a quasi-2D Hele-Shaw cell packed with soft hydrogel particles”的实验设计，并使用了“high-resolution imaging and continuous pressure monitoring”等实验手段。；研究对象：可变形多孔介质（由软水凝胶颗粒填充的准二维Hele-Shaw池）中的气-液两相流，具体研究不同初始孔隙度下循环气体注入和捕集行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 气体进入压力随孔隙度降低而增大；低孔隙度下气体入侵由局部孔隙主导，高孔隙度下由空腔扩张主导；残余气体饱和度随循环次数增加而升高，且孔隙度越低最终值越高；气团界面长度与气团尺寸呈幂律关系，其标度指数随孔隙度降低和循环进行而减小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：气体进入压力随孔隙度降低而增大；低孔隙度下气体入侵由局部孔隙主导，高孔隙度下由空腔扩张主导；残余气体饱和度随循环次数增加而升高，且孔隙度越低最终值越高；气团界面长度与气团尺寸呈幂律关系，其标度指数随孔隙度降低和循环进行而减小。；创新点：揭示了孔隙度在可变形多孔介质循环注入过程中对气体入侵模式、压力波动、残余捕集及界面演化的系统性影响，特别是发现了孔隙度依赖的标度指数变化和循环导致的优先路径重用效应。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：使用准二维Hele-Shaw池填充软水凝胶颗粒，通过交替注入气体和水进行循环注入实验；结合高分辨率成像和连续压力监测，定量分析气体动力学和压力演化；利用Young-Laplace方程基于有效孔喉宽度估算气体进入压力。

papers.title: Ferrimagnetic and Haldane-type phases in a mixed-spin $1$-$\tfrac{1}{2}$-$\tfrac{1}{2}$ quantum trimer chain
papers.abstract: Bipartite Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetism and the symmetry-protected Haldane phase are paradigmatic mechanisms in quasi-one-dimensional quantum magnets. Both emerge, in distinct regimes, in a mixed-spin $1$-$\tfrac{1}{2}$-$\tfrac{1}{2}$ Heisenberg trimer chain with antiferromagnetic backbone exchange $J$ and a side spin-$\tfrac{1}{2}$ coupled to each backbone spin by an exchange $J_t$ of either sign. Using the density matrix renormalization group, we compute magnetization curves and the entanglement spectrum and entropy. For $J_t>0$ a robust ferrimagnetic plateau forms at magnetization per unit cell $m=1$, whose multiplet entropy reflects how the conserved magnetization splits between the halves. For $J_t<0$ an $m=0$ plateau opens and grows with $|J_t|$, while the $m=1$ plateau closes. As $J_t\to-\infty$ the chain maps onto a spin-$1$ Heisenberg chain with coupling $J/2$: the $m=0$ width $Δh\simeq 0.196$ matches half the Haldane gap. Exponentially localized spin-$\tfrac{1}{2}$ edge states and the even-fold degeneracy of the entanglement spectrum confirm the Haldane character of the $m=0$ phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：density matrix renormalization group（DMRG）、magnetization curves、entanglement spectrum。；研究对象：混合自旋1-½-½量子三聚体链，具体为具有反铁磁骨干交换耦合J和侧自旋耦合J_t（可正可负）的海森堡三聚体链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当J_t>0时，体系呈现稳健的铁磁亚铁磁平台（每原胞磁化m=1）；当J_t<0时，体系在m=0处打开一个随|J_t|增大的能隙，并在J_t→-∞极限下映射为自旋1海森堡链，其m=0平台宽度Δh≈0.196恰好等于Haldane能隙的一半，且通过边缘态和纠缠谱简并性确认了该相的Haldane相特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当J_t>0时，体系呈现稳健的铁磁亚铁磁平台（每原胞磁化m=1）；当J_t<0时，体系在m=0处打开一个随|J_t|增大的能隙，并在J_t→-∞极限下映射为自旋1海森堡链，其m=0平台宽度Δh≈0.196恰好等于Haldane能隙的一半，且通过边缘态和纠缠谱简并性确认了该相的Haldane相特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算磁化曲线、纠缠谱和纠缠熵。

papers.title: Competing spin-1 and spin-2 regimes in a frustrated four-leg spin-1/2 ladder
papers.abstract: We investigate a frustrated four-leg spin-$1/2$ ladder using density matrix renormalization group calculations. The uniform system displays three regimes: short-range antiferromagnetic legs, short-range ferromagnetic legs, and an effective spin-2 Heisenberg chain, separated by a crossover and a first-order transition. The spin-2 regime is confirmed through its finite string order parameter, edge-localized excitations, and excellent agreement with a projected $S_r=2$ effective Hamiltonian. Recasting the model as two frustrated two-leg ladders coupled by rung and diagonal interactions, we track how the trivial and Haldane phases of an isolated ladder evolve as interladder couplings are introduced. The resulting phase diagrams reveal crossover and first-order lines whose locations are captured by the spin-2 projection and show how singlet- and triplet-dominated regimes reorganize when two ladders merge into a four-leg structure, clarifying the emergence of effective spin-1 versus spin-2 behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density matrix renormalization group calculations（密度矩阵重正化群计算）。；研究对象：受挫四腿自旋-1/2梯子模型（frustrated four-leg spin-1/2 ladder），即具有阻挫相互作用的四腿自旋梯子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该均匀系统存在三种不同区域：短程反铁磁腿、短程铁磁腿，以及一个有效的自旋-2海森堡链区域。自旋-2区域通过有限弦序参量、边缘局域激发以及与投影自旋-2有效哈密顿量的高度一致得到确认。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该均匀系统存在三种不同区域：短程反铁磁腿、短程铁磁腿，以及一个有效的自旋-2海森堡链区域。自旋-2区域通过有限弦序参量、边缘局域激发以及与投影自旋-2有效哈密顿量的高度一致得到确认。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）数值计算方法，并结合有效哈密顿量投影分析。

papers.title: Nonextensive Statistical Signatures of the Bilaterian Transition in Proteome Length Distributions
papers.abstract: Protein length distributions across the tree of life carry a quantitative signature of organismal complexity. Nonextensive statistical mechanics, through the Tsallis generalized entropy formalism, provides a natural framework for describing complex systems characterized by long-range correlations, scale invariance, and hierarchical organization -- features that classical Boltzmann-Gibbs statistics cannot accommodate. In this work, the complementary cumulative distribution function (CCDF) of protein lengths is analyzed within this framework for the reference proteomes of 22 fully sequenced organisms spanning the domains Archaea, Bacteria, and Eukarya, with deliberate sampling across the animal transition zone from sponges and cnidarians to higher bilaterians. Maximum likelihood (MLE) fitting of truncated discrete q-exponential distributions, with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (CIs) reveals that the entropic index q resolves into three statistically distinct regimes: superextensive (q < 1) for prokaryotes, unicellular and non-animal multicellular eukaryotes, and basal animals; a boundary regime (CI on spanning unity) for the two cnidarians studied and the basal bilaterian C. teleta; and subextensive (q > 1) for all higher bilaterians, with q increasing monotonically across the four deuterostomes sampled from S. purpuratus (1.033) to H. sapiens (1.147). The q-exponential outperforms the ordinary exponential distribution across all 22 proteomes and becomes progressively more competitive against alternative two-parameter distributions as proteome complexity increases. These results identify the Tsallis entropic index as a continuous, physically interpretable indicator of proteome organizational complexity and extend the applicability of nonextensive statistical mechanics to proteomic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/数据分析文章。关键词：nonextensive statistical mechanics、Tsallis generalized entropy formalism、maximum likelihood fitting。；研究对象：22个完全测序生物（涵盖古菌、细菌、真核生物）的参考蛋白质组中蛋白质长度分布，特别关注从海绵、刺胞动物到两侧对称动物的动物过渡区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蛋白质长度分布的Tsallis熵指数q可区分为三个统计上不同的区间：原核生物、单细胞及非动物多细胞真核生物和基础动物为超广延（q<1）；刺胞动物和基础两侧对称动物为边界区间（q的置信区间跨越1）；所有高等两侧对称动物为亚广延（q>1），且q值在后口动物中从紫海胆（1.033）到人类（1.147）单调递增。q指数分布优于普通指数分布，且随蛋白质组复杂度增加，其与替代双参数分布的竞争力增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蛋白质长度分布的Tsallis熵指数q可区分为三个统计上不同的区间：原核生物、单细胞及非动物多细胞真核生物和基础动物为超广延（q<1）；刺胞动物和基础两侧对称动物为边界区间（q的置信区间跨越1）；所有高等两侧对称动物为亚广延（q>1），且q值在后口动物中从紫海胆（1.033）到人类（1.147）单调递增。q指数分布优于普通指数分布，且随蛋白质组复杂度增加，其与替代双参数分布的竞争力增强。；创新点：将Tsallis非广延统计力学应用于蛋白质组系统，将熵指数q识别为蛋白质组组织复杂性的连续、物理可解释指标，并揭示两侧对称动物转变在蛋白质长度分布中的非广延统计特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用截断离散q指数分布的最大似然估计（MLE）拟合，结合bootstrap 95%置信区间（CIs）分析蛋白质长度互补累积分布函数（CCDF）。

papers.title: Comment on "Altermagnetic and Dipolar Spitting of Magnons in FeF_2" arXiv:2601.04303
papers.abstract: Conclusions by Sears et al. (arXiv: 2601.04303) about dispersions of magnons in rutile FeF_2 are unsound because compulsory lattice vibrations are omitted in the analysis of their neutron scattering spectra. Hybridized magnon-phonon modes in magnetically ordered FeF_2 were observed and successfully analysed half a century ago.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/评论文章。关键词：Comment on（评论）、analysis（分析）、omitted（遗漏）。；研究对象：论文评论的对象是FeF₂（金红石结构）中的磁振子（magnons）色散关系，以及磁振子与晶格振动（声子）的杂化模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sears等人关于FeF₂中磁振子色散的分析结论不可靠，因为他们在分析中子散射谱时忽略了晶格振动（声子）的贡献。实际上，FeF₂中磁振子-声子杂化模式在半个世纪前就已被观测并成功分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sears等人关于FeF₂中磁振子色散的分析结论不可靠，因为他们在分析中子散射谱时忽略了晶格振动（声子）的贡献。实际上，FeF₂中磁振子-声子杂化模式在半个世纪前就已被观测并成功分析。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该评论的核心在于指出前人工作中一个被忽略的关键物理过程（磁振子-声子耦合），并强调该过程在历史文献中已有充分研究。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体研究方法，但指出Sears等人的工作基于中子散射谱分析，而正确的分析应包含磁振子-声子杂化模式。

papers.title: A Finite Element Method for Fluctuating Navier--Stokes Equations
papers.abstract: We introduce a finite-element framework for simulating thermal fluctuations in compressible fluids governed by the fluctuating Navier-Stokes equations. The method is designed to preserve the fundamental fluctuation-dissipation balance at the discrete level. This is achieved by defining the stochastic forcing term in the weak formulation, ensuring its covariance is proportional to the discrete viscous dissipation operator. A nodal quadrature rule is employed to eliminate unphysical mesh-scale correlations. The time integration is performed using the Crank-Nicolson scheme to maintain numerical stability and accuracy. The proposed approach is numerically validated in one, two, and three spatial dimensions, demonstrating its capability to correctly capture equilibrium fluctuation statistics across various discretisation parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：finite-element framework（有限元框架）、numerically validated（数值验证）、simulating（模拟）。；研究对象：可压缩流体中的热涨落现象，具体由涨落Navier-Stokes方程描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该有限元方法能够在离散层面上保持涨落-耗散平衡，并正确捕捉不同空间维度（1D、2D、3D）下的平衡涨落统计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该有限元方法能够在离散层面上保持涨落-耗散平衡，并正确捕捉不同空间维度（1D、2D、3D）下的平衡涨落统计。；创新点：在有限元框架下通过弱形式构造随机强迫项，实现了离散层面上的涨落-耗散平衡，并利用节点求积规则避免了网格尺度上的虚假相关性。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元方法离散涨落Navier-Stokes方程，通过弱形式定义随机强迫项并使其协方差与离散粘性耗散算符成正比，使用节点求积规则消除非物理的网格尺度关联，时间积分采用Crank-Nicolson格式。

papers.title: Hidden valley dynamics behind vanishing circular polarization in moiré excitons
papers.abstract: Optically addressable valley degrees of freedom in transition-metal dichalcogenide heterostructures provide a powerful platform for valleytronic and quantum-optical functionalities. In moiré superlattices, interlayer excitons inherit valley-contrasting optical selection rules while acquiring long lifetimes, electric dipoles, and site-dependent optical responses. However, because conventional measurements typically probe time-integrated valley polarization, the dynamical origin of vanishing polarization has remained elusive. Here, we show that a nearly zero steady-state valley polarization in electrically tunable moiré excitons does not necessarily indicate fast valley relaxation. Helicity-resolved time-resolved photoluminescence reveals a temporal crossing between co- and cross-circularly polarized emission, indicating that helicity-opposite dynamical components coexist and compensate after time integration. A minimal two-channel model, representing A-like and B-like moiré emission channels with opposite optical selection rules and distinct effective decay/depolarization rates, reproduces the observed helicity crossing without invoking a single rapid valley relaxation process. Furthermore, two-dimensional gate-field maps show that the crossing time evolves systematically with electrostatic tuning, demonstrating that the hidden valley dynamics are electrically controllable. These results show that time-integrated circular polarization can give a false-negative indication of valley polarization in multichannel valley emitters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：helicity-resolved time-resolved photoluminescence、electrically tunable、gate-field maps）；研究对象：过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）异质结中的moiré激子，具体为moiré超晶格中的层间激子及其谷极化动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电可调的moiré激子中，近零的稳态谷极化并不一定意味着快速的谷弛豫；时间分辨光致发光揭示出同旋与反旋圆偏振发射之间存在时间交叉，表明隐藏的谷动力学过程在时间积分后相互补偿。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电可调的moiré激子中，近零的稳态谷极化并不一定意味着快速的谷弛豫；时间分辨光致发光揭示出同旋与反旋圆偏振发射之间存在时间交叉，表明隐藏的谷动力学过程在时间积分后相互补偿。；创新点：首次通过时间分辨测量揭示了moiré激子中时间积分圆偏振极化消失的动力学起源，证明其源于具有相反光学选择规则和不同有效衰减/退极化速率的A-like和B-like发射通道的共存与时间补偿，而非单一的快速谷弛豫过程。
papers.method_zh: 采用螺旋度分辨的时间分辨光致发光（helicity-resolved time-resolved photoluminescence）实验，并结合二维栅压场映射（2D gate-field maps）以及一个最小双通道模型（two-channel model）进行理论分析。

papers.title: Open Nanoacoustic Resonators Based on SrTiO$_3$/YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-x}$ Superlattices
papers.abstract: We report the design and experimental demonstration of an open nanophononic cavity based on a hybrid oxide superlattice composed of SrTiO$_3$ (STO) and YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-x}$ (YBCO), combined with a metallic Ni transducer for coherent phonon generation. The STO/YBCO periodic stack acts as an acoustic distributed Bragg reflector supporting confined longitudinal acoustic phonons in the sub-THz regime, while the Ni layer enables efficient ultrafast optical excitation and detection by time-domain Brillouin scattering. Transient reflectivity measurements reveal confined acoustic dynamics and a well-defined cavity resonance, in agreement with transfer-matrix calculations of acoustic reflectivity and mode profiles. These results demonstrate phonon confinement in multifunctional oxide heterostructures and establish complex oxide superlattices as a platform for hybrid nano-acoustic resonators and ultrafast phonon control of correlated electronic phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“report the design and experimental demonstration”、“Transient reflectivity measurements”、“demonstrate phonon confinement”。；研究对象：基于SrTiO₃ (STO) 和 YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋ₓ (YBCO) 构成的混合氧化物超晶格，结合金属Ni换能器形成的开放纳米声学谐振腔。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在STO/YBCO超晶格中实现了亚THz频率范围内纵向声学声子的局域化，并观测到明确的腔共振模式，与转移矩阵计算结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在STO/YBCO超晶格中实现了亚THz频率范围内纵向声学声子的局域化，并观测到明确的腔共振模式，与转移矩阵计算结果一致。；创新点：首次在多功能氧化物异质结构中实现声子局域化，并建立了复杂氧化物超晶格作为混合纳米声学谐振腔的平台，用于超快声子调控关联电子相。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快光学激发与时间域布里渊散射探测，结合转移矩阵计算声学反射率和模式分布。

papers.title: Metamagnetism in UTe2: the roles of itinerancy and localization
papers.abstract: The metamagnetic transition in UTe$_2$ plays a key role in stabilizing two enigmatic field-induced superconducting phases. One of these phases (SC2) is truncated by the transition, lying directly below it, while the other (SC3) sits predominantly above it and appears to be stabilized because of it. While numerous pulsed field studies have examined this transition, comparatively few steady field experiments have investigated it. Here we report a suite of measurements of metamgnetism in UTe$_2$, at ambient pressure by torque magnetometry and extraction magnetometry techniques, and of the magnetoconductance under pressure. Our steady field measurements resolve a complex sub-structure within the transition, with separate features that possess different temperature evolutions, pointing to distinct contributions from itinerant and localized moments. The itinerant contribution might relate to a possible spin-density wave state. We theoretically model the evolution of Kondo and RKKY interactions and propose that the SC2 state is stabilized under pressure due to the collapse of magnetic anisotropy, leading to an enhancement of longitudinal spin fluctuations along the hard $b$ axis, which are pair-forming in the $p$-wave channel.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合型文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“报告一系列测量”（实验）和“理论上建模”（理论）。；研究对象：UTe₂ 中的变磁相变及其与场致超导相（SC2、SC3）的关系，重点关注巡游与局域磁矩的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UTe₂ 的变磁相变内部存在复杂子结构，不同特征具有不同的温度演化行为，表明巡游与局域磁矩的独立贡献；理论建模提出 SC2 超导相在压力下稳定是由于磁各向异性坍塌导致沿硬 b 轴的纵向自旋涨落增强，从而在 p 波通道中形成配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UTe₂ 的变磁相变内部存在复杂子结构，不同特征具有不同的温度演化行为，表明巡游与局域磁矩的独立贡献；理论建模提出 SC2 超导相在压力下稳定是由于磁各向异性坍塌导致沿硬 b 轴的纵向自旋涨落增强，从而在 p 波通道中形成配对。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扭矩磁强计、提取磁强计（环境压力）以及压力下的磁导测量；理论上对 Kondo 与 RKKY 相互作用随压力的演化进行建模。

papers.title: Symmetry-Selective Strain Control of Spin-Momentum Locking and Spin Transport in Two-Dimensional Pentagonal Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are compensated magnets featuring momentum-dependent nonrelativistic spin splitting generated by nontrivial operations connecting opposite-spin sublattices. A direct symmetry-based route to control this spin splitting is to modify the real-space operations that define the altermagnetic spin-momentum locking (SML). Here, we develop a strain-resolved symmetry framework for two-dimensional pentagonal altermagnets, classifying whether uniaxial and shear strain tensors preserve, reconstruct, or eliminate the SML. Using the above criterion combined with first-principles screening, we identify 94 stable altermagnetic candidates from 3330 materials. These candidates cover all type-III spin Laue groups of orthorhombic lattices and are classified into three strain-response types: Type-I preserves the SML; Type-II reconstructs the SML through partial symmetry breaking while retaining essential altermagnetic features; and Type-III destroys the altermagnetic SML. Representative materials further demonstrate this classification: ferroelastic $α$-CoS$_2$ exhibits ferroelastically switchable SML and reverses the sign of the off-diagonal spin conductivity; shear-strained \(α\)-CoP\(_2\) undergoes a \(g\)- to \(d\)-wave reconstruction of the SML, activating off-diagonal spin conductivity; and uniaxially strained FeSSe realizes strain-selected spin-valley transport. This work provides theoretical and material guidance for strain-controlled transport in two-dimensional orthorhombic altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a strain-resolved symmetry framework”、“first-principles screening”、“classification”等关键词，属于理论框架构建与第一性原理计算筛选。；研究对象：二维五边形交变磁体（two-dimensional pentagonal altermagnets）中的自旋-动量锁定（SML）与自旋输运现象，具体涉及应变对SML的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对称性分析，将二维正交晶系五边形交变磁体对应变的响应分为三类：I型保持SML，II型通过部分对称性破缺重构SML，III型完全破坏SML。代表性材料中，铁弹性的α-CoS₂可实现铁弹可切换的SML并反转非对角自旋电导率符号；剪切应变下的α-CoP₂发生g波到d波的SML重构，激活非对角自旋电导率；单轴应变下的FeSSe实现应变选择的自旋谷输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对称性分析，将二维正交晶系五边形交变磁体对应变的响应分为三类：I型保持SML，II型通过部分对称性破缺重构SML，III型完全破坏SML。代表性材料中，铁弹性的α-CoS₂可实现铁弹可切换的SML并反转非对角自旋电导率符号；剪切应变下的α-CoP₂发生g波到d波的SML重构，激活非对角自旋电导率；单轴应变下的FeSSe实现应变选择的自旋谷输运。；创新点：首次建立了针对二维五边形交变磁体的应变分辨对称性框架，系统分类了不同应变张量（单轴、剪切）对自旋-动量锁定的影响，并通过大规模材料筛选提供了具体的材料候选。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析的应变分辨理论框架，结合第一性原理（first-principles）筛选，从3330种材料中识别出94种稳定的交变磁候选材料，覆盖所有III型自旋Laue群的正交晶格。

papers.title: Unlocking Cryogenic Energy Storage by Constructing Dipole Glass with Unit-cell-level Polar Disorder
papers.abstract: Cryogenic energy storage is vital for frontier technologies including deep-space exploration and quantum computing, yet conventional electrochemical energy systems fail below ~230 K due to frozen ion migration. While relaxor-based dielectric capacitors provide high efficiency at room temperature, the intrinsic freezing/growth of polar nanodomains at extended cryogenic regime limits their applications with deteriorated hysteresis losses. Here, we realize superior cryogenic energy-storage performance by designing unit-cell-level disordered dipole-glass state in Pb0.6Sr0.4ZrO3 thin films with composition near antiferroelectric-paraelectric phase boundary. The antiferroelectric-derived dipole-glass introduces enhanced unit-cell-level complexity of dipole interaction that suppresses long-range ferroelectric order. This enables ultralow-hysteresis operation (efficiency > 88%) down to 4 K, delivering record-high energy density (211 J/cm^3) at 9 MV/cm, stability over 10^8 charge/discharge cycles and microsecond-scale charge/discharge capability. This work establishes a dipole-glass paradigm for cryogenic dielectric capacitors, opening a new avenue to highly-efficient energy-storage systems with broad applications in frontier nanoelectronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及了薄膜制备（Pb0.6Sr0.4ZrO3 thin films）和性能测试（能量密度、效率、循环稳定性等）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是Pb0.6Sr0.4ZrO3薄膜，其组分位于反铁电-顺电相边界附近。研究的核心物理现象是偶极玻璃态（dipole-glass state）及其在低温下的储能特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在反铁电-顺电相边界附近设计具有单胞级极性无序的偶极玻璃态，实现了在4K极低温下仍具有超高效率（>88%）和创纪录能量密度（211 J/cm³）的储能性能，解决了弛豫铁电体在低温下因极性纳米微区冻结而导致的损耗问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在反铁电-顺电相边界附近设计具有单胞级极性无序的偶极玻璃态，实现了在4K极低温下仍具有超高效率（>88%）和创纪录能量密度（211 J/cm³）的储能性能，解决了弛豫铁电体在低温下因极性纳米微区冻结而导致的损耗问题。；创新点：提出了利用“反铁电衍生的偶极玻璃态”作为低温介电电容器的新范式。与传统的弛豫铁电体不同，该设计通过引入单胞级的极性无序，从根本上抑制了长程铁电序的形成，从而在极低温（4K）下实现了超低滞后和高效率的储能，突破了现有技术瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用薄膜制备技术（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如脉冲激光沉积或溶胶-凝胶法等）构建了Pb0.6Sr0.4ZrO3薄膜。通过组分调控使其接近反铁电-顺电相边界，从而诱导出单胞尺度的偶极玻璃态。性能表征手段包括：能量密度和效率测试（在9 MV/cm电场下）、循环稳定性测试（10^8次充放电循环）以及充放电速度测试（微秒级）。

papers.title: A stochastic model of a nuclear reactor with directed percolation. Overjump and maximum power
papers.abstract: A stochastic risk model is applied to simulating the behavior of a nuclear reactor in a situation where the neutron chain length is described by a distribution with heavy "tails," such as the Pareto distribution. Probabilities of a fluctuation exceeding a critical threshold are obtained, and risk bounds for power-law distributions of jumps are estimated. Functionals of the reactor power maximum, the instant of first reaching the maximum, and the distribution of the overjump magnitude are considered. A relationship between the shape parameter and the physical constants of reactors is obtained, as well as the relationship with the noise spectrum and physical constants. The finite dimensions of a real reactor are taken into account. The autocorrelation function of the truncated Lévy process and its relationship with the frequency filters of the neutron flux monitoring equipment are considered.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“随机风险模型”“概率分布”“函数泛函”“自相关函数”等理论建模与数学分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：核反应堆中的中子链式反应行为，具体关注中子链长度服从重尾分布（如帕累托分布）时的随机风险过程，包括功率波动、超阈值概率、最大功率及过冲量分布等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了中子链长度重尾分布下反应堆功率波动的风险界限，得到了形状参数与反应堆物理常数、噪声谱之间的定量关系，并考虑了有限尺寸效应及中子通量监测设备频率滤波器的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了中子链长度重尾分布下反应堆功率波动的风险界限，得到了形状参数与反应堆物理常数、噪声谱之间的定量关系，并考虑了有限尺寸效应及中子通量监测设备频率滤波器的影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机风险模型，基于截断Lévy过程描述中子链长度分布，通过概率论方法计算波动超临界阈值的概率与风险界，分析最大功率泛函、首次达到最大值时刻及过冲量分布，并推导自相关函数与频率滤波器的关联。

papers.title: Quantum enhancement of information-mediated energy transfer
papers.abstract: Thermodynamics of information identifies information flow as a thermodynamic resource, but whether quantum coherence and collective coupling can enhance it at low entropy-production cost remains unresolved. We address this question for interacting open quantum systems by deriving a thermodynamic uncertainty relation that bounds information flow by entropy production in nonequilibrium steady states. We construct a quantum engine in which N-fold degenerate ground and excited states are collectively coupled to heat baths. Collective jumps enhance heat currents and information flow linearly with N, while entropy production remains independent of N, realizing a high-power, low-dissipation autonomous quantum Maxwell's demon that leverages collectively enhanced information flow to pump heat against a temperature gradient. Beyond steady states, collective interactions amplify the unitary component of quantum information flow, yielding a quadratic enhancement of the free-energy charging power of quantum batteries. Our results reveal scalable advantages of quantum coherence and collective effects in quantum engines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic uncertainty relation（热力学不确定关系）、deriving（推导）、construct（构建理论模型）。；研究对象：信息介导能量传递过程中的量子增强效应，具体涉及相互作用的开放量子系统、量子引擎（含N重简并基态和激发态）、量子电池。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非平衡稳态下，集体耦合可使热流和信息流随系统大小N线性增强，而熵产生与N无关，从而实现高功率、低耗散的自主量子麦克斯韦妖；在非稳态下，集体相互作用可使量子信息流的幺正分量二次增强，从而提升量子电池的自由能充电功率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非平衡稳态下，集体耦合可使热流和信息流随系统大小N线性增强，而熵产生与N无关，从而实现高功率、低耗散的自主量子麦克斯韦妖；在非稳态下，集体相互作用可使量子信息流的幺正分量二次增强，从而提升量子电池的自由能充电功率。；创新点：首次揭示了量子相干性和集体耦合在信息介导能量传递中可带来可扩展的增强优势（线性或二次标度），同时保持低熵产生成本，解决了信息流能否在低熵产生代价下被量子效应增强这一未决问题。
papers.method_zh: 通过推导热力学不确定关系来约束信息流与熵产生的关系；构建了N重简并能级集体耦合热浴的量子引擎模型，分析稳态与非稳态下的信息流、热流、熵产生及充电功率的标度行为。

papers.title: Single-Crystalline Al/Ge Heterostructure with an Atomically Sharp Commensurate Interface
papers.abstract: A key challenge in developing Al/Ge heterostructures for quantum applications is Al-Ge interdiffusion. This process is facilitated by grain boundaries in polycrystalline films, which degrades interface quality and impairs device performance and reliability. Here, we present epitaxial growth of single-crystalline Al(111) on Ge(111) by molecular beam epitaxy, achieving an atomically flat and sharp interface. At the interface, a commensurate 7-Al-lattice/5-Ge-lattice epitaxial relationship is observed, which dramatically reduces the intrinsic lattice mismatch from 28.4% to about 0.1%. Interestingly, this well-ordered interface does not form below a critical thickness of 0.3 nm. Instead, Al initially nucleates as random clusters, which then transform into two-dimensional (2D) islands and, as Al deposition further increases, eventually develop into a continuous film. By optimizing the growth parameters, we have achieved an ultra-flat Al film with a surface root-mean-square roughness of about 0.16 nm and an ultra-thin continuous film with thickness of only 2 nm. These epitaxially grown Al-Ge heterostructures, with their atomically flat surfaces and sharp interfaces, provide a promising platform for studying topological quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“epitaxial growth”、“molecular beam epitaxy”、“optimizing the growth parameters”等实验手段描述。；研究对象：Al/Ge异质结，具体为单晶Al(111)在Ge(111)衬底上的外延生长体系，用于量子应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子束外延成功制备了具有原子级平整和尖锐界面的单晶Al(111)/Ge(111)异质结，界面处形成7个Al晶格与5个Ge晶格的公度外延关系，将本征晶格失配从28.4%大幅降低至约0.1%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子束外延成功制备了具有原子级平整和尖锐界面的单晶Al(111)/Ge(111)异质结，界面处形成7个Al晶格与5个Ge晶格的公度外延关系，将本征晶格失配从28.4%大幅降低至约0.1%。；创新点：实现了单晶Al/Ge异质结中原子级尖锐且公度的界面，有效抑制了多晶薄膜中常见的Al-Ge互扩散问题，为拓扑量子态研究提供了高质量平台。摘要未突出说明与以往单晶Al/Ge异质结研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长技术，结合对临界厚度（0.3 nm）以下成核行为（随机团簇→二维岛→连续薄膜）的观察，以及表面粗糙度（均方根约0.16 nm）和超薄连续膜（2 nm）的优化生长参数调控。

papers.title: Rare Events Govern Defect Formation under Weak Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: Crossing a continuous phase transition out of equilibrium typically generates topological defects whose density obeys a universal power-law scaling predicted by the Kibble-Zurek mechanism. Recent numerical studies have revealed systematic deviations from this scaling in the presence of weak explicit symmetry breaking, manifested as an additional exponential suppression of defect formation. However, the origin of this correction and a general theoretical framework to describe it have remained elusive. Here, using large-deviation theory, we show that defect formation under weak symmetry breaking is controlled by rare fluctuations that drive local regions into the disfavored symmetry-broken state. This mechanism yields a closed-form expression for the defect density in arbitrary dimensions, valid in the weak-field and weak-noise limits. These theoretical predictions are verified through direct simulations of stochastic Ginzburg-Landau models in one and two spatial dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。关键词：large-deviation theory、theoretical predictions、direct simulations、stochastic Ginzburg-Landau models。；研究对象：弱显式对称破缺下连续相变过程中的拓扑缺陷形成，具体为缺陷密度偏离Kibble-Zurek标度律的指数抑制行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弱对称破缺下的缺陷形成由驱动局部区域进入不利对称破缺态的稀有涨落（rare fluctuations）主导，并由此推导出任意维度下缺陷密度的闭式表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弱对称破缺下的缺陷形成由驱动局部区域进入不利对称破缺态的稀有涨落（rare fluctuations）主导，并由此推导出任意维度下缺陷密度的闭式表达式。；创新点：首次利用大偏差理论揭示了弱对称破缺下缺陷形成指数抑制的物理起源——稀有涨落机制，并给出了任意维度下缺陷密度的闭式解析解，填补了此前缺乏统一理论框架的空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用大偏差理论（large-deviation theory）建立理论框架，推导出弱场和弱噪声极限下的缺陷密度解析公式，并通过一维和二维随机Ginzburg-Landau模型的直接数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Theory of Electron Spin Resonance Scanning Tunneling Microscopy: The First Decade
papers.abstract: Electron spin resonance in scanning tunneling microscopy enabled the study of electronic transitions of magnetic impurities on surfaces at the atomic scale. This ESR-STM technique allows to spectroscopically probe and coherently manipulate spins using an all-electrical method without oscillating external magnetic driving fields. Here, we aim to review recent advancements in ESR-STM. We will discuss possible fundamental mechanisms by which the electric field drives spin resonance based on Heisenberg exchange, Kondo scattering, and Anderson impurity models. We validate theoretical predictions against experimental observations, to understand how electronic correlations, spin exchange, and many-body effects manifest in ESR-STM signals. After reviewing coherent spin control in the STM junction, we discuss potential applications of the ESR-STM method for coherent multi-spin control which enables multiple-qubit operations. Finally, we address recent developments in coupled electron-nuclear spin systems, including hyperfine-resolved ESR spectroscopy, and the driving and polarization of nuclear spins in ESR-STM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：review、mechanisms、models、theoretical predictions）；研究对象：扫描隧道显微镜中的电子自旋共振（ESR-STM）技术，具体涉及磁性杂质在表面的电子跃迁、自旋相干操控以及耦合电子-核自旋系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 综述了ESR-STM技术在过去十年中的理论进展，确认了电场驱动自旋共振的多种微观机制（如海森堡交换、近藤散射、安德森杂质模型），并验证了电子关联、自旋交换和多体效应对ESR-STM信号的解释能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：综述了ESR-STM技术在过去十年中的理论进展，确认了电场驱动自旋共振的多种微观机制（如海森堡交换、近藤散射、安德森杂质模型），并验证了电子关联、自旋交换和多体效应对ESR-STM信号的解释能力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于海森堡交换模型、近藤散射模型和安德森杂质模型的理论框架，通过理论预测与实验观测的对比验证机制。

papers.title: Universality in strongly interacting bosonic clusters
papers.abstract: We develop an effective field theory (EFT) for strongly interacting bosonic clusters, using $^4$He as a paradigmatic example of universality in systems with large scattering length. At leading order (LO), two- and three-body zero-range interactions are entirely determined by the dimer and trimer ground-state energies. We show that ground-state energies for up to $N=15$ particles converge to cutoff-independent limits with extrapolation coefficients of natural size. At next-to-leading order (NLO), corrections stemming from the two-body interaction range and a four-body force, calibrated to the tetramer ground-state energy, reduce cutoff sensitivity. Close agreement with results from a realistic potential is found at LO and improved at NLO, demonstrating systematic convergence with few parameters at each order. The resulting EFT is directly applicable to larger clusters and bulk helium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：effective field theory (EFT)、leading order、next-to-leading order、systematic convergence。；研究对象：强相互作用的玻色子团簇，以⁴He原子团簇为范例，研究大散射长度体系中的普适性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在领头阶（LO），仅由二体和三体基态能量确定的零程相互作用即可准确描述多达15个粒子的团簇基态能量；在次领头阶（NLO）引入两体相互作用范围和四体力修正后，结果与真实势模型的计算高度一致，展示了系统性的收敛性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在领头阶（LO），仅由二体和三体基态能量确定的零程相互作用即可准确描述多达15个粒子的团簇基态能量；在次领头阶（NLO）引入两体相互作用范围和四体力修正后，结果与真实势模型的计算高度一致，展示了系统性的收敛性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 有效场论（EFT）方法，在领头阶（LO）使用二体和三体零程相互作用，在次领头阶（NLO）引入两体相互作用范围和四体力修正，并通过截断依赖性分析验证收敛性。

papers.title: Exceptional Points as Manifestations of Topological-Charge Breakdown in a Non-Hermitian Skyrmion
papers.abstract: The integer topological charge of a magnetic skyrmion is the standard emblem of topological protection. We ask what happens to that protection when the magnet is made non-Hermitian, with balanced gain and loss or a PT-symmetric anisotropy. A non-Hermitian skyrmion turns out to carry two charges that coincide in the Hermitian limit but part ways under deformation. The charge built from the right state alone is homotopy-protected: the PT flow reduces exactly to a Gilbert-type relaxation on the target sphere, so it cannot change under smooth evolution. The charge built from the biorthogonal left-right pair is complex, loses quantization as soon as the gain/loss is turned on, and breaks down at the exceptional point of the local generator -- a ring on the skyrmion's equator, where the biorthogonal Bloch field itself diverges. Topological protection of a skyrmion is therefore not a single statement once the dynamics is non-Hermitian: it splits at an exceptional point. This is the real-space topological counterpart of the analyticity breakdown a causal response function suffers at an exceptional point, both being manifestations of the same non-Hermitian degeneracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we ask”“turns out”“is therefore”等理论推导和概念分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非厄米磁性斯格明子（non-Hermitian skyrmion），具体指在具有平衡增益与损耗或PT对称各向异性的磁性材料中形成的斯格明子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米斯格明子携带两种拓扑荷：一种由右态单独构建，在PT流下保持同伦保护；另一种由双正交左右态对构建，在增益/损耗开启后失去量子化，并在局域生成元的奇异点（斯格明子赤道上的一个环）处发散。拓扑保护在非厄米动力学中分裂于奇异点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米斯格明子携带两种拓扑荷：一种由右态单独构建，在PT流下保持同伦保护；另一种由双正交左右态对构建，在增益/损耗开启后失去量子化，并在局域生成元的奇异点（斯格明子赤道上的一个环）处发散。拓扑保护在非厄米动力学中分裂于奇异点。；创新点：首次将非厄米奇异点与实空间斯格明子的拓扑荷分解联系起来，揭示了拓扑保护在非厄米体系中的分裂机制，并将其与因果响应函数在奇异点处的解析性破坏类比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：非厄米拓扑能带理论、PT对称性分析、同伦论（homotopy protection）、双正交量子态（biorthogonal left-right pair）与奇异点（exceptional point）分析。

papers.title: Eigenvalue Statistics of Random Quantum Geometry
papers.abstract: The quantum geometric tensor is a fundamental property of quantum states, with broad applications in condensed matter physics, topological phases, and quantum phase transitions. The eigenvalues characterize the scale, anisotropy, and effective rank of random quantum geometry, going beyond scalar quantities such as the trace. Here we study the eigenvalue statistics of the quantum geometric tensor in finite-dimensional parameter-dependent random Hamiltonians. We obtain exact analytical results for the first two nontrivial cases, $N=2$ and $N=3$, with $N=3$ already showing genuine shape fluctuations. We further propose a finite-$N$, arbitrary-$D$ description of QGT eigenvalue statistics and verify it by numerical simulations. Our results provide exact benchmarks and a practical framework for random quantum geometry in finite-dimensional disordered and chaotic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact analytical results、numerical simulations、propose a description。；研究对象：随机量子几何（random quantum geometry），具体为有限维参数依赖随机哈密顿量中量子几何张量（quantum geometric tensor）的本征值统计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于N=2和N=3的量子几何张量，获得了本征值统计的精确解析结果，其中N=3已展现出真实的形状涨落；并提出了适用于任意维度D和任意N的有限N描述框架，通过数值模拟验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于N=2和N=3的量子几何张量，获得了本征值统计的精确解析结果，其中N=3已展现出真实的形状涨落；并提出了适用于任意维度D和任意N的有限N描述框架，通过数值模拟验证。；创新点：将量子几何张量的研究从标量量（如迹）推广到本征值统计，首次给出N=2和N=3情形的精确解析结果，并建立了适用于有限N和任意D的统计描述框架，为有限维无序和混沌系统中的随机量子几何提供了精确基准。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（exact analytical results）与数值模拟（numerical simulations）相结合。具体针对有限维参数依赖随机哈密顿量，计算量子几何张量的本征值统计。

papers.title: Non-Newtonian two-dimensional electron fluid in magnetic field
papers.abstract: We predict a mechanism for the non-Newtonian behavior of a two-dimensional (2D) electron fluid due to the local Joule heating of electrons. Within this mechanism, the electron shear viscosity is a non-monotonic function of the velocity gradient. This means that 2D electrons form an unusual non-Newtonian fluid, either dilatant or pseudoplastic, depending on the flow regime. We construct and solve the hydrodynamic equations for a hydrodynamic velocity and a corresponding temperature profile for a Poiseuille-like flow geometry. We demonstrate that the considered non-Newtonian non-linearity induced by the local heating is apparently responsible for the nontrivial differential magnetoresistance observed for 2D electrons in ultra-high-quality GaAs quantum wells, so we conclude that a 2D non-Newtonian electron fluid is realized in these systems at high currents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“预测机制”“构建并求解流体动力学方程”，属于理论建模与数值求解。；研究对象：二维电子流体在磁场中的非牛顿行为，具体涉及超高质量GaAs量子阱中的电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 二维电子流体的剪切粘度因局部焦耳加热而成为速度梯度的非单调函数，从而表现出非牛顿流体行为（胀流型或假塑型），并解释了高电流下超高质量GaAs量子阱中观测到的非平凡微分磁电阻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：二维电子流体的剪切粘度因局部焦耳加热而成为速度梯度的非单调函数，从而表现出非牛顿流体行为（胀流型或假塑型），并解释了高电流下超高质量GaAs量子阱中观测到的非平凡微分磁电阻。；创新点：提出局部焦耳加热导致二维电子流体呈现非牛顿行为的新机制，并指出该机制可解释高电流下超高质量GaAs量子阱中的微分磁电阻现象。
papers.method_zh: 构建并求解包含流体速度和温度分布的流体动力学方程，采用类似泊肃叶流的几何构型，分析局部加热引起的非线性效应。

papers.title: Confined exciton polaron in MoS$_2$ on twisted-hBN
papers.abstract: The simple electrostatic picture of a trion is that of an excess charge inducing an exciton polarization and binding closer (farther) to the hole (electron) side of it. Trion formation can be forbidden when such spontaneous rearrangement of charges is not allowed by the application of external perturbation, such as electric field. Here we test this hypothesis experimentally using a non-monotonic electric field. We realize this scenario by imprinting the ferroelectric domains at the AA-stacked twisted-hBN (t-hBN) interface onto a monolayer of MoS2 placed over it. The spatially varying in-plane electric field around the domain wall serves the dual purpose of (a) confining and polarizing the 2D exciton in the domain wall, and (b) depleting the free charge carriers from the domain wall. We observe a large quantized exciton splitting confirming strong exciton confinement in the domain wall. Forced by the confining potential, the electron side of the polarized exciton lies closer to the domain with accumulated free electrons, which should ideally prevent any trion formation. Contrary to the laid hypothesis, we observe signatures of quantized charged exciton emission, with an inter-level splitting that mimics the level-splitting of the quantized excitons. This paradox is explained using the many-body picture of exciton polaron, where a conduction band hole attractively binds the polarized exciton and the electron Fermi sea. The results provide a definitive way to unambiguously discern exciton polaron from trion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“test this hypothesis experimentally”、“We observe”、“experimentally”等关键词，并描述了具体实验设置和观测结果。；研究对象：MoS₂单层置于扭转六方氮化硼（twisted-hBN）上形成的异质结体系，具体研究AA堆叠的t-hBN界面铁电畴对MoS₂中激子与带电激子（trion）行为的影响，以及激子极化子（exciton polaron）的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MoS₂/t-hBN异质结中，通过畴壁的空间限制电场实现了激子的强量子化束缚，但原本预期会抑制带电激子（trion）形成的条件下，却观测到了量子化的带电激子发射。这一矛盾可用激子极化子的多体图像解释：导带空穴吸引极化激子与电子费米海形成束缚态，从而区分了激子极化子与传统的trion。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在MoS₂/t-hBN异质结中，通过畴壁的空间限制电场实现了激子的强量子化束缚，但原本预期会抑制带电激子（trion）形成的条件下，却观测到了量子化的带电激子发射。这一矛盾可用激子极化子的多体图像解释：导带空穴吸引极化激子与电子费米海形成束缚态，从而区分了激子极化子与传统的trion。；创新点：首次通过实验在空间限制电场下观测到原本应被抑制的带电激子发射，并利用激子极化子的多体图像解释了这一悖论，提供了一种明确区分激子极化子与trion的实验方法。
papers.method_zh: 利用AA堆叠的扭转六方氮化硼（t-hBN）界面铁电畴，将其印刻到上方的MoS₂单层中，形成空间变化的平面内电场。通过畴壁附近的电场同时实现二维激子的空间束缚与极化，并耗尽畴壁处的自由载流子。采用光学光谱测量（如激子分裂与发射谱）观测量子化能级。

papers.title: Collision and coalescence dynamics of bosonic quantum Hall droplets
papers.abstract: Recently bosonic quantum Hall droplets have been observed in rapidly rotating two-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs), which exhibit robust dynamical stability. Inspired by this, we systematically investigate the collision and coalescence dynamics of these droplets within the Gross-Pitaevskii framework. For two-droplet collisions, we find two distinct collision outcomes, namely merging and separation, that are controlled by the initial relative velocity. The critical velocity exhibits a universal scaling law with the interaction and the particle number as $v_c \propto (gN)^{1/4}$, which can be interpreted from a simplified analytical model, revealing the essential role of the collision time. It differs fundamentally from the mechanism governing the conventional Lee-Huang-Yang stabilized quantum droplets. Furthermore, while the collision can change the shape of the droplet significantly, the center of mass trajectory remains nearly unaffected, owing to the conservation of angular momentum. For overlapping stationary droplets, vortex arrays can emerge through Kelvin-Helmholtz instability driven by phase-induced shear flow. Although two droplets may merge into a larger one, extended states cannot be constructed from multiple overlapping droplets. Instead, the system dynamically reorganizes into new isolated droplets, revealing the localized property in the bulk region.
