Our results reveal the unique nonequilibrium dynamics of quantum Hall droplets and suggest new pathways for manipulating strongly correlated rotating quantum fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Gross-Pitaevskii框架、数值模拟、解析模型。；研究对象：玻色子量子霍尔液滴的碰撞与合并动力学，具体为快速旋转二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中形成的量子霍尔液滴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两液滴碰撞存在合并与分离两种结果，由初始相对速度控制，临界速度满足普适标度律 \(v_c \propto (gN)^{1/4}\)；多个静止重叠液滴会通过开尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性产生涡旋阵列，但无法形成扩展态，系统会动态重组为新的孤立液滴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两液滴碰撞存在合并与分离两种结果，由初始相对速度控制，临界速度满足普适标度律 \(v_c \propto (gN)^{1/4}\)；多个静止重叠液滴会通过开尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性产生涡旋阵列，但无法形成扩展态，系统会动态重组为新的孤立液滴。；创新点：揭示了玻色子量子霍尔液滴碰撞动力学与常规Lee-Huang-Yang稳定量子液滴的根本区别，发现了角动量守恒导致质心轨迹几乎不受碰撞影响，以及相位驱动剪切流引发的涡旋阵列形成机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于Gross-Pitaevskii方程框架进行数值模拟，并结合简化解析模型解释临界速度的标度律。

papers.title: Three-dimensional visualization of threading dislocation in GaN by polarized-light microscopy
papers.abstract: We demonstrate high-throughput three-dimensional imaging of threading dislocations in ammonothermal GaN wafers using polarized-light microscopy with collimated LED illumination. Threading dislocations exhibited focal-depth-dependent in-plane shifts, enabling visualization of their three-dimensional inclination behavior over large areas. Synchrotron radiation X-ray topography indicated that dislocations with identical in-plane Burgers vector components tended to exhibit similar trace geometries and inclination directions. The threading dislocations were found to be tilted by approximately 3.3° from the c-axis in directions perpendicular to their Burgers vectors, indicating climb-mediated motion associated with strain relaxation during crystal growth. These results demonstrate a simple nondestructive approach for large-area three-dimensional characterization of dislocations in GaN wafers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：polarized-light microscopy（偏振光显微镜）、synchrotron radiation X-ray topography（同步辐射X射线形貌术）、demonstrate（演示）。；研究对象：氨热法生长的GaN晶圆中的穿透位错（threading dislocations）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用偏振光显微镜实现了对GaN晶圆中穿透位错的大面积三维成像，发现位错相对于c轴倾斜约3.3°，倾斜方向垂直于其伯氏矢量，表明位错在晶体生长过程中通过攀移运动释放应变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用偏振光显微镜实现了对GaN晶圆中穿透位错的大面积三维成像，发现位错相对于c轴倾斜约3.3°，倾斜方向垂直于其伯氏矢量，表明位错在晶体生长过程中通过攀移运动释放应变。；创新点：提出了一种简单、非破坏性、高通量的方法，用于GaN晶圆中穿透位错的大面积三维可视化，无需复杂样品制备或同步辐射设施即可实现三维倾角表征。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段为：准直LED照明的偏振光显微镜（用于三维成像），以及同步辐射X射线形貌术（用于确认位错伯氏矢量分量与迹线几何的关系）。

papers.title: Vacancy-mediated nitrogen diffusion and aggregation via high-fluence electron beam irradiation in HPHT synthesized diamond crystal
papers.abstract: The negatively charged nitrogen vacancy (NV-) center in diamonds is promising point defect for highly sensitive quantum sensing. The formation of high-density NV- centers is essential for improving sensitivity. We performed room-temperature electron beam irradiation (EBI) and annealing on nitrogen-doped high-pressure high-temperature diamond crystals to convert substitutional nitrogen into NV centers. In the low-fluence region of EBI, neutral substitutional nitrogen (Ns0) concentration decreased and NV0 and NV- center concentration increased with increasing EBI fluence. The decrease in Ns0 concentration was comparable to the increase in total NV center concentration; thus, the conversion from Ns0 to NV0 and NV- centers is a dominant defect formation process. In a high-fluence region, NV0 and NV- center and Ns0 and Ns+ concentrations decreased with increasing EBI fluence, indicating the formation of unknown nitrogen-related defects such as the H3 center, which is a nitrogen and vacancy aggregation defect. Although H3 centers were observed at high EBI fluence, their forming annealing temperature of 1375 +- 25 degrees Celsius was lower than the typically reported temperatures over 1600 degrees Celsius. We attribute this low-temperature formation to vacancy-mediated nitrogen diffusion and aggregation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron beam irradiation (EBI)、annealing、concentration measurement。；研究对象：高压高温（HPHT）合成的含氮金刚石晶体中，通过高注量电子束辐照诱导的氮空位（NV）中心及其他氮相关缺陷的形成与转化过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低注量电子束辐照下，替代氮（Ns0）主要转化为NV0和NV-中心；在高注量下，所有已知缺陷浓度均下降，并出现未知氮相关缺陷（如H3中心），且H3中心在远低于文献报道的温度下形成，归因于空位介导的氮扩散与聚集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低注量电子束辐照下，替代氮（Ns0）主要转化为NV0和NV-中心；在高注量下，所有已知缺陷浓度均下降，并出现未知氮相关缺陷（如H3中心），且H3中心在远低于文献报道的温度下形成，归因于空位介导的氮扩散与聚集。；创新点：首次在高注量电子束辐照下观察到H3中心在1375±25°C的较低温度下形成，并提出了空位介导的氮扩散与聚集机制来解释这一现象。
papers.method_zh: 室温电子束辐照（EBI）结合退火处理，通过测量不同辐照注量下Ns0、Ns+、NV0、NV-及H3中心等缺陷浓度的变化，分析缺陷转化与形成过程。

papers.title: Amorphous Fe-Sn nanofilms for anomalous-Nernst heat-flux sensing
papers.abstract: Amorphous magnetic films are promising for anomalous-Nernst heat-flux sensing because their low thermal conductivity can enhance the temperature gradient generated by an applied heat flux. However, amorphization often degrades electronic transport and thermoelectric properties, making it challenging to obtain a large anomalous Nernst response in structurally disordered films. Here, we demonstrate nanometer-thick amorphous Fe-Sn films as high-sensitivity anomalous-Nernst heat-flux sensing materials. By systematically controlling composition and thickness, we find that amorphous Fe-Sn nanofilms combine a large anomalous Nernst response with low thermal conductivity, resulting in a heat-flux sensitivity of 0.37 um/A. This value exceeds the sensitivities reported for both amorphous magnetic thin films and representative crystalline topological magnets. X-ray diffraction and Mossbauer spectroscopy show that the optimized films lack long-range crystallinity while retaining local Fe-Sn environments, suggesting that short-range atomic order contributes to the anomalous Nernst response in the amorphous matrix. The sensitivity is also reproduced on flexible polymer substrates, indicating compatibility with mechanically compliant device architectures. These results establish amorphous Fe-Sn nanofilms as a platform for anomalous-Nernst heat-flux sensing and provide a materials design route based on local-structure control and thermal-conductivity reduction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验制备（X射线衍射、穆斯堡尔谱）、性能测试（热流灵敏度）和材料表征。；研究对象：非晶态Fe-Sn纳米薄膜，用于反常能斯特热流传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非晶态Fe-Sn纳米薄膜兼具大的反常能斯特响应和低热导率，实现了0.37 μm/A的热流灵敏度，超过已报道的非晶磁性薄膜和典型晶体拓扑磁体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非晶态Fe-Sn纳米薄膜兼具大的反常能斯特响应和低热导率，实现了0.37 μm/A的热流灵敏度，超过已报道的非晶磁性薄膜和典型晶体拓扑磁体。；创新点：通过短程原子序和降低热导率的材料设计策略，在非晶态薄膜中实现了优于晶体材料的热流传感性能，并展示了与柔性器件的兼容性。
papers.method_zh: 系统调控成分和厚度制备纳米薄膜；使用X射线衍射和穆斯堡尔谱表征结构；在柔性聚合物基底上验证灵敏度兼容性。

papers.title: Circularly Polarized Magneto-Photoluminescence in Two-Dimensional Chiral Perovskites R- and S-(C4H9NH3)2PbI4 under High Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: We report circularly polarized magneto-photoluminescence (MPL) measurements on the enantiomeric pair of two-dimensional chiral perovskites R- and S-(C4H9NH3)2PbI4 in pulsed magnetic fields up to 50 T at 4.2 K. The R-form exhibits strong preferential emission into the RC channel (I_RC/I_LC = 10:1), with the S-form showing the opposite sense, robust against the applied field. Three key observations are reported: (i) an anomalous redshift of all exciton transition energies with increasing field-contrasting with the normal diamagnetic blueshift of achiral perovskites-with a non-monotonic initial blueshift to 7.6 T in the dominant RC channel of the R-form; (ii) complete invariance of PL peak positions upon reversal of the field direction, consistent with Rashba-induced mixing of the bright exciton with a nearby m_x = 0 dark state; and (iii) field-induced increase in PL intensity and narrowing of the linewidth, attributed to suppression of disorder scattering as the cyclotron orbit contracts. These results are interpreted in the framework of Rashba spin-splitting and polaron formation in the chiral two-dimensional perovskite lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：circularly polarized magneto-photoluminescence measurements, pulsed magnetic fields。；研究对象：二维手性钙钛矿R-和S-(C4H9NH3)2PbI4的对映体对，及其在强磁场下的圆偏振磁光致发光行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: R-型样品在右旋圆偏振通道中表现出强烈的优先发射（强度比10:1），S-型则相反，且该手性偏好不受外加磁场影响；同时观察到反常的红移、峰位对磁场方向的不变性以及磁场诱导的发光增强和线宽变窄。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：R-型样品在右旋圆偏振通道中表现出强烈的优先发射（强度比10:1），S-型则相反，且该手性偏好不受外加磁场影响；同时观察到反常的红移、峰位对磁场方向的不变性以及磁场诱导的发光增强和线宽变窄。；创新点：首次在二维手性钙钛矿中系统研究了高达50 T强磁场下的圆偏振光致发光，发现了与常规非手性钙钛矿不同的反常红移现象，并基于Rashba自旋劈裂和极化子形成框架进行了解释。
papers.method_zh: 在4.2 K温度下，使用脉冲磁场（最高50 T）进行圆偏振磁光致发光（MPL）测量。

papers.title: Thickness dependence of diode efficiency in superconducting Fe(Se,Te)/FeTe thin-film heterostructure devices
papers.abstract: The superconducting diode effect (SDE) is a nonreciprocal transport phenomenon, in which the superconducting critical current density depends on the polarity of the current. It has attracted recent attention because of its potential applications to a rectifier without energy dissipation. While SDE has been observed in a wide range of superconducting materials with broken inversion symmetry as well as thin-film heterostructures, the microscopic origin linking structural inversion asymmetry of electronic band, spin-orbit interaction, and vortex pinning remains to be clarified. In this study, we investigate SDE in Fe(Se,Te)/FeTe heterostructure devices as a function of the superconducting Fe(Se,Te) layer thickness tFST to elucidate the role of structural inversion asymmetry on the vortex-induced SDE. We find that the SDE efficiency monotonically increases with increasing tFST, which can be understood by considering that the band bending in the bulk Fe(Se,Te) layer induces the structural inversion asymmetry and thus, the Rashba spin-orbit interaction. In addition, we demonstrate almost 100% rectification for the Fe(Se,Te)/FeTe heterostructure devices in half- and full-wave oscillation configurations. Our findings point out the importance of structural architecture for realization of highly efficient SDE devices based on superconducting thin-film heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“we investigate”、“we find”、“we demonstrate”等实验性动词，并涉及器件制备和测量。；研究对象：Fe(Se,Te)/FeTe 薄膜异质结构器件中的超导二极管效应（SDE）。具体研究了超导层 Fe(Se,Te) 厚度对二极管效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导二极管效应（SDE）的效率随 Fe(Se,Te) 层厚度单调增加，这归因于体层中能带弯曲引起的结构反演不对称性和 Rashba 自旋-轨道相互作用。此外，在半波和全波振荡配置中实现了接近 100% 的整流效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导二极管效应（SDE）的效率随 Fe(Se,Te) 层厚度单调增加，这归因于体层中能带弯曲引起的结构反演不对称性和 Rashba 自旋-轨道相互作用。此外，在半波和全波振荡配置中实现了接近 100% 的整流效率。；创新点：通过系统改变超导层厚度，阐明了结构反演不对称性在涡旋诱导的超导二极管效应中的具体作用，并展示了基于该异质结构实现近乎完美整流的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 通过改变 Fe(Se,Te) 超导层的厚度（tFST），系统测量了 Fe(Se,Te)/FeTe 异质结构器件的超导临界电流密度对电流极性的依赖关系，从而表征 SDE 效率。

papers.title: CoTAR: Topology and Atomic State Reconstruction in Condensed Phases
papers.abstract: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) enable condensed-phase molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with near-first-principles accuracy, but their lack of explicit molecular topology limits bond-aware analysis and reconnection to classical force fields. Here, we present CoTAR, a hybrid graph neural network (GNN)--hidden Markov model (HMM) framework that reconstructs molecular topology, formal charges, and unpaired electrons from atomic species, coordinates, and total charge by combining message passing on a proximity graph with a van der Waals prior, chemical constraints, and temporal smoothing. Across 128 nonreactive, topology-preserving condensed-phase systems, CoTAR achieved a bond-order-weighted F1 score of 0.906 on classical-MD data; for uMLIP trajectories, few-shot fine-tuning improved the valid-snapshot rate from 38.6\% to 84.7\%. The reconstructed topologies also supported downstream classical MD simulations, and HMM smoothing improved system-level MD simulation feasibility from 83.6\% to 85.9\%, indicating that CoTAR provides a practical framework for bond-aware analysis of condensed-phase uMLIP trajectories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs)、graph neural network (GNN)、hidden Markov model (HMM)、molecular dynamics (MD) simulations。；研究对象：凝聚相体系中的分子拓扑结构、形式电荷和未配对电子的重建。具体涉及128个非反应性、拓扑保持的凝聚相系统，以及uMLIP轨迹。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CoTAR框架在经典MD数据上实现了0.906的键序加权F1分数；通过少样本微调，将uMLIP轨迹的有效快照率从38.6%提升至84.7%，为凝聚相uMLIP轨迹的键感知分析提供了实用框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CoTAR框架在经典MD数据上实现了0.906的键序加权F1分数；通过少样本微调，将uMLIP轨迹的有效快照率从38.6%提升至84.7%，为凝聚相uMLIP轨迹的键感知分析提供了实用框架。；创新点：提出了一种结合GNN与HMM的混合框架，专门用于从原子种类、坐标和总电荷中重建分子拓扑、形式电荷和未配对电子，弥补了uMLIP缺乏显式分子拓扑的缺陷，并支持下游经典MD模拟。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合图神经网络（GNN）与隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）框架。GNN在邻近图上进行消息传递，结合范德华先验、化学约束和时间平滑；HMM用于时间序列上的拓扑平滑。数据来源包括经典MD模拟和uMLIP轨迹，并进行了少样本微调。

papers.title: The Second Law, Symmetry of Time Reversal and Thermodynamic Equilibrium in Superconductors
papers.abstract: The Second law, universally applicable to all states of all sorts of matter and radiation, is undeniably the brightest jewel in the tiara of laws of thermodynamics; recall that the achievements of this law include the principle of least action, the atomistic structure of matter, the quantization of radiant heat, and much more. However, there is a significant gap in understanding the application of the Second law to magnetizing materials, especially to superconductors. This communication is targeted to fill the gap. The concepts of equilibrium and reversibility in thermodynamic processes are considered with particular attention to specifics of superconductivity. These include (1) the primary role of the field strength $\textbf{H}$ in forming magnetization; (2) the zero entropy of samples in a state of thermodynamic equilibrium; and (3) two kinds of superconducting currents in samples out of equilibrium. As shown, time reversal symmetry in superconductors is a consequence of the Second law and, therefore, is a mandatory property of these materials in a state of equilibrium. Necessary conditions for achieving the latter are framed out. Awareness of these aspects is important for advancing research on superconductivity in all kinds of superconducting materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论热力学第二定律、时间反演对称性、平衡态等概念，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：超导体中的热力学平衡、可逆性与时间反演对称性，特别是磁化材料（超导体）中第二定律的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超导体中的时间反演对称性是热力学第二定律的必然结果，因此是超导体处于平衡态时的必备性质。论文还提出了实现超导体热力学平衡的必要条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超导体中的时间反演对称性是热力学第二定律的必然结果，因此是超导体处于平衡态时的必备性质。论文还提出了实现超导体热力学平衡的必要条件。；创新点：填补了第二定律在磁化材料（尤其是超导体）中应用的理解空白，明确将时间反演对称性作为第二定律在超导平衡态中的推论，并系统阐述了超导平衡态的必要条件。
papers.method_zh: 基于热力学第二定律的理论分析，结合超导体的特殊性质（如磁场强度H在磁化中的首要作用、平衡态下样品的零熵、非平衡态下的两类超导电流）进行概念性推导。

papers.title: Entropy engineering of BF-BT-based high-entropy ceramics for ultra-high energy storage performance
papers.abstract: Dielectric capacitors are promising for pulsed power applications, but the energy storage performance of lead-free bulk ceramics is often limited by low breakdown strength and large ferroelectric hysteresis. Herein, a high entropy perovskite oxide BaTi0.2Zr0.2Sn0.2Hf0.2Nb0.1Sc0.1O3 was introduced into the BF-BT matrix to develop lead free high entropy ferroelectric ceramics. Multicomponent B-site substitution induces lattice distortion, enhanced pseudocubic characteristics, relaxor behavior, and grain refinement. These effects suppress polarization hysteresis and electrical conduction, resulting in a significant increase in breakdown strength. A maximum breakdown strength of 840 kV/cm1 and a recoverable energy density of 10.55 J/cm3 were achieved. Entropy-induced microstructural heterogeneity promotes a more uniform electric-field distribution and delays dielectric breakdown. This work demonstrates entropy engineering as an effective route to achieving high breakdown strength and superior energy-storage performance in lead-free ferroelectric ceramics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了材料制备（“引入到BF-BT基体中”）、性能测试（“击穿强度840 kV/cm”、“可恢复能量密度10.55 J/cm³”）等实验过程。；研究对象：高熵铁电陶瓷，具体为BF-BT基（BiFeO₃-BaTiO₃）高熵钙钛矿氧化物BaTi₀.₂Zr₀.₂Sn₀.₂Hf₀.₂Nb₀.₁Sc₀.₁O₃，以及其储能性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过熵工程（多组分B位取代）引入晶格畸变、增强赝立方特性、弛豫行为和晶粒细化，显著提高了击穿强度（840 kV/cm）和可恢复能量密度（10.55 J/cm³），实现了无铅铁电陶瓷中优异的储能性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过熵工程（多组分B位取代）引入晶格畸变、增强赝立方特性、弛豫行为和晶粒细化，显著提高了击穿强度（840 kV/cm）和可恢复能量密度（10.55 J/cm³），实现了无铅铁电陶瓷中优异的储能性能。；创新点：提出“熵工程”策略，通过引入高熵组分诱导微观结构异质性，实现更均匀的电场分布并延迟介电击穿，从而在无铅铁电陶瓷中获得超高击穿强度和储能性能。
papers.method_zh: 采用高熵钙钛矿氧化物引入BF-BT基体，通过多组分B位取代实现成分设计；利用微观结构表征（如晶粒细化、赝立方特性）和电学性能测试（击穿强度、能量密度）分析性能提升机制。

papers.title: Emergence of millimeter-wave resonances in self-assembled ferroelectric metamaterials
papers.abstract: Resonators are a key component in modern communications and computing. As demand and technological advances push component requirements into the terahertz regime, there is significant research devoted to the search for resonances at these frequencies. While uniform solid-state materials usually do not intrinsically feature resonances in this frequency range, self-assembled periodic arrays of ferroelectric nanodomains may provide an engineering route to design millimeter-wave properties. Here, we utilize prototypical dielectric-ferroelectric SrTiO3/PbTiO3 superlattices to robustly design periodic ferroelectric nano-scale domains. Phase field simulations predict an emergent domain breathing mode in complex polar textures and state-of-the-art millimeter-wave characterization shows evidence for such emergent resonances up to hundreds of GHz. Complex polar textures in these superlattices lead to emergent piezoelectric properties that also result in millimeter-wave resonances, which are predicted by second principles methods and confirmed by direct measurement. The principles investigated in this work suggest a new modality for ferroelectrics in the design of millimeter-wave electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及“相场模拟预测”“第二原理方法预测”等计算手段，以及“毫米波表征”“直接测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：自组装铁电超材料，具体为SrTiO₃/PbTiO₃介电-铁电超晶格中形成的周期性铁电纳米畴结构及其在毫米波频段（数百GHz）的共振行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SrTiO₃/PbTiO₃超晶格中，通过自组装形成的周期性铁电纳米畴可产生一种“畴呼吸模式”的毫米波共振，该共振频率可达数百GHz，且复杂极性织构导致的压电效应也能诱发毫米波共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SrTiO₃/PbTiO₃超晶格中，通过自组装形成的周期性铁电纳米畴可产生一种“畴呼吸模式”的毫米波共振，该共振频率可达数百GHz，且复杂极性织构导致的压电效应也能诱发毫米波共振。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用最先进的毫米波表征技术进行直接测量；计算上采用相场模拟预测畴呼吸模式，并利用第二原理方法预测压电效应引发的共振行为。

papers.title: Thermal Corrections and Analysis on the Phase Stability of CsPbCl3 and Cs2AgSbCl6 during In-Situ Thermal Treatment
papers.abstract: Cesium lead chloride (CsPbCl3) is a well known and principal model for inorganic perovskite halide optoelectronic research. The many available techniques including high temperature stability testing have been used to investigate the increasing interest in inorganic perovskites as primary layers in solar cell applications. Due to the nature of high temperature testing, the characterization technique, reproducibility, and the true sample temperature are vital in determining relative stability. By choosing CsPbCl3 in the investigation of the structural stability of perovskites at high temperatures, it acts as a baseline to create and verify a methodology that accurately probes sample temperature, phase transitions, and decomposition onsets. Therefore, we present a methodological approach to investigate the thermal interactions and stability of CsPbCl3 as a parent single perovskite halide based on ligand-assisted re-precipitation synthesis techniques. Where we use our approach to inform and probe thermal interactions in other cesium/chlorine compounds like Cs2AgSbCl6. By analyzing the stoichiometry and initial phases through investigations of the crystalline structure and particle morphology, we calculated temperature conversions using a control substrate and refinements to best estimate changing structure parameters. Using in-situ temperature dependent X-ray diffraction, we were able to effectively probe the phase transitions and decomposition temperatures of the investigated halide powders. Creating a process that can confirm known high temperature structural phenomena of model perovskite halides while verifying our true sample temperature. Which allowed for further testing on the thermal kinetics of on the double perovskite structure Cs2AgSbCl6 and will continue to allow us to test other perovskites and perovskite families of interest in modern high temperature perovskite halide research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：in-situ temperature dependent X-ray diffraction（原位变温X射线衍射）、ligand-assisted re-precipitation synthesis（配体辅助再沉淀合成）、characterization technique（表征技术）。；研究对象：CsPbCl3（铯铅氯）单钙钛矿卤化物和Cs2AgSbCl6（铯银锑氯）双钙钛矿卤化物在高温下的相稳定性、相变及分解行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过建立一套精确探测样品真实温度、相变和分解起始温度的方法学，验证了CsPbCl3已知的高温结构现象，并成功将该方法应用于双钙钛矿Cs2AgSbCl6的热动力学测试。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过建立一套精确探测样品真实温度、相变和分解起始温度的方法学，验证了CsPbCl3已知的高温结构现象，并成功将该方法应用于双钙钛矿Cs2AgSbCl6的热动力学测试。；创新点：提出了一种系统的方法学流程，能够准确校准样品真实温度，从而可靠地探测钙钛矿卤化物在高温下的相变和分解起始点，并将该方法从单钙钛矿CsPbCl3推广至双钙钛矿Cs2AgSbCl6的热稳定性研究。
papers.method_zh: 配体辅助再沉淀合成技术制备样品；使用控制衬底进行温度转换计算和结构参数精修；采用原位变温X射线衍射（in-situ temperature dependent XRD）探测相变和分解温度。

papers.title: PtyRANNOSAUR: Ptychography with Robust Artificial Neural Networks Optimized for Sub-Angstrom Accuracy and Ultrafast Reconstruction
papers.abstract: We present PtyRANNOSAUR, a data-driven neural network code that reconstructs atomic resolution electron ptychography data in seconds, 10-100x faster than standard methods. PtyRANNOSAUR uses convolutional autoencoders to map 4D-scanning transmission electron microscopy data to 2D phase images. Each model is trained on a large database of crystal structures and is tailored for a range of experimental parameters, such as accelerating voltage, convergence angle, defocus, and sample thickness. This approach yields high quality reconstructions without requiring any fine-tuning of hyperparameters. In addition, the code handles spatial partial coherence, multiple scattering, and scan position errors, which are critical for state-of-the-art electron ptychography reconstructions. By testing PtyRANNOSAUR on experimental and simulated data, we show that the neural networks accurately reconstruct atomic structures of a broad range of materials systems and can achieve high resolutions of $<0.5$ Å, comparable to the best iterative reconstructions of the same data. These advances enable near-live, state-of-the-art electron ptychography reconstructions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：data-driven neural network code, convolutional autoencoders, trained on a large database）；研究对象：电子叠层衍射成像（electron ptychography）中的原子级分辨率相位重建，适用于多种晶体材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: PtyRANNOSAUR神经网络代码可在数秒内重建原子分辨率的电子叠层衍射数据，速度比标准方法快10-100倍，且能达到优于0.5 Å的分辨率，与最佳迭代重建结果相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：PtyRANNOSAUR神经网络代码可在数秒内重建原子分辨率的电子叠层衍射数据，速度比标准方法快10-100倍，且能达到优于0.5 Å的分辨率，与最佳迭代重建结果相当。；创新点：无需超参数微调即可获得高质量重建；同时处理空间部分相干、多次散射和扫描位置误差等实际实验中的关键问题，实现接近实时的先进电子叠层衍射重建。
papers.method_zh: 使用卷积自编码器（convolutional autoencoders）将4D扫描透射电子显微镜（4D-STEM）数据直接映射为2D相位图像；模型基于大量晶体结构数据库训练，并针对加速电压、汇聚角、离焦量、样品厚度等实验参数进行定制。

papers.title: Multiphoton Fingerprints of Altermagnetic Spin Splittings
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate multiphoton absorption as a polarization-resolved nonlinear optical probe of planar altermagnets (ALMs). We show that the angular harmonic of the altermagnetic spin splitting fixes the lowest optical absorption at which a symmetry-selective response appears: two-photon absorption for $d$-wave order, four-photon absorption for $g$-wave order, and six-photon absorption for $i$-wave order. In each case, there exists a polarization channel locked to the symmetry harmonic of the altermagnetic texture in which the direct $n$-photon contribution to the transition matrix element is absent. This changes the frequency scaling of the absorption rate relative to other polarization channels and provides a direct optical fingerprint of the underlying altermagnetic harmonic. Our results establish a hierarchy of nonlinear spectroscopic signatures that distinguishes $d$-, $g$-, and $i$-wave altermagnetic spin splittings beyond linear response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We systematically investigate”“We show”“Our results establish”等理论推导和预测性表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：平面交变磁体（planar altermagnets, ALMs）中的多光子吸收过程，具体针对d波、g波和i波交变磁自旋劈裂的对称性特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁自旋劈裂的角谐波阶次决定了最低阶对称选择性光学吸收的阶数：d波对应双光子吸收，g波对应四光子吸收，i波对应六光子吸收。每种情况下存在一个与交变磁纹理对称谐波锁定的偏振通道，其中直接n光子对跃迁矩阵元的贡献为零，从而改变吸收率的频率标度，形成直接的光学指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁自旋劈裂的角谐波阶次决定了最低阶对称选择性光学吸收的阶数：d波对应双光子吸收，g波对应四光子吸收，i波对应六光子吸收。每种情况下存在一个与交变磁纹理对称谐波锁定的偏振通道，其中直接n光子对跃迁矩阵元的贡献为零，从而改变吸收率的频率标度，形成直接的光学指纹。；创新点：建立了超越线性响应的非线性光谱学层级结构，首次区分d波、g波和i波交变磁自旋劈裂的独特光学指纹。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用偏振分辨的非线性光学理论框架，系统分析多光子吸收作为探测交变磁自旋劈裂对称性的手段。通过分析不同偏振通道下跃迁矩阵元的对称性约束，推导出吸收率频率标度律的变化。

papers.title: A BRAVE Alloy Design Campaign (Bayesian Risk-aware Alloy discoVery and Exploration)
papers.abstract: In constrained alloy optimization, the compositions with the highest performance potential often reside at the boundary of phase stability -- where the risk of experimental failure is also highest. This work demonstrates this principle through a risk-aware Bayesian optimization campaign on single-phase FCC high-entropy alloys in the Al-V-Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni-Cu system. A learned feasibility classifier, integrated directly into the multi-objective acquisition function, probabilistically penalizes candidates likely to produce failed experiments while preserving access to high-performing boundary compositions. From approximately 27,000 CALPHAD-screened candidates, 48 alloys were synthesized over three closed-loop iterations targeting five objectives (yield strength, UTS/YS ratio, strain at UTS, dynamic-to-quasi-static hardness ratio, and simulated depth of penetration), exploring 0.12\% of the feasible space. Two compositional regimes emerged: a V-rich, Ni-rich high-strength regime (UTS up to ${\sim}1480$~MPa at 50% elongation) and a Mn-containing high-ductility regime (UTS/YS up to 4.20 at $>$50% elongation). Among feasible alloys, vanadium simultaneously drives yield strength ($r = 0.84$) and sigma-phase formation ($r = 0.54$ with infeasibility); at V = 24~at.%, the three strongest alloys and three sigma failures share the same compositional point. Additionally, the strongest performing alloys cluster in a narrow region of compositional space (V $\geq$ 20 at.%, Ni $\geq$ 36 at.%), representing ${\sim}100$ of $27,074$ feasible candidates -- a probability of $P \approx 6.5 \times 10^{-6}$ under random sampling. This dual role -- consistent with the KKT prediction that constrained optima lie on active constraint boundaries -- required feasibility-aware acquisition to access; hard filtering would have excluded this region entirely.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提到“Bayesian optimization campaign”（贝叶斯优化计算框架）、“CALPHAD-screened candidates”（CALPHAD计算筛选）以及“48 alloys were synthesized”（合金合成实验）、“three closed-loop iterations”（闭环迭代实验）。；研究对象：单相FCC高熵合金体系，具体为Al-V-Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni-Cu八元合金系，聚焦于相稳定边界附近的成分优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在约束合金优化中，最高性能成分往往位于相稳定边界（即实验失败风险最高的区域），且钒（V）同时驱动屈服强度（相关系数r=0.84）和sigma相形成（r=0.54），导致最强合金与实验失败合金共享同一成分点。这一现象符合KKT条件预测的约束最优解位于主动约束边界上的原理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在约束合金优化中，最高性能成分往往位于相稳定边界（即实验失败风险最高的区域），且钒（V）同时驱动屈服强度（相关系数r=0.84）和sigma相形成（r=0.54），导致最强合金与实验失败合金共享同一成分点。这一现象符合KKT条件预测的约束最优解位于主动约束边界上的原理。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统方法的具体对比，但核心创新在于：将可行性分类器概率性地嵌入多目标采集函数，而非采用硬过滤（hard filtering），从而保留了位于相稳定边界上的高性能成分区域。
papers.method_zh: 采用风险感知贝叶斯优化（risk-aware Bayesian optimization）框架，将学习的可行性分类器（feasibility classifier）直接集成到多目标采集函数中，对可能产生实验失败的候选成分进行概率性惩罚。目标函数包括五个性能指标：屈服强度、极限抗拉强度/屈服强度比、极限抗拉强度对应的应变、动态/准静态硬度比、模拟穿透深度。通过CALPHAD筛选约27,000个候选成分，在三个闭环迭代中合成48种合金，仅探索了可行空间的0.12%。

papers.title: Mapping the Growth of Two-Dimensional $π$-Conjugated Polymers on Au(111): Organometallic Intermediates and Edge Terminations
papers.abstract: Kagome lattices provide an exciting space for the exploration of graphene-like $π$-conjugated molecular systems with flat bands. Using heterotriangulene-derived precursors, along with an on-surface Ullmann coupling process, makes growing polymers with Kagome lattices accessible and straightforward. Here, we use scanning tunneling microscopy alongside high-resolution atomic force microscopy to examine the evolution of tribromotrioxaazatriangulene on Au(111) into ordered, covalent films. Using density functional theory and scanning probe methods, we find previously unreported organometallic intermediate states involving Au adatoms incorporated within the growing polymer lattice. We also find that a majority of polymer edges remain brominated up to 250 $^{\circ}$C and a large number of edges bonded to Au adatoms coordinated to an adjacent bromine atom. These observations suggest that residual bromine could play a role in stabilizing the polymer edges to Au adatoms and thereby influence the growth pathways that lead to ordered Kagome polymer lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy, atomic force microscopy, density functional theory）；研究对象：在Au(111)表面生长的二维π共轭聚合物，具体为基于三溴三氧杂三氮杂三角烯（tribromotrioxaazatriangulene）前驱体形成的Kagome晶格聚合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了此前未报道的有机金属中间态，其中金原子嵌入生长中的聚合物晶格；多数聚合物边缘在250°C下仍保持溴化，且大量边缘与金原子及相邻溴原子配位，表明残余溴可能稳定聚合物边缘并影响有序Kagome晶格的生长路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了此前未报道的有机金属中间态，其中金原子嵌入生长中的聚合物晶格；多数聚合物边缘在250°C下仍保持溴化，且大量边缘与金原子及相邻溴原子配位，表明残余溴可能稳定聚合物边缘并影响有序Kagome晶格的生长路径。；创新点：首次揭示了Au(111)表面上Kagome聚合物生长过程中涉及金原子的有机金属中间态，并指出残余溴对边缘稳定性和生长路径的潜在调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）、高分辨率原子力显微镜（AFM）、密度泛函理论（DFT）

papers.title: Ultrafast non-thermal suppression of ferroelectricity by carrier screening in LiNbO3
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric materials are key to energy-efficient electronics, memory, and optical applications. While charge carriers typically screen and suppress ferroelectricity, their role under nonequilibrium conditions remains elusive. Here, we use femtosecond laser pulses to liberate trapped carriers in LiNbO3 and track the response using time-resolved second-harmonic generation and stimulated Raman scattering. Even dilute photoexcited carriers induce a rapid yet enduring suppression of polarization and Raman susceptibility. Fluence- and temperature-dependent analyses confirm the suppression is non-thermal and arises from transient carrier screening. These findings reveal an efficient, reversible, and symmetry-preserving mechanism to modulate ferroelectricity on ultrafast timescales, offering a new route to control ferroic and competing quantum phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：femtosecond laser pulses、time-resolved second-harmonic generation、stimulated Raman scattering。；研究对象：铁电材料铌酸锂（LiNbO₃）中非平衡载流子对铁电性的超快调控机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使极低浓度的光激发载流子也能通过瞬态载流子屏蔽效应，在非热条件下快速且持久地抑制铁电极化与拉曼响应，提供了一种高效、可逆且保持对称性的超快铁电调控新机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使极低浓度的光激发载流子也能通过瞬态载流子屏蔽效应，在非热条件下快速且持久地抑制铁电极化与拉曼响应，提供了一种高效、可逆且保持对称性的超快铁电调控新机制。；创新点：揭示了在非平衡条件下，稀薄光生载流子通过屏蔽效应而非热效应实现铁电性的超快抑制，为超快调控铁性及竞争量子相提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒激光脉冲激发束缚载流子，结合时间分辨二次谐波产生（time-resolved second-harmonic generation）和受激拉曼散射（stimulated Raman scattering）探测极化与晶格响应；通过改变激光通量和温度进行非热效应验证。

papers.title: SU(4) Heisenberg model on the hyperhoneycomb lattice
papers.abstract: We study the ground state of the SU(4) Heisenberg model on the hyperhoneycomb lattice using three-dimensional projected entangled pair states. We show that it is possible to compute physical observables for the ground states using loop expansions, which converge quickly on tree-like lattices. Our extrapolations to the limit of infinite bond dimensions point toward gapless spin-liquid ground state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用“projected entangled pair states”（投影纠缠对态）进行数值计算，并涉及“loop expansions”（环展开）和“extrapolations to the limit of infinite bond dimensions”（外推到无限键维极限）。；研究对象：超蜂窝晶格（hyperhoneycomb lattice）上的SU(4)海森堡模型（SU(4) Heisenberg model），属于三维量子自旋液体体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过外推至无限键维极限，计算结果表明该模型的基态可能是一种无能隙的自旋液体（gapless spin-liquid ground state）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过外推至无限键维极限，计算结果表明该模型的基态可能是一种无能隙的自旋液体（gapless spin-liquid ground state）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用三维投影纠缠对态（three-dimensional projected entangled pair states, 3D PEPS）方法，并结合环展开（loop expansions）技术计算基态物理可观测量。

papers.title: Jarzynski equality for counterwork under reversed memory-filtered driving
papers.abstract: We introduce a counterwork functional generated by a sign-inverting memory-filtered effective protocol. Given an imposed protocol $λ(t)$, the effective protocol $Λ(t)$ is obtained by applying an active protocol-memory kernel to $\dotλ(t)$, rather than by invoking a passive bath response. The counterwork is then the ordinary Hamiltonian work associated with $H(Γ,Λ(t))$, so that Jarzynski's equality applies directly to it. When $Λ(t)$ reverses the endpoints of $λ(t)$, the corresponding free-energy difference satisfies $ΔF_C=-ΔF_W$, and the exponential average of the counterwork is the reciprocal of that of the original work. We derive the kernel normalization realizing this reversed displacement and show, by Jensen's inequality, that the product of the exponentials of the average work and counterwork is bounded by unity, implying $\langle C\rangle+\langle W\rangle\geq0$. Thus negative average counterwork is possible only when compensated by the average work of the original operation. We further discuss the counteroperation under incomplete thermodynamic information, showing that the robust strategy is to enforce endpoint reversal while minimizing dissipated counterwork.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论理论框架（Jarzynski equality、counterwork functional、kernel normalization、Jensen's inequality），未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：非平衡统计物理中的功与反功（counterwork）关系，具体研究在记忆滤波驱动（memory-filtered driving）下，通过符号反转有效协议生成的counterwork泛函及其与Jarzynski等式的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当有效协议Λ(t)反转原协议λ(t)的端点时，对应的自由能差满足ΔF_C = -ΔF_W，且counterwork的指数平均是原work指数平均的倒数。平均功与平均反功之和非负（⟨C⟩+⟨W⟩≥0），因此负平均反功只有在原操作的平均功补偿下才可能实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当有效协议Λ(t)反转原协议λ(t)的端点时，对应的自由能差满足ΔF_C = -ΔF_W，且counterwork的指数平均是原work指数平均的倒数。平均功与平均反功之和非负（⟨C⟩+⟨W⟩≥0），因此负平均反功只有在原操作的平均功补偿下才可能实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但核心创新在于提出“符号反转记忆滤波”生成counterwork的概念，并证明其满足Jarzynski等式的直接适用性，以及端点反转条件下自由能差与功平均的对称关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：引入主动协议-记忆核（active protocol-memory kernel）作用于λ̇(t)以生成有效协议Λ(t)，而非依赖被动浴响应；利用Jarzynski等式直接应用于counterwork；通过Jensen不等式推导功与反功的平均值约束；讨论不完全热力学信息下的最优策略。

papers.title: Collection, characterization, and precision measurement of levitated charged nanoparticles
papers.abstract: We describe apparatus and experimental procedures for high stability precision measurements of levitated nanoscale particles confined in an ion trap in high vacuum. We discuss methods for particle generation and collection using electrospray emission, for rapid characterization by direct imaging of thermal motion, and for transfer of the particle from the trap where it is collected to a separate analysis trap in order to achieve better vacuum and lower noise. In the analysis trap at high vacuum (pressure $p\simeq10^{-8}$ Torr), we employ thermostatic control of the trapped particle oscillation amplitudes, allowing long-term, precision measurements of oscillation frequencies, from which the charge to mass ratio ($Q/M$) can be deduced. Under these conditions, we achieve $Q/M$ measurement precision approaching $10^{-5}$. This sensitivity will enable, for example, investigations of the surface chemistry of $μ$m-scale levitated materials in ultra-high vacuum environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：apparatus and experimental procedures、precision measurements、electrospray emission、direct imaging of thermal motion。；研究对象：悬浮在离子阱中的带电纳米颗粒，具体涉及颗粒的生成、收集、表征以及电荷质量比（Q/M）的高精度测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高真空（~10⁻⁸ Torr）条件下，通过恒温控制悬浮颗粒的振荡幅度，实现了电荷质量比（Q/M）测量精度接近10⁻⁵，为研究微米级悬浮材料的表面化学提供了可能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高真空（~10⁻⁸ Torr）条件下，通过恒温控制悬浮颗粒的振荡幅度，实现了电荷质量比（Q/M）测量精度接近10⁻⁵，为研究微米级悬浮材料的表面化学提供了可能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用电喷雾发射生成并收集纳米颗粒；通过直接成像热运动进行快速表征；将颗粒从收集阱转移至独立分析阱以获得更佳真空和更低噪声；在高真空分析阱中利用恒温控制振荡幅度，进行长期、高精度的振荡频率测量，从而推导出Q/M。

papers.title: Magnetic long-range order at finite temperature in two-dimensional hyperbolic lattices
papers.abstract: Infrared singularities of gapless Goldstone modes preclude magnetic long-range order at finite temperature in conventional two-dimensional systems. By studying the spin-$S$ Heisenberg model on regular tilings of the hyperbolic plane, we show that this obstruction is absent in negatively curved space. Using spin-wave theory, we find that the zero-energy collective modes required by symmetry carry vanishing local spectral weight and are separated from the thermodynamic bulk magnon continuum by a finite gap in the bulk local spectral density. As a result, local transverse correlations remain short ranged, with a finite correlation length, despite the presence of Goldstone modes associated with the broken SO(3) spin-rotation symmetry. Stronger negative curvature is found to suppress quantum fluctuations in bulk thermodynamic quantities, pushing the ordered state toward "mean-field-like" behavior. We further estimate the ordering temperature from the thermal spin-wave correction to the ordered moment. These results establish hyperbolic geometry as a route to finite-temperature magnetic order that circumvents the Mermin-Wagner obstruction without breaking or modifying the continuous symmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spin-wave theory（自旋波理论）、theoretical analysis（理论分析）。；研究对象：二维双曲晶格（hyperbolic lattices）上的自旋-S 海森堡模型（Heisenberg model）。具体研究在负曲率空间（双曲平面）中，磁性长程序（magnetic long-range order）在有限温度下是否存在。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在负曲率空间（双曲晶格）中，二维系统可以规避 Mermin-Wagner 定理的限制，在有限温度下维持磁长程序。更强的负曲率会抑制量子涨落，使有序态趋向于“平均场”行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在负曲率空间（双曲晶格）中，二维系统可以规避 Mermin-Wagner 定理的限制，在有限温度下维持磁长程序。更强的负曲率会抑制量子涨落，使有序态趋向于“平均场”行为。；创新点：该工作首次证明，通过引入负曲率几何（而非破坏或修改连续对称性），可以规避 Mermin-Wagner 定理对二维系统有限温度磁有序的阻碍。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 自旋波理论（Spin-wave theory）。具体包括：分析集体模式的局域谱权重、计算体态局域谱密度中的能隙、以及通过热自旋波修正来估算有序温度。

papers.title: Elimination of Flux Trapping in Superconducting Circuits in Ambient Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: Superconductor digital electronics and quantum computing with superconducting qubits are promising next-generation computing technologies. When cooled down or operated in the presence of a nonzero background magnetic field $B_r$, superconducting thin films comprising the circuits can trap magnetic vortices that can degrade circuit or qubit performance. In this work, we report a practical solution for eliminating flux trapped during cooldown in ambient magnetic fields, $B_r\leq 60$ $\upmu$T, based on controlled local thermal gradients and moats, etched holes in the superconducting films of the circuit. Thermal gradients created by integrated on-chip resistive heaters move vortices towards the moats, where they become trapped away from circuitry regions and pinning sites. Using magnetic imaging and electrical circuit readout, we demonstrate that this approach is capable of removing magnetic flux trapped during field cooling and magnetic flux nucleated by circuit operation. If used in an environment with basic magnetic shielding, this solution is capable of suppressing all magnetic flux in a large-scale circuit, overcoming one of the long-standing challenges preventing high-performance scalable computing using superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“magnetic imaging”、“electrical circuit readout”、“demonstrate”等实验手段。；研究对象：超导电路中的磁通陷阱（magnetic flux trapping）现象，具体涉及超导薄膜中的磁通涡旋及其对超导数字电子学和超导量子比特性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过集成片上电阻加热器产生可控局部热梯度，结合超导薄膜中刻蚀的“护城河”（moats），能够有效消除在环境磁场（≤60 μT）下冷却过程中形成的磁通陷阱，并抑制电路运行中产生的磁通。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过集成片上电阻加热器产生可控局部热梯度，结合超导薄膜中刻蚀的“护城河”（moats），能够有效消除在环境磁场（≤60 μT）下冷却过程中形成的磁通陷阱，并抑制电路运行中产生的磁通。；创新点：提出了一种基于局部热梯度和结构设计（moats）的实用方案，能够在基本磁屏蔽环境下完全抑制大规模超导电路中的磁通陷阱，解决了长期阻碍超导高性能可扩展计算的关键挑战。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：利用集成在芯片上的电阻加热器产生局部热梯度，驱动磁通涡旋向刻蚀的“护城河”移动并固定；采用磁成像技术（magnetic imaging）和电路读出（electrical circuit readout）来验证磁通消除效果。

papers.title: Diameter truncated operator evolution
papers.abstract: We present a method for simulating operator dynamics in out-of-equilibrium quantum systems. Due to the rapid growth of complexity in these systems, this is typically speaking an intractable task. However, exceptional progress has been made in recent years to sidestep this barrier, with the introduction of a number of methods that make use of a truncation of the simulation to low-weight (the number of non-trivial terms in a Pauli string basis expansion) observables, which turns out to be a good approximation for many dynamical quantities of interest, e.g., two-point infinite-temperature correlation functions between local operators. In this work, we extend this idea to a leaner truncation protocol, truncating operators based on their diameter - that is, the size of the region on the lattice on which they are non-trivially supported. Using existing analysis for generic circuits we argue that this kind of truncation protocol is physically well-motivated, and show via extensive numerical simulations for a number of systems of interest (here, the kicked Ising model and the Heisenberg XXZ model) that it is effective, and allows us to efficiently and accurately extract local correlation functions and transport properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：method for simulating、truncation protocol、numerical simulations）；研究对象：非平衡量子系统中的算符动力学，具体以 kicked Ising 模型和 Heisenberg XXZ 模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于算符“直径”（即算符在格点上非平凡支撑的区域大小）的截断方案，能够高效且准确地提取局域关联函数和输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于算符“直径”（即算符在格点上非平凡支撑的区域大小）的截断方案，能够高效且准确地提取局域关联函数和输运性质。；创新点：将已有的低权重（low-weight）算符截断方案推广为更精简的直径截断（diameter truncation）方案，并证明其在物理动机和计算效率上的优势。
papers.method_zh: 通过理论分析（generic circuits）论证截断方案的物理合理性，并结合大规模数值模拟（具体方法摘要未明确说明，可能涉及张量网络或量子电路模拟）对 kicked Ising 模型和 Heisenberg XXZ 模型进行验证。

papers.title: The Allee Effect in Compressible Flows
papers.abstract: Microbes in marine environments are often confined to thin near-surface layers while being advected by turbulent flows. Because such constrained advection generates an effectively compressible flow, reproduction and transport interact in a nontrivial way. Here, we focus on populations whose growth is governed by an Allee effect and show that sinks and sources, generated by the compressible flow, have dramatic consequences for the survival of such species. We derive analytical expressions for the carrying capacity as a function of the Allee strength in the limit of small and large Damköhler number, which measures the product of the large eddy turnover time and the organism growth rate. Numerical simulations reveal how these two limits connect. In the limit of small Damköhler number, we find a maximal Allee strength, set by the statistics of the compressible flow, that leads to species extinction in fully developed turbulence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：推导解析表达式、数值模拟、理论分析。；研究对象：受Allee效应（种群密度过低时生长率下降）调控的微生物种群，在可压缩湍流（由海洋近表层受限平流产生）中的生存与灭绝动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 可压缩流动产生的“源”和“汇”对具有Allee效应的种群生存有显著影响；在达姆科勒数（Damköhler number）较小时，存在由可压缩流统计性质决定的最大Allee强度，超过该强度则种群在充分发展的湍流中灭绝。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：可压缩流动产生的“源”和“汇”对具有Allee效应的种群生存有显著影响；在达姆科勒数（Damköhler number）较小时，存在由可压缩流统计性质决定的最大Allee强度，超过该强度则种群在充分发展的湍流中灭绝。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导（小和大达姆科勒数极限下的承载能力表达式）与数值模拟（连接两个极限行为）。

papers.title: How Width and Data Shape Generalization Scaling Laws in Quadratic Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Understanding how performance scales jointly with model size and data is a central problem in modern machine learning. Existing theoretical works on scaling laws typically describe generalization as a function of data or compute, often in fixed-feature or infinite-width regimes and for online SGD. Here, we instead study how generalization scales with the number of trainable parameters and the number of samples in a feature-learning model. We analyze $\ell_2$-regularized empirical test error minimization in a quadratic two-layer network in a finite-sample setting with structured data. This setting allows for an explicit characterization of the generalization error as a function of the number of samples, model width, and regularization. Our results reveal a phase diagram with distinct scaling regimes as the number of parameters varies. In particular, the generalization error follows data-dependent power laws controlled by the spectral structure of the target. We further characterize the transitions between regimes, including the onset of interpolation, and their impact on generalization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical works、explicit characterization、phase diagram、scaling regimes。；研究对象：二次两层神经网络（quadratic two-layer network）中的泛化缩放规律，具体研究模型宽度（可训练参数数量）与数据样本数量如何共同影响泛化误差。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 泛化误差随模型宽度和样本数量呈现数据依赖的幂律缩放行为，其幂律指数由目标函数的谱结构决定；随着参数数量变化，系统展现出包含不同缩放区域的相图，并刻画了插值开始等转变点对泛化的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：泛化误差随模型宽度和样本数量呈现数据依赖的幂律缩放行为，其幂律指数由目标函数的谱结构决定；随着参数数量变化，系统展现出包含不同缩放区域的相图，并刻画了插值开始等转变点对泛化的影响。；创新点：不同于以往在固定特征或无限宽度条件下研究缩放规律的工作，本文在特征学习模型（feature-learning model）中，联合分析了可训练参数数量与样本数量对泛化缩放的影响，并揭示了由目标谱结构控制的相图与缩放转变。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：对带有ℓ2正则化的二次两层神经网络，在有限样本设定下解析求解经验测试误差最小化问题，得到泛化误差作为样本数、模型宽度和正则化参数的显式表达式。

papers.title: Higher dimensional quantum Hall effect and the analog of $W_\infty$-algebra
papers.abstract: We show that Abelian and nonabelian gauge transformations are the analog of $W_\infty$ transformations for higher dimensional quantum Hall effect. The commutator anomaly and the extended algebra of such transformations on the edge modes of a droplet are obtained by purely topological arguments, basically utilizing the two-cocycle in the descent procedure for anomalies and using the fact that there is anomaly cancellation between the bulk and boundary actions. The method relies on the fact that bulk actions are easily constructed in general using the Dolbeault index theorem. The resulting algebras are shown to agree with explicit edge mode calculations for cases where they are available. We also comment on the similarities and differences in the nature of these transformations between two and higher dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑论证、Dolbeault指标定理、代数结构分析。；研究对象：高维量子霍尔效应中的规范变换与W_∞代数之间的类比关系，以及边缘模上的代数结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 阿贝尔与非阿贝尔规范变换可视为高维量子霍尔效应中W_∞变换的类比；通过纯拓扑论证（利用降序程序中的二上循环以及体-边界作用量之间的反常抵消）得到了边缘模上这些变换的对易子反常及其扩展代数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：阿贝尔与非阿贝尔规范变换可视为高维量子霍尔效应中W_∞变换的类比；通过纯拓扑论证（利用降序程序中的二上循环以及体-边界作用量之间的反常抵消）得到了边缘模上这些变换的对易子反常及其扩展代数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用拓扑场论方法，基于Dolbeault指标定理构建体作用量，并结合反常降序程序与体-边界反常抵消机制推导边缘模代数；在已有显式边缘模计算结果的情形下进行了验证。

papers.title: Hybrid quantum-classical neural network for sample-efficient recognition of topological phases
papers.abstract: With increasing maturity of quantum computers, standard methods for characterizing global properties of their output quantum states via direct measurements and classical post-processing are becoming increasingly impractical due to large measurement costs. Although quantum neural networks could directly process quantum states to identify underlying characteristics with reduced measurement efforts, they often require deep quantum circuits that cannot be implemented on existing devices. To overcome these challenges, we introduce a hybrid quantum-classical neural network that consists of a shallow parameterized quantum circuit, measurements, and a classical neural network. The parameterized quantum circuit performs a nonlocal transformation of the measurement basis, which is jointly trained with the classical neural network to maximize the statistical distance between data obtained by measuring different quantum states. Using supervised learning, we demonstrate that the hybrid neural network distinguishes the topological phase of the surface code from a symmetry-enriched topological phase and random product states. Moreover, this hybrid neural network reduces both inference and training sample complexities of recognizing the topological phase by approximately one order of magnitude compared to a classical neural network trained on randomized Pauli measurements. As this hybrid neural network features a shallow quantum circuit that can be readily implemented on existing quantum computers, it enables the efficient characterization of complex quantum states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+计算）。关键词：hybrid quantum-classical neural network、supervised learning、sample complexity reduction。；研究对象：拓扑相的识别，具体为表面码（surface code）的拓扑相与对称性富集拓扑相（symmetry-enriched topological phase）及随机乘积态（random product states）的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合量子-经典神经网络能以约一个数量级更少的样本（sample complexity）识别拓扑相，且其浅层量子电路可在现有量子计算机上实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合量子-经典神经网络能以约一个数量级更少的样本（sample complexity）识别拓扑相，且其浅层量子电路可在现有量子计算机上实现。；创新点：相比仅基于随机泡利测量（randomized Pauli measurements）的经典神经网络，该混合网络在推理和训练样本复杂度上均降低约一个数量级；同时，浅层量子电路的设计使其可直接在现有量子硬件上运行，克服了深度量子电路难以实现的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 构建一个由浅层参数化量子电路（shallow parameterized quantum circuit）、测量环节和经典神经网络组成的混合模型。量子电路对测量基进行非局域变换，与经典神经网络联合训练以最大化不同量子态测量数据间的统计距离。采用监督学习（supervised learning）进行训练和测试。

papers.title: A single platform with van der Pauw geometry for measurement of Seebeck coefficient, resistivity, and Hall effect of thin films
papers.abstract: A modular thermoelectric properties measurement setup in van der Pauw configuration was developed for a straightforward and simultaneous measurement of electrical resistivity and Seebeck coefficient in an extensive temperature range of 25°C - 600°C and can also perform Hall measurements at room temperature. The setup is optimized for accurate measurement of voltages and temperatures gradients by minimizing possible errors from offset voltages, wire contributions and thermal contact resistances which helps getting reliable data. The setup is user friendly, and the measurements are fully automated and controlled using a LabVIEW program. The detachable modules make this setup quite versatile and provide an all-in-one (except thermal conductivity) solution for thermoelectric measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：measurement setup、developed、measurements、automated、LabVIEW program。；研究对象：薄膜材料的热电输运性质，具体包括塞贝克系数、电阻率和霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种基于范德堡构型的模块化热电性能测量平台，可在25°C至600°C宽温区内同时测量电阻率和塞贝克系数，并能在室温下进行霍尔测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种基于范德堡构型的模块化热电性能测量平台，可在25°C至600°C宽温区内同时测量电阻率和塞贝克系数，并能在室温下进行霍尔测量。；创新点：该平台具有可拆卸模块，提供除热导率外的“一站式”热电测量解决方案，且操作简便、自动化程度高。摘要未突出说明与其他现有装置的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用范德堡（van der Pauw）几何构型搭建测量装置，通过优化电压和温度梯度的测量精度（消除偏移电压、导线贡献和热接触电阻误差），并使用LabVIEW程序实现全自动控制与数据采集。

papers.title: Static features from mixing in short- and long-range Lindbladians: Markov property and correlations
papers.abstract: The classification of mixed-state phases requires criteria beyond two-point correlation functions, such as the decay of the mutual information (MI) and the conditional mutual information (CMI), with the latter encapsulated in the notion of Markov length. Here we show how such static properties of the fixed point of a Lindbladian follow from natural dynamical features of its generators: rapid mixing and frustration-freeness. We focus on systems with long-range interactions, and prove (i) that local Lindbladians satisfying (global) rapid mixing and frustration-freeness have fixed-points whose CMI decays with the shielding distance, and (ii) that (local) rapid mixing together with primitivity and regularity implies global decay of MI. For long-range interactions decaying with a power law with rate $α$, both quantities decay polynomially rather than exponentially, in contrast to the finite- and short-range regimes where exponential decay (a finite Markov length) is expected within a phase. We further show that Gibbs states of long-range, non-commuting Hamiltonians satisfy a local Markov property at any temperatures, extending the recent results (Chen--Rouzé, 2025) for short-range systems to the long-range regime relevant to a variety of experimental platforms. As a numerical example, we study the long-range Ising model both with and without a transverse field. We find regimes in which the polynomial decay of the CMI holds, in accordance with the bounds proven.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要讨论数学证明（prove）、理论推导（bounds proven）和数值示例（numerical example），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：长程相互作用开放量子系统的稳态（fixed point）性质，具体包括长程Lindblad主方程描述的混合态及其马尔可夫性质、互信息和条件互信息的衰减行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于满足快速混合（rapid mixing）和无挫（frustration-freeness）的局域Lindblad生成元，其稳态的条件互信息随屏蔽距离呈多项式衰减（而非短程系统中的指数衰减）；长程非对易哈密顿量的吉布斯态在任意温度下均满足局域马尔可夫性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于满足快速混合（rapid mixing）和无挫（frustration-freeness）的局域Lindblad生成元，其稳态的条件互信息随屏蔽距离呈多项式衰减（而非短程系统中的指数衰减）；长程非对易哈密顿量的吉布斯态在任意温度下均满足局域马尔可夫性质。；创新点：将短程系统中关于马尔可夫长度和条件互信息衰减的结论（如Chen–Rouzé 2025）推广到长程相互作用体系，并证明长程相互作用下指数衰减退化为多项式衰减，适用于多种实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明：利用Lindblad生成元的快速混合性和无挫性推导稳态关联函数的衰减界；数值示例：研究长程伊辛模型（含/不含横场），验证条件互信息的多项式衰减行为。

papers.title: Heterogeneous synaptic motifs bridge microscale structure and macroscale nonlinear dynamics
papers.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in synaptic-resolution network connectomics have revealed that brain circuits feature fine-scale structural connectivity, such as pairs of correlated synaptic couplings known as second-order motifs. Large-scale recordings of neuronal activity in networks containing nonlinear neurons reveal macroscopic heterogeneous population dynamics throughout the brain. These findings rekindle the inquiry into this intriguing question: Can microscale synaptic structures contribute to macroscopic heterogeneous dynamics and computations in ways that canonical brain circuit models cannot? To answer this question, we create random RNNs with various cell types, nonlinear non-negative neural responses, and arbitrary marginal and second-order correlated synaptic statistics. We derive mean-field low-rank equations for P-population networks in which the pre- and postsynaptic neuronal population identities determine the synaptic and motif strengths. Our framework requires 2P latent dynamic variables with P variables describing mean population activity and P variables capturing within-population variability. Theoretical and simulational results demonstrate that chain motifs induce correlations in synaptic variability, enabling microscopic fluctuations to be integrated and influence mesoscopic mean population dynamics. We apply this framework to reverse engineer network connectivity that recapitulates the heterogeneous activity across the population in the mouse primary visual cortex. By bridging the gap between synaptic organization and nonlinear heterogeneous population dynamics, our results offer a principled approach and testable predictions regarding the relationship between fine-scale connectivity, heterogeneous dynamics, and functional computations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：random RNNs、mean-field low-rank equations、theoretical and simulational results。；研究对象：大脑神经回路中的微观突触结构（特别是二阶关联突触基序，如链式基序）如何影响宏观非线性群体动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 链式基序（chain motifs）能够诱导突触变异的相关性，使微观波动得以整合并影响介观平均群体动力学，从而桥接微观突触结构与宏观异质性群体动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：链式基序（chain motifs）能够诱导突触变异的相关性，使微观波动得以整合并影响介观平均群体动力学，从而桥接微观突触结构与宏观异质性群体动力学。；创新点：提出了一个仅需2P个潜在动态变量（P个描述平均群体活动，P个捕获群体内变异）的框架，能够反向工程网络连接以复现小鼠初级视觉皮层中的异质性群体活动，为精细尺度连接、异质性动力学与功能计算之间的关系提供了可检验的预测。
papers.method_zh: 构建具有多种细胞类型、非线性非负神经响应以及任意边际与二阶关联突触统计的随机循环神经网络（RNN）；推导出P群体网络的平均场低秩方程，其中突触与基序强度由前后突触神经元群体身份决定；理论分析与数值模拟相结合。

papers.title: Industry-ready spin-photon interfaces for hybrid photonic quantum computing
papers.abstract: Hybrid photonic quantum computers, combining stationary matter qubits and flying photonic qubits, offer an intrinsically networked and resource-efficient route to large-scale, error-corrected quantum computation. Their core components are cavity-coupled matter qubits that act as light--matter interfaces, enabling: high-efficiency on-demand single-photon generation, stable near-unity photon indistinguishability and spin--multi-photon entanglement. Semiconductor quantum dots in microcavities are a leading platform for realizing such devices. Yet reaching the performance, reproducibility and spin-coherence thresholds for large-scale error correction remains a major challenge requiring industrial fabrication and control. Here we report thousands of monolithic semiconductor quantum-dot devices fabricated using a III--V pilot production-line process compatible with large-scale deployment. Systematic control of source parameters yields state-of-the-art efficiency and supports a path to optical losses below fault-tolerance thresholds. Using field-quadrature state reconstruction as a stringent joint test of efficiency and indistinguishability, we observe near-unity photon quantum purity stable over tens of minutes and a record single-photon Wigner-function negativity. We further demonstrate seven-partite spin--multi-photon entanglement and spin coherence extendable to microsecond timescales in the low-magnetic-field regime. Finally, photons from distant sources are as indistinguishable as photons emitted successively by a single source. These results establish foundry-compatible III--V quantum dots as a scalable platform for hybrid photonic quantum computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“Here we report thousands of monolithic semiconductor quantum-dot devices fabricated...”、“we observe...”、“We further demonstrate...”等实验操作与观测结果。；研究对象：半导体量子点（III-V族量子点）与微腔耦合形成的自旋-光子界面，用于混合光子量子计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过工业级III-V族半导体生产线工艺制备的量子点器件，实现了接近完美的单光子量子纯度、创纪录的Wigner函数负性、七体自旋-多光子纠缠，以及远距离光子与单源光子间的高不可区分性，证明了该平台可规模化用于混合光子量子计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过工业级III-V族半导体生产线工艺制备的量子点器件，实现了接近完美的单光子量子纯度、创纪录的Wigner函数负性、七体自旋-多光子纠缠，以及远距离光子与单源光子间的高不可区分性，证明了该平台可规模化用于混合光子量子计算。；创新点：首次将工业级（foundry-compatible）III-V族量子点生产线工艺应用于自旋-光子界面器件的规模化制备，并系统验证了其性能达到容错量子计算所需阈值，同时实现了远距离光子与单源光子间的高不可区分性。
papers.method_zh: 采用III-V族半导体试产线工艺（pilot production-line process）进行大规模单片量子点器件制备；使用场正交态重构（field-quadrature state reconstruction）联合测试效率与不可区分性；通过Wigner函数负性表征单光子量子纯度；在低磁场条件下测量自旋相干性并演示七体自旋-多光子纠缠。

papers.title: Fault tolerant computation of the static structure factor and finite size effects
papers.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum algorithms offer a promising pathway for estimating the ground-state energies of periodic materials that are beyond the practical reach of classical electronic-structure methods. A remaining challenge is finite-size mitigation: quantum algorithms evaluate a finite supercell or finite Brillouin-zone mesh, while materials properties are defined in the thermodynamic limit. In this work we develop a quantum post-processing strategy for the leading two-body finite-size correction. After one-body shell effects are reduced by twist averaging, the dominant residual error is controlled by long-wavelength density fluctuations, which are encoded in the small-momentum static structure factor $S(q)$. We formulate the corresponding operator in a Bloch-orbital basis, construct its block encoding through the density operator, and estimate its ground-state expectation value using an amplified Hadamard test. We also introduce adaptive global and local binary search procedures for identifying the infrared fitting window used to reconstruct the two-body finite size error correction. The resulting cost remains subleading relative to the main ground-state energy estimation routine: the structure-factor correction has leading $\tilde{O}(N_bN_k)^3$ dependence on the Bloch-orbital basis size, avoids the large plane-wave prefactor of full Hamiltonian simulation, and requires only $\tilde{O}(N_bN_k)$ logical qubits. This provides a fault-tolerant alternative to down-sampling, replacing repeated energy calculations on larger cells with targeted measurements of the infrared density correlations that control the finite-size effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“fault-tolerant quantum algorithms”、“quantum post-processing strategy”、“block encoding”、“Hadamard test”，属于量子算法与凝聚态理论交叉研究。；研究对象：周期性材料在热力学极限下的静态结构因子（static structure factor）及其有限尺寸效应（finite-size effects），具体关注长波长密度涨落对两体有限尺寸修正的控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种容错量子后处理策略，通过测量小动量静态结构因子 $S(q)$ 来主导两体有限尺寸误差修正，从而避免对更大超胞进行重复能量计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种容错量子后处理策略，通过测量小动量静态结构因子 $S(q)$ 来主导两体有限尺寸误差修正，从而避免对更大超胞进行重复能量计算。；创新点：提供了容错量子计算中有限尺寸修正的替代方案：用针对红外密度关联的目标测量替代传统下采样（down-sampling）方法，避免了全哈密顿量模拟的大平面波预因子，且计算成本（$\tilde{O}(N_bN_k)^3$ 和 $\tilde{O}(N_bN_k)$ 逻辑量子比特）相对于主基态能量估计程序是次主导的。
papers.method_zh: 基于布洛赫轨道基（Bloch-orbital basis）构建静态结构因子算符，利用密度算符实现其块编码（block encoding），并通过放大阿达马测试（amplified Hadamard test）估计基态期望值；引入自适应全局与局部二分搜索（adaptive global and local binary search）以确定红外拟合窗口，用于重建两体有限尺寸误差修正。

papers.title: Self-organized robustness in mean-field interacting systems
papers.abstract: Self-organization is a defining feature of living systems, with order often maintained through interactions between constituent units rather than centralized feedback. We introduce a tractable mean-field model of self-organized robustness, formulated as meta-optimization over the system's response to perturbations. The resulting interaction structure has an intuitive picture as a dynamically modulated landscape (``seascape'') whose shape is determined self-consistently to accelerate relaxation back to equilibrium. The collective dynamics follows an optimized Wasserstein gradient flow toward an attractor in the space of collective states. When communication is limited, interactions preferentially encode slowly relaxing modes and modes that are frequently perturbed. The model further shows that robust collective states are associated with flatter equilibrium landscapes and predicts a continuum of intermediate ``reservoir states'' in such systems. The model offers a perspective of self-organization as a hierarchical associative memory that operates on the scale of a collective of interacting computational units.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mean-field model、meta-optimization、Wasserstein gradient flow。；研究对象：自组织鲁棒性（self-organized robustness）的统计物理模型，具体为平均场相互作用系统中的集体动力学与平衡态恢复机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自组织鲁棒性可表述为对系统扰动响应的元优化，其相互作用结构形成一种自洽确定的动态调制景观（“海景”），能加速系统向平衡态的弛豫；当通信受限时，相互作用优先编码慢弛豫模式和频繁受扰模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自组织鲁棒性可表述为对系统扰动响应的元优化，其相互作用结构形成一种自洽确定的动态调制景观（“海景”），能加速系统向平衡态的弛豫；当通信受限时，相互作用优先编码慢弛豫模式和频繁受扰模式。；创新点：将自组织鲁棒性统一为一种元优化框架，并揭示其与层次化联想记忆（hierarchical associative memory）的等价性，预测了平坦平衡景观与连续“储备态”（reservoir states）的存在。
papers.method_zh: 构建可解析的平均场模型，将自组织鲁棒性形式化为对系统扰动响应的元优化问题；利用Wasserstein梯度流描述集体态空间中的吸引子动力学；通过自洽条件确定相互作用结构。

papers.title: Soft QED as Open Quantum System: Infrared Cancellation and Soft-Shell Coarse Graining
papers.abstract: I formulate unresolved soft-photon sector of QED as open quantum system. Resolved charged particles and hard photons form the system, unresolved soft photons form the environment, and basic object is the reduced density matrix. A resolved outcome $f$ of multiple hard particles and photons has probability $P_{f}(i) =\sum_n|\langle f,n|S|i,0\rangle|^2=\langle i|F_f|i\rangle$, with Kraus operators $K_n= {}_{\rm soft} \langle n|S|0 \rangle_{\rm soft}$ and effect $F_f=\sum_nK_n^\daggerΠ_fK_n$. The SK formulation places unresolved virtual and real terms in one doubled-contour expansion. At one loop they carry the same on-shell eikonal kernel with opposite signs. This elegantly organizes the QED probability: for the same observable, perturbative order, diagrams, and phase space, the OQS gives the same infrared-finite terms as the full-QED. The soft-photon evolution is a unitary coherent-state displacement driven by the scattering current. The equal-history identity of influence functional exactly normalizes this soft evolution; together with the soft-photon theorem it removes the IR divergent leading-soft factor from inclusive probability. I also derive explicit leading-soft QED realization of scale-parametrized Lindblad evolution on a fixed hard-branch space. Tracing an infinitesimal soft-photon shell produces diagonal jump operators whose entries are fixed by the corresponding eikonal emission amplitudes. The finite-shell map is a completely positive unital Schur channel and, in the sharp scale-invariant leading-soft regime, a dephasing semigroup of a completely-positive-divisible scale flow. The resulting logarithmic visibility slope and monotonic purity loss are off-diagonal predictions of the reduced-state description. The same controlled-displacement dilation gives the Sudakov probability, Poisson soft-photon multiplicities, and the bremsstrahlung number spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“formulate”（构建）、“SK formulation”（SK形式）、“OQS gives”（开放量子系统给出）、“derive”（推导）等理论构建和推导的词汇。；研究对象：量子电动力学（QED）中未分辨的软光子部分，将其作为开放量子系统进行研究。具体物理现象是QED中的红外发散问题及其消除。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将未分辨的软光子视为环境，构建开放量子系统框架，可以优雅地组织QED概率计算，并得到与完整QED相同的红外有限项。通过影响泛函的等历史恒等式和软光子定理，可以从包含性概率中移除红外发散的领头软因子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将未分辨的软光子视为环境，构建开放量子系统框架，可以优雅地组织QED概率计算，并得到与完整QED相同的红外有限项。通过影响泛函的等历史恒等式和软光子定理，可以从包含性概率中移除红外发散的领头软因子。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的对比，但核心创新在于：1）将QED中未分辨的软光子部分系统性地构建为一个开放量子系统，并利用其形式体系（如Kraus算符、Lindblad方程）重新组织红外发散问题的处理。2）明确展示了在领头软近似下，该框架如何自然地产生退相半群、对数可见度斜率和单调纯度损失等约化态描述的预言。
papers.method_zh: 开放量子系统（OQS）理论框架，具体包括：使用约化密度矩阵作为基本对象；引入Kraus算符和效应算符描述可分辨末态的概率；采用Schwinger-Keldysh（SK）形式处理未分辨的虚、实软光子；利用相干态位移描述软光子演化；推导了尺度参数化的Lindblad演化方程；使用完全正定单比特Schur信道描述有限壳层映射。

papers.title: Sampling the Schwinger Model with Gauge-Equivariant Diffusion
papers.abstract: We present a first study of a diffusion-based approach to accelerated sampling of the $N_f = 2$ lattice Schwinger model. Our work is inspired by recent and growing successes in developing such generative models for ensemble generation in LFT to overcome the well-known critical slowing down problem. We train a U(1)-equivariant score-based generative model to sample gauge link configurations from the marginal Schwinger model. By computing model likelihoods, we obtain unbiased estimates for observables that closely match those produced by MCMC simulations. We also demonstrate improvement over HMC as measured qualitatively by a reduction in topological freezing near critical parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：diffusion-based approach、generative models、MCMC simulations、HMC。；研究对象：N_f = 2 格点 Schwinger 模型（二维量子电动力学）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于 U(1) 规范等变扩散的生成模型能够高效采样格点规范场构型，产生的可观测量无偏估计与 MCMC 模拟结果高度一致，并在临界参数附近相比 HMC 表现出拓扑冻结的减轻。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于 U(1) 规范等变扩散的生成模型能够高效采样格点规范场构型，产生的可观测量无偏估计与 MCMC 模拟结果高度一致，并在临界参数附近相比 HMC 表现出拓扑冻结的减轻。；创新点：首次将扩散模型应用于格点 Schwinger 模型的加速采样，并利用规范等变性（U(1)-equivariant）提升生成模型的物理一致性。
papers.method_zh: 训练 U(1) 规范等变的基于分数的生成模型（score-based generative model），用于从边缘 Schwinger 模型中采样规范链接构型，并通过计算模型似然获得可观测量无偏估计。

papers.title: A General Pipeline for Digesting Scientific Literature into a Shared Scientific Knowledge Base
papers.abstract: The published scientific literature is a rich, continuously growing record of measurements, correlations, and observations that modern AI tools can now make accessible in new ways. The Materials Explorer Pipeline digests collections of scientific papers into a structured, queryable database, producing sample records with full provenance and confidence, making them interactively explorable, and surfacing hypothesis candidates for scientist review. Each extracted record is a self-contained, portable unit of knowledge, carrying the measurements, research details, and source citations needed to use and cite the data appropriately. The Pipeline is demonstrated on recent superconducting qubit materials literature of the Co-design Center for Quantum Advantage, a DOE National Quantum Information Science Research Center, producing a corpus of 233 samples across 10 material classes. The Pipeline architecture is domain-agnostic and designed to be readily portable to other scientific domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（方法学/工具开发）。判断依据：论文描述了一个通用的“Pipeline”（流水线/流程），用于消化科学文献，属于方法论和工具开发，并进行了案例演示。；研究对象：论文研究的对象并非特定的物理材料或现象，而是**科学文献本身**，特别是**超导量子比特材料**领域的文献。其目标是构建一个结构化的科学知识库。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出并演示了一个名为“Materials Explorer Pipeline”的通用流程，该流程能够将科学文献自动消化并转化为一个结构化、可查询、带有完整溯源和置信度的知识库，并从中提取出可供科学家审查的假设候选。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出并演示了一个名为“Materials Explorer Pipeline”的通用流程，该流程能够将科学文献自动消化并转化为一个结构化、可查询、带有完整溯源和置信度的知识库，并从中提取出可供科学家审查的假设候选。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于提出了一个**领域无关的通用流水线架构**，能够将非结构化的科学文献转化为结构化的、可交互探索的知识库，并自动生成假设候选，从而将AI工具应用于科学知识的发现和整合。摘要未突出说明与传统文献综述或手动数据库构建相比的具体性能提升。
papers.method_zh: 论文主要采用**自然语言处理（NLP）**和**信息抽取**技术，构建了一个自动化流水线。具体方法包括：从论文中提取测量数据、研究细节和引用信息，并将其组织成自包含、可移植的知识单元（样本记录）。该方法在**超导量子比特材料**文献上进行了演示。

papers.title: Large Fluctuations in Open Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: We study statistics of atypical measurement outcomes in the steady states of driven open quantum systems. In equilibrium, the probability distribution over the phase space, as encoded in, e.g., the Wigner function, is analytic in the phase-space coordinates. We show that this property is generically lost in driven dissipative systems: their {\it large-deviation function} develops lines and surfaces across which its derivatives are discontinuous. As an illustrative example, we consider a parametrically driven Kerr oscillator coupled linearly and/or nonlinearly to a dissipative bath. Rare fluctuations in the amplitude and phase of the induced oscillations are governed by semiclassical instanton trajectories of the corresponding Keldysh-Lindblad action. We demonstrate that a given fluctuation can be realized through multiple distinct instanton trajectories. The competition between these trajectories leads to abrupt switching of the dominant instanton and, consequently, to non-analytic features in the large-deviation function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：large-deviation function、semiclassical instanton trajectories、Keldysh-Lindblad action。；研究对象：开放量子系统中稳态下非典型测量结果的统计特性，具体以参数驱动Kerr振子（与耗散浴线性/非线性耦合）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在驱动耗散系统中，大偏差函数（large-deviation function）会出现导数不连续的线或面，即失去解析性；特定涨落可通过多个不同的瞬子（instanton）轨迹实现，这些轨迹之间的竞争导致主导瞬子的突然切换，从而产生大偏差函数的非解析特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在驱动耗散系统中，大偏差函数（large-deviation function）会出现导数不连续的线或面，即失去解析性；特定涨落可通过多个不同的瞬子（instanton）轨迹实现，这些轨迹之间的竞争导致主导瞬子的突然切换，从而产生大偏差函数的非解析特征。；创新点：揭示了平衡态下相空间概率分布（如Wigner函数）的解析性在驱动耗散系统中普遍丧失，并首次通过多瞬子轨迹竞争机制解释了大偏差函数中的非解析行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于Keldysh-Lindblad作用量的半经典瞬子轨迹分析，研究驱动耗散量子系统稳态中振幅和相位涨落的统计。

papers.title: Range-controlled entanglement in Lindbladian skin states of monitored fermions
papers.abstract: Reservoir engineering can stabilize states inaccessible to unitary dynamics. Directed particle-conserving dissipation creates Lindbladian skin states, where Pauli exclusion turns edge accumulation into a many-body density imbalance. In a monitored fermion chain with tunable hopping range, we identify, within a Gaussian trajectory approximation, two finite-size scaling regimes: short-range hopping is consistent with complete skin accumulation and area-law entanglement, whereas sufficiently long-range hopping produces a finite bulk tail and effective algebraic sub-volume-law entanglement. Dissipation and coherent hopping thus jointly control skin localization and quantum entanglement, highlighting their close interconnection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Gaussian trajectory approximation、finite-size scaling regimes、理论分析）；研究对象：受监测费米子链中的Lindbladian skin态，具体研究可调跳跃范围下耗散与相干跳跃共同控制的纠缠特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 短程跳跃导致完全的边界累积和面积律纠缠，而足够长程跳跃产生有限体态拖尾和有效的亚体积律纠缠，表明耗散与相干跳跃共同调控skin局域化与量子纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：短程跳跃导致完全的边界累积和面积律纠缠，而足够长程跳跃产生有限体态拖尾和有效的亚体积律纠缠，表明耗散与相干跳跃共同调控skin局域化与量子纠缠。；创新点：揭示了在粒子数守恒耗散驱动的Lindbladian skin态中，通过调控跳跃范围可实现从面积律到亚体积律纠缠的转变，并建立了skin局域化与纠缠之间的紧密关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用高斯轨迹近似（Gaussian trajectory approximation）进行理论分析，研究有限尺寸标度行为。

papers.title: Dirac fermions in non-Hermitian magnetic fields: Zero modes and index theorem
papers.abstract: In a Lorentz symmetric non-Hermitian (NH) Dirac theory, containing the canonical relativistic Hamiltonian accompanied by a masslike anti-Hermitian Dirac operator, when the associated NH parameter becomes spatially modulated it couples massless Dirac fermions as NH gauge fields. With specific choices of such resulting NH gauge potential, the system experiences NH magnetic fields. When a planar Dirac system encloses a finite flux of such NH magnetic fields, a manifold of spatially localized \emph{right or left} zero-energy eigenmodes appear in the spectrum, which we numerically anchor from microscopic realizations of NH magnetic fields on graphene's honeycomb lattice. Potential experimental platforms to test these predictions are discussed. Altogether, zero-energy NH flat bands of right or left modes promise fascinating future realizations of NH magnetic catalysis, strongly-coupled NH fractional topological phases, and NH chiral anomaly, to name a few.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“Lorentz symmetric non-Hermitian Dirac theory”、“numerically anchor from microscopic realizations”等关键词，表明主要基于理论框架推导，并辅以数值模拟验证。；研究对象：非厄米磁场中的狄拉克费米子，具体以石墨烯的蜂窝晶格作为微观实现平台，研究零能模及其与指标定理（index theorem）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当非厄米参数空间调制产生非厄米磁场时，平面狄拉克系统在该磁场的有限通量下会出现空间局域的“右”或“左”零能本征模，形成零能非厄米平带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当非厄米参数空间调制产生非厄米磁场时，平面狄拉克系统在该磁场的有限通量下会出现空间局域的“右”或“左”零能本征模，形成零能非厄米平带。；创新点：首次将非厄米磁场与狄拉克费米子的零能模及指标定理联系起来，并预言了非厄米磁催化、强耦合非厄米分数量子拓扑相及非厄米手征反常等未来可能实现的新物理现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含类质量反厄米狄拉克算子的洛伦兹对称非厄米狄拉克理论框架，通过将非厄米参数空间调制视为非厄米规范场，构造非厄米磁场；并在石墨烯蜂窝晶格上对非厄米磁场的微观实现进行数值模拟，以确认零能模的存在。

papers.title: Hidden-ordered Dirac fermions
papers.abstract: I propose a Hermitian extension of the Lorentz-symmetric Dirac theory by complementing the associated Hamiltonian with another \emph{masslike} anticommuting Dirac operator. The resulting theory manifests the iconic linear energy-momentum relationship in any dimension ($d$) and hence the emergent nodal quasiparticle excitations are named \emph{hidden-ordered Dirac fermions}, which are symmetry protected and their responses are analogous to those in original Dirac systems, however, in terms of a renormalized (due to the hidden ordering) Fermi velocity. Typically, such a hidden ordering pushes any quantum phase transition into an insulation toward even stronger coupling in any $d>1$. However, depending on the internal algebra between the candidate insulating order parameter and masslike Dirac operator, the hidden-ordering may survive or disappear near the corresponding itinerant quantum critical point. I construct lattice models for such hidden-ordered massless Dirac fermions and outline promising platforms (numerical and experimental) to test these predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“I propose”、“I construct”、“outline promising platforms”，以及全文为理论推导和模型构建，未提及实验或计算数据。；研究对象：一种新型的狄拉克费米子体系，称为“隐藏序狄拉克费米子”（hidden-ordered Dirac fermions），其核心是提出了一种洛伦兹对称的狄拉克理论的厄米扩展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入一个额外的反交换质量型狄拉克算符，可以构造出具有线性色散关系的隐藏序狄拉克费米子，其行为类似于原始狄拉克系统但费米速度被重整化；这种隐藏序在d>1维中会将量子相变推向绝缘相，且在巡游量子临界点附近可能存续或消失，取决于内部代数结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入一个额外的反交换质量型狄拉克算符，可以构造出具有线性色散关系的隐藏序狄拉克费米子，其行为类似于原始狄拉克系统但费米速度被重整化；这种隐藏序在d>1维中会将量子相变推向绝缘相，且在巡游量子临界点附近可能存续或消失，取决于内部代数结构。；创新点：提出了一种新的狄拉克费米子实现方式——通过隐藏序（hidden ordering）而非传统质量项来产生线性色散，并揭示了该隐藏序对量子临界点行为的独特影响（如将相变推向更强耦合的绝缘相）。摘要未突出说明与已有具体模型或实验的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于厄米扩展的狄拉克哈密顿量，引入反交换质量型狄拉克算符；构建晶格模型；分析对称性保护、重整化费米速度、量子相变行为及内部代数关系。

papers.title: 3D Imaging of Complex Skyrmion and Hopf Topologies in an Extended Sample
papers.abstract: Spin textures are key for emergent magnetic phenomena such as topological protection and underpin novel spintronic device paradigms based on racetrack memory, logic gates, and neuromorphic computing. Using a coherent diffractive imaging technique called vector ptycho-tomography, in combination with algorithms that are robust to noise, we image the 3D magnetic texture of skyrmion and Hopf topologies with no prior assumptions about the sample. This directly reveals experimentally for the first time an extended 3D skyrmion lattice, including the domain wall shape, topological charge, helicity, and Hopf index. Our findings demonstrate experimentally that dipole stabilized skyrmions in Fe/Gd multilayers exhibit barrel-shaped skyrmion tubes with a twisted helicity, transitioning from N$é$el-type winding at the surfaces to both clockwise and counterclockwise Bloch-type winding in the bulk, that can also be described as fractional hopfions. We image a lattice of 24 skyrmions with topological charge 1, average depth-dependent domain wall width of 23 to 40 nm, depth-dependent twisted helicity from $\pm$155$°$ to $\pm$30$°$, and fractional Hopf index of $\pm$0.3. Over 10 TB of data were analyzed to yield a fully-resolved 3D reconstruction over a >0.4 $μ$m$^3$ volume, with high fidelity down to the Nyquist limit of 8 nm. This method fills a key gap in the current landscape of magnetic imaging by enabling high-resolution, element-specific 3D reconstructions of full-field extended spin textures - offering a new route for exploring the topological complexity of magnetic materials in three dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用“coherent diffractive imaging technique called vector ptycho-tomography”进行实验成像，并分析大量实验数据（over 10 TB of data）。；研究对象：Fe/Gd多层膜中由偶极子稳定的斯格明子（skyrmion）和霍普夫子（Hopf）拓扑自旋纹理的三维磁结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实验揭示了扩展三维斯格明子晶格，发现斯格明子管呈桶状且具有扭曲的螺旋度，从表面的Néel型缠绕过渡到体相的顺时针和逆时针Bloch型缠绕，可描述为分数霍普夫子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实验揭示了扩展三维斯格明子晶格，发现斯格明子管呈桶状且具有扭曲的螺旋度，从表面的Néel型缠绕过渡到体相的顺时针和逆时针Bloch型缠绕，可描述为分数霍普夫子。；创新点：填补了当前磁成像领域的关键空白，首次实现了对全视野扩展自旋纹理的高分辨率、元素特异性三维重建，直接实验观测了斯格明子晶格的畴壁形状、拓扑电荷、螺旋度和霍普夫子指数。
papers.method_zh: 矢量叠层断层扫描（vector ptycho-tomography）结合对噪声鲁棒的算法，实现了无先验假设的三维磁纹理成像，空间分辨率达到奈奎斯特极限8 nm。

papers.title: Specific absorption rate of uniaxial single-domain nanomagnets: stochastic spin dynamics versus linear response theory
papers.abstract: We compute the specific absorption rate of a uniaxial single-domain nanomagnet driven by an alternating magnetic field by two methods: i) direct numerical integration of the stochastic (Langevin) Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation (the LLL approach), and ii) linear response theory (LRT) based on the Debye susceptibility with the Néel relaxation time $τ_\mathrm{N}$. We first analytically show that both methods are equivalent for small magnetic field amplitude, and then compute their deviation $Λ\equiv \mathrm{SAR}_{\mathrm{LLL}}/\mathrm{SAR}_{\mathrm{LRT}}-1$ as a function of the magnetic field amplitude for two temperatures chosen on opposite sides of the Debye resonance. One of the main results is that the sign and magnitude of $Λ$ are governed by the dimensionless product $ωτ_\mathrm{N}$, in addition to the linearity parameter $ξ=μ_{s}B_{0}/k_{B}T$ for the easy-axis geometry considered here. Indeed, below resonance ($ωτ_\mathrm{N}<1$), linear response theory overestimates the specific absorption rate. In contrast, above resonance ($ωτ_\mathrm{N}>1$, the regime typical of blocked nanoparticles), linear response theory can underestimate the specific absorption rate by up to $\sim70\%$ at $ξ\sim2$. We expect this work to provide quantitative guidance for the use of linear response theory in magnetic hyperthermia and related nanoscale heat-transport problems, and to serve as a single-particle benchmark for extensions to many-spin and interacting systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：直接数值积分随机（Langevin）Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程（LLL方法），以及基于Debye磁化率与Néel弛豫时间的线性响应理论（LRT）。；研究对象：单轴单畴纳米磁体在交变磁场驱动下的比吸收率（SAR）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 线性响应理论对SAR的预测偏差由无量纲乘积ωτ_N（频率与Néel弛豫时间的乘积）主导：在共振以下（ωτ_N<1）时高估SAR，在共振以上（ωτ_N>1，即阻塞纳米颗粒典型区域）时可能低估SAR高达约70%（在ξ~2时）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：线性响应理论对SAR的预测偏差由无量纲乘积ωτ_N（频率与Néel弛豫时间的乘积）主导：在共振以下（ωτ_N<1）时高估SAR，在共振以上（ωτ_N>1，即阻塞纳米颗粒典型区域）时可能低估SAR高达约70%（在ξ~2时）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1）直接数值积分随机Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程（LLL方法）；2）基于Debye磁化率与Néel弛豫时间τ_N的线性响应理论（LRT）。通过解析推导证明两者在小磁场振幅下等价，并数值计算了偏差Λ随磁场振幅的变化。

papers.title: Exact subsystem dynamics in the deterministic Floquet-PXP model
papers.abstract: The dynamics of local subsystems in a thermodynamically large quantum many-body system can be understood as effectively open as the system produces its own effective bath. The action of this bath can be characterised in terms of the so-called influence matrices.
