In generic situations, the complexity of these objects grows unfavourably with time, however, there exist solvable cases where influence matrices can be characterised exactly even in the presence of non-trivial interactions. Here we show that Rule 201, a deterministic version of the Floquet-PXP model, is one of these solvable instances. Indeed, it admits influence matrices given by a finite-dimensional matrix-product operator (MPO) that solves a finite set of algebraic conditions. We provide the solution, and characterise multi-time autocorrelation functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论的是量子多体系统的动力学、影响矩阵、矩阵乘积算符等理论概念，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：确定性Floquet-PXP模型（Rule 201）中的局域子系统动力学，具体研究该模型下子系统如何被自身产生的有效环境（bath）影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定性Floquet-PXP模型（Rule 201）是少数可精确求解的相互作用多体系统之一，其影响矩阵可由有限维矩阵乘积算符（MPO）精确描述，该MPO满足一组有限的代数条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定性Floquet-PXP模型（Rule 201）是少数可精确求解的相互作用多体系统之一，其影响矩阵可由有限维矩阵乘积算符（MPO）精确描述，该MPO满足一组有限的代数条件。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过构造影响矩阵的矩阵乘积算符（MPO）表示，并求解其满足的代数条件，从而精确刻画子系统动力学；同时计算了多时间自关联函数。

papers.title: Proactivity and pinning in the non-reciprocal XY model with vision anisotropy
papers.abstract: We study a non-reciprocal XY model on a square lattice, in which spins interact with their nearest neighbors through vision-induced anisotropic interaction. Such anisotropy breaks rotational symmetry and leads to the pinning of the spin orientation along preferred lattice directions. We systematically characterize this phenomenon for different interaction kernels, including modulated, sinusoidal, von Mises, and hard vision-cone couplings, and for two classes of microscopic update rules: Glauber and Langevin dynamics. A central result of this work is the identification and detailed analysis of two distinct contributions that naturally arise in the Langevin formulation, which we refer to as the reactive and the proactive term. We derive the corresponding equations governing both local fluctuations and the global orientation, and use them to characterize the mechanisms responsible for directional pinning. We show that both reactive and proactive contributions can generate global pinning, whereas their role in determining local pinning depends on the specific interaction kernel and may differ qualitatively. Our analysis clarifies the distinction between local and global pinning, explains the emergence of preferred lattice directions in the different models considered, and reconciles apparent discrepancies reported in previous studies. More generally, it provides a microscopic framework for understanding lattice-induced orientational selection in non-reciprocal XY models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We study, derive, characterize, provides a microscopic framework。；研究对象：非互易XY模型（non-reciprocal XY model），具体研究该模型中由视觉各向异性（vision anisotropy）导致的钉扎（pinning）现象，以及由此产生的方向选择性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别并详细分析了朗之万动力学框架下自然产生的两种不同贡献——反应项（reactive term）和主动项（proactive term），并证明两者都能产生全局钉扎，而它们在决定局部钉扎中的作用则依赖于具体的相互作用核，且可能定性不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别并详细分析了朗之万动力学框架下自然产生的两种不同贡献——反应项（reactive term）和主动项（proactive term），并证明两者都能产生全局钉扎，而它们在决定局部钉扎中的作用则依赖于具体的相互作用核，且可能定性不同。；创新点：首次在非互易XY模型中明确区分并系统分析了“反应项”和“主动项”对方向钉扎的不同贡献，阐明了局部钉扎与全局钉扎的区别，并解释了不同模型中择优晶格方向的出现，调和了先前研究中看似矛盾的结论。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。在正方晶格上构建具有视觉诱导各向异性最近邻相互作用的非互易XY模型，采用多种相互作用核（调制型、正弦型、冯·米塞斯型、硬视觉锥耦合）和两种微观更新规则（Glauber动力学和Langevin动力学）进行系统研究。推导了控制局部涨落和全局取向的方程。

papers.title: Weak-Flow Induced Dielectric Axes Rotation in Dipolar Suspensions
papers.abstract: Conventional rheodielectric studies of dipolar suspensions primarily examine flow-induced variations in the principal permittivity components. In contrast, an asymptotic solution of the perturbed Fokker--Planck equation for orientable Brownian dipoles under weak flow predicts the emergence of off-diagonal permittivity components that are linear in the relative flow strength. For planar shear flow, these terms exceed the corresponding higher-order diagonal corrections, leading to a rotation of the principal dielectric axes. This previously unrecognized rheodielectric response suggests new possibilities for flow-controlled dielectric and electro-optical functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“asymptotic solution of the perturbed Fokker--Planck equation”（扰动福克-普朗克方程的渐近解）表明该工作基于理论推导。；研究对象：偶极悬浮液（dipolar suspensions）中可定向布朗偶极子（orientable Brownian dipoles）在弱流动下的介电响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱剪切流动下，偶极悬浮液会出现与流动强度线性相关的非对角介电常数分量，导致主介电轴发生旋转。这一效应此前未被认识。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱剪切流动下，偶极悬浮液会出现与流动强度线性相关的非对角介电常数分量，导致主介电轴发生旋转。这一效应此前未被认识。；创新点：发现了弱流动诱导的主介电轴旋转效应，该效应源于非对角介电常数分量（与流动强度线性相关）超过相应的高阶对角修正项，为流动控制的介电和电光功能提供了新可能性。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过求解受弱流动扰动的福克-普朗克方程（Fokker-Planck equation）的渐近解，分析可定向布朗偶极子在平面剪切流中的介电张量变化。

papers.title: Strong coupling between propagating spin wave and microwave photons in a superconducting resonator
papers.abstract: We demonstrate strong coupling between propagating spin wave modes and microwave photons in superconducting resonator-magnetic thin film hybrid circuits. By fabricating the resonator directly on yttrium iron garnet thin films grown on rare-earth-free Y$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$ substrates, we achieve strong coupling of both Damon-Eshbach and backward-volume spin wave modes to the resonator, with coupling strengths exceeding both the magnon and photon damping rates. Furthermore, we observe nonreciprocal spin wave radiation of the hybrid magnonic mode in the Damon-Eshbach configuration, highlighting the potential for incorporating intrinsic spin-wave nonreciprocity into hybrid magnonic systems. These results open new avenues for integrating spin-wave magnonics with cavity magnonics, and for harnessing spin waves for potential applications in quantum information science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、fabricating、observe、coupling strengths exceeding。；研究对象：超导谐振器-磁性薄膜混合电路中的传播自旋波模式与微波光子之间的强耦合现象。具体材料为钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜生长在无稀土Y₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂衬底上，并直接在其上制备超导谐振器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了Damon-Eshbach和backward-volume两种自旋波模式与超导谐振器的强耦合，耦合强度超过磁振子和光子阻尼率；在Damon-Eshbach构型中观察到混合磁振子模式的非互易自旋波辐射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了Damon-Eshbach和backward-volume两种自旋波模式与超导谐振器的强耦合，耦合强度超过磁振子和光子阻尼率；在Damon-Eshbach构型中观察到混合磁振子模式的非互易自旋波辐射。；创新点：首次在超导谐振器-磁性薄膜混合电路中实现传播自旋波模式（而非局域磁振子模式）与微波光子的强耦合，并利用自旋波固有的非互易性（Damon-Eshbach构型）实现混合模式的非互易辐射，为自旋波磁子学与腔磁子学的集成提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：将超导谐振器直接制备在YIG薄膜上，通过测量耦合系统的微波响应来表征自旋波-光子耦合强度及非互易辐射特性。

papers.title: Field theories for Laplacian Growth
papers.abstract: Loop-erased random walks (LERW), the $O(n)$-model at ${n=-2}$ and Laplacian random walks (LRW) are three realizations of the same random process. While this equivalence holds on any graph, renormalization is possible only via the $O(-2)$-model. To generalize LRWs to $b$-LRWs or to Diffusion Limited Aggregation (DLA), a field theory directly on the Laplacian growth process is necessary. Here we construct an exact lattice action for LRWs and show that its perturbative expansion equals that of LERWs. We then generalize this approach to $b$-LRWs and DLA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“构建精确格点作用量”“微扰展开”“场论”等理论方法关键词。；研究对象：拉普拉斯生长过程（Laplacian growth），具体包括：环擦除随机游走（LERW）、O(n)模型在n=-2时的特例、拉普拉斯随机游走（LRW）及其推广形式b-LRW和扩散限制聚集（DLA）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了拉普拉斯随机游走（LRW）的精确格点作用量及其微扰展开与环擦除随机游走（LERW）等价，并将该场论方法推广至b-LRW和扩散限制聚集（DLA）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了拉普拉斯随机游走（LRW）的精确格点作用量及其微扰展开与环擦除随机游走（LERW）等价，并将该场论方法推广至b-LRW和扩散限制聚集（DLA）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建了拉普拉斯随机游走的精确格点场论作用量，通过微扰展开证明其与环擦除随机游走的等价性，并进一步将这一场论框架推广到b-LRW和DLA过程。

papers.title: Investigation on the temperature dependence of substrate-induced in-plane uniaxial magnetic anisotropy in Ni thin films grown on 128° Y-cut LiNbO3
papers.abstract: We report the temperature dependence of the substrate-induced magnetic anisotropy in continuous Ni thin films deposited at room temperature using magnetron sputtering on a 128° Y-cut LiNbO3 substrate. Ultrathin films exhibit a pronounced temperature dependence in magnetization, with as-grown films showing isotropic behavior and an unconventional hysteresis branch crossing at relatively low temperatures, whereas no branch crossing is observed in annealed films over the investigated temperature range, indicating suppression of the underlying mechanism. Temperature-dependent magnetization measurements show that post-deposition annealing establishes uniaxial anisotropy with well-defined easy and hard axes, whose strength evolves with temperature due to the nature of residual strain governed by both lattice mismatch and coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) mismatch between the Ni film and the 128° Y-cut substrate, independent of film thickness for both 5 nm and 100 nm films. The emergence of this anisotropy following annealing indicates enhanced magnetoelastic coupling at the film-substrate interface, as the magnetic response begins to follow the anisotropic strain imposed by lattice mismatch and CTE mismatch.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magnetron sputtering（磁控溅射）、magnetization measurements（磁化测量）、deposition（沉积）、annealing（退火）。；研究对象：连续Ni薄膜（厚度5 nm和100 nm）生长在128° Y切LiNbO3衬底上，研究衬底诱导的面内单轴磁各向异性随温度的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 退火处理在Ni薄膜中建立了明确的单轴磁各向异性，其强度随温度变化，源于Ni膜与LiNbO3衬底之间晶格失配和热膨胀系数失配共同决定的残余应变；而未经退火的超薄薄膜在低温下表现出反常的磁滞回线分支交叉现象，退火后该现象被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：退火处理在Ni薄膜中建立了明确的单轴磁各向异性，其强度随温度变化，源于Ni膜与LiNbO3衬底之间晶格失配和热膨胀系数失配共同决定的残余应变；而未经退火的超薄薄膜在低温下表现出反常的磁滞回线分支交叉现象，退火后该现象被抑制。；创新点：揭示了退火处理对Ni/128° Y-cut LiNbO3体系中衬底诱导磁各向异性的关键调控作用，特别是退火后各向异性的出现与磁弹耦合增强的关联，以及低温下未退火薄膜中反常磁滞回线分支交叉现象的发现与抑制。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁控溅射在室温下沉积Ni薄膜；通过温度依赖的磁化测量（具体技术摘要未明确说明，可能为振动样品磁强计或超导量子干涉仪）表征各向异性；对比了as-grown（生长态）与annealed（退火态）样品的磁行为；分析了5 nm和100 nm两种厚度薄膜。

papers.title: Light-driven active phase separation and droplet division
papers.abstract: Phase separation organizes matter across scales, yet how it operates under sustained energy input remains poorly understood. Experimental approaches to driven phase separation have largely relied on chemically fueled systems, in which reaction fluxes are intrinsically coupled to fuel consumption and reaction-network complexity. Here we show that continuous molecular switching alone is sufficient to generate active phase behavior in a minimal two-phase system. Using light-responsive DNA-azobenzene coacervates confined in microfluidic droplets, we modulate intermolecular interactions with spatiotemporal precision and quantitatively track phase separation dynamics under illumination. Light-driven azobenzene isomerization controls both thermodynamics and kinetics, setting phase boundaries and regulating dissolution and nucleation rates. Under single-wavelength illumination that couples forward and backward isomerization into a dynamic photostationary state, coarsening is arrested and micron-sized coacervates are stabilized. When the two photoisomerization pathways are driven independently, spatially unbalanced reaction fluxes generate sustained interfacial instabilities, including surface undulations, budding, and division. These behaviors arise from a physical coupling between reaction kinetics and phase separation, without chemical fuels or biochemical regulation. Our results show that non-equilibrium phase behavior is governed by how opposing reaction fluxes are imposed, establishing reversible molecular switching as a minimal route to active materials from equilibrium building blocks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimental approaches、microfluidic droplets、light-driven、quantitatively track。；研究对象：光驱动的活性相分离现象，具体体系为光响应DNA-偶氮苯凝聚液滴（coacervates）在微流控液滴中的相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅通过连续分子开关（无需化学燃料或生化调控）即可实现活性相分离行为，包括粗化停滞、表面波动、出芽和液滴分裂，且这些行为由反应动力学与相分离的物理耦合决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅通过连续分子开关（无需化学燃料或生化调控）即可实现活性相分离行为，包括粗化停滞、表面波动、出芽和液滴分裂，且这些行为由反应动力学与相分离的物理耦合决定。；创新点：首次证明仅依靠可逆分子开关（而非化学燃料或复杂反应网络）即可驱动非平衡相分离行为，并揭示了反应通量的空间不平衡如何产生界面不稳定性（如分裂）。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：微流控液滴技术（confined in microfluidic droplets）结合光响应DNA-偶氮苯凝聚液滴；通过单波长或双波长光照精确调控偶氮苯异构化，实时追踪相分离动力学。

papers.title: Organic Semiconductor Alignment via Confinement in Vapor-Guided Droplets
papers.abstract: Organic semiconductors are lightweight, solution-processable materials with strong potential for printed and flexible electronics, from deformable displays to wearable sensors. Despite significant advances in materials synthesis and manufacturing, controlling molecular and mesoscale alignment during deposition remains a central challenge, as film morphology critically governs charge transport and device performance. Here, we demonstrate that flows developing within the intrinsically confined volume of microliter vapor-guided droplets can be harnessed to produce highly aligned organic semiconductor films. As droplets move in response to an external vapor source, internal flows align organic semiconducting nanowires within the droplet prior to deposition, yielding films with pronounced directional order. Organic field-effect transistors fabricated with this approach exhibit approximately 40% enhancement in saturation current relative to spin-coated controls. Beyond improved device performance, the contactless and compact nature of our method enables the deposition and alignment of organic semiconductors on curved and flexible surfaces. More broadly, vapor-guided droplets offer a scalable framework for the confinement-induced alignment of functional soft materials, with potential for integration into existing additive manufacturing platforms for flexible electronics and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体实验过程（如“vapor-guided droplets”“spin-coated controls”）、器件制备（“organic field-effect transistors”）及性能测试（“saturation current”提升40%）。；研究对象：有机半导体薄膜的分子与介观尺度取向排列（alignment），具体材料为有机半导体纳米线（organic semiconducting nanowires），以及基于该薄膜的有机场效应晶体管。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用微升级蒸汽引导液滴（vapor-guided droplets）在受限体积内产生的内部流动，可在沉积前使有机半导体纳米线定向排列，从而制备出具有显著方向性有序的薄膜，并使场效应晶体管的饱和电流相比旋涂法提升约40%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用微升级蒸汽引导液滴（vapor-guided droplets）在受限体积内产生的内部流动，可在沉积前使有机半导体纳米线定向排列，从而制备出具有显著方向性有序的薄膜，并使场效应晶体管的饱和电流相比旋涂法提升约40%。；创新点：提出一种非接触、紧凑的液滴受限流动诱导取向方法，可在曲面和柔性基底上实现有机半导体的沉积与取向排列，并具备与现有增材制造平台集成的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：蒸汽引导液滴沉积技术（vapor-guided droplet deposition），通过外部蒸汽源驱动液滴运动，利用液滴内部流动实现纳米线预排列；器件表征：有机场效应晶体管（OFET）电学性能测试（饱和电流对比）；对比方法：旋涂法（spin-coating）。

papers.title: Finite temperature precursors of Mottness in the Fermi Hubbard model
papers.abstract: We investigate finite-temperature precursors of Mottness in the repulsive Hubbard model above the spin-ordering temperature, using numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo. We show that the finite-temperature crossover is accompanied by a pronounced suppression of charge fluctuations, despite the presence of a gapless single-particle spectra, demonstrating that Mottness first emerges via two-particle response in an anomalous metallic regime, before appearing in single-particle spectral functions. We further show that a gap formation in the density of states occurs through momentum-resolved redistribution of spectral weight across the Brillouin zone, that begins at the onset of anomalous metallic regime, rather than through gap formation in single-particle spectral functions at individual momenta. Upon doping, the anomalous-metallic regime generates transport and spectroscopic signatures characteristic of doped Mott insulators. This shows that the transport and spectroscopic anomalies of the doped Hubbard model do not require the presence of a fully formed Mott insulator at half-filling, but instead originate from the strong charge-response renormalization and spectral-weight redistribution that develop within the precursor anomalous metallic regime at half-filling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了“numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo”（数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛）方法。；研究对象：费米哈伯德模型（Fermi Hubbard model）中，在自旋有序温度以上、有限温度下的“Mottness”（莫特绝缘体特征）前驱现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单粒子谱仍为无能隙的“反常金属态”中，莫特绝缘体特征首先通过双粒子响应（电荷涨落的显著抑制）出现，而非通过单粒子谱函数。态密度中的能隙形成源于布里渊区内动量分辨的谱权重重新分布，该过程始于反常金属态的开端，而非单个动量点上的单粒子谱函数出现能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单粒子谱仍为无能隙的“反常金属态”中，莫特绝缘体特征首先通过双粒子响应（电荷涨落的显著抑制）出现，而非通过单粒子谱函数。态密度中的能隙形成源于布里渊区内动量分辨的谱权重重新分布，该过程始于反常金属态的开端，而非单个动量点上的单粒子谱函数出现能隙。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinant quantum Monte Carlo, DQMC）模拟。

papers.title: An integrable approach to macroscopic fluctuation theory for the multispecies SSEP
papers.abstract: We study the macroscopic fluctuation theory (MFT) of a multispecies generalization of the symmetric simple exclusion process (mSSEP) on the infinite line, in which particles of $N+1$ species -- including, possibly, a vacancy species -- exchange positions at unit rate. Working with the full, redundant set of coarse-grained densities $\bfrho=\{ρ_0,\dots,ρ_N\}$ keeps the relabelling symmetry of the model manifest throughout. We first extend the argument of Derrida and Gerschenfeld to the multispecies setting, showing that the cumulant generating function of the multispecies current between two regions of an arbitrary graph depends on the boundary densities $ \bfrho_L,\bfrho_R$ and on the fugacities $\bflambda$ only through a single scalar variable $ω$. We then formulate the MFT saddle-point equations for the mSSEP on the infinite line and show that they define an integrable system: they are of Landau--Lifshitz type, and a Zakharov--Takhtajan gauge transformation recasts them in AKNS form. Solving the resulting linear scattering problem by the inverse scattering method, we recover the cumulant generating function $F(ω)$ for the multispecies current, as well as the initial and final density profiles conditioned on a prescribed current fluctuation. In particular, we show that $F(ω)$ coincides with the function obtained by Derrida and Gerschenfeld for the single-species SSEP, now derived for an arbitrary number of species directly from the integrable structure of the multispecies MFT equations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论“宏观涨落理论（MFT）”、“可积系统”、“逆散射方法”等理论框架，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：多物种对称简单排斥过程（mSSEP）在无限长直线上的宏观涨落理论。该模型包含N+1种粒子（包括空穴），粒子间以单位速率交换位置。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多物种SSEP的MFT鞍点方程构成一个可积系统（Landau-Lifshitz型），通过Zakharov-Takhtajan规范变换可化为AKNS形式；利用逆散射方法求解后，发现多物种电流的累积生成函数与Derrida和Gerschenfeld先前得到的单物种SSEP结果完全相同，与物种数目无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多物种SSEP的MFT鞍点方程构成一个可积系统（Landau-Lifshitz型），通过Zakharov-Takhtajan规范变换可化为AKNS形式；利用逆散射方法求解后，发现多物种电流的累积生成函数与Derrida和Gerschenfeld先前得到的单物种SSEP结果完全相同，与物种数目无关。；创新点：首次将多物种SSEP的MFT鞍点方程与可积系统（AKNS层次）直接联系起来，并利用逆散射方法严格求解，从而将单物种SSEP的经典结果（Derrida和Gerschenfeld）自然推广到任意物种数，且证明累积生成函数形式不变。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：首先将Derrida和Gerschenfeld的论证推广到多物种情形，证明任意图上两区域间多物种电流的累积生成函数仅依赖于边界密度和逸度通过单一标量变量ω；然后建立无限长直线上mSSEP的MFT鞍点方程，识别其可积结构（Landau-Lifshitz型），通过Zakharov-Takhtajan规范变换转化为AKNS线性散射问题，最后用逆散射方法求解，得到累积生成函数及条件密度分布。

papers.title: Phase-Shifted Planar Hall and Magnetoresistive Responses in Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: The planar Hall resistivity and magnetoresistivity of Weyl semimetals are conventionally expected to exhibit $\sin 2φ$ and $\cos2φ$ angular dependences, respectively, where $φ$ is the angle between electric and magnetic fields. However, experiments reveal shifted extrema in the planar Hall signal and sign reversals in magnetoresistivity at $φ< π/4$. Here, using a diagrammatic Kubo-formula approach, we identify an intrinsic quadratic magnetic-field contribution to the planar transport response that is absent in conventional semiclassical description. This contribution introduces an additional term proportional to $\cos 2 φ$ and $\sin 2φ$, respectively, in transverse and longitudinal conductivities. Consequently, both planar Hall and magnetoresistive responses acquire a phase-shifted form $\sin 2(φ+φ_r)$ and $\cos 2(φ+φ_r)$, respectively. The same phase shift extracted independently from longitudinal and transverse responses quantitatively describes available experimental data. Our results establish a microscopic origin of the anomalous angular dependence observed in Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用“diagrammatic Kubo-formula approach”（图解Kubo公式方法）进行理论推导，并分析实验数据。；研究对象：Weyl半金属中的平面霍尔效应和磁电阻响应，具体关注其反常的角度依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一个传统半经典描述中缺失的、与磁场平方成正比的固有贡献，该贡献导致平面霍尔和磁电阻响应出现相位偏移，即其角度依赖关系变为 $\sin 2(φ+φ_r)$ 和 $\cos 2(φ+φ_r)$。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一个传统半经典描述中缺失的、与磁场平方成正比的固有贡献，该贡献导致平面霍尔和磁电阻响应出现相位偏移，即其角度依赖关系变为 $\sin 2(φ+φ_r)$ 和 $\cos 2(φ+φ_r)$。；创新点：首次从微观理论上识别并解释了导致Weyl半金属中平面霍尔信号极值偏移和磁电阻符号反转的固有机制，即一个与磁场平方成正比的贡献，该贡献在传统半经典理论中被忽略。
papers.method_zh: 图解Kubo公式方法（diagrammatic Kubo-formula approach），用于计算横向和纵向电导率。

papers.title: Unraveling Internal Friction in a Coarse-Grained Protein Model
papers.abstract: Understanding the dynamic behavior of complex biomolecules requires simplified models that not only make computations feasible but also reveal fundamental mechanisms. Coarse-graining (CG) achieves this by grouping atoms into beads, whose stochastic dynamics can be derived using the Mori-Zwanzig formalism, capturing both reversible and irreversible interactions. In liquid, the dissipative bead-bead interactions have so far been restricted to hydrodynamic couplings. However, friction does not only arises from the solvent but notably, from the internal degrees of freedom missing in the CG beads. This leads to an additional ''internal friction'' whose relevance is studied in this contribution. By comparing with all-atom molecular dynamics (MD), we neatly show that in order to accurately reproduce the dynamics of a globular protein in water using a coarse-grained (CG) model, not only a precise determination of elastic couplings and the Stokesian self-friction of each bead is required. Critically, the inclusion of internal friction between beads is also necessary for a faithful representation of protein dynamics. We propose to optimize the parameters of the CG model through a self-averaging method that integrates the CG dynamics with an evolution equation for the CG parameters. This approach ensures that selected quantities, such as the radial distribution function and the time correlation of bead velocities, match the corresponding MD values.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：coarse-grained model, all-atom molecular dynamics, Mori-Zwanzig formalism, 参数优化）；研究对象：球状蛋白质在水溶液中的动力学行为，具体关注粗粒化模型中由缺失内部自由度引起的“内摩擦”效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 为了准确再现全原子分子动力学模拟中球状蛋白质的动力学行为，粗粒化模型不仅需要精确确定弹性耦合和每个珠子的斯托克斯自摩擦，还必须包含珠子之间的内摩擦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：为了准确再现全原子分子动力学模拟中球状蛋白质的动力学行为，粗粒化模型不仅需要精确确定弹性耦合和每个珠子的斯托克斯自摩擦，还必须包含珠子之间的内摩擦。；创新点：明确揭示了在粗粒化蛋白质模型中，除了溶剂摩擦和自摩擦外，珠子间的内摩擦对于忠实再现蛋白质动力学是必要的，并提出了相应的参数优化方案。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于Mori-Zwanzig形式论的粗粒化建模方法，通过自平均方法优化粗粒化参数，该参数演化方程与粗粒化动力学方程耦合，使径向分布函数和珠子速度时间关联函数等选定量匹配全原子分子动力学模拟结果。

papers.title: Connection between the GKSL master equation and the Landauer formula
papers.abstract: We derive a current formula within the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equation formalism for a non-interacting system, and identify the conditions under which it reduces to the Landauer formula.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive”（推导）、“formalism”（形式理论）、“conditions”（条件）。；研究对象：非相互作用系统中的量子输运现象，具体关注GKSL主方程形式与Landauer公式之间的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非相互作用系统中，从GKSL主方程形式出发可以推导出一个电流公式，并明确了该公式在何种条件下会简化为Landauer公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非相互作用系统中，从GKSL主方程形式出发可以推导出一个电流公式，并明确了该公式在何种条件下会简化为Landauer公式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。具体使用了Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) 主方程形式论。

papers.title: Magnetoresistance in chiral systems driven by inter-band spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: Chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS), in which electrons transmitted through nonmagnetic chiral materials exhibit strong spin-dependent transport, has attracted growing interest for spintronic applications. However, a quantitative understanding of CISS remains elusive, partly because most previous studies rely on single-band models. In this work, we theoretically investigate multi-band effects on magnetoresistance (MR)-CISS, which is typically observed in experiments using magnetic conductive atomic force microscopy. To evaluate the spin polarization in MR-CISS, we simulate the nonequilibrium steady-state current using the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad master equation. We find that spin polarization exceeding 25% can be achieved for realistic inter-band spin-orbit coupling strengths in the presence of on-site Coulomb interactions. These findings highlight the crucial role of inter-band spin-orbit coupling in the mechanism of CISS.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、simulate、master equation。；研究对象：手性体系中的磁电阻（MR-CISS）现象，具体为手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）中的多能带效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在存在在位库仑相互作用时，对于实际的能带间自旋-轨道耦合强度，可实现超过25%的自旋极化，揭示了能带间自旋-轨道耦合在CISS机制中的关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在存在在位库仑相互作用时，对于实际的能带间自旋-轨道耦合强度，可实现超过25%的自旋极化，揭示了能带间自旋-轨道耦合在CISS机制中的关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad主方程模拟非平衡稳态电流，以评估MR-CISS中的自旋极化。

papers.title: Low-energy model for doped graphene nanoribbons
authors: H. S. J. van der Zant
papers.abstract: We analyse in this article the many-body behavior of free-standing doped graphene nanoribbons where the chemical potential lies inside the bulk single-particle bands. We perform an exact mapping from both an extended and an on-site Hubbard model of the ribbons to a Kanamori model, which includes ferromagnetic exchange and pair-hopping interactions. We determine the resulting Coulomb matrix elements analytically, and identify their scaling behavior as a function of ribbon width and length. We propose a low-energy version of the Kanamori Hamiltonian to address the response of the ribbons to external fields, with a view to their use as transport channels in nanoelectronics. We find that the model and the proposed ribbon parameters can produce open-shell, high-spin many-body states that can lead to shell- and spin-blockade responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact mapping、analytically、low-energy model、Hamiltonian。；研究对象：掺杂石墨烯纳米带（doped graphene nanoribbons）中的多体行为，特别是化学势位于体单粒子带内的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将扩展和局域Hubbard模型精确映射为包含铁磁交换和配对跳跃相互作用的Kanamori模型，发现该模型及所提出的纳米带参数可以产生开壳层、高自旋的多体态，进而导致壳层阻塞和自旋阻塞响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将扩展和局域Hubbard模型精确映射为包含铁磁交换和配对跳跃相互作用的Kanamori模型，发现该模型及所提出的纳米带参数可以产生开壳层、高自旋的多体态，进而导致壳层阻塞和自旋阻塞响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确映射方法，将扩展Hubbard模型和局域Hubbard模型映射为Kanamori模型；解析计算库仑矩阵元并识别其随纳米带宽度和长度的标度行为；提出低能Kanamori哈密顿量。

papers.title: High temperature transitions in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates La$_{n+1}$Ni$_{n}$O$_{3n+1}$
papers.abstract: The discovery of superconductivity at $15\,\mathrm{K}$ in the infinite-layer nickelate $(\mathrm{Nd},\mathrm{Sr})\mathrm{NiO}_2$, followed by superconductivity at $80\,\mathrm{K}$ in the Ruddlesden--Popper phase $\mathrm{La}_3\mathrm{Ni}_2\mathrm{O}_7$, has ushered in a new era of nickelate research. Despite this progress, large discrepancies between reports exist. Here, we investigate the complete series of bulk-stable $\mathrm{La}_{n+1}\mathrm{Ni}_n\mathrm{O}_{3n+1}$ compounds using a comprehensive set of experimental techniques, including PXRD, single-crystal XRD, electron microscopy, heat capacity, differential scanning calorimetry, magnetic susceptibility, and transport measurements, over a broad temperature range from $2$ to $1000\,\mathrm{K}$. By studying high-quality single crystals, we identify a previously underappreciated high-temperature phase transition in Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates $\mathrm{La}_{n+1}\mathrm{Ni}_n\mathrm{O}_{3n+1}$ distinct from the one going to a tetragonal phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用了多种实验技术（PXRD、单晶XRD、电子显微镜、热容、差示扫描量热、磁化率、输运测量）。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper相镍氧化物La_{n+1}Ni_nO_{3n+1}系列化合物（n=1,2,3,...）的高温相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐La_{n+1}Ni_nO_{3n+1}中，发现了一个此前未被充分认识的高温相变，该相变不同于已知的向四方相的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐La_{n+1}Ni_nO_{3n+1}中，发现了一个此前未被充分认识的高温相变，该相变不同于已知的向四方相的转变。；创新点：识别并报道了Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐中一个此前被忽视的高温相变，该相变与已知的四方相转变不同。
papers.method_zh: 综合运用了粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）、单晶X射线衍射、电子显微镜、热容测量、差示扫描量热法、磁化率测量以及输运测量，温度范围覆盖2 K至1000 K，研究对象为高质量单晶。

papers.title: Spin-orbit coupling driven topological superconductivity in twisted bilayer graphene-WSe$_2$ heterostructures
papers.abstract: Commencing from the low-energy Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model of twisted bi-layer graphene (tBLG) with proximity-induced Ising, Rashba, and intrinsic spin-orbit couplings (SOCs), we construct the corresponding Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian with conventional $s$-wave pairing and theoretically investigate the emergence of topological superconductivity in it. The latter can possibly be experimentally demonstrated in tBLG, Niobium and tungsten diselenide heterostructures. The topological superconducting phases, bearing an effective $p$-wave pairing profile and exhibiting inverted band dispersion, are protected by a bulk gap and are topologically characterized by Chern numbers. In the absence of intrinsic SOC, variation of the twist angle and other SOC strengths yield extended gapless, trivial, and topological phases, with phase boundaries exactly matching the closing of direct band gaps. The topological regime exhibits clear band inversion in the combined particle-hole and spin space, along with distinct Bloch localization profiles compared to the trivial phase. Including intrinsic SOC generates additional topological phases and eliminates the gapless phase, indicating the enhanced stability of the gapped topological superconducting regime in tBLG.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：关键词“construct... Hamiltonian”、“theoretically investigate”、“characterized by Chern numbers”。；研究对象：扭曲双层石墨烯（tBLG）与二硒化钨（WSe₂）构成的异质结，具体研究其中由自旋-轨道耦合驱动的拓扑超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控邻近诱导的Ising、Rashba和本征自旋-轨道耦合强度以及扭转角，可以在具有s波配对的扭曲双层石墨烯-WSe₂异质结中实现由Chern数表征的拓扑超导相。本征自旋-轨道耦合的引入可以消除无带隙相，增强拓扑超导相的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控邻近诱导的Ising、Rashba和本征自旋-轨道耦合强度以及扭转角，可以在具有s波配对的扭曲双层石墨烯-WSe₂异质结中实现由Chern数表征的拓扑超导相。本征自旋-轨道耦合的引入可以消除无带隙相，增强拓扑超导相的稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于低能Bistritzer-MacDonald连续模型，构建包含邻近诱导Ising、Rashba和本征自旋-轨道耦合以及常规s波配对的Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量，通过计算Chern数、能带结构、布洛赫局域化轮廓等性质来表征拓扑超导相。

papers.title: Odd transport in a two-temperature Brownian dimer
papers.abstract: We investigate a two-temperature Brownian dimer with odd mobility, characterized by antisymmetric transport coefficients, as a controlled paradigm for odd nonequilibrium dynamics. The system is made of two harmonically confined particles coupled by an elastic spring and connected to reservoirs at different temperatures. Odd mobility converts conservative forces into transverse motion, linking heat exchange to circulating probability currents without requiring external torques, spatial anisotropy, or nonconservative driving. Our exact solution shows that odd mobility creates handed correlations between the two particles while leaving the individual particle distributions isotropic. These correlations arise only when temperature imbalance, elastic coupling, and odd mobility act together, and their handedness reverses when the odd response is reversed. The steady probability current contains two distinct parts: the ordinary irreversible current of a two-temperature dimer and an additional handed contribution generated by odd mobility. When projected onto the motion of each particle, this handed contribution becomes a pair of counter-rotating circulating currents inside the traps. Based on the currents we compute the heat transfer and entropy production analytically. We show that odd mobility enhances thermal conductance between the reservoirs, while the net heat current and total dissipation remain unchanged under reversal of the odd handedness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、exact solution、analytically、theoretical framework。；研究对象：一种双温度布朗二聚体（two-temperature Brownian dimer），其中粒子具有奇迁移率（odd mobility），表现为反对称输运系数，用于研究奇非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇迁移率在温度不平衡、弹性耦合和奇迁移率共同作用下，在两个粒子之间产生手征关联，并在每个粒子的陷阱内产生一对反向旋转的循环概率流，同时增强储热器之间的热导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇迁移率在温度不平衡、弹性耦合和奇迁移率共同作用下，在两个粒子之间产生手征关联，并在每个粒子的陷阱内产生一对反向旋转的循环概率流，同时增强储热器之间的热导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过精确求解双温度布朗二聚体的动力学方程，解析计算稳态概率流、热传递和熵产生。

papers.title: Local and nonlocal STM transport signatures of spin polarization in second order topological superconductors
papers.abstract: We investigate numerically the spin and transport properties of two-dimensional second-order topological superconductors (2D SOTSCs) hosting a pair of Majorana corner states (MCSs). First, we show that MCSs in the considered setup are characterized by a distinct spatial distribution of electronic spin polarization in the direction perpendicular to an applied in-plane magnetic field, with opposite signs for each MCS. Such a property can be used to label MCSs in a pair by their electronic spin. We propose a comprehensive spin-resolved transport protocol for measuring such a spin texture and further detecting the braiding (exchange) of a pair of MCSs, a crucial prerequisite for topological quantum computing. To be specific, we show that the magnitude of local conductance and the sign of nonlocal conductance are precisely linked to the sign of the electronic part of the MCS spin density and the spin polarization of the probe. Moreover, we show that the proposed technique can be used to detect the spin density profile of higher-energy quasiparticle states, e.g., edge states hosted in the SOTSC. We showed that all analyzed features are highly robust to strong static disorder , which makes our findings a clear experimental pathway to verify the spin structure of MCS and other quasiparticles hosted in SOTSCs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We investigate numerically”（我们进行了数值研究）。；研究对象：二维二阶拓扑超导体（2D SOTSCs）中的马约拉纳角态（MCSs）及其自旋极化性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现二阶拓扑超导体中的一对马约拉纳角态具有垂直于外加面内磁场方向的自旋极化空间分布，且两个角态的自旋极化符号相反。该自旋纹理可通过局域和非局域的自旋分辨扫描隧道显微镜（STM）输运信号进行测量，并用于探测马约拉纳角态的编织（交换）过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现二阶拓扑超导体中的一对马约拉纳角态具有垂直于外加面内磁场方向的自旋极化空间分布，且两个角态的自旋极化符号相反。该自旋纹理可通过局域和非局域的自旋分辨扫描隧道显微镜（STM）输运信号进行测量，并用于探测马约拉纳角态的编织（交换）过程。；创新点：提出了一个完整的自旋分辨输运测量方案，将局域电导的大小和非局域电导的符号与马约拉纳角态的自旋密度及探针的自旋极化直接关联起来，为实验上区分和操控马约拉纳角态（特别是用于拓扑量子计算的编织操作）提供了清晰的实验路径。摘要未突出说明与已有理论工作的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟。具体方法摘要未明确说明，但根据研究内容推断，可能涉及基于紧束缚模型的输运计算（如格林函数方法）和自旋极化计算。

papers.title: Physical Neural Networks Need Nonlinearity, Amplification, and Suppression for Learning
papers.abstract: The exponential growth in energy consumption of artificial intelligence systems has spurred interest in physical computing paradigms that exploit the relaxation of physical systems toward steady states. However, many existing physical networks are fundamentally linear and incapable of performing nonlinear operations crucial for meaningful machine learning tasks. Here we use simulations to show that nonlinearity alone is insufficient; physical learning systems must also support signal amplification and suppression to perform nontrivial computations. We present physically plausible circuit designs that incorporate these essential features, enabling effective nonlinear information processing. Our findings clarify the limitations of linear physical networks and provide guidance for developing energy-efficient physical learning architectures capable of general machine learning tasks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：simulations、physically plausible circuit designs）；研究对象：物理神经网络（physical neural networks），特别是基于物理系统稳态弛豫的计算架构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 物理学习系统仅具备非线性是不够的，还必须支持信号放大与抑制功能，才能执行有意义的机器学习任务。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：物理学习系统仅具备非线性是不够的，还必须支持信号放大与抑制功能，才能执行有意义的机器学习任务。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟（simulations）研究物理网络的计算能力，并设计具有物理可实现性的电路方案（physically plausible circuit designs）。

papers.title: Electric-Field Switchable Magnetic Spin Hall Effect
papers.abstract: It is established that the polarity of a time-reversal-odd ($\mathcal{T}$-odd) physical quantity can be reversed under the $\mathcal{T}$ operation. Here, we use the spin-group analysis to directly demonstrate that the $\mathcal{T}$-odd magnetic spin Hall effect in ferroelectric altermagnets can be switchable by electric fields beyond the $\mathcal{T}$ operation. This arises from the ferroelectric switching of the nonrelativistic spin splitting, which swaps the roles of spin up and down channels in the reciprocal space. As a result, the $\mathcal{T}$-odd spin conductivity that are proportional to the spin-polarized conductivity difference reverses its polarity upon polarization switching. We identify spin-group operations to switch both the polarization and the magnetic spin Hall effect simultaneously for non-centrosymmetric spin point groups. Then, we exemplify those phenomena in the ferroelectric altermagnet VOI$_2$ monolayer based on density functional theory calculations and an effective Hamiltonian analysis. Our findings not only provide novel strategies to switch the magnetic spin Hall effect using the dissipation-free electric field but also open a promising avenue for electrically programmable spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算验证）。判断依据：spin-group analysis、density functional theory calculations、effective Hamiltonian analysis。；研究对象：铁电交变磁体（ferroelectric altermagnets）中的电场可切换磁自旋霍尔效应（Electric-Field Switchable Magnetic Spin Hall Effect），具体材料为VOI₂单层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁电交变磁体中，通过电场翻转铁电极化，可以非磁性地切换时间反演奇（𝒯-odd）磁自旋霍尔效应的极性，其物理根源在于非相对论自旋劈裂的极化翻转导致倒空间中自旋上、下通道角色互换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁电交变磁体中，通过电场翻转铁电极化，可以非磁性地切换时间反演奇（𝒯-odd）磁自旋霍尔效应的极性，其物理根源在于非相对论自旋劈裂的极化翻转导致倒空间中自旋上、下通道角色互换。；创新点：首次提出利用无耗散电场而非磁场或自旋极化电流来切换磁自旋霍尔效应，为电可编程自旋电子器件提供了新策略。
papers.method_zh: 自旋群分析（spin-group analysis）、基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算、有效哈密顿量分析（effective Hamiltonian analysis）。

papers.title: Coexistence of static order and spin dynamics in an S = 5/2 frustrated triangular antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: Frustrated triangular-lattice antiferromagnets in the classical high-spin limit provide a paradigmatic setting in which the interplay of competing exchange interactions, anisotropy, and collective degrees of freedom can lead to unconventional low-energy excitations, anomalous criticality, and persistent dynamical responses. Here, we present comprehensive thermodynamic, $μ$SR, and neutron diffraction experiments, along with first-principles calculations, on a triangular-lattice antiferromagnet, MnSnB$_2$O$_6$, where Mn$^{2+}$ ($S=5/2$) moments form a nearly perfect 2D triangular network without any anti-site disorder. The Curie-Weiss fit to the magnetic susceptibility yields a moderate Curie-Weiss temperature of $-12$ K, indicating dominant antiferromagnetic interactions between Mn$^{2+}$ moments, which is supported by first-principles calculations. Specific-heat measurements reveal the onset of long-range magnetic order at $T_{\rm N}\approx 1$ K, which is ascribed to intraplane exchange interactions. The specific heat exhibits pronounced short-range correlations above $T_{\rm N}$ and an unconventional power-law behavior, $C\propto T^{1.37}$, deep in the ordered state, suggesting the presence of non-trivial low-energy excitations. Zero-field $μ$SR experiments down to 50~mK confirm the presence of magnetic ordering below $T_{\rm N}$, in agreement with thermodynamic and neutron diffraction experiments. The $μ$SR measurements detect persistent spin dynamics coexisting with static magnetic order. The temperature evolution of the order parameter down to 50~mK from neutron diffraction suggests that the ordered state is consistent with a 3D Ising-like antiferromagnet. This family of archetypal frustrated magnets offers a promising venue for the experimental realization of emergent phenomena governed by competing exchange interactions and exotic low-energy excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：thermodynamic, μSR, neutron diffraction experiments, first-principles calculations）；研究对象：三角晶格反铁磁体 MnSnB₂O₆，其中 Mn²⁺（S=5/2）形成近乎完美的二维三角网络，无反位无序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 MnSnB₂O₆ 中，静态磁有序与持续自旋动力学共存，且有序态表现出非平凡的低能激发（比热呈幂律行为 C ∝ T^{1.37}）和三维 Ising 型反铁磁特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 MnSnB₂O₆ 中，静态磁有序与持续自旋动力学共存，且有序态表现出非平凡的低能激发（比热呈幂律行为 C ∝ T^{1.37}）和三维 Ising 型反铁磁特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 热力学测量（磁化率、比热）、μSR（零场）、中子衍射实验，以及第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Quasiclassical theory of nonlinear response in d-wave superconductors
papers.abstract: We use a self-consistent Keldysh--Nambu quasiclassical theory to study two related nonlinear phenomena in clean d-wave superconductors: the photo-induced static correction to the order parameter -- the Eliashberg effect -- and third-harmonic generation. Both follow from a systematic perturbative solution of the out-of-equilibrium Eilenberger equation for the Keldysh propagator. For the steady-state correction to the pairing amplitude we find that at temperatures close to the critical temperature and to leading order in the gap magnitude $Δ$, the photo-induced change of the order parameter is zero at all drive frequencies: in contrast to s-wave superconductors, a clean d-wave superconductor exhibits no Eliashberg enhancement at this order. The gap-enhancing quasiparticle-redistribution channel that drives the effect in the s-wave case is suppressed by an additional power of $Δ$ in the d-wave case. For third-harmonic generation we find that the charge-density-fluctuation (particle--hole) channel significantly dominates the Schmid--Higgs amplitude-mode contribution over a broad frequency range, the two becoming comparable only in a narrow window near the resonance frequency $ω\approx 2\sqrt{2}\,Δ$ if one neglects the diamagnetic part of the current in the normal state. We trace this to the nonequilibrium dynamics of nodal quasiparticles, which must be retained explicitly and which also makes the response sensitive to the orientation of the driving field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quasiclassical theory（准经典理论）、Keldysh–Nambu formalism（Keldysh–Nambu形式）、Eilenberger equation（Eilenberger方程）、perturbative solution（微扰解）。；研究对象：d波超导体中的非线性响应现象，具体包括：光致静态序参量修正（Eliashberg效应）和三次谐波产生。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在干净d波超导体中，接近临界温度时，光致序参量变化在领先阶为零，即不存在类似s波超导体的Eliashberg增强；三次谐波产生中，电荷密度涨落（粒子-空穴）通道在宽频率范围内显著主导Schmid–Higgs振幅模贡献，两者仅在共振频率附近窄窗口内可比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在干净d波超导体中，接近临界温度时，光致序参量变化在领先阶为零，即不存在类似s波超导体的Eliashberg增强；三次谐波产生中，电荷密度涨落（粒子-空穴）通道在宽频率范围内显著主导Schmid–Higgs振幅模贡献，两者仅在共振频率附近窄窗口内可比。；创新点：揭示了d波超导体中Eliashberg效应在领先阶被抑制的机制（节点准粒子的重分布通道被额外Δ幂次压制），并指出三次谐波产生中节点准粒子的非平衡动力学必须显式保留，且响应依赖于驱动场取向。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽的Keldysh–Nambu准经典理论，通过系统微扰求解非平衡Eilenberger方程（针对Keldysh传播子），分析d波超导体的非线性响应。

papers.title: Rashba and Electrostatic Control of Charge-Visible Spin Demons in Two-Dimensional d-Wave Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Spin demons in d-wave altermagnets are acoustic collective modes formed by nearly out-of-phase oscillations of spin-split quasiparticle populations. Their weak net charge fluctuation makes them long lived, but also makes them difficult to access with charge-sensitive probes. We propose a route to tune and brighten these modes in a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet by combining Rashba spin-orbit coupling with electrostatic gate screening. Rashba coupling converts the spin-conserving problem into a generalized charge-spin response problem, in which mixed susceptibilities between density and spin channels become finite. As a result, the originally charge-dark longitudinal spin demon acquires finite charge spectral weight while remaining predominantly spin-like. Electrostatic gate screening provides an independent control of the Coulomb feedback and tunes the collectivemode dispersion and quality factor. Within a Rashba-altermagnetic continuum model and randomphase approximation, we show that the spin-demon ridge survives moderate spin-orbit mixing, develops a finite charge-visibility ratio, and retains dominant Sz character over the relevant control range. Parameter scans in Rashba strength and gate distance reveal a trade-off between charge visibility and mode quality, identifying regimes where the excitation remains underdamped while becoming more accessible to charge probes. These results establish Rashba spin-orbit coupling and electrostatic screening as control mechanisms for tunable, charge-visible spin demons in twodimensional altermagnetic platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：continuum model、random phase approximation、parameter scans。；研究对象：二维d波交变磁体（d-wave altermagnet）中的自旋恶魔（spin demon）集体模式，以及通过Rashba自旋轨道耦合和静电栅极调控实现其电荷可见性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Rashba自旋轨道耦合使原本电荷暗态的自旋恶魔获得有限电荷谱权重，同时保持主要自旋特征；静电栅极屏蔽可独立调控库仑反馈，从而调节集体模式的色散与品质因子，在欠阻尼条件下实现电荷可见性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Rashba自旋轨道耦合使原本电荷暗态的自旋恶魔获得有限电荷谱权重，同时保持主要自旋特征；静电栅极屏蔽可独立调控库仑反馈，从而调节集体模式的色散与品质因子，在欠阻尼条件下实现电荷可见性。；创新点：提出将Rashba自旋轨道耦合与静电栅极屏蔽相结合，作为在二维交变磁平台中实现可调谐、电荷可见的自旋恶魔的控制机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于Rashba-交变磁连续模型（Rashba-altermagnetic continuum model）和随机相位近似（random phase approximation）进行理论计算，通过参数扫描分析Rashba强度与栅极距离对电荷可见性与模式品质的权衡。

papers.title: HF Etching and Silanization: Evidence for the Role of Surface Hydroxyl Groups in Silicon Nitride Resonator Loss
papers.abstract: Silicon nitride $SiN_x$ nanomechanical resonators are central to sensing, quantum technologies, and fundamental physics experiments due to their exceptional mechanical quality factors (Q). However, as resonator thickness approaches the nano-scale, surface-related dissipation limits performance. Here, we investigate the role of surface chemistry in low-stress Si-rich SiNx membranes through a combination of hydrofluoric acid (HF) etching and trimethylchlorosilane (TMCS) silanization, correlated with surface characterization and mechanical measurements. Preliminary analysis by TEM-EELS, XPS, RBS/ERDA, and XRR reveals a native oxide surface layer (1-2 nm). Surface modification by HF and TMCS was subsequently evaluated using XPS, photothermal FTIR, contact-angle measurements, and intrinsic quality factor ($Q_{int}$) characterization. While HF etching effectively removes the native oxide and TMCS introduces hydrophobic $Si-(CH_3)_3$ termination, neither oxide thickness nor surface energy correlates with mechanical dissipation. TMCS treatments produce the largest enhancements, increasing $Q_{int}$ by up to 50%, whereas HF etching alone yields lower gains of 20-25%. These findings suggest surface hydroxyl groups as a key contributor to energy loss in $SiN_x$ resonators and demonstrate that chemical functionalization can substantially suppress surface dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了通过HF刻蚀和TMCS硅烷化处理进行表面改性，并结合表面表征（XPS、FTIR、接触角测量）和机械测量（品质因子Qint表征）的实验流程。；研究对象：低应力富硅氮化硅（SiNx）纳米机械谐振器，重点研究其表面化学（特别是表面羟基基团）对机械耗散的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 表面羟基基团是SiNx谐振器能量损失的关键因素；通过TMCS硅烷化处理引入疏水性Si-(CH3)3末端基团，可将本征品质因子（Qint）提升高达50%，而仅用HF刻蚀去除原生氧化层仅能提升20-25%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：表面羟基基团是SiNx谐振器能量损失的关键因素；通过TMCS硅烷化处理引入疏水性Si-(CH3)3末端基团，可将本征品质因子（Qint）提升高达50%，而仅用HF刻蚀去除原生氧化层仅能提升20-25%。；创新点：首次将HF刻蚀与TMCS硅烷化处理相结合，系统关联表面化学状态（特别是羟基基团）与机械耗散，证明化学功能化可显著抑制表面耗散，而传统认为的氧化层厚度和表面能并非耗散主因。
papers.method_zh: 采用HF刻蚀去除原生氧化层，TMCS硅烷化进行表面疏水修饰；利用TEM-EELS、XPS、RBS/ERDA、XRR表征原生氧化层（1-2 nm）；通过XPS、光热FTIR、接触角测量评估表面改性效果；通过本征品质因子（Qint）表征机械耗散。

papers.title: A Hybrid Quantum Mechanics Machine Learning Forcefield (QM/ML) Framework for Accurate Solute-Dislocation Interaction Simulations
papers.abstract: Solute-dislocation interactions play a central role in controlling microstructural evolution and mechanical behaviour of structural materials, yet conventional atomistic modelling approaches struggle to combine the chemical accuracy with computational scalability. In the nuclear industry, these challenges become particularly acute, as experiments reveal strong correlations between solute segregation and irradiation-induced dislocation loops. However, theoretical insight remains limited because density functional theory (DFT) simulations are prohibitively expensive at relevant length scales, while traditional semi-empirical interatomic potentials lack the chemical fidelity required for predictive solute-defect calculations. Here, we introduce a hybrid quantum-mechanics/machine-learning (QM/ML) simulation framework that couples DFT with neural-network machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), enabling accurate atomistic dislocation simulations at reduced computational cost. We demonstrate the QM/ML framework's capability by reproducing the experimentally observed Sn and Fe segregation to dislocation loops in Zr and investigating magnetically complex solute-dislocation interactions in steel. These results establish the approach as a transferable, high-fidelity tool for modelling irradiation-induced defect structures and benchmarking emerging MLIPs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：hybrid quantum-mechanics/machine-learning (QM/ML) simulation framework、DFT、neural-network machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)。；研究对象：溶质-位错相互作用，具体涉及Zr中Sn和Fe在辐照诱导位错环上的偏聚，以及钢中磁复杂溶质-位错相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该QM/ML框架能够以降低的计算成本实现精确的原子尺度位错模拟，成功复现了实验观察到的Zr中Sn和Fe在位错环上的偏聚，并可用于研究钢中磁复杂的溶质-位错相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该QM/ML框架能够以降低的计算成本实现精确的原子尺度位错模拟，成功复现了实验观察到的Zr中Sn和Fe在位错环上的偏聚，并可用于研究钢中磁复杂的溶质-位错相互作用。；创新点：提出了一种将DFT与MLIPs耦合的混合QM/ML框架，在保持化学精度的同时显著降低计算成本，解决了传统DFT在相关尺度上计算成本过高、而半经验势化学保真度不足的问题。
papers.method_zh: 混合量子力学/机器学习（QM/ML）模拟框架，将密度泛函理论（DFT）与神经网络机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）耦合。

papers.title: Giant and Broadband Circular Dichroism from Particle-Hole Symmetry Breaking in Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: Circular dichroism originates from symmetry breaking of material structure, leading to differential absorption of left- and right-circularly polarized light. However, circular dichroism in most materials is inherently weak and spectrally narrow, especially in the mid-to-far infrared. Here, we uncover giant infrared circular dichroism in the magnetic-field-forced Weyl semimetal Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4, driven by extreme particle-hole symmetry breaking. Helicity-resolved magneto-infrared spectroscopy reveals circular dichroism exceeding 3000 mdeg (~130 mdeg/nm) with above-degree response extending over the 6-13 μm spectral range. The optical resonances are enhanced by a strong band nesting effect intrinsic to the Landau levels of type-II Weyl dispersion. A symmetry-based kp model reproduces these magneto-infrared responses and demonstrates that magnetization-induced asymmetric spin-orbit coupling generates particle-hole symmetry breaking, suppressing spin-up, parity-even wavefunction components in the valence Landau band and thereby producing pronounced optical helicity selectivity. Our findings establish particle-hole symmetry breaking as an effective route toward helicity-resolved optical control in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：helicity-resolved magneto-infrared spectroscopy、磁光光谱实验）；研究对象：磁场诱导的Weyl半金属Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4中的圆二色性现象
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁场驱动的Weyl半金属Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4中，由于极端粒子-空穴对称性破缺，观测到超过3000 mdeg（约130 mdeg/nm）的巨红外圆二色性，且在6-13 μm波段具有宽带响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁场驱动的Weyl半金属Mn(Bi,Sb)2Te4中，由于极端粒子-空穴对称性破缺，观测到超过3000 mdeg（约130 mdeg/nm）的巨红外圆二色性，且在6-13 μm波段具有宽带响应。；创新点：首次揭示粒子-空穴对称性破缺是产生巨宽带圆二色性的有效机制，具体表现为磁化诱导的不对称自旋-轨道耦合抑制了价带朗道能级中自旋向上、宇称偶的波函数分量，从而产生显著的光学螺旋度选择性。
papers.method_zh: 采用螺旋度分辨的磁红外光谱（helicity-resolved magneto-infrared spectroscopy）进行实验测量，并结合基于对称性的kp模型进行理论模拟。

papers.title: Hydrogen segregation around a straight screw dislocation in bcc iron
papers.abstract: The interaction between hydrogen and screw dislocations in bcc iron is central to understanding hydrogen embrittlement. A major challenge lies in the high-dimensional parametric landscape governing this interaction. In this work, we perform a comprehensive set of molecular simulations using a reliable neural network interatomic potential, systematically exploring hydrogen binding across dislocation core structures (easy and hard cores), site types, and concentrations. From these energetics, we construct a thermodynamic framework that quantifies the statistical relevance of the various trapping configurations, thereby significantly reducing the complexity of the problem. Our results show good agreement with the limited density functional theory data available in the literature. We further delineate the validity domain of an elastic dipole description of hydrogen-dislocation interactions, providing a simplified yet physically grounded modeling approach. Finally, we demonstrate that the easy-core configuration plays a key role in rationalizing experimental hydrogen solubility limits. These findings establish a consistent multiscale foundation for incorporating hydrogen-dislocation interactions into larger-scale models of plasticity and embrittlement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular simulations（分子模拟）、neural network interatomic potential（神经网络原子间势）、thermodynamic framework（热力学框架）。；研究对象：氢原子在体心立方（bcc）铁中直螺型位错周围的偏聚行为，具体涉及位错芯结构（易芯与难芯）、位点类型及氢浓度对氢-位错相互作用的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 易芯（easy-core）构型在解释实验测得的氢溶解度极限中起关键作用；同时，研究界定了弹性偶极子描述氢-位错相互作用的有效范围，为简化建模提供了物理基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：易芯（easy-core）构型在解释实验测得的氢溶解度极限中起关键作用；同时，研究界定了弹性偶极子描述氢-位错相互作用的有效范围，为简化建模提供了物理基础。；创新点：通过热力学框架将高维参数空间（位错芯结构、位点类型、浓度）的复杂性降维，并首次明确界定了弹性偶极子模型的适用性范围，同时揭示了易芯构型在解释实验溶解度极限中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用可靠的神经网络原子间势进行大规模分子模拟，系统计算不同位错芯结构、位点类型和浓度下的氢结合能；基于这些能量学数据构建热力学框架，量化不同俘获构型的统计权重。

papers.title: Controlled chemical vapor deposition for synthesis of emerging Mo(W)Te2 systems
papers.abstract: The Group-VI transition metal ditellurides offer a rich platform for correlated and topological phenomena, yet their structural polymorphism and instability complicate the creation of single crystals and heterointerfaces. Here, we introduce a confined-space chemical vapor deposition (CVD) strategy that lowers the growth temperature window and, when combined with tailored precursor configurations and stepwise thermal ramps, enables the deterministic synthesis of high-quality single crystals, alloys, and lateral/vertical heterostructures. High-resolution aberration-corrected STEM provides atomic characterization of lattice-matched Mo(W)Te2 lateral heterostructure, revealing nearly atomically sharp, compositionally well-defined seamless boundaries. This approach avoids the thickness nonuniformity and structural limitations commonly associated with exfoliated samples, enabling reproducible fabrication of clean heterointerfaces and establishing a nearly ideal in-situ experimental system. Furthermore, scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM and STS) enable direct imaging of the seamless boundaries in Mo(W)Te2 lateral heterostructures, while uncovering their distinct real-space distributions of the local density of states. Our results establish a scalable pathway for engineering crystalline Te-based structures with controlled geometry and stacking, providing an essential step toward quantum and topological device platforms based on the transition metal ditellurides family.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：chemical vapor deposition (CVD)、STEM、STM、STS。；研究对象：Mo(W)Te₂体系，具体包括高质量单晶、合金以及横向/纵向异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过限域空间化学气相沉积（CVD）策略，结合定制前驱体构型和逐步升温程序，实现了Mo(W)Te₂体系的高质量单晶、合金及异质结的可控合成，并获得了原子级锐利、成分明确的无缝界面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过限域空间化学气相沉积（CVD）策略，结合定制前驱体构型和逐步升温程序，实现了Mo(W)Te₂体系的高质量单晶、合金及异质结的可控合成，并获得了原子级锐利、成分明确的无缝界面。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 限域空间化学气相沉积（CVD）、球差校正扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）、扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和扫描隧道谱（STS）。

papers.title: Solid-to-solid transition in dense assemblies of elongated cells
papers.abstract: Cell shapes in confluent tissues range from nearly isotropic epithelial morphologies to highly elongated endothelial ones. In standard vertex models, tissue rigidity is controlled by a target shape index; increasing this index drives cell elongation and ultimate tissue fluidization. Here, we consider the case where cell elongation emerges autonomously by assigning an intrinsic, passive elastic preference for anisotropic shape. This distinction reverses the usual expectation: cell elongation does not fluidize the tissue, but drives a solid-to-solid transition from an ordered isotropic solid to a disordered anisotropic solid, with finite yield stress and shear rigidity on either side of the transition. These results decouple cell shape from tissue rheology and caution against inferring fluid-like mechanics from elongated cell morphologies alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：vertex models（顶点模型）、passive elastic preference（被动弹性偏好）、solid-to-solid transition（固-固转变）。；研究对象：密集排列的伸长细胞（elongated cells）构成的汇合组织（confluent tissues），具体研究细胞伸长如何影响组织的刚性与流变学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细胞伸长并不导致组织流体化，而是驱动从有序各向同性固体到无序各向异性固体的固-固转变，转变两侧均具有有限屈服应力和剪切刚性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细胞伸长并不导致组织流体化，而是驱动从有序各向同性固体到无序各向异性固体的固-固转变，转变两侧均具有有限屈服应力和剪切刚性。；创新点：逆转了传统认知——通常认为细胞伸长会驱动组织流体化，而本工作发现细胞伸长反而导致固-固转变，将细胞形状与组织流变学解耦，警示不能仅凭伸长细胞形态推断类流体力学行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用标准顶点模型（vertex models），并引入细胞对非各向同性形状的内在被动弹性偏好（intrinsic passive elastic preference for anisotropic shape），通过改变目标形状指数（target shape index）控制细胞伸长，分析组织力学响应。

papers.title: Perfect Absorption in the Strong Coupling Regime via Degenerate Critical Coupling
papers.abstract: Perfect absorption (PA) represents a fundamental limit of light-matter interaction and a means to maximize nanoscale energy conversion. While PA is now a well-established phenomenon, both the theoretical feasibility and a practical mechanism for achieving it under single-beam excitation within the strong coupling regime is unknown. Through rigorous solution of Maxwells equations for a compact photonic crystal (PhC) architecture incorporating a two-dimensional semiconductor, we present a general method based on degenerate critical coupling for single-port PA of exciton-polaritons. At the crossing of two polariton branches, we achieve near-unity absorption exceeding 99.8 \% in a structure thinner than $100\,$nm. This effect is robust under realistic Gaussian beam excitation, and can be realized across different temperatures and excitonic materials by tailoring the PhC geometry. Our results establish a strategy for enabling efficient light-matter coupling, with direct implications for the development of metal-free, ultra-compact polaritonic logic devices, sensors, and energy-harvesting platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过严格求解麦克斯韦方程组”（rigorous solution of Maxwell's equations）以及“基于简并临界耦合的一般方法”（general method based on degenerate critical coupling）。；研究对象：基于紧凑光子晶体（PhC）架构与二维半导体复合体系中的激子-极化激元（exciton-polaritons）的完美吸收现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合区间的两个极化激元分支交叉点，通过简并临界耦合机制，实现了单端口入射下对激子-极化激元的近完美吸收（吸收率超过99.8%），且结构厚度小于100纳米。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合区间的两个极化激元分支交叉点，通过简并临界耦合机制，实现了单端口入射下对激子-极化激元的近完美吸收（吸收率超过99.8%），且结构厚度小于100纳米。；创新点：首次从理论上证明并提出了在强耦合区间、单光束激发条件下实现完美吸收的可行机制（即简并临界耦合），此前该条件下的完美吸收在理论和实验上均属未知。
papers.method_zh: 严格求解麦克斯韦方程组（Maxwell's equations），对包含二维半导体的紧凑光子晶体结构进行理论建模与分析。

papers.title: Thermal Rectification from Size-Dependent Phonon Confinement in Nanoparticle Assemblies
papers.abstract: Thermal insulation remains an important technological challenge across the vast number of applications, from living quarters to quantum technology. Here, we exploit the size-dependent modification of the phonon density of states arising from phonon confinement in nanoparticles to fabricate a simple phonon rectifier. The smaller of the two connected nanoparticles imposes stronger phonon confinement leading to rectifying phonon transport. This concept is extended to the macroscale by constructing two overlapping layers of differently sized nanoparticles, thereby realizing a macroscopic phonon diode. Following the localized heat deposition by laser light, the temperature profiles across a phonon-diode were measured by infrared imaging. Although the rectifying strength is moderate, the abundance of optimization possibilities makes this method promising for ultra-low volume thermal insulation at both the nano- and macroscale
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“温度剖面由红外成像测量”（measured by infrared imaging），并描述了具体的实验过程（激光局部加热、温度测量）。；研究对象：纳米颗粒组装体中的声子整流现象。具体体系为两种不同尺寸的纳米颗粒构成的双层重叠结构，用于实现宏观声子二极管。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用纳米颗粒中声子限制导致的尺寸依赖的态密度变化，可以制造简单的声子整流器。较小颗粒施加更强的声子限制，从而产生整流效应；该概念可扩展至宏观尺度，通过构建不同尺寸纳米颗粒的双层重叠层实现宏观声子二极管。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用纳米颗粒中声子限制导致的尺寸依赖的态密度变化，可以制造简单的声子整流器。较小颗粒施加更强的声子限制，从而产生整流效应；该概念可扩展至宏观尺度，通过构建不同尺寸纳米颗粒的双层重叠层实现宏观声子二极管。；创新点：首次利用纳米颗粒中尺寸依赖的声子限制效应（phonon confinement）来设计并实现宏观尺度的声子二极管，将纳米尺度的声子整流概念扩展至宏观器件。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：激光局部加热（localized heat deposition by laser light），红外成像（infrared imaging）测量温度剖面。未使用计算或理论框架。

papers.title: Preconditioning Magnetic Systems in Kohn-Sham Density Functional Theory
papers.abstract: The convergence of the self-consistent field iterations in Kohn-Sham density functional theory can be significantly hindered by the presence of small eigenvalues in the dielectric matrix, which are often associated with electronic phase transitions in magnetic systems. In this work, we study this type of convergence issues and propose a new preconditioning scheme to mitigate them. Our preconditioning scheme is inspired by the Stoner model and based on a non-interacting susceptibility that neglects orbital variations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a range of ferromagnetic systems, showing that it can significantly reduce the number of iterations required to achieve convergence in the vicinity of magnetic phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Kohn-Sham density functional theory、self-consistent field iterations、preconditioning scheme。；研究对象：磁性系统中的电子相变，特别是铁磁体系在自洽场迭代中的收敛问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于Stoner模型、忽略轨道变化的非相互作用磁化率的新型预处理方案，可显著减少磁性相变附近自洽场迭代所需的步数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于Stoner模型、忽略轨道变化的非相互作用磁化率的新型预处理方案，可显著减少磁性相变附近自洽场迭代所需的步数。；创新点：针对磁性系统中介电矩阵小本征值导致的收敛困难，提出了一种受Stoner模型启发的预处理方案，该方案通过忽略轨道变化来简化磁化率计算，从而有效加速磁性相变附近的收敛。
papers.method_zh: 采用Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（KS-DFT）中的自洽场迭代方法，并引入基于Stoner模型和非相互作用磁化率的预处理方案。摘要未明确说明具体使用的DFT软件或赝势类型。

papers.title: Floquet Topological Phases and Anomalous Hall Signatures in Irradiated Two-dimensional $d_{xy}$-Wave Altermagnets
papers.abstract: We study Floquet topological phases in two-dimensional $d_{xy}$-wave altermagnets driven by off-resonant circularly polarized light and subject to an out-of-plane magnetization induced via extrinsic exchange coupling from a proximate ferromagnet. Using a lattice Floquet formulation, we show that the system is governed by a driving parameter $β$ that controls the emergence of distinct gap-closing points and associated topological phases. For $|β|>1$, topology is dominated by anisotropic Dirac points at high symmetry points, leading to Chern phases with $|\mathcal{C}|=2$. For $|β|<1$, light-induced off-symmetry $G$ points appear in four families in the Brillouine zone, enabling higher Chern phases up to $|\mathcal{C}|=4$. Low-energy analysis reveals that high symmetry points host anisotropic massive Dirac fermions, while $G$ points realize generalized two-dimensional anisotropic Dirac points with fully momentum-dependent pseudospin structure, leading to distinct Berry curvature distributions. In the metallic regime, the anomalous Hall conductivity provides an experimental signature of these Floquet topological phases, exhibiting sharp features associated with Berry curvature accumulation near local gap-closing regions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Floquet formulation、low-energy analysis、理论推导。；研究对象：受圆偏振光辐照的二维 \(d_{xy}\)-波交变磁体（altermagnet），并考虑通过邻近铁磁体引入的面外磁化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统由驱动参数 \(\beta\) 控制拓扑相变：当 \(|\beta|>1\) 时，拓扑由高对称点处的各向异性狄拉克点主导，产生陈数为 \(|\mathcal{C}|=2\) 的陈相；当 \(|\beta|<1\) 时，光诱导出四族离对称 \(G\) 点，可实现高达 \(|\mathcal{C}|=4\) 的陈相。在金属态下，反常霍尔电导可作为这些 Floquet 拓扑相的实验探测信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统由驱动参数 \(\beta\) 控制拓扑相变：当 \(|\beta|>1\) 时，拓扑由高对称点处的各向异性狄拉克点主导，产生陈数为 \(|\mathcal{C}|=2\) 的陈相；当 \(|\beta|<1\) 时，光诱导出四族离对称 \(G\) 点，可实现高达 \(|\mathcal{C}|=4\) 的陈相。在金属态下，反常霍尔电导可作为这些 Floquet 拓扑相的实验探测信号。；创新点：首次在二维 \(d_{xy}\)-波交变磁体中系统研究了 Floquet 工程下的拓扑相，揭示了由驱动参数 \(\beta\) 调控的高对称点与离对称 \(G\) 点两类不同的能隙闭合机制，并预言了高达 \(|\mathcal{C}|=4\) 的陈数相及其在反常霍尔电导中的特征信号。
papers.method_zh: 采用晶格 Floquet 理论框架（lattice Floquet formulation）处理非共振圆偏振光驱动，并结合低能有效模型分析狄拉克点的质量项与赝自旋结构。

papers.title: Analysing gelation transition through fractional viscoelasticity and Mittag-Leffler-Prabhakar function
papers.abstract: The gelation transition, a process that transforms a flowable liquid into an elastic solid, is a present in variety of systems, from colloidal to polymeric. During the gelation transition, a system passes through a critical gel state characterized by scale-free power-law viscoelasticity. Interestingly, the fractional calculus provides a natural mathematical language for such power-law viscoelasticity. In this work, we develop physically constrained fractional viscoelastic models as well as those based on the three-parameter Mittag-Leffler-Prabhakar function for both, the pre-gel state and the post-gel regimes, ensuring consistency with the conventional scaling relations in each regime. While the fractional pre-gel model is observed to be valid only for a restricted subset of parameter values, the Prabhakar function-based model rigorously removes this limitation. We enforce continuity of the dynamic moduli and their derivatives across the critical gel point, which universally imposes a symmetry in the relaxation dynamics on either side of the critical gel state. Such enforcement further validates the hyper-scaling relation connecting the critical exponents, making it a theoretical necessity rather than an empirical coincidence. We validate the proposed models against time- and frequency-domain experimental data. A model-agnostic, frequency-independent rheological fingerprint of the critical gel state, uniquely determined by two critical exponents, is also identified.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中提及“develop physically constrained fractional viscoelastic models”、“validate the proposed models against time- and frequency-domain experimental data”，表明主要工作是理论建模，并用实验数据验证。；研究对象：凝胶化转变（gelation transition），即从可流动液体转变为弹性固体的过程，具体涉及临界凝胶态（critical gel state）的标度无关幂律黏弹性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于三参数Mittag-Leffler-Prabhakar函数的黏弹性模型能严格消除分数阶预凝胶模型在参数取值上的限制，并在临界凝胶点处强制动态模量及其导数连续，从而将临界指数间的超标度关系从经验巧合提升为理论必然。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于三参数Mittag-Leffler-Prabhakar函数的黏弹性模型能严格消除分数阶预凝胶模型在参数取值上的限制，并在临界凝胶点处强制动态模量及其导数连续，从而将临界指数间的超标度关系从经验巧合提升为理论必然。；创新点：首次提出基于Prabhakar函数的凝胶化转变模型，消除了传统分数阶模型在参数取值上的限制；通过强制临界点处动态模量及其导数的连续性，将临界指数间的超标度关系从经验观察提升为理论必然；识别出由两个临界指数唯一确定的、与模型无关的频率无关临界凝胶态流变指纹。
papers.method_zh: 采用分数阶微积分（fractional calculus）构建物理约束的黏弹性模型，并引入三参数Mittag-Leffler-Prabhakar函数描述预凝胶态和后凝胶态；通过强制临界点处动态模量及其导数的连续性，推导出弛豫动力学的对称性；利用时域和频域实验数据验证模型。

papers.title: Solid adsorption: the missing mechanism for surfactant contact lines -- a phase-field approach
papers.abstract: We develop a thermodynamically consistent phase-field model for soluble surfactants in two-phase flows, incorporating both interfacial and solid surface adsorption. The model is derived via variational principles consistent with the second law of thermodynamics, resulting in modified free energies and boundary conditions that capture surfactant transport, adsorption, and wetting dynamics. A key contribution of this work is the inclusion of surfactant adsorption on solid walls, which leads to qualitative agreement with experimental observations: unlike prior numerical studies that predicted hydrophilic surfaces becoming more hydrophilic and hydrophobic surfaces more hydrophobic, our model shows a shift toward increased hydrophilicity across all contact angles-consistent with experimental trends. Our results establish that solid adsorption provides the missing mechanism required for predictive modelling of surfactant-laden contact line dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：phase-field model（相场模型）、variational principles（变分原理）、thermodynamically consistent（热力学一致）。；研究对象：可溶性表面活性剂在两相流中的吸附行为，特别是固体壁面上的表面活性剂吸附对接触线动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 固体壁面上的表面活性剂吸附是导致亲水性增强的关键机制：与以往数值研究预测的“亲水表面更亲水、疏水表面更疏水”不同，本模型在所有接触角下均表现出向亲水性增强的转变，与实验趋势一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：固体壁面上的表面活性剂吸附是导致亲水性增强的关键机制：与以往数值研究预测的“亲水表面更亲水、疏水表面更疏水”不同，本模型在所有接触角下均表现出向亲水性增强的转变，与实验趋势一致。；创新点：首次在相场模型中系统纳入固体壁面上的表面活性剂吸附，揭示了该机制是预测表面活性剂接触线动力学所缺失的关键环节。
papers.method_zh: 基于热力学第二定律的变分原理，推导出包含界面和固体表面吸附的相场模型，并得到修正的自由能表达式和边界条件。

papers.title: Dynamic heterogeneity in sodium silicate melts via machine-learning potential
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive characterisation of dynamic heterogeneity in sodium silicate melts using molecular dynamics simulation with machine-learning potentials. By studying sodium disilicate, tetrasilicate, and hexasilicate melts across a range of temperatures, mean squared displacement and a time-correlation function computed up to the nanosecond timescale provide a detailed account of how spatial mobility disparities emerge in a realistic multicomponent oxide glass. Within these timescales, the self-part of the van Hove function for sodium displays a bimodality, demonstrating that alkali transport is mediated by discrete displacement events consistent with a hopping mechanism. This distinct hopping allows sodium ions to decouple from the sluggish relaxation of the silicate matrix. Furthermore, evaluation of the non-Gaussian parameter reveals that, although all constituent species exhibit dynamic heterogeneity, the non-Gaussian behaviour is most pronounced for oxygen atoms. This trend reflects the intermittency of structural rearrangements, where framework atoms undergo rare and stochastic events compared to the frequent displacements of mobile ions. Our findings elucidate the microscopic mechanism of ion transport and its connection to dynamic heterogeneity in silicate melts, offering a new avenue to study fundamental glassy physics in realistic vitreous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular dynamics simulation（分子动力学模拟）、machine-learning potentials（机器学习势）。；研究对象：钠硅酸盐熔体（sodium silicate melts），具体包括二硅酸钠、四硅酸钠和六硅酸钠熔体，以及其中的动态异质性（dynamic heterogeneity）和离子输运机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钠离子在硅酸盐熔体中的输运通过离散跳跃（hopping）机制实现，与硅酸盐基质的缓慢弛豫解耦；所有组分均表现出动态异质性，其中氧原子的非高斯行为最为显著，反映了结构重排的间歇性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钠离子在硅酸盐熔体中的输运通过离散跳跃（hopping）机制实现，与硅酸盐基质的缓慢弛豫解耦；所有组分均表现出动态异质性，其中氧原子的非高斯行为最为显著，反映了结构重排的间歇性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于机器学习势的分子动力学模拟，计算了均方位移（mean squared displacement）、时间关联函数、van Hove函数（自部分）以及非高斯参数（non-Gaussian parameter），时间尺度覆盖至纳秒。

papers.title: Lattice Reconstruction and Orbital Hybridization Suppress Magnetism in TaCo$_2$Te$_2$
papers.abstract: Structural reconstruction in low-dimensional quantum materials can strongly modify electronic symmetry and magnetic stability through orbital hybridization. Here, we investigate the interplay between lattice reconstruction, electronic structure, and magnetic instability in the layered van der Waals compound TaCo$_2$Te$_2$ using scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/STS), non-contact atomic force microscopy (nc-AFM), angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), and density functional theory (DFT). While nc-AFM resolves a distorted hexagonal Te surface lattice, STM/STS reveal a pronounced square-like electronic symmetry that does not directly follow the atomic structure. ARPES further shows a strongly anisotropic Fermi surface and reconstructed low-energy states. Spatially resolved spectroscopy and orbital-projected DFT demonstrate that the bias-dependent STM contrast does not arise from a simple reversal between occupied and unoccupied states, but from the energy-integrated local density of states dominated by electronic states exhibiting opposite spatial contrast at selected energies. DFT calculations further show that reconstruction suppresses the magnetic instability present in the undistorted structure, stabilizing a nonmagnetic ground state through enhanced orbital hybridization. These results establish TaCo$_2$Te$_2$ as a model system in which lattice reconstruction reorganizes electronic symmetry and suppresses magnetism, highlighting structural reconstruction as a route for controlling correlated and magnetic phases in low-dimensional quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/STS）、非接触原子力显微镜（nc-AFM）、角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）等实验手段，以及密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：层状范德瓦尔斯化合物 TaCo₂Te₂ 中的晶格重构、电子结构及磁不稳定性之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 晶格重构通过增强轨道杂化抑制了未重构结构中的磁不稳定性，稳定了非磁基态，并导致电子对称性从六角原子结构转变为明显的四方对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：晶格重构通过增强轨道杂化抑制了未重构结构中的磁不稳定性，稳定了非磁基态，并导致电子对称性从六角原子结构转变为明显的四方对称性。；创新点：揭示了 TaCo₂Te₂ 中晶格重构如何重新组织电子对称性并抑制磁性，将其确立为通过结构重构调控低维量子材料中关联和磁相的一个模型体系。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/STS）、非接触原子力显微镜（nc-AFM）、角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）。计算方法：密度泛函理论（DFT）及轨道投影分析。

papers.title: Floquet-Engineered Chern Insulator in two-dimensional $d_{x^2-y^2}$-Wave Altermagnets
papers.abstract: We investigate Floquet-engineered topological phases in two-dimensional $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave altermagnets irradiated by circularly polarized light in the off-resonant regime. These materials exhibit large momentum-dependent spin-splitting governed by distinctive magnetic symmetries. Using a lattice model combined with Floquet theory, we demonstrate that irradiation induces the light-tunable quantum anomalous Hall phases with the Chern numbers up to $\pm 3$. The resultant phase diagram is verified by calculating the anomalous Hall conductivity and also the edge modes inside the band gap of a nanoribbon version of the altermagnet. Our findings establish d-wave altermagnets as promising platforms for realizing nonequilibrium topological states of matter. The low-energy continuum limit of the lattice-based Floquet Hamiltonian results in a linear and higher-order-in-momentum spin-orbit couplings, and also a Zeeman-like magnetization, all arising from light-induced virtual photon processes. The resulting higher-order spin-orbit coupling generates the additional gapless Dirac points which, together with the high-symmetry gap-closings, yield enhanced Berry curvature and high Chern numbers. The light irradiation effectively breaks the static $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave magnetic symmetry mixing in an isotropic photo-induced $s$-wave correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Floquet theory、lattice model、low-energy continuum limit。；研究对象：二维 \(d_{x^2-y^2}\)-波交变磁体（altermagnet）在圆偏振光辐照下的非平衡拓扑相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光辐照可在 \(d_{x^2-y^2}\)-波交变磁体中诱导出陈数高达 ±3 的光可调量子反常霍尔相，并产生高阶动量依赖的自旋-轨道耦合和类塞曼磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光辐照可在 \(d_{x^2-y^2}\)-波交变磁体中诱导出陈数高达 ±3 的光可调量子反常霍尔相，并产生高阶动量依赖的自旋-轨道耦合和类塞曼磁化。；创新点：首次在 \(d\)-波交变磁体中利用非共振圆偏振光实现高陈数（±3）的 Floquet 拓扑相，揭示了光诱导虚光子过程产生高阶自旋-轨道耦合并增强贝里曲率的机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于晶格模型结合 Floquet 理论，计算反常霍尔电导和纳米带边缘态，并推导低能连续极限下的 Floquet 哈密顿量。

papers.title: Photon-Assisted Tunneling in Double Quantum Dot: Application of Scattering Theory
papers.abstract: We theoretically examine the photon-assisted tunneling (PAT) in a double quantum dot (DQD) in parallel when one of the quantum dots (QDs) is irradiated by an AC field. First, we formulate the PAT in a single QD by solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation using the scattering theory. The QD has an oscillating energy level, $\varepsilon(t)=\varepsilon_0+eV_{\mathrm{AC}}\cosωt$, and is connected to two leads by the tunnel coupling $Γ$. We show that the resonant tunneling takes place through energy levels of the polariton, $\varepsilon_0+N\hbarω$ ($N=0,\pm 1, \pm 2, \cdots$), when $Γ\ll \hbarω$ (PAT) and through the energy level $\varepsilon(t)$ when $Γ\gg \hbarω$ (adiabatic transport). Then, the scattering theory is applied to the PAT in the DQD in the presence of magnetic flux penetrating between the QDs. We observe the Aharonov--Bohm effect not only in the main peak ($N=0$) but also in subpeaks ($N \ne 0$), indicating coherent transport through the polariton states. Our theory is also applicable to the DQD in the three-terminal geometry. We demonstrate the phase measurement through the irradiated QD and show that the measured phase shift changes continuously from 0 to $π$ around both the main peak and subpeaks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：scattering theory、theoretically examine、formulate、solve the time-dependent Schrödinger equation。；研究对象：双量子点（Double Quantum Dot, DQD）中的光子辅助隧穿（Photon-Assisted Tunneling, PAT），以及磁场和AC场作用下的Aharonov-Bohm效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双量子点体系中，当其中一个量子点被AC场照射时，不仅主峰（N=0）出现Aharonov-Bohm效应，子峰（N≠0）也出现该效应，表明通过极化激元态存在相干输运。此外，通过被照射量子点的相位测量显示，在主峰和子峰附近，测量到的相移从0连续变化到π。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双量子点体系中，当其中一个量子点被AC场照射时，不仅主峰（N=0）出现Aharonov-Bohm效应，子峰（N≠0）也出现该效应，表明通过极化激元态存在相干输运。此外，通过被照射量子点的相位测量显示，在主峰和子峰附近，测量到的相移从0连续变化到π。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于散射理论（scattering theory）求解含时薛定谔方程（time-dependent Schrödinger equation），分别处理单量子点和双量子点中的光子辅助隧穿问题，并考虑了磁通和AC场的影响。

papers.title: Binary Dipolar Condensates of Dysprosium Isotopes with Tunable Spatial Order
papers.abstract: Dipolar quantum mixtures provide a unique route to interaction-driven many-body phases, where long-range anisotropic interactions intertwine the density, spin and spatial order. Here we realize binary Bose--Einstein condensates of the highly magnetic isotopes $^{162}$Dy and $^{164}$Dy in a technically minimal, single-species-like apparatus. Their nearly identical single-particle properties yield naturally matched trapping potentials, while dense intra- and inter-species Feshbach spectra provide strong interaction tunability. We use this platform to drive an interaction-controlled miscibility transition of a dipolar binary condensate, accompanied by a reconfiguration of the condensate interface from core--shell-like to side-by-side and exchanged core--shell-like geometries. At fixed interactions, population imbalance provides a second control knob by reshaping the effective mean-field pressures and continuously tuning the phase-separated order. These results establish dysprosium isotope mixtures as a compact platform for engineering miscibility, interfaces, and spatial order in dipolar quantum matter, with direct connections to coupled density--spin physics and binary supersolidity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here we realize...”、“We use this platform to drive...”、“These results establish...”，描述了具体的实验实现和观测。；研究对象：二元偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC），具体为高磁性的镝（Dy）同位素¹⁶²Dy和¹⁶⁴Dy的混合体系，研究其相互作用驱动的空间有序性、混溶-相分离转变及界面重构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控同位素间的相互作用，实现了二元偶极凝聚体的混溶-相分离转变，并观察到凝聚体界面从核-壳状到并排状再到交换核-壳状的几何重构；同时，粒子数不平衡可作为第二个调控旋钮，连续调节相分离的空间有序性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控同位素间的相互作用，实现了二元偶极凝聚体的混溶-相分离转变，并观察到凝聚体界面从核-壳状到并排状再到交换核-壳状的几何重构；同时，粒子数不平衡可作为第二个调控旋钮，连续调节相分离的空间有序性。；创新点：利用两种镝同位素几乎相同的单粒子性质实现自然匹配的捕获势，从而在最小化技术复杂度的前提下，构建了一个高度可调的二元偶极量子混合物平台，并首次在该体系中实现了相互作用控制的混溶转变及界面几何的连续调控。摘要未突出说明与二元超固态的直接关联细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用单一物种类装置（technically minimal, single-species-like apparatus）制备两种镝同位素的二元BEC；利用密集的种内和种间Feshbach共振谱实现强相互作用可调性；通过改变相互作用参数和粒子数不平衡，观测凝聚体界面的几何重构。

papers.title: Shape-Constrained Bayesian Active Learning of Self-Limiting Saturation Curves
papers.abstract: Self-limiting saturation curves, monotone responses that rise from zero to a plateau, govern gas adsorption, enzyme kinetics, dose-response pharmacology, and the growth per cycle of atomic layer deposition (ALD), yet mapping each curve from a handful of costly measurements is a shared bottleneck. The standard surrogate, a stationary-kernel Gaussian process, enforces no shape constraint: on sparse, noisy data it produces unphysical dips that corrupt both the inferred curve and the uncertainty used to choose the next experiment. We present an active-learning platform built on Bayesian monotonic I-spline regression, in which every posterior curve rises from exactly zero and never decreases, the plateau is set by a measurement at maximum exposure rather than a prior, and the input at any saturation level is read from the posterior by level crossing with no kinetic model assumed.
