Other magnets: the triangular antiferromagnet keeps a continuous superradiant-superradiant line (3D-XY, no fold forced); the compass chain a BKT-functional onset; the Heisenberg and XX chains, via a conserved operator, a spectrally silent first-order onset; and the Dicke-Heisenberg diagram an exact tricritical point at the saturation corner.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamic-limit account、exact self-consistent functional、Landau coefficients、iDMRG。；研究对象：Dicke模型（一个腔模与相互作用物质集体耦合）的超辐射相图，特别是物质间相互作用对相变行为的影响。具体研究了Dicke-Ising模型、三角反铁磁模型、罗盘链、海森堡链和XX链等不同磁性物质体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超辐射相变的一级相变线并非来自不同热力学分支的交叉，而是来自单一状态方程曲线（磁化强度m作为耦合强度λ的函数）的折叠（fold）。该折叠可以拉直为连续线，且相变的级次（连续或一级）由物质本身的响应函数（如Landau四次项系数或发散磁化率）决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超辐射相变的一级相变线并非来自不同热力学分支的交叉，而是来自单一状态方程曲线（磁化强度m作为耦合强度λ的函数）的折叠（fold）。该折叠可以拉直为连续线，且相变的级次（连续或一级）由物质本身的响应函数（如Landau四次项系数或发散磁化率）决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过积分掉腔模，将问题简化为一个关于磁化强度m的精确自洽泛函。利用Landau相变理论进行解析分析，给出了Dicke-Ising模型的精确二阶相变边界和三临界点。对于Rydberg-blockade链，采用严格阻塞条件下的无限大密度矩阵重整化群（iDMRG）方法进行数值求解。

papers.title: Strong photogalvanic effect in Weyl materials due to magnetic resonances
papers.abstract: We study the photogalvanic effect in Weyl semimetals under a magnetic field, focusing on the shift current. Using the Kubo formalism for an ideal, clean Weyl node at zero temperature, we derive a general analytic expression valid for arbitrary light frequency, Fermi energy, and magnetic field strength. We identify a series of resonances that can be probed experimentally. To complement the microscopic analysis, we employ the semiclassical Boltzmann approach, which allows us to incorporate finite scattering phenomenologically. Unlike most previous studies using this method, we do not treat the magnetic field perturbatively; instead, we solve the Boltzmann equation for a Weyl node exactly within the limits of validity of the semiclassical theory. Our solution reproduces the low-frequency resonances and elucidates the role of finite scattering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Kubo formalism”“semiclassical Boltzmann approach”等理论方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Weyl半金属在磁场下的光电流效应（photogalvanic effect），具体聚焦于位移电流（shift current）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Weyl半金属中，磁场可诱导一系列可实验探测的光电流共振，且通过非微扰求解玻尔兹曼方程，能够复现低频共振并阐明有限散射的作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Weyl半金属中，磁场可诱导一系列可实验探测的光电流共振，且通过非微扰求解玻尔兹曼方程，能够复现低频共振并阐明有限散射的作用。；创新点：不同于以往多数研究将磁场作为微扰处理，本文在玻尔兹曼方法中非微扰地求解磁场下的Weyl节点，从而更准确地揭示低频共振机制及有限散射的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用零温下理想干净Weyl节点的Kubo形式论，推导出适用于任意光频率、费米能和磁场强度的解析表达式；同时使用半经典玻尔兹曼方法，在有效范围内非微扰地精确求解Weyl节点的玻尔兹曼方程，以引入有限散射效应。

papers.title: All-electrical dephasing-protected spin qubits in altermagnets
papers.abstract: We introduce altermagnetic semiconductors as a materials platform for scalable, all-electrical controllable spin qubits that operate without magnetic fields in gate-defined quantum dots. The altermagnet intrinsic finite-momentum spin polarization provides a field-free qubit splitting that is fully and continuously tunable through the dot ellipticity with electrostatic gates, delivering individually addressable qubit frequencies. Furthermore, the altermagnetic spin splitting is first-order insensitive to electric field fluctuations by construction and quantization-axis fluctuations produce only transverse coupling, yielding relaxation without pure dephasing, a distinct dephasing-protection yielding an advantage over conventional spin qubits. The net-zero magnetization eliminates stray-fields and renders the platform compatible with superconducting resonators thus enabling high-fidelity, non-demolition circuit-QED readout by dispersive coupling of the qubit spin-dependent electric dipole couples to a resonator. Starting from an effective quantum-dot description, supported by a microscopic lattice-model, we derive the qubit Hamiltonian and establish that it naturally supports a complete gate set: electric-dipole spin resonance controls single qubits, while tunable exchange combined with per-qubit frequency addressing directly implements the fermionic simulation (fSim) family of two-qubit gates. Crucially, within the same platform it is possible to implement a singlet-triplet qubit with fully electrical control over both exchange and splitting differences, removing the need for micromagnets or nuclear polarization gradients, while enabling baseband operation. Our results establish altermagnetic quantum dots as a novel, all-electrical route to spin qubits with enhanced protection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：introduce、derive、establish、theoretical framework（提出理论平台并推导哈密顿量）。；研究对象：交变磁半导体（altermagnetic semiconductors）中的自旋量子比特，具体为门定义量子点（gate-defined quantum dots）中的全电控自旋量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交磁体固有的有限动量自旋极化可在零磁场下实现量子比特分裂，且该分裂对电场波动一阶不敏感，从而提供无纯退相干的退相干保护；该平台天然支持完整的量子门集，包括电偶极自旋共振单比特门和fSim双比特门，并可通过全电控实现单重态-三重态量子比特。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交磁体固有的有限动量自旋极化可在零磁场下实现量子比特分裂，且该分裂对电场波动一阶不敏感，从而提供无纯退相干的退相干保护；该平台天然支持完整的量子门集，包括电偶极自旋共振单比特门和fSim双比特门，并可通过全电控实现单重态-三重态量子比特。；创新点：首次提出交变磁半导体作为可扩展、全电控、无需磁场的自旋量子比特平台，其退相干保护机制（纯退相干的完全消除）优于传统自旋量子比特，且零净磁化消除了杂散场，兼容超导谐振腔实现高保真度非破坏性电路QED读取。
papers.method_zh: 基于有效量子点描述（effective quantum-dot description），辅以微观晶格模型（microscopic lattice-model）进行理论推导，建立量子比特哈密顿量，并分析其退相干特性、门操作机制及与超导谐振腔的色散耦合。

papers.title: Quantum Back-Action Expands the Excitonic Hilbert Space in a Soft Polar Semiconductor
papers.abstract: Electronic excitations in solids are commonly described within a hierarchy in which the excitonic Hamiltonian is defined first and the lattice acts later through renormalization, relaxation, and dephasing. This picture assumes that the optically accessible excitonic manifold is already present at the moment of photoexcitation. Here we show that this assumption fails in a soft polar semiconductor. Using femtosecond coherent multidimensional spectroscopy on lead-halide perovskite nanocrystals, we observe quantum back-action between an electronic excitation and a collective lattice-polarization field that expands the excitonic Hilbert space in real time. The optical pulse first prepares an excitonic polarization, X1. A second configuration, X2, emerges only after the polaron field develops, while coherent X1-X2 coupling appears at later times. State formation and coherence formation are therefore resolved as distinct stages of quasiparticle formation. In contrast, CdSe quantum dots exhibit the conventional limit in which excitonic states and couplings are present at time zero and are only weakly perturbed by phonons. The observed diagonal and anti-diagonal splittings increase with nanocrystal size and correlate with radiative oscillator strength, opposite to expectations from simple quantum confinement. A dynamical polaron-field model describes the lattice polarization as an order parameter that expands the optically accessible manifold and generates time-dependent coherent coupling. These results show that strong system-bath coupling can actively create excitonic states and the coherent manifold in which they evolve.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：femtosecond coherent multidimensional spectroscopy、observation、measurement）；研究对象：软极性半导体中的激子-极化子体系，具体为铅卤钙钛矿纳米晶（lead-halide perovskite nanocrystals），并与CdSe量子点对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在软极性半导体中，光激发后激子与晶格极化场之间的量子反作用（quantum back-action）会实时扩展激子希尔伯特空间，使激子态的形成与相干性的建立成为两个可分辨的阶段，而非传统认为的激子态在光激发瞬间已完全存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在软极性半导体中，光激发后激子与晶格极化场之间的量子反作用（quantum back-action）会实时扩展激子希尔伯特空间，使激子态的形成与相干性的建立成为两个可分辨的阶段，而非传统认为的激子态在光激发瞬间已完全存在。；创新点：首次实验揭示了强系统-浴耦合（strong system-bath coupling）能够主动创造激子态及其演化的相干流形，打破了传统激子-声子层级模型中“激子哈密顿量先定义、晶格后作用”的假设。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒相干多维光谱（femtosecond coherent multidimensional spectroscopy），并结合动力学极化场模型（dynamical polaron-field model）进行理论描述。

papers.title: Telecom-band site-controlled quantum dots with engineered low fine-structure splitting
papers.abstract: Deterministic quantum light sources emitting at telecom wavelengths with vanishing fine-structure splitting (FSS) are essential components for scalable quantum communication. While self-assembled Stranski-Krastanov (SK) quantum dots (QDs) are high-quality emitters, their random positioning and shape-induced anisotropy typically limit their use in entangled-photon applications. In this work, we demonstrate site-controlled SK growth where InAs/InP QDs nucleate at the symmetric apexes of truncated InP nanopyramids. Confining adatom diffusion to a small, symmetric nucleation area suppresses anisotropic growth, promoting the nucleation of highly symmetric QDs with FSS reduced to values below our statistically validated resolution limit of $9.2~μ$eV. At the same time, lithographically defined nucleation sites enable deterministic control of the QD position, overcoming the limitations of conventional SK growth. The high structural quality of single symmetric QDs is evidenced by the single-photon character of the emission ($g^{(2)}(0)=0.07^{+0.27}_{-0.07}$) spanning the S, C, and L telecom bands, with no evidence of lithography-induced defects affecting emission dynamics. These results demonstrate that tailoring QD symmetry through nanopyramid growth engineering provides a route toward site-controlled emitters suitable for entangled photon generation and integrated quantum photonics devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、site-controlled SK growth、lithographically defined、single-photon character。；研究对象：InAs/InP 量子点，具体为在截断的 InP 纳米金字塔对称顶端成核的位点可控量子点，发射波长覆盖电信 S、C、L 波段。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过纳米金字塔生长工程，实现了位点可控的 InAs/InP 量子点，其精细结构分裂（FSS）降低至统计验证的分辨极限 9.2 μeV 以下，同时保持了单光子发射特性（g²(0)=0.07），且无光刻诱导缺陷影响发射动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过纳米金字塔生长工程，实现了位点可控的 InAs/InP 量子点，其精细结构分裂（FSS）降低至统计验证的分辨极限 9.2 μeV 以下，同时保持了单光子发射特性（g²(0)=0.07），且无光刻诱导缺陷影响发射动力学。；创新点：将位点可控 SK 生长与纳米金字塔几何对称性工程相结合，同时解决了传统 SK 量子点的随机定位和形状诱导各向异性问题，实现了低 FSS 与电信波段单光子发射的集成。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长技术，具体采用位点可控的 Stranski-Krastanov（SK）生长模式，在截断的 InP 纳米金字塔对称顶端成核；通过限制吸附原子扩散至小对称成核区域抑制各向异性生长；利用光刻定义成核位点实现位置确定性控制；通过单光子发射测量（g²(0)）和 FSS 统计验证评估量子点质量。

papers.title: Epitaxial Strain Activates Altermagnetic Spin-Splitting Torques in RuO2(100)
papers.abstract: The altermagnetic nature of rutile RuO2 remains under active debate: bulk measurements indicate a nearly nonmagnetic ground state, whereas thin-film studies have reported symmetry-dependent transport signatures consistent with altermagnetism. Here, we provide experimental evidence that altermagnetic spin splitting in RuO2 is a strain-stabilized emergent state rather than an intrinsic bulk property. Angular-resolved spin-torque measurements reveal a symmetry-selected spin Hall response characteristic of altermagnetic spin splitting, which is strongest in the strained regime but progressively suppressed as the lattice relaxes toward the bulk limit. Complementary magnetic measurements further reveal enhanced coercivity and exchange-bias behavior exclusively in strained films, indicating the emergence of a strain-stabilized magnetic state. First-principles calculations reproduce the strain-dependent evolution of the Neel order and spin-split electronic structure, supporting the experimental observations. Together, these results establish altermagnetic spin splitting in RuO2 as a strain-stabilized emergent state and provide a unified explanation for the long-standing discrepancy between bulk and thin-film observations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“angular-resolved spin-torque measurements”“magnetic measurements”等实验手段，并辅以“first-principles calculations”进行理论验证。；研究对象：金红石相RuO₂(100)薄膜中的交变磁自旋劈裂现象，以及外延应变对该现象的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RuO₂中的交变磁自旋劈裂并非其本征体相性质，而是一种由外延应变稳定化的涌现态；应变越强，自旋劈裂效应越显著，随晶格弛豫向体相极限靠近，该效应逐渐被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RuO₂中的交变磁自旋劈裂并非其本征体相性质，而是一种由外延应变稳定化的涌现态；应变越强，自旋劈裂效应越显著，随晶格弛豫向体相极限靠近，该效应逐渐被抑制。；创新点：通过实验与计算结合，首次明确将RuO₂中交变磁自旋劈裂归因于应变稳定化的涌现态，而非其本征体相属性，从而统一解释了长期以来体相与薄膜实验观测之间的矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨自旋力矩测量（探测对称性选择的类自旋霍尔响应）、互补磁性测量（矫顽力与交换偏置行为）、第一性原理计算（重现应变依赖的奈尔序与自旋劈裂电子结构演化）。

papers.title: Primary damage and mechanical degradation of WTaCrV refractory high-entropy alloy: effects of solid-solution and chemical ordering
papers.abstract: As advanced nuclear reactors demand novel irradiation-tolerant materials, this study investigates the radiation damage and mechanical degradation of the promising WTaCrV refractory high-entropy alloy (RHEA). To isolate complex nanoscale chemical effects, we propose an atomistic modeling strategy comparing Average-Atom (AA), random solid-solution (RSS), and local chemical order (LCO) configurations using newly developed interatomic potentials. Collision cascades simulations reveal that the number of Frenkel pairs follow NRSS > NLCO > NAA at the same radiation dose. While the RSS effect accelerates defect generation due to rugged energy landscapes, LCO enhances lattice cohesion to mitigate radiation damage. Despite more primary defects in the RSS and LCO configurations compared with the AA configurations, the RSS and LCO effects can suppress radiation-induced mechanical degradation. Irradiation severely degrade the homogenized AA model but exert a limited impact on the strength and flow stress of the RSS and LCO models. This exceptional resistance is driven by inherent lattice distortion resulting from interactions among different alloy elements, which outweighs point defect induced lattice disruptions. Moreover, the complex interactions between deformation twins and point defects cause confined plastic flow, elevating flow stress in the RSS and LCO models. The findings provide atomistic guidance for performance assessment of next-generation structural materials for extreme nuclear environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“atomistic modeling strategy”、“Collision cascades simulations”、“interatomic potentials”。；研究对象：WTaCrV难熔高熵合金（RHEA）的辐照损伤与力学性能退化机制，重点研究固溶效应和化学有序性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在WTaCrV合金中，随机固溶（RSS）和局域化学有序（LCO）构型虽然比平均原子（AA）构型产生更多初级缺陷，但能有效抑制辐照引起的力学性能退化；而AA模型在辐照后强度和流动应力显著下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在WTaCrV合金中，随机固溶（RSS）和局域化学有序（LCO）构型虽然比平均原子（AA）构型产生更多初级缺陷，但能有效抑制辐照引起的力学性能退化；而AA模型在辐照后强度和流动应力显著下降。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：通过对比AA、RSS和LCO三种不同化学有序程度的模型，系统分离并揭示了固溶效应和化学有序性对辐照损伤及后续力学性能退化的不同影响机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子尺度建模策略，通过新开发的原子间势能，对比了三种构型：平均原子（AA）、随机固溶（RSS）和局域化学有序（LCO）。具体方法包括碰撞级联模拟。

papers.title: Spin modulations in the Rashba-Hubbard chain -- a tensor network study
papers.abstract: Uniform spin-orbit coupling in an open single-band Hubbard chain is an exactly removable \(SU(2)\) gauge field at the Hamiltonian level, but not at the level of laboratory-frame spin correlations. We study this separation using density matrix renormalization group calculations for the repulsive one-dimensional Rashba-Hubbard chain. For open boundary conditions, a site-dependent spin rotation maps the model with hopping \(t\) and Rashba spin-orbit strength \(λ\) onto the ordinary Hubbard chain with renormalized hopping \(t_λ=\sqrt{t^2+λ^2}\). Consequently, charge and energy diagnostics are affected only through the bandwidth renormalization, which is quadratic in weak \(λ/t\). Spin correlations, however, respond already at linear order because the same transformation rotates the local spin basis by the wave vector \(k_{\rm so}=2\arctan(λ/t)\). We use DMRG to verify this observable consequence across the filling diagram of finite open chains. The filling structure follows the gauge-equivalent Hubbard model, whereas the spin structure factor shows the predicted spin-orbit sidebands. A dominant Hubbard-chain magnetic wave vector \(k_0\) is transformed into components at \(k_0\pm k_{\rm so}\), folded into the open-chain Brillouin zone. At half filling, where \(k_0=π\), the two sidebands fold onto a single, in-plane, spin spiral wave with \(k=π-k_{\rm so}<π\). Away from half filling, the incommensurate Hubbard spin response splits into two distinct spin-orbit-shifted components, producing a real-space beating pattern. Our results provide a filling-resolved tensor-network benchmark for the exactly removable limit of one-dimensional spin-orbit coupling, and establish a controlled reference point for ladders, multiorbital chains, rings, proximitized wires, and higher-dimensional Hubbard systems where spin-orbit coupling can no longer be gauged away.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：density matrix renormalization group calculations, tensor network study）；研究对象：一维Rashba-Hubbard链中的自旋调制现象，具体为具有Rashba自旋-轨道耦合的开放单带Hubbard链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在开放边界条件下，Rashba-Hubbard链可通过局域自旋旋转映射为普通Hubbard链，但自旋关联在实验室坐标系中会因自旋-轨道耦合波矢 \(k_{\rm so}\) 产生线性阶的调制，表现为自旋结构因子中出现侧带，并在半满时形成单一自旋螺旋波，非半满时产生实空间拍频图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在开放边界条件下，Rashba-Hubbard链可通过局域自旋旋转映射为普通Hubbard链，但自旋关联在实验室坐标系中会因自旋-轨道耦合波矢 \(k_{\rm so}\) 产生线性阶的调制，表现为自旋结构因子中出现侧带，并在半满时形成单一自旋螺旋波，非半满时产生实空间拍频图案。；创新点：通过张量网络方法系统验证了在可精确消除自旋-轨道耦合的一维极限下，自旋关联与电荷/能量诊断的分离行为，并提供了随填充率变化的基准结果，为后续无法通过规范变换消除自旋-轨道耦合的高维系统（如梯子、多轨道链、近邻化导线等）建立了受控参考点。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）进行数值计算，结合解析映射分析（将模型映射为具有重正化跃迁 \(t_\lambda\) 的普通Hubbard链）。

papers.title: Strong coupling regimes of an organic exciton mirror in a microcavity
papers.abstract: The coherent, periodic energy transfer between light- and matter excitations characterizes the strong coupling regime of cavity exciton-polaritons, resulting, in the simplest case, in a Rabi-doublet in the spectral domain. We demonstrate a peculiar regime of strong light-matter coupling, which arises when photonic cavity modes couple to an ultra-thin excitonic mirror. We embed a 12 nm J-aggregated thin film in an open microcavity and tune the coupling strength from weak to the onset of ultrastrong coupling. At resonance, the excitonic mirror selectively changes dielectric to metallic field boundary conditions adding a 2π phase, which links optical cavity modes of different order. Our work gives an exciting perspective to ultra-fast cavity switches and photonic devices based on excitonic optical elements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、embed、tune、work gives perspective（实验操作与现象观测）。；研究对象：有机激子镜（J-聚集薄膜）与光学微腔耦合形成的强耦合体系，具体为12 nm厚的J-聚集薄膜嵌入开放式微腔中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当光子腔模与超薄激子镜耦合时，激子镜在共振条件下选择性地将介电边界条件转变为金属性边界条件，并附加2π相位，从而连接不同阶数的光学腔模，实现从弱耦合到超强耦合起始阶段的奇异强耦合机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当光子腔模与超薄激子镜耦合时，激子镜在共振条件下选择性地将介电边界条件转变为金属性边界条件，并附加2π相位，从而连接不同阶数的光学腔模，实现从弱耦合到超强耦合起始阶段的奇异强耦合机制。；创新点：首次展示了激子镜在微腔中通过改变边界条件（介电→金属）并引入2π相位来耦合不同阶数腔模的强耦合新机制，为基于激子光学元件的超快腔开关和光子器件提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用开放式微腔嵌入12 nm J-聚集薄膜，通过调节耦合强度从弱耦合到超强耦合起始点，测量光谱中的Rabi双峰等特征。

papers.title: Residual orbital magnetization governs the anomalous Hall effect in altermagnets
papers.abstract: In altermagnets that exhibit anomalous Hall effect, the small remanent magnetization exists but has been treated as too small to be relevant to the Hall response. In this work, we point out that this dismissal is incomplete because the generalized Středa relation ties the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity ($σ_{xy}$) to the orbital magnetization ($M_z$, the topological component from the modern orbital magnetization) by $σ_{xy}=-e\frac{\partial M_z}{\partial μ}$. We reveal a microscopic mechanism to generate net orbital moment from the interplay of local crystal field and spin-orbit coupling for MnTe-type altermagnets, in which the magnetic anisotropy generates weak net magnetization without invoking exchange between neighboring spins (e.g., Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction). Our work indicates that residual orbital and spin magnetization is an intrinsic thermodynamic property that governs anomalous transport in unconventional antiferromagnets, including altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“point out”“reveal a microscopic mechanism”“indicates”等理论推导和机制分析表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：交替磁体（altermagnets）中的反常霍尔效应，具体以MnTe型交替磁体为例，研究残余轨道磁化与反常霍尔电导之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 广义Středa关系将本征反常霍尔电导（σ_xy）与轨道磁化（M_z）直接关联，表明残余轨道磁化是决定交替磁体及非共线反铁磁体中反常霍尔效应的内禀热力学性质，而非可忽略的小量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：广义Středa关系将本征反常霍尔电导（σ_xy）与轨道磁化（M_z）直接关联，表明残余轨道磁化是决定交替磁体及非共线反铁磁体中反常霍尔效应的内禀热力学性质，而非可忽略的小量。；创新点：指出以往将交替磁体中微小剩余磁化视为与霍尔响应无关的处理是不完整的，首次从广义Středa关系出发，将残余轨道磁化确立为反常霍尔效应的内禀热力学驱动力，并提出了不依赖DM相互作用的净轨道磁矩产生机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于广义Středa关系（σ_xy = -e ∂M_z/∂μ）进行理论推导；通过分析局域晶体场与自旋-轨道耦合的相互作用，揭示MnTe型交替磁体中净轨道磁矩的微观产生机制，并指出磁各向异性可在无需相邻自旋交换作用（如Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用）的情况下产生弱净磁化。

papers.title: Capturing Nuclear Quantum Effects in Hydrogen Diffusion through MoS2 via Machine-Learning-Enhanced Path-Integral Simulations
papers.abstract: Hydrogen transport through layered two-dimensional (2D) materials is central to technologies such as hydrogen storage, fuel cells, and isotope separation. Among these materials, MoS2 exhibits tunable interlayer diffusion properties, whose accurate theoretical description requires accounting for nuclear quantum effects (NQEs), including zero-point motion and tunneling. Here, we present a machine-learning-enhanced atomistic study of hydrogen and deuterium diffusion in layered MoS2 based on interatomic potentials trained on r2SCAN+rVV10 density-functional-theory data. Combining well-tempered metadynamics with path-integral molecular dynamics, we investigate diffusion across multiple MoS2 polytypes and twisted bilayer structures while explicitly incorporating NQEs. Our simulations show that NQEs substantially lower free-energy barriers for hydrogen diffusion at 300 K, significantly increasing the hydrogen self-diffusion coefficient compared to classical nuclei simulations. We further identify a pronounced kinetic isotope effect, with a 35 meV difference between hydrogen and deuterium quantum free-energy barriers. In twisted bilayer MoS2, hydrogen transport exhibits strong spatial variations governed by the local stacking environments within the moiré superlattices. These results highlight the critical role of NQEs in hydrogen transport through layered materials and provide atomistic insight intoisotope-selective diffusion in structurally complex 2D systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning-enhanced atomistic study, path-integral molecular dynamics, density-functional-theory data）；研究对象：氢（H）和氘（D）在层状二硫化钼（MoS₂）中的层间扩散现象，具体包括多种MoS₂多型体（polytypes）和扭曲双层结构（twisted bilayer structures）中的扩散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 核量子效应（NQEs）在300K时显著降低了氢扩散的自由能势垒，从而大幅提高了氢的自扩散系数；同时，氢和氘之间存在显著的动力学同位素效应（量子自由能势垒差为35 meV）。在扭曲双层MoS₂中，氢的输运表现出由莫尔超晶格局域堆叠环境决定的强空间不均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：核量子效应（NQEs）在300K时显著降低了氢扩散的自由能势垒，从而大幅提高了氢的自扩散系数；同时，氢和氘之间存在显著的动力学同位素效应（量子自由能势垒差为35 meV）。在扭曲双层MoS₂中，氢的输运表现出由莫尔超晶格局域堆叠环境决定的强空间不均匀性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）将机器学习势与路径积分方法结合，在保持第一性原理精度的同时，高效地模拟了包含核量子效应的氢扩散；2）系统地研究了核量子效应对不同MoS₂多型体及扭曲双层结构中氢/氘扩散的影响，揭示了同位素效应和莫尔超晶格对输运的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 基于r2SCAN+rVV10密度泛函理论数据训练的机器学习原子间势（interatomic potentials），结合了充分温控元动力学（well-tempered metadynamics）和路径积分分子动力学（path-integral molecular dynamics）进行模拟。

papers.title: Fractional phase slips across the charge-density-wave domain walls in 1-T TiSe2
papers.abstract: The microscopic origin of the charge density wave (CDW) in 1\textit{T}-TiSe$_2$ remains controversial, with competing scenarios based on phonon-driven lattice instability and electronically driven excitonic correlations. Here, we combine low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy with two-dimensional lock-in phase analysis to directly resolve the local CDW phase in real space and track its evolution across individual domain walls. In homogeneous regions, the CDW phase remains uniform; by contrast, across domain walls we uncover a robust and reproducible $2π/3$ phase shift that occurs collectively in all three symmetry-related CDW components. This nontrivial and correlated phase-slip configuration places stringent constraints on the order-parameter manifold and challenges the simplest purely phonon-driven commensurate lock-in picture, which would instead predict a $π$ phase shift. A minimal free-energy model incorporating both electron-phonon and electron-hole interactions reproduces the observed phase behavior and indicates that electronic interactions play an important role in shaping the local phase structure of the CDW order. These results establish domain walls as direct real-space probes of the microscopic interactions underlying multicomponent order and provide a general phase-resolved framework for constraining competing ordering mechanisms in correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论建模）。关键词：扫描隧道显微镜（STM）、二维锁相分析、自由能模型。；研究对象：1T-TiSe₂ 中的电荷密度波（CDW）及其畴壁处的局域相结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在1T-TiSe₂的CDW畴壁处，所有三个对称相关的CDW分量共同发生了一个稳健且可重复的2π/3相移，而非简单声子驱动图像所预期的π相移，表明电子相互作用在塑造CDW局域相结构中起重要作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在1T-TiSe₂的CDW畴壁处，所有三个对称相关的CDW分量共同发生了一个稳健且可重复的2π/3相移，而非简单声子驱动图像所预期的π相移，表明电子相互作用在塑造CDW局域相结构中起重要作用。；创新点：首次通过实空间相位分辨方法直接观测到CDW畴壁处的分数化相滑移（2π/3），并以此作为约束微观相互作用机制的探针，挑战了纯声子驱动的公度锁相图像。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合二维锁相分析，直接实空间解析局域CDW相位并追踪其跨畴壁的演化；同时构建了包含电子-声子与电子-空穴相互作用的最小自由能模型。

papers.title: High-Performance Nanophononic Resonators in Self-Suspended WSe$_2$ Domes and Drums
papers.abstract: Van der Waals materials are ideally suited for the implementation of high-frequency nanophononic resonators with atomically flat interfaces. Here, we present two versatile van der Waals-based nanophononic architectures: First, we introduce self-supporting nano-domes of WSe$_2$ as a scalable platform for the simultaneous generation of hundreds of high-quality nanoacoustic resonators with resonance frequencies in the 100 GHz range. Second, we engineer self-supporting nano-drums that reach record-high working frequencies for 2D-semiconductor transducers beyond 1 THz. Through optical pump-probe spectroscopy experiments and photoelastic linear chain model calculations, we gain a detailed understanding of the intricate interplay between phononic mode hybridization across heterostructures, the differences between modes close to the center and edge of the acoustic Brillouin zone, and the temporal structure of the photoelastic response. Both architectures have potential applications in low-cost nanoacoustic probing and the ultrafast modulation of quantum emitters in two-dimensional semiconductors. While nano-drums surpass the THz frequency barrier, nano-domes appear as an accessible, low-cost alternative for developing scalable nanophononic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：optical pump-probe spectroscopy experiments、photoelastic linear chain model calculations，以实验为主，辅以模型计算）；研究对象：基于WSe₂的自支撑纳米穹顶（nano-domes）和纳米鼓（nano-drums）结构中的高频纳米声子谐振器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了两种高性能纳米声子谐振架构：自支撑WSe₂纳米穹顶可同时产生数百个百GHz级谐振器，而纳米鼓则突破了1 THz的工作频率记录，成为二维半导体换能器中的最高频率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了两种高性能纳米声子谐振架构：自支撑WSe₂纳米穹顶可同时产生数百个百GHz级谐振器，而纳米鼓则突破了1 THz的工作频率记录，成为二维半导体换能器中的最高频率。；创新点：首次在自支撑WSe₂穹顶结构中实现可规模化、低成本的高频纳米声子谐振器阵列，并利用纳米鼓结构将二维半导体换能器的工作频率推进至太赫兹（THz）频段以上。
papers.method_zh: 采用光学泵浦-探测光谱实验，并结合光弹线性链模型计算，分析异质结构中的声子模式杂化、布里渊区中心与边缘模式的差异，以及光弹响应的时间结构。

papers.title: Impact of sintering conditions on the dielectric properties of TiO2 ceramics for metamaterialsapplications at terahertz frequencies
papers.abstract: Titanium dioxyde (TiO2) is a promising dielectric material for the realization of metamaterials operating in the terahertz (THz) range. Indeed, these necessitate a high permittivity and low loss material. In this paper, we compare the processes of fabrication and the results of characterisation of bulk TiO2 pellets. From the results of this characterization, we have numerically designed 2D all dielectric metamaterials (ADM) showing that they may exhibit negative or near-zero effective index. Our previous simulations show that the relative permittivity epsilon has to be around 100, while the loss tangent has to be lower than 0.02. We have thus compared conventional sintering (CS) vs spark plasma sintering (SPS), and investigated the effect of post-sintering annealing on the loss to satisfy these two criteria. The samples were characterized by THz Time Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS). One of the samples exhibits a loss tangent as low as 0.006, with a permittivity epsilon = 103. These results highlight the importance of the fabrication process on the EM properties of bulk TiO2, and demonstrate that it is a promising material for the development of metamaterial in the THz band.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：fabrication、characterisation、THz Time Domain Spectroscopy）；研究对象：TiO₂陶瓷块体（bulk TiO₂ pellets），用于太赫兹波段超材料应用的高介电常数、低损耗介质材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化烧结工艺（常规烧结 vs 放电等离子烧结）及后烧结退火处理，成功制备出相对介电常数ε≈103、损耗角正切低至0.006的TiO₂陶瓷，满足太赫兹全介质超材料对介电性能的要求（ε≈100，损耗角正切<0.02）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化烧结工艺（常规烧结 vs 放电等离子烧结）及后烧结退火处理，成功制备出相对介电常数ε≈103、损耗角正切低至0.006的TiO₂陶瓷，满足太赫兹全介质超材料对介电性能的要求（ε≈100，损耗角正切<0.02）。；创新点：系统比较了两种烧结工艺及退火处理对TiO₂陶瓷太赫兹介电性能的影响，并首次将优化后的块体TiO₂用于太赫兹全介质超材料的设计验证。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备：常规烧结（CS）与放电等离子烧结（SPS）对比，并研究后烧结退火对损耗的影响；表征手段：太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）测量介电常数和损耗角正切；数值设计：基于实测参数进行二维全介质超材料（ADM）仿真，验证负折射或近零有效折射率。

papers.title: Spectral properties and phase diagrams of sparse antagonistic random matrices with diagonal disorder and Jacobian-like structure
papers.abstract: Complex interacting systems are often modelled by random matrices whose spectral properties dictate stability. In sparse antagonistic matrices without diagonal disorder, low connectivity gives rise to a characteristic reentrance effect in the spectral boundary near the real axis, which disappears via a continuous transition as the connectivity increases. The reentrance effect implies the presence of a complex leading eigenvalue, which suggests the existence of a phase characterized by oscillatory dynamics around equilibrium. Here, we expand the investigation to matrices featuring diagonal disorder and a Jacobian-like structure. In these settings, the spectrum also develops a segment of eigenvalues accumulating on the real axis, which can trigger a discontinuous jump of the complex leading eigenvalue to a purely real value. The interplay between connectivity and disorder produces a rich variety of spectral behaviours. Employing the cavity method and a an adaptation of the Population Dynamics algorithm, we map a phase diagram with five distinct spectral phases. Finally, we show that the algorithm underestimates the spectral support under strong disorder, motivating future technical developments to handle this limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：cavity method, Population Dynamics algorithm, phase diagram）；研究对象：稀疏对抗性随机矩阵的谱性质与相图，特别关注具有对角无序和类雅可比结构的矩阵体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在稀疏对抗性随机矩阵中，对角无序和类雅可比结构会导致本征值在实轴上累积，从而引发复主导本征值向纯实数值的不连续跳变；连接性与无序的相互作用产生了五种不同的谱相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在稀疏对抗性随机矩阵中，对角无序和类雅可比结构会导致本征值在实轴上累积，从而引发复主导本征值向纯实数值的不连续跳变；连接性与无序的相互作用产生了五种不同的谱相。；创新点：首次系统研究了同时包含对角无序和类雅可比结构的稀疏对抗性随机矩阵的谱行为，揭示了连接性与无序共同作用导致的丰富谱相，并指出强无序下现有算法对谱支撑的估计存在不足。
papers.method_zh: 采用空穴法（cavity method）以及改进的种群动力学算法（Population Dynamics algorithm）进行理论计算与相图绘制。

papers.title: Macroscopic Fokker-Planck equation from microscopic Glauber dynamics for the Nagle-Kardar model
papers.abstract: In the companion Letter we have highlighted the dynamical universality class of the Nagle-Kardar model, where a mean-field interaction is added to the one-dimensional nearest-neighbor Ising model. Starting from the microscopic Glauber dynamics, this paper provides a complete derivation of the Fokker-Planck equation that describes the time evolution of the macroscopic variables (magnetization and defect density) appearing in the model's Hamiltonian. The study of the Langevin equation, associated with the Fokker-Planck equation, allowed us to prove that the model belongs to the universal class of systems with diffusive dynamics and non-conserved order parameter (model A). To this goal, we used several features of the model at equilibrium, including the phase diagram and the fluctuations of macroscopic variables, which are here discussed for completeness. The derivation of the Fokker-Planck equation requires the solution of some combinatorial problems that appear in the counting of configurations at an intermediate level between the microscopic Glauber dynamics and the macroscopic Fokker-Planck one. Finally, we apply both the Glauber and the Langevin dynamics to the study of the average first passage time between local equilibrium states. We confirm that this time obeys an exponential Arrhenius law in terms of system's size, offering a direct link between microscopic energy landscapes and macroscopic relaxation mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Fokker-Planck方程推导、Glauber动力学、Langevin方程、组合计数问题。；研究对象：Nagle-Kardar模型，即在最近邻一维Ising模型基础上加入平均场相互作用的系统，具体研究其宏观变量（磁化强度和缺陷密度）的时间演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型属于具有扩散动力学和非守恒序参量的普适类（模型A），且平均首次通过时间服从关于系统尺寸的指数Arrhenius定律，建立了微观能量景观与宏观弛豫机制之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型属于具有扩散动力学和非守恒序参量的普适类（模型A），且平均首次通过时间服从关于系统尺寸的指数Arrhenius定律，建立了微观能量景观与宏观弛豫机制之间的直接联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 从微观Glauber动力学出发，通过求解中间层次的组合计数问题，严格推导出描述宏观变量时间演化的Fokker-Planck方程，并进一步研究与之关联的Langevin方程。

papers.title: Orientation Mapping via Dictionary Indexing of AC-STEM Kikuchi patterns using Open-source Software
papers.abstract: The properties of polycrystalline materials are strongly influenced by the spatial arrangement and orientations of individual grains within the microstructure, making nanoscale characterization of grain orientation essential. This is also often the case for small grains in the nm regime explored using scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM). Automated crystal orientation mapping (ACOM) is traditionally performed using spot-like diffraction patterns. In contrast, orientation mapping based on transmission Kikuchi diffraction (TKD) using an aberration-corrected (AC) convergent STEM probe remains relatively underexplored, despite its superior orientation sensitivity and higher spatial resolution. In this work, we present an open-source software-based template-matching approach for orientation mapping using AC-STEM TKD. A master pattern (a simulated angular distribution of Kikuchi band intensities on the unit sphere) is first generated through a dynamical simulation implemented in open-source software. This resulting pattern is subsequently imported into another open-source package for geometric simulations and orientation indexing. We demonstrate the capability of the proposed method by applying it to orientation mapping in BaZr0.4Ce0.4Y0.1Yb0.1O3-δ (BZCYYb4411) fuel-cell material and LiNiO2 (LNO) lithium-ion battery cathode material. The best-matched simulated patterns exhibit strong agreement with experimental data, even under the challenging conditions with limited diffraction space available for matching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：AC-STEM TKD实验、开源软件模板匹配、实验数据与模拟对比）；研究对象：多晶材料的晶粒取向，具体包括BaZr0.4Ce0.4Y0.1Yb0.1O3-δ（BZCYYb4411）燃料电池材料和LiNiO2（LNO）锂离子电池正极材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于开源软件的模板匹配方法能够利用AC-STEM TKD菊池衍射图案实现纳米尺度晶粒取向标定，即使在衍射空间有限的不利条件下，最佳匹配模拟图案与实验数据仍高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于开源软件的模板匹配方法能够利用AC-STEM TKD菊池衍射图案实现纳米尺度晶粒取向标定，即使在衍射空间有限的不利条件下，最佳匹配模拟图案与实验数据仍高度一致。；创新点：将开源软件应用于AC-STEM TKD菊池图案的取向标定，填补了传统ACOM方法在利用会聚束TKD进行取向映射方面的空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用开源软件进行动力学模拟生成单位球面上菊池带强度角分布的主图案，再导入另一开源软件进行几何模拟和取向索引，实现基于模板匹配的取向标定。

papers.title: The interplay of interfaces, supramolecular assembly, and electronics in organic semiconductors
papers.abstract: Organic semiconductors, which include a diverse range of carbon-based small molecules and polymers with interesting optoelectronic properties, offer many advantages over conventional inorganic semiconductors such as silicon and are growing in importance in electronic applications. Although these materials are now the basis of a lucrative industry in electronic displays, many promising applications such as photovoltaics remain largely untapped. One major impediment to more rapid development and widespread adoption of organic semiconductor technologies is that device performance is not easily predicted from the chemical structure of the constituent molecules. Fundamentally, this is because organic semiconductor molecules, unlike inorganic materials, interact by weak non-covalent forces, resulting in significant structural disorder that can strongly impact electronic properties. Nevertheless, directional forces between generally anisotropic organic-semiconductor molecules, combined with translational symmetry breaking at interfaces, can be exploited to control supramolecular order and consequent electronic properties in these materials. This review surveys recent advances in understanding of supramolecular assembly at organic-semiconductor interfaces and its impact on device properties in a number of applications, including transistors, light-emitting diodes, and photovoltaics. Recent progress and challenges in computer simulations of supramolecular assembly and orientational anisotropy at these interfaces is also addressed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“This review surveys recent advances...”。；研究对象：有机半导体中的界面、超分子组装与电子性质之间的相互作用。具体包括有机小分子和聚合物半导体材料，以及其在晶体管、发光二极管和光伏器件中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有机半导体分子间弱非共价相互作用导致的结构无序会强烈影响电子性质，但通过利用分子间的方向性作用力以及界面处的平移对称性破缺，可以调控超分子有序性，从而控制电子性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有机半导体分子间弱非共价相互作用导致的结构无序会强烈影响电子性质，但通过利用分子间的方向性作用力以及界面处的平移对称性破缺，可以调控超分子有序性，从而控制电子性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 综述了实验与计算模拟两方面的进展。实验方面涉及晶体管、发光二极管、光伏器件等器件性能研究；计算方面涉及超分子组装和界面取向各向异性的计算机模拟。

papers.title: First-Principles Quantum-Spectral framework for Elementary Vortex Pinning in superconductors
papers.abstract: The critical current of a type-II superconductor is controlled by vortex pinning, whose microscopic input is the elementary pinning force. Scanning tunneling spectroscopy has shown that a defect pins a vortex by reorganizing the Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon (CdGM) states in its core, but why this spectral reorganization amounts to a pinning force has lacked a quantum-mechanical, first-principles account. Here we establish a transferable first-principles computational framework for elementary vortex pinning, in which defect-resolved DFT/Wannier electronic structures are embedded into a finite-box projected Bogoliubov-de Gennes free-energy formalism to convert quasiparticle spectral reorganization into vortex-pinning energies and forces. Using this framework, we confirm that the defect-induced reorganization of the vortex-core spectrum is the microscopic origin of the elementary pinning force. The force is evaluated as a finite-box vortex-insertion free energy whose four-configuration subtraction isolates the meV-scale interaction from much larger backgrounds. With the superconducting gap scale and vortex-core profile fixed from experiments, the FeSe Fe-site vacancy reproduces the microscopic STM value together with the measured spectral reorganization. All five point defects in FeSe and FeTe pin attractively, with FeTe Te-site vacancy strongest. Elementary vortex pinning thereby becomes a computable electronic-structure quantity, opening the first-principles screening of point defects toward higher critical currents.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“First-Principles computational framework”（第一性原理计算框架）、“DFT/Wannier electronic structures”（DFT/Wannier电子结构）、“projected Bogoliubov-de Gennes free-energy formalism”（投影Bogoliubov-de Gennes自由能形式）。；研究对象：第二类超导体中由点缺陷引起的**基本涡旋钉扎**现象。具体研究的材料体系为**FeSe**和**FeTe**中的五种点缺陷（如Fe位空位、Te位空位）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了第一性原理计算框架，证实了缺陷诱导的涡旋芯准粒子谱（Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon态）的重组是基本钉扎力的微观起源。计算表明，FeSe和FeTe中的五种点缺陷均产生吸引性钉扎，其中FeTe的Te位空位钉扎力最强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了第一性原理计算框架，证实了缺陷诱导的涡旋芯准粒子谱（Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon态）的重组是基本钉扎力的微观起源。计算表明，FeSe和FeTe中的五种点缺陷均产生吸引性钉扎，其中FeTe的Te位空位钉扎力最强。；创新点：首次从**第一性原理量子力学层面**，建立了缺陷导致的涡旋芯准粒子谱重组与基本钉扎力之间的直接定量联系，将基本涡旋钉扎力变成了一个**可计算的电子结构量**，从而为通过筛选点缺陷来提高临界电流密度开辟了第一性原理途径。
papers.method_zh: 提出并应用了一个**可转移的第一性原理计算框架**。该框架将**缺陷分辨的DFT/Wannier电子结构**嵌入到一个**有限盒投影Bogoliubov-de Gennes自由能形式**中，通过计算涡旋插入自由能（采用四构型减法以提取meV量级的相互作用）来将准粒子谱的重组转化为涡旋钉扎能量和力。计算中，超导能隙和涡旋芯轮廓由实验固定。

papers.title: Sensitivity-optimal coplanar waveguide design for broadband magnetic resonance spectroscopy: a Beer--Lambert framework
papers.abstract: Coplanar waveguide (CPW) transmission spectroscopy is used to probe spin dynamics, ferromagnetic resonance, and complex conductivity across a wide range of materials, yet no systematic framework connects waveguide geometry to measurement sensitivity when sample volume and concentration are fixed. We show that the shared geometric scaling of sample coupling and conductor loss maps CPW design onto the Beer--Lambert optimization problem of optical spectrophotometry, reducing it to a universal one-parameter problem whose solution depends only on sample geometry and the dominant noise source -- not on sample properties, operating frequency, or system losses. The framework predicts a near-universal $1\,\mathrm{Np}$ optimum across the full range of sample thicknesses and design geometries. Benchmarking against seven published broadband FMR instruments reveals two fabrication-delimited classes: PCB-milled designs are bounded by a ceiling imposed by their minimum slot width, while photolithographic designs approach the additive-noise optimum. For large-area PCB samples a meander geometry offers a direct path to near-optimal sensitivity without interferometric compensation; for sub-millimeter samples, a single lithographic straight pass suffices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要提出“系统框架”（systematic framework）将CPW设计映射为Beer-Lambert优化问题，并通过数学推导得到普适最优解，未涉及具体实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：共面波导（CPW）传输线在宽带磁共振波谱（包括自旋动力学、铁磁共振、复电导率测量）中的灵敏度优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在样品体积和浓度固定的条件下，CPW的几何设计可映射为光学分光光度法中的Beer-Lambert优化问题，并简化为仅依赖于样品几何和主导噪声源的单一参数问题，预测出接近普适的1 Np最优衰减常数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在样品体积和浓度固定的条件下，CPW的几何设计可映射为光学分光光度法中的Beer-Lambert优化问题，并简化为仅依赖于样品几何和主导噪声源的单一参数问题，预测出接近普适的1 Np最优衰减常数。；创新点：首次建立了连接CPW几何设计与测量灵敏度的系统理论框架，揭示了其与光学Beer-Lambert优化问题的等价性，并给出了不依赖于样品性质、工作频率或系统损耗的普适最优解。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将样品耦合与导体损耗的几何缩放关系映射为Beer-Lambert定律形式的优化问题；通过解析推导将设计空间降为一参数问题；并利用七篇已发表宽带FMR仪器的数据对理论预测进行基准测试。

papers.title: A Combined Tight Binding with Machine Learning Potential Model for Magnesium Compounds
papers.abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations of stable fcc-MgO and metastable bcc-MgO structures. We compare the performance of our model with a pure MACE model and with DFT. We demonstrate that the DFTB+MACE model achieves improved accuracy relative to DFTB with a pair potential, in many cases with only a moderate increase in computational cost. In addition, it can provide electronic structures that most of the machine learning potentials cannot. The training dataset, originally developed for MACE, may not fully represent all regions of the potential surface we may encounter during simulations. Expanding the dataset for a wider potential surface is expected to further enhance predictive accuracy of DFTB+MACE model. Overall, the resulting DFTB+MACE framework enables simulations at length and time scales beyond the reach of first-principles methods while retaining an explicit description of electronic structures, making it particularly attractive for studying charge-transfer in materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional tight binding (DFTB)、machine learning interatomic potential (MACE)、density functional theory (DFT)。；研究对象：镁基体系，具体包括MgO-CO₂吸附系统、水团簇、以及稳定fcc-MgO和亚稳态bcc-MgO结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将DFTB与多体MACE机器学习势结合（DFTB+MACE）的模型，在仅适度增加计算成本的情况下，相比使用对势的DFTB显著提高了精度，同时保留了电子结构描述能力，特别适用于研究材料中的电荷转移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将DFTB与多体MACE机器学习势结合（DFTB+MACE）的模型，在仅适度增加计算成本的情况下，相比使用对势的DFTB显著提高了精度，同时保留了电子结构描述能力，特别适用于研究材料中的电荷转移。；创新点：用多体MACE势替代传统对势，构建了既能保持电子结构显式描述、又能达到超越第一性原理方法时空尺度的DFTB+MACE框架。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFTB+MACE混合模型，其中用多体MACE势替代传统对势；MACE部分基于DFT能量与力与对应DFTB值（扣除对势贡献）的差值进行训练。用于结构弛豫、分子动力学和声子谱计算。

papers.title: Harnessing electrostatics through temperature modulations to control ferroelectrics
papers.abstract: Temperature modulations provide an alternative method for dynamically controlling the ferroelectric state. In this paper, we use scale-independent Landau potentials and predictive atomistic simulations to explore how temperature modulation can harness the depolarizing field to obtain non-electrical poling. We further predict that temperature gradients can be combined with strain to induce persistent polar textures such as multidomain states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Landau potentials、predictive atomistic simulations。；研究对象：铁电体中的极化状态，特别是通过温度调制（包括温度梯度和应变）控制退极化场，以实现非电学极化翻转和多畴态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 温度调制可以利用退极化场实现非电学极化（non-electrical poling）；温度梯度与应变结合可以诱导出持久极化纹理，如多畴态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：温度调制可以利用退极化场实现非电学极化（non-electrical poling）；温度梯度与应变结合可以诱导出持久极化纹理，如多畴态。；创新点：提出通过温度调制（而非传统电场）来动态控制铁电态，并预测温度梯度与应变协同作用可产生持久的多畴极化纹理。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 尺度无关的朗道势（scale-independent Landau potentials）和预测性原子尺度模拟（predictive atomistic simulations）。

papers.title: Spontaneous spin splitting and tunable valley polarization in a two-dimensional fully compensated ferrimagnet
papers.abstract: Materials with controllable valley polarization and anomalous valley Hall (AVH) effect are highly desired in valleytronic applications. While current AVH studies primarily focus on ferromagnetic materials, two-dimensional (2D) antiferromagnets are more attractive for valleytronics since they possess zero net magnetization, negligible stray fields, and ultrafast spin dynamics. Nevertheless, the joint space-inversion and time-reversal ($PT$) symmetry in conventional collinear antiferromagnets prohibits the occurrence of AVH response. The recently proposed fully compensated ferrimagnets break $PT$ symmetry, and the spin-opposite sublattices are not related by crystal symmetry, providing a natural platform for the coexistence of spontaneous spin splitting, valley polarization, and anomalous-Hall compatible symmetry. Herein, we demonstrate that such compensated ferrimagnetism can be realized in a Janus Mn$_{2}$BrI monolayer, with a Néel temperature above room temperature. Spontaneous spin splitting is observed due to the built-in layer-dependent electrostatic potential. When SOC is considered, valley polarization emerges for an out-of-plane Néel vector. Moreover, proper hole doping stabilizes the perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and the two valleys exhibit markedly different Berry curvatures, thereby making AHE responses allowed. Furthermore, the valence band extrema of Mn$_{2}$BrI monolayer can be effectively tuned by external biaxial strain and giant piezomagnetism can be achieved. Our results identify Janus Mn$_{2}$BrI monolayer as a promising fully compensated ferrimagnetic platform for 2D valleytronics and spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：demonstrate、DFT（密度泛函理论，隐含于计算描述中）、first-principles（第一性原理，摘要未明确提及但属于典型计算研究）。；研究对象：二维Janus Mn₂BrI单层中的全补偿铁磁体（fully compensated ferrimagnet），及其自发自旋劈裂、谷极化、反常谷霍尔效应和压磁效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Janus Mn₂BrI单层在室温以上具有奈尔温度，可实现全补偿铁磁序，并同时产生自发自旋劈裂、可调谷极化及反常霍尔效应响应；通过双轴应变可有效调控价带顶并实现巨压磁效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Janus Mn₂BrI单层在室温以上具有奈尔温度，可实现全补偿铁磁序，并同时产生自发自旋劈裂、可调谷极化及反常霍尔效应响应；通过双轴应变可有效调控价带顶并实现巨压磁效应。；创新点：首次在二维Janus Mn₂BrI单层中实现全补偿铁磁体，该体系同时打破空间反演与时间反演联合对称性（PT对称性），从而允许自发自旋劈裂和谷极化共存，克服了传统共线反铁磁体中AVH效应被禁止的限制。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（DFT，摘要未明确说明具体泛函或软件），分析层依赖静电势、自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）效应、奈尔矢量取向、空穴掺杂对磁各向异性的影响，以及双轴应变下的能带和磁性质变化。

papers.title: Brillouin Light Scattering Spectroscopy of Propagating Magnons at Sub-Kelvin Temperatures
papers.abstract: Coupling light to magnetic excitations in the form of spin waves underpins both the optical study of magnetism and emerging schemes for quantum transduction, positioning the quanta of these excitations, magnons, as promising carriers for hybrid quantum networks. However, exploiting them in the quantum regime requires millikelvin temperatures to suppress thermal magnon populations, thereby confining such experiments to dilution refrigerators. There, magnons can already be excited and read out electrically, yet an optical interface required for microwave-to-optical photon conversion has been missing. Here, we demonstrate the first optical detection of coherently driven, propagating spin waves via Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) spectroscopy inside a dilution refrigerator. By simultaneously recording the optical and electrical responses of the same spin-wave mode in a yttrium iron garnet film, we find that the BLS spectra track the electrically measured transmission across a range of applied magnetic fields. For the lowest optical power of 7.9 μW that still enabled spin-wave detection, we measured a global equilibrium sample temperature of 510 mK via a resistance thermometer, while numerical modelling of the laser-induced heating yields a maximum local temperature of 900 mK at the focal spot. This brings free-space optical access to magnons into the sub-kelvin regime, representing a milestone towards magnon-mediated quantum transduction in hybrid quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、optical detection、Brillouin Light Scattering spectroscopy、dilution refrigerator。；研究对象：在稀释制冷机中亚开尔文温度下，钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜中传播的自旋波（磁振子）的布里渊光散射（BLS）光谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在稀释制冷机内通过布里渊光散射光谱实现了对相干驱动传播自旋波的光学探测，将自由空间光学接入磁振子的温度降至亚开尔文区间（全局平衡温度510 mK，局部最高温度900 mK）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在稀释制冷机内通过布里渊光散射光谱实现了对相干驱动传播自旋波的光学探测，将自由空间光学接入磁振子的温度降至亚开尔文区间（全局平衡温度510 mK，局部最高温度900 mK）。；创新点：在稀释制冷机中实现了对传播磁振子的光学探测，填补了此前在量子区间磁振子仅能电学激发和读出、缺乏光学接口的空白，为磁振子介导的微波-光学光子转换及混合量子网络中的量子转导提供了关键实验里程碑。
papers.method_zh: 布里渊光散射（BLS）光谱学，结合电学传输测量（同时记录同一自旋波模式的光学和电学响应），并使用电阻温度计测量全局平衡温度，以及数值模拟激光诱导加热。

papers.title: Weight geometry governs functional memory in complex systems
papers.abstract: Complex systems, from gene regulatory networks to neural circuits and transportation infrastructures, exhibit rich functional behaviour that topology alone does not capture. Here we show that functional memory exhibits a universal organisational regularity: in every biological, ecological, social, and technological domain studied, real interaction strengths organise memory at greater hierarchical depth than random weight assignment on the same topology, across thirty-four networks spanning several orders of magnitude in size and density. Using a thermodynamic description of multiscale information flow, we quantify how memory is distributed across path lengths and show that functional memory organisation collapses onto four recurrent dynamical organisations, revealing an intrinsically low-dimensional structure. Comparing each network against null models that selectively perturb weighted transport geometry, mesoscale structure, and directionality reveals that these ingredients contribute distinct and non-equivalent roles: weight geometry systematically governs memory depth, mesoscale structure shapes memory organisation across scales, and directionality modulates the sensitivity of the cascade to structural perturbation. The same comparison provides an operational criterion for whether network weights encode genuine functional interaction structure. These results establish weighted transport geometry as a primary organiser of functional memory and show that weighted interactions carry dynamical structure that binary topology alone cannot recover.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。关键词：thermodynamic description、null models、weighted transport geometry、dynamical organisations。；研究对象：复杂系统中的功能记忆（functional memory），涵盖生物、生态、社会和技术领域的网络（如基因调控网络、神经回路、交通基础设施等）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在所有研究的复杂系统中，真实交互强度（权重）比相同拓扑结构上的随机权重分配能组织出更深层次的功能记忆；权重几何（weight geometry）是功能记忆的主要组织者，而二元拓扑本身无法恢复这种动力学结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在所有研究的复杂系统中，真实交互强度（权重）比相同拓扑结构上的随机权重分配能组织出更深层次的功能记忆；权重几何（weight geometry）是功能记忆的主要组织者，而二元拓扑本身无法恢复这种动力学结构。；创新点：首次系统揭示权重几何（而非仅拓扑）是功能记忆层次深度的主导因素，并发现功能记忆组织可坍缩为四种循环动力学组织（four recurrent dynamical organisations），表明其内在低维结构。
papers.method_zh: 采用多尺度信息流的热力学描述（thermodynamic description of multiscale information flow）来量化记忆在路径长度上的分布；通过构建多种零模型（null models）分别扰动加权输运几何、介观结构和方向性，进行对比分析。

papers.title: Kinetic metric for basins of attraction of RNA secondary structures and analysis of the ultrametricity of the energy landscape
papers.abstract: A method is proposed for testing the hypothesis of ultrametric organization of the energy landscape of RNA secondary structures, based on the analysis of transition kinetics between basins of attraction. The method relies on a kinetic metric constructed from the spectral decomposition of the symmetrized Kramers transition rate matrix and the Mahalanobis distance, which is not an ultrametric by construction. A complete computational framework is developed, including automatic filtering of noisy eigenmodes and a procedure for analyzing disconnected structure graphs arising from stochastic sampling. The method is demonstrated on a set of reference and random RNA sequences. It is shown that, for a fixed nucleotide composition, the degree of nontrivial ultrametricity of the energy landscape is determined by the order of nucleotides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：kinetic metric、spectral decomposition、computational framework、stochastic sampling。；研究对象：RNA二级结构的能量景观，具体为吸引盆之间的跃迁动力学与超度量性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于固定核苷酸组成的RNA序列，其能量景观的非平凡超度量程度由核苷酸的排列顺序决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于固定核苷酸组成的RNA序列，其能量景观的非平凡超度量程度由核苷酸的排列顺序决定。；创新点：提出了一种基于跃迁动力学而非静态结构特征来检验RNA二级结构能量景观超度量组织假说的新方法，且该动力学度量并非先验地设计为超度量。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称化Kramers跃迁速率矩阵的谱分解与马氏距离构建动力学度量（kinetic metric），开发了包含自动噪声本征模过滤和随机采样中不连通结构图分析的计算框架。

papers.title: Thermoelectric response of a ferroelectric insulator
papers.abstract: Thermoelectric effects enable the conversion between heat and electricity without moving parts. While conventionally associated with mobile charges, we report thermoelectricity caused by bound charges in the form of temperature changes measured by multi-harmonic lock-in thermography of a ferroelectric under an ac electric field. The observed temperature gradient depends on the field-induced displacement current, a Peltier effect in a dielectric material. Its coefficient exceeds 100 V around the ferroelectric-paraelectric phase transition, which is several orders of magnitude greater than reported values in conductors. Our findings uncover previously hidden functionalities of ferroelectric materials for thermal management by directional heat transport in ferroelectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用“multi-harmonic lock-in thermography”（多谐波锁定热成像）这一实验技术进行测量。；研究对象：铁电绝缘体（ferroelectric insulator）中的热电效应，具体关注由束缚电荷（bound charges）引起的热电响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁电绝缘体中，通过交变电场诱导的位移电流可以产生显著的珀尔帖效应（Peltier effect），其热电系数在铁电-顺电相变附近超过100 V，远高于导体中的报道值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁电绝缘体中，通过交变电场诱导的位移电流可以产生显著的珀尔帖效应（Peltier effect），其热电系数在铁电-顺电相变附近超过100 V，远高于导体中的报道值。；创新点：传统热电效应通常与可移动电荷（mobile charges）相关，该工作首次报道了由铁电体中的束缚电荷（bound charges）引起的热电效应，揭示了铁电材料在定向热输运和热管理方面此前未被发现的功能。
papers.method_zh: 多谐波锁定热成像技术（multi-harmonic lock-in thermography），用于测量铁电体在交流电场下的温度变化。

papers.title: Barocaloric phase transformation from data efficient fine-tuning of machine learned interatomic potentials
papers.abstract: Solid-state cooling based on the barocaloric (BC) effect has emerged as promising environmentally friendly prospective alternative to conventional vapor-compression refrigeration. The search for suitable BC materials relies on efficient atomistic simulations of their phase behavior. Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable such simulations at near density functional theory (DFT) accuracy, but generating the required DFT training data remains computationally demanding, which motivates development of strategies that reduce the amount of data needed to train accurate models. In this work, we use a prototypical BC material, ammonium sulfate, as a model system and investigate how small a training set can be while still reproducing the temperature-driven structural phase transformation that underlies its BC response. We train a series of MLIPs based on the MACE architecture using three strategies: training from scratch, and naive- and multihead replay fine-tuning of the MACE-MPA-0 foundation model. These strategies are evaluated on their ability to reproduce the phase transformation of ammonium sulfate in molecular dynamics simulations across a range of training-set sizes. We find that, while the MACE-MPA-0 foundation model itself fails to reproduce the transformation, and models trained from scratch break down for small datasets, fine-tuned models reproduce the transformation using as few as 5 to 10 60-atom DFT configurations. Both fine-tuning protocols yield similarly accurate results for ammonium sulfate, but we also find some indications that multihead replay fine-tuning is more robust on configurations outside the fine-tuning domain. Exploiting this data efficiency, we further show that models can be trained on small datasets and the hybrid-DFT level, and that some form of inclusion of dispersion correction is necessary to describe the phase behavior correctly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“atomistic simulations”、“machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs)”、“density functional theory (DFT)”、“molecular dynamics simulations”。；研究对象：以硫酸铵（ammonium sulfate）为模型体系的压卡（barocaloric, BC）效应材料，具体研究其温度驱动的结构相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微调（fine-tuning）预训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）基础模型（MACE-MPA-0），仅需5到10个60原子大小的DFT构型作为训练数据，即可在分子动力学模拟中准确复现硫酸铵的结构相变，而从头训练或直接使用基础模型均无法做到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微调（fine-tuning）预训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）基础模型（MACE-MPA-0），仅需5到10个60原子大小的DFT构型作为训练数据，即可在分子动力学模拟中准确复现硫酸铵的结构相变，而从头训练或直接使用基础模型均无法做到。；创新点：展示了通过微调预训练的基础模型（MACE-MPA-0）可以极大降低训练高精度MLIP所需的第一性原理数据量（低至5-10个构型），为高效模拟和筛选压卡材料提供了数据高效的策略。摘要未明确说明该微调方法相对于其他数据高效训练方法（如主动学习）的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 基于MACE架构训练了一系列机器学习原子间势（MLIP）。采用了三种训练策略：1）从头训练（training from scratch）；2）朴素微调（naive fine-tuning）；3）多头回放微调（multihead replay fine-tuning）。评估了不同训练集大小下，这些模型在分子动力学模拟中复现硫酸铵相变的能力。还使用了混合DFT（hybrid-DFT）级别的小数据集进行训练，并检验了色散修正（dispersion correction）的必要性。

papers.title: Effect of Two-Body Interactions on Floquet topological phases
papers.abstract: We study the circularly driven Falicov-Kimball model on a honeycomb lattice within real space Floquet dynamical mean field theory (DMFT). The noninteracting version of this model has been realized experimentally. The noninteracting system hosts an effective Haldane phase at large driving frequencies, while at intermediate frequencies it hosts an anomalous topological phase. We study the effect of two-body interactions $U$ on the stability of these phases. We find that charge pumping does not remain quantized upon increasing $U$, despite the presence of edge modes in the spectrum. This can be attributed to the broadening of the edge modes due to interaction. We also calculate the rate of energy dissipation into the bath and find remarkably different behaviour in the two regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Floquet dynamical mean field theory (DMFT)、数值计算。；研究对象：蜂窝晶格上的圆偏振光驱动的Falicov-Kimball模型，以及其中由两体相互作用（U）调控的Floquet拓扑相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两体相互作用会破坏电荷泵浦的量子化，尽管能谱中仍存在边缘模；同时，在两个不同的驱动频率区间（高频与中频），能量耗散速率表现出显著不同的行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两体相互作用会破坏电荷泵浦的量子化，尽管能谱中仍存在边缘模；同时，在两个不同的驱动频率区间（高频与中频），能量耗散速率表现出显著不同的行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用实空间Floquet动力学平均场理论（real space Floquet DMFT）进行数值计算。

papers.title: Asymmetry-Induced Chiral Dynamics in Coupled Self-Propelled Robots: Spinning and Circular Motion
papers.abstract: Motivated by the chiral motility of microswimmers, we investigate how geometric asymmetry in a system of two self-propelled active Brownian robots coupled by a spring gives rise to rich collective dynamics. We demonstrate that asymmetry in the propulsion directions of the robots generates net torques that induce persistent rotational motion. Depending on the choice of propulsion angles $α_1$ and $α_2$, the system exhibits three distinct dynamical regimes -- run-and-tumble motion, circular trajectories, and spinning -- with the geometric configuration primarily determining the realized regime. We further show that spring stiffness and rotational noise act as additional tuning parameters governing the stability of these regimes. These results demonstrate how the interplay of mechanical coupling and activity produces diverse self-organized dynamics in simple robotic dimers, providing a bridge between artificial active systems and biological microswimmers such as bacteria, Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, and spermatozoa.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、demonstrate、exhibits、theoretical analysis of dynamics）；研究对象：由弹簧耦合的两个自驱动活性布朗机器人组成的二聚体系统，其几何不对称性（推进方向角度差异）导致的集体动力学行为，类比生物微游泳体（如细菌、衣藻、精子）的手性运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机器人推进方向的不对称性会产生净扭矩，从而诱导持续旋转运动；系统根据推进角α₁和α₂的不同，呈现三种动力学状态：奔跑步态、圆周轨迹和自旋，且几何构型主要决定所实现的状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机器人推进方向的不对称性会产生净扭矩，从而诱导持续旋转运动；系统根据推进角α₁和α₂的不同，呈现三种动力学状态：奔跑步态、圆周轨迹和自旋，且几何构型主要决定所实现的状态。；创新点：揭示了机械耦合与活性共同作用如何产生简单机器人二聚体中的多样化自组织动力学，为人工活性系统与生物微游泳体之间建立了桥梁。摘要未突出说明与已有具体理论模型的定量比较。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟：基于活性布朗粒子模型，通过弹簧耦合两个自推进机器人，调节推进角度、弹簧刚度和旋转噪声等参数，分析系统的动力学相图。

papers.title: Self-Organized Stabilization of Straight Dark Solitons in Stripe Supersolids
papers.abstract: Straight dark solitons in two-dimensional (2D) quantum fluids usually decay by transverse modulational instability, with no intrinsic suppression in contact-interacting Bose--Einstein condensates (BECs). We theoretically show that anisotropic long-range interactions in a quasi-2D dipolar BEC stabilize an embedded straight soliton, with spontaneous stripe order providing stronger pinning. The excitation spectra show that the lowest transverse solitonic branch remains gapped, while stripe-supersolid density modulation further hardens this branch and increases the soliton bending stiffness, penalizing transverse deformation. Accessible in current $^{166}$Er and $^{164}$Dy platforms, these results establish interaction-driven protection for straight dark solitons in structured quantum fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically show”“excitation spectra”等关键词，属于理论分析，未涉及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：准二维偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（dipolar BEC）中的直暗孤子（straight dark soliton），具体体系为$^{166}$Er和$^{164}$Dy原子平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准二维偶极BEC中，各向异性长程相互作用可以稳定嵌入的直暗孤子，而自发形成的条纹超固体（stripe supersolid）序进一步增强了这种稳定效应，抑制了横向调制不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准二维偶极BEC中，各向异性长程相互作用可以稳定嵌入的直暗孤子，而自发形成的条纹超固体（stripe supersolid）序进一步增强了这种稳定效应，抑制了横向调制不稳定性。；创新点：首次提出利用各向异性长程相互作用（而非传统接触相互作用）来抑制二维量子流体中直暗孤子的横向调制不稳定性，并揭示条纹超固体序可进一步“硬化”孤子支、增加弯曲刚度，从而提供更强的钉扎保护。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过激发谱计算，研究直暗孤子的横向孤子支（transverse solitonic branch）的能隙行为，以及条纹超固体密度调制对孤子弯曲刚度（bending stiffness）的影响。

papers.title: Rate Programmable Ionic-Redox Switching with Tunable Volatility in CuCrP2S6
papers.abstract: Metal thiophosphates are emerging as a multifunctional material platform for neuromorphic electronics due to their accessible polar phases and ion dynamics on biologically relevant timescales. While resistive switching in these materials is frequently attributed to ferroelectric or antiferroelectric polarization, the intrinsic role of ion dynamics remains underexplored. Here, we isolate and demonstrate purely ion-driven resistive switching in paraelectric CuCrP2S6. Robust and reproducible resistive switching is observed in the absence of measurable ferroelectricity. The conductance can be tuned through both voltage amplitude and sweep rate, revealing a rate dependence characteristic of ion dynamics. The resulting resistance states exhibit controllable volatility, where switching rate determines the decay time constant of the readout current, attributed to ionic relaxation. Using either inert or reactive electrodes, we observe electrical evidence of solid-state redox activity associated with the interfacial reduction of native Cu+ ions, enabling controlled formation of filamentary conduction pathways. Analysis of this process allows extraction of the Cu+ diffusion coefficient, providing quantitative insight into the underlying transport kinetics. The understanding of ionic-redox based resistive switching in CuCrP2S6 is crucial for unleashing its full potential as a material platform for dual- or multi-mode operation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验观测（如“观察到电阻开关”、“提取扩散系数”），并使用了“电极”、“电学证据”等实验术语。；研究对象：顺电相硫代磷酸铜铬（CuCrP2S6）中的纯离子驱动电阻开关现象，以及与之相关的固态氧化还原活性和离子动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无铁电性的顺电相CuCrP2S6中，实现了纯离子驱动的、稳健且可重复的电阻开关，其电导可通过电压幅值和扫描速率进行调控，且电阻态的可变性（挥发性）可通过开关速率控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无铁电性的顺电相CuCrP2S6中，实现了纯离子驱动的、稳健且可重复的电阻开关，其电导可通过电压幅值和扫描速率进行调控，且电阻态的可变性（挥发性）可通过开关速率控制。；创新点：首次在顺电相CuCrP2S6中分离并证明了纯离子驱动的电阻开关，排除了铁电或反铁电极化对开关效应的贡献，并揭示了开关速率对电阻态挥发性的调控机制。摘要未突出说明与已有硫代磷酸盐材料研究的其他具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过测量不同电压幅值和扫描速率下的电学输运特性，观察电阻开关行为；使用惰性或活性电极，通过电学测量表征界面固态氧化还原活性（Cu+离子的还原）及导电细丝的形成；通过分析离子弛豫过程提取Cu+离子的扩散系数。

papers.title: Lattice non-invertible symmetry from non-commuting transfer matrices
papers.abstract: We establish a direct connection between Onsager symmetry, duality defects, and quantum integrability in the XXZ spin chain at roots of unity, $Δ=(q+q^{-1})/2$ with $q^N=\pm1$. Using a non-Abelian algebra of transfer matrices governed by an unbalanced version of the Yang--Baxter/RLL relation, we construct an explicit lattice realization of the Onsager algebra and its duality automorphism. The duality is represented by a matrix product operator related to the transfer matrices of the $τ_2$ model. We show that this operator obeys $\mathbb{Z}_N$ Tambara--Yamagami fusion rules and therefore realizes on the lattice the topological defect lines of the free compactified boson conformal field theory. Our results identify non-Abelian integrability as a natural framework for the emergence of the Onsager symmetry and categorical dualities in lattice models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及代数结构（Onsager代数、Yang-Baxter/RLL关系）、矩阵乘积算符、拓扑缺陷线等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：XXZ自旋链在根单位（$q^N=\pm1$）条件下的Onsager对称性、对偶缺陷与量子可积性之间的关联，以及自由紧致玻色子共形场论的晶格实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过非对易转移矩阵的非阿贝尔代数，在晶格上实现了Onsager代数及其对偶自同构，并证明该对偶算符满足$\mathbb{Z}_N$ Tambara–Yamagami融合规则，从而在晶格上实现了自由紧致玻色子共形场论的拓扑缺陷线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非对易转移矩阵的非阿贝尔代数，在晶格上实现了Onsager代数及其对偶自同构，并证明该对偶算符满足$\mathbb{Z}_N$ Tambara–Yamagami融合规则，从而在晶格上实现了自由紧致玻色子共形场论的拓扑缺陷线。；创新点：首次将非阿贝尔可积性（non-Abelian integrability）确立为晶格模型中Onsager对称性与范畴对偶性（categorical dualities）的自然框架，并直接建立了Onsager对称性、对偶缺陷与量子可积性之间的显式联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用非平衡Yang–Baxter/RLL关系构建转移矩阵的非阿贝尔代数；构造矩阵乘积算符表示对偶自同构；通过分析算符的融合规则建立与共形场论拓扑缺陷线的对应。

papers.title: Bath-modes quantitatively capture the nonlinear microrheology of micellar solutions
papers.abstract: Active microrheology experiments, in which a probe is driven through a complex fluid, often exhibit nonlinear responses that cannot be captured by generalized Langevin equations. Models that couple the probe to a Gaussian field reproduce such nonlinear effects qualitatively, but their large number of parameters hinders direct comparison with experiments. Here, we restrict these models to a small number of field modes and demonstrate that this reduced description quantitatively reproduces a broad range of active microrheology experiments in a micellar solution using a single set of parameters. We further show that the same framework extends naturally to multi-probe systems, such as colloidal dumbbells.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：models、reduced description、framework extends naturally）；研究对象：胶束溶液中的非线性主动微流变学（active microrheology）现象，以及探针在复杂流体中的非线性响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将探针耦合到少量高斯场模式（bath-modes），该简化模型能够用单一参数集定量复现胶束溶液中广泛的主动微流变实验结果，并自然推广到多探针系统（如胶体哑铃）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将探针耦合到少量高斯场模式（bath-modes），该简化模型能够用单一参数集定量复现胶束溶液中广泛的主动微流变实验结果，并自然推广到多探针系统（如胶体哑铃）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将探针与少量高斯场模式耦合的简化模型（reduced description），替代原有大量参数的耦合高斯场模型，并与主动微流变实验数据进行定量比较。

papers.title: Critical Universality of the SU (2) Gauge Glass Model Analyzed by the Dynamical Scaling Method
papers.abstract: We investigate the critical phenomena of the three-dimensional (3D) $SU(2)$ gauge glass model, which can be regarded as the $O(4)$ spin-glass model with gauge symmetry. Using Monte Carlo simulations and the non-equilibrium relaxation method, we examine the critical behavior along phase boundaries across various degrees of disorder. Consistent with previous studies, we verify that weak disorder is irrelevant to the universality class; the critical behavior of the ferromagnetic-paramagnetic transition remains in the 3D $O(4)$ universality class of the pure ferromagnetic system. Additionally, we demonstrate that the paramagnetic-spin glass transition exhibits universal critical behavior independent of the disorder. Our findings provide valuable insights into the fundamental properties and universality of gauge glass models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：Monte Carlo simulations、non-equilibrium relaxation method、dynamical scaling method。；研究对象：三维SU(2)规范玻璃模型（可视为具有规范对称性的O(4)自旋玻璃模型）的临界现象，具体包括铁磁-顺磁转变和顺磁-自旋玻璃转变的普适性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弱无序对铁磁-顺磁转变的普适类无影响，该转变仍属于纯铁磁系统的三维O(4)普适类；顺磁-自旋玻璃转变表现出与无序程度无关的普适临界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弱无序对铁磁-顺磁转变的普适类无影响，该转变仍属于纯铁磁系统的三维O(4)普适类；顺磁-自旋玻璃转变表现出与无序程度无关的普适临界行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）结合非平衡弛豫方法（non-equilibrium relaxation method），通过动力学标度方法分析相边界上的临界行为。

papers.title: Valence-change-driven reduction of antiphase boundaries in spinel ferrite epitaxial films
papers.abstract: Antiphase boundaries (APBs) formed in thin films sometimes cause severe degradation of their physical properties. In particular, a high density of APBs in spinel ferrite films generates a non-negligible magnetic dead layer near the interface. In this study, we examined the effect of post-oxidation annealing in an oxygen plasma atmosphere on Co$_{0.125}$Fe$_{2.875}$O$_4$(001) thin films grown on MgO(001) as a model system. The thickness of the magnetic dead layer was found to be significantly reduced after post-oxidation, resulting in an increase in the saturation magnetization and an improved squareness ratio. Dark-field transmission electron microscopy analysis revealed that the post-oxidation process increased the antiphase domain size, indicating a substantial reduction in APB density. Furthermore, reflection high-energy electron diffraction and x-ray diffraction measurements confirmed that the spinel crystal structure and epitaxial strain were preserved after post-oxidation. These results suggest that post-oxidation proceeds through a topotactic solid-state reaction in which Fe$^{2.5+}$ ions are oxidized to Fe$^{3+}$, accompanied by cation rearrangement across APBs, thereby reducing APB density without degrading crystallinity and leading to improved magnetic properties in spinel ferrite epitaxial films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：post-oxidation annealing、dark-field transmission electron microscopy、reflection high-energy electron diffraction、x-ray diffraction measurements。；研究对象：Co₀.₁₂₅Fe₂.₈₇₅O₄(001)薄膜（尖晶石铁氧体外延薄膜）中的反相畴界（APBs）及其对磁性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在氧等离子体气氛中进行后氧化退火，可显著减小反相畴界密度，从而降低磁性死层厚度，提高饱和磁化强度和矩形比，同时保持尖晶石晶体结构和外延应变不变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在氧等离子体气氛中进行后氧化退火，可显著减小反相畴界密度，从而降低磁性死层厚度，提高饱和磁化强度和矩形比，同时保持尖晶石晶体结构和外延应变不变。；创新点：首次通过后氧化退火（伴随Fe².⁵⁺氧化为Fe³⁺及跨反相畴界的阳离子重排）实现反相畴界密度的降低，且不破坏晶体质量，为改善尖晶石铁氧体薄膜磁性能提供了一种新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用氧等离子体后氧化退火处理；使用暗场透射电子显微镜分析反相畴尺寸；利用反射高能电子衍射和X射线衍射确认晶体结构与应变；通过磁学测量（饱和磁化强度、矩形比）评估磁性死层变化。

papers.title: Mechanical response of quasi-two-dimensional colloidal clusters under uniaxial tension
papers.abstract: Despite extensive studies of equilibrium conformations of colloidal clusters, little is known about their mechanical response. Here, we investigate the tensile behavior of a quasi-two-dimensional colloidal cluster subjected to uniaxial tension up to fracture. The sample is a ribbon-shaped assembly of 16 colloidal beads bound by short-range depletion attraction. Using multiple optical tweezers, we clamp the cluster at both ends and perform a tensile test along its long axis. Combining video microscopy with particle tracking, we measure the tensile stress, strain, and particle configurations during deformation. We observe diverse mechanical response behaviors, including elastic, plastic, and soft-mode deformation, with fracture occurring at a strain near 10\%. To explain these behaviors, we construct a spring-mass frame model with breakable elastic bonds. We perform canonical Monte Carlo simulations on the full model with 32 degrees of freedom and compute the statistical distributions of mechanical observables using a simplified model with only 7 degrees of freedom. Both the simulations and the theoretical calculations accurately reproduce the experimental stress--strain curves. Moreover, the configuration distributions predicted by the simplified model agree well with both experiment and simulation in the elastic and soft-mode regimes, with only minor discrepancies in the plastic regime. This work demonstrates that the simplified spring-mass model captures the essential physics governing the rich tensile response behavior of the colloidal cluster.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。关键词：tensile test（实验）、Monte Carlo simulations（计算）、spring-mass model（理论）。；研究对象：准二维胶体团簇在单轴拉伸下的力学响应，具体为16个胶体球通过短程耗尽吸引力结合成的带状团簇。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 准二维胶体团簇在单轴拉伸下表现出弹性、塑性和软模变形等多种力学响应行为，断裂发生在约10%应变处；一个仅含7个自由度的简化弹簧-质量模型能准确复现实验应力-应变曲线及构型分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：准二维胶体团簇在单轴拉伸下表现出弹性、塑性和软模变形等多种力学响应行为，断裂发生在约10%应变处；一个仅含7个自由度的简化弹簧-质量模型能准确复现实验应力-应变曲线及构型分布。；创新点：首次系统研究了准二维胶体团簇在拉伸直至断裂过程中的力学响应，并证明一个极简的弹簧-质量模型（仅7自由度）即可捕捉其丰富拉伸行为的关键物理。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用多光镊夹持团簇两端进行单轴拉伸测试，结合视频显微镜与粒子追踪测量应力、应变及粒子构型。理论上构建了含可断裂弹性键的弹簧-质量框架模型，对完整模型（32自由度）进行正则系综蒙特卡洛模拟，并用简化模型（7自由度）计算力学观测量的统计分布。

papers.title: A topology-tuned pressure valve across the isoreticular RHO zeolite family
papers.abstract: The isoreticular index of the eight-member embedded RHO zeolite hierarchy operates as a phenomenological design knob that tunes the mechanical critical pressure of the framework valve from $\sim 0.94$ GPa for parent RHO down to a predicted $\lesssim 0.03$ GPa for the largest member PST-28, more than an order of magnitude lower across a single family of synthesizable nanoporous solids. The molecular-valve effect that defines zeolite RHO (a reversible centric-to-acentric phase transition triggered by water, gas pressure, or mechanical loading) is shown here to be not a peculiarity of the smallest member but a generic property of the whole hierarchy, with a critical pressure that decays exponentially with the isoreticular order $k$. Combining lattice dynamics, full elastic-constant tensors, and finite-temperature free-energy reconstructions within a classical core-shell description of the pure-silica frameworks (independently validated against r$^2$SCAN+rVV10 density-functional theory on $G_1$ and $G_2$), we find that the entire family is well described by an effective mean-field Landau picture in which the framework distortion couples quadratically to the volumetric strain. We emphasise that $p_c$ is a mechanical (hydrostatic) critical pressure of the bare pure-silica framework, used as a proxy for the intrinsic framework softness and for the cation- and dehydration-driven response of the real aluminosilicates; it is not a gas-adsorption pressure. The exponential extrapolation places $p_c(G_6\text{-}G_8) \lesssim 0.1$ GPa (model-dependent band $0.03$-$0.15$ GPa), identifying the higher-order members as the softest, most stimuli-responsive frameworks of the hierarchy; whether this intrinsic softness translates into guest-driven switching at low gas activities will depend on the Al distribution, extra-framework cations and adsorbed molecules, and remains to be tested experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“lattice dynamics, full elastic-constant tensors, finite-temperature free-energy reconstructions within a classical core-shell description”以及“r²SCAN+rVV10 density-functional theory”等计算方法，并构建了“effective mean-field Landau picture”理论框架。；研究对象：等网状RHO沸石家族（isoreticular RHO zeolite family）中的拓扑调谐压力阀效应。具体物理现象为：纯硅沸石框架在机械（静水）压力下发生的可逆中心-非中心相变（分子阀效应），以及该相变的临界压力随等网状序数k的变化规律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RHO沸石家族的分子阀效应并非最小成员的特例，而是整个等网状家族的通用性质；其机械临界压力p_c随等网状序数k呈指数衰减，从母体RHO的~0.94 GPa降至最大成员PST-28的预测值≲0.03 GPa，跨越一个数量级以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RHO沸石家族的分子阀效应并非最小成员的特例，而是整个等网状家族的通用性质；其机械临界压力p_c随等网状序数k呈指数衰减，从母体RHO的~0.94 GPa降至最大成员PST-28的预测值≲0.03 GPa，跨越一个数量级以上。；创新点：首次证明RHO沸石家族中分子阀效应（中心-非中心相变）是等网状结构的通用特性，而非个别成员的偶然现象；揭示了临界压力随等网状序数指数衰减的规律，并建立了将机械临界压力作为框架本征柔软度代理的Landau理论描述。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典核-壳模型（core-shell description）描述纯硅框架，结合晶格动力学、完整弹性常数张量计算以及有限温度自由能重构；对G₁和G₂成员使用r²SCAN+rVV10密度泛函理论进行独立验证；并构建有效平均场Landau理论，其中框架畸变与体积应变呈二次耦合。

papers.title: Mode-locking in a colloidal ring driven by power-modulated optical tweezers
papers.abstract: Particles and clusters moving across real-space periodic potentials can become locked to discrete directions or orientations due to competing symmetries. Here, we demonstrate an analogous locking phenomenon within a synthetic frequency space. We drive ring-shaped colloidal clusters using a circular optical tweezer array, where power modulation of the traps generates coexisting, distinct potential waves. Relative displacements between the cluster and these waves trace zigzag trajectories across a synthetic two-dimensional lattice, mirroring directionally locked motion in real-space periodic potentials. By tuning the relative wave amplitudes, both the cluster's direction in synthetic space and its velocity in real space exhibit discrete plateaus, both governed by square-lattice symmetry. Furthermore, the formation of superlattices between the particles and potential wave minima mirrors the characteristic features of kinetically locked two-dimensional clusters, demonstrating the capability to explore driven cluster dynamics within higher-dimensional potentials using lower-dimensional setups. Our findings establish new strategies for controlling transport of particle clusters via power-modulated laser tweezers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验操作（“使用圆形光镊阵列驱动环形胶体团簇”）和观测现象（“观察到离散平台”、“形成超晶格”）。；研究对象：由功率调制光镊驱动的环形胶体团簇。具体研究在合成频率空间中，胶体团簇的动力学行为，特别是其运动方向锁定现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在由功率调制光镊产生的合成频率空间中，环形胶体团簇的运动方向（在合成空间中）和速度（在实空间中）均表现出由正方晶格对称性决定的离散平台，类似于实空间周期势中的方向锁定现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在由功率调制光镊产生的合成频率空间中，环形胶体团簇的运动方向（在合成空间中）和速度（在实空间中）均表现出由正方晶格对称性决定的离散平台，类似于实空间周期势中的方向锁定现象。；创新点：将实空间周期势中常见的“方向锁定”现象，类比并演示于一个“合成频率空间”中。通过低维（环形）的实验装置，探索了高维（二维合成空间）势中的团簇动力学，为利用功率调制激光镊控制粒子团簇输运提供了新策略。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用圆形光镊阵列驱动环形胶体团簇，通过调制光镊的功率来产生共存的、不同的势波。通过分析团簇与这些势波之间的相对位移，在合成的二维晶格中追踪其运动轨迹。

papers.title: Dynamic dissipative structures in bistable magnetic ordered spin crossover systems: self-oscillations of magnetization
papers.abstract: Dissipative systems can exhibit a variety of behavioral modes, ranging from complex deterministic chaos to the spontaneous emergence of ordered structures. A simple example of the latter is Benard cells. More complex examples include lasers, droplet clusters, the Belousov--Zhabotinsky reaction, and biological life. Of particular interest in the context of the formation of spatiotemporal dissipative structures are bistable systems with spin crossover. This paper discusses the possibility of observing self-oscillations of magnetization in magnetically ordered systems with spin crossover. The results of theoretical calculations of the nonlinear dynamics of bistable magnetic systems under nonequilibrium conditions are presented.
