papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical calculations、nonlinear dynamics。；研究对象：具有自旋交叉（spin crossover）的磁有序双稳态系统，具体关注其在外界非平衡条件下磁化强度的自振荡行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非平衡条件下，双稳态磁有序自旋交叉体系可以产生磁化强度的自振荡，即一种动态耗散结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非平衡条件下，双稳态磁有序自旋交叉体系可以产生磁化强度的自振荡，即一种动态耗散结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用非线性动力学理论计算，对双稳态磁系统在非平衡条件下的动力学行为进行理论建模与分析。

papers.title: A Differentiable DFT-Based Framework for Inverse Materials Design
papers.abstract: Discovering solid-state materials with target properties remains a central challenge in computational materials science. Existing approaches -- high-throughput screening, surrogate optimization, and generative models -- require extensive evaluations or training data and extrapolate poorly to unseen compositions. Here we develop a first-principles inverse-design framework, integrating reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD) into KKR-CPA -- the Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker method with the coherent potential approximation -- where atomic compositions are continuous variables to be optimized. Reverse-mode AD yields gradients of objective functions with respect to composition at a cost independent of the number of candidate elements, enabling gradient-based optimization to identify materials from compositional spaces spanning dozens of elements. In this framework, any computable quantity can serve as the objective. We demonstrate this generality through two contrasting applications, magnetic alloys and half-metals, yielding candidates such as (Lu$_{0.553}$Yb$_{0.447}$)(Co$_{0.759}$Fe$_{0.241}$)$_2$Fe$_3$ and FeZr(Sb$_{0.94}$Te$_{0.06}$). Our framework offers a physically grounded route from a target property to the material that realizes it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles inverse-design framework、reverse-mode automatic differentiation、KKR-CPA、gradient-based optimization。；研究对象：固态材料，具体包括磁性合金和半金属（half-metals），如(Lu₀.₅₅₃Yb₀.₄₄₇)(Co₀.₇₅₉Fe₀.₂₄₁)₂Fe₃和FeZr(Sb₀.₉₄Te₀.₀₆)。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种基于第一性原理的反向设计框架，能够通过梯度优化从包含数十种元素的成分空间中高效识别出具有目标性能的固态材料，并成功应用于磁性合金和半金属的候选材料发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种基于第一性原理的反向设计框架，能够通过梯度优化从包含数十种元素的成分空间中高效识别出具有目标性能的固态材料，并成功应用于磁性合金和半金属的候选材料发现。；创新点：首次将自动微分技术引入KKR-CPA第一性原理计算框架，使得目标函数对成分的梯度计算成本与候选元素数量无关，从而能够高效搜索大成分空间；且任何可计算的物理量均可作为优化目标，具有通用性。
papers.method_zh: 将反向模式自动微分（reverse-mode AD）集成到KKR-CPA（Korringa–Kohn–Rostoker方法与相干势近似）框架中，将原子成分作为连续优化变量，利用梯度优化进行材料逆向设计。

papers.title: Automatic-differentiation-enabled dynamic parameter retrieval with sub-pulse-width resolution
papers.abstract: Time-resolved terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) is a phase-sensitive tool in condensed matter physics for tracking photoinduced non-equilibrium dynamics of low-energy elementary excitations. However, the measured response function, optical conductivity $σ(ω,t_{pp})$, becomes unreliable in reporting the state of matter when material properties drastically change on a timescale comparable to or less than the probe pulse duration, obscuring the sub-pulse-width dynamics. To resolve this issue, we present a full-waveform inversion framework inspired by the multi-dimensional retrieval philosophy of frequency-resolved optical gating (FROG). By leveraging the automatic differentiation (AD) technique and the two-dimensional time-domain signal $E(t_{g},t_{pp})$, we show one can uniquely solve the inverse problem, at the sub-pulse-width resolution, of retrieving physical observables that are still well-defined, i.e., time-dependent scattering rate $γ(t)$, plasma frequency $ω_\mathrm{p}(t)$ and resonance frequency $ω_0(t)$, while the response functions are not. Further optimization by gradient-based routines (Adam + L-BFGS) via JAX makes the method exceptionally robust against experimental noise and probe pulse distortions. The validity of the AD-enabled methodology is benchmarked both by a self-consistent numerical approach and by experimental data from real ultrafast THz spectroscopy measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“全波形反演框架”“自动微分技术”“梯度优化算法（Adam + L-BFGS）”，并通过数值方法和实验数据验证，属于计算方法与理论框架的提出。；研究对象：超快太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）中，材料性质在亚脉冲宽度时间尺度上发生剧烈变化时的非平衡动力学过程。具体物理可观测量包括：时间依赖的散射率 γ(t)、等离子体频率 ω_p(t) 和共振频率 ω_0(t)。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于自动微分（AD）的全波形反演方法，能够在亚脉冲宽度分辨率下，从二维时域信号 E(t_g, t_pp) 中唯一地反演出原本因响应函数失效而无法可靠获得的物理可观测量（如时间依赖的散射率、等离子体频率和共振频率）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于自动微分（AD）的全波形反演方法，能够在亚脉冲宽度分辨率下，从二维时域信号 E(t_g, t_pp) 中唯一地反演出原本因响应函数失效而无法可靠获得的物理可观测量（如时间依赖的散射率、等离子体频率和共振频率）。；创新点：首次将自动微分技术与全波形反演相结合，用于解决太赫兹时域光谱中因探针脉冲宽度限制导致的亚脉冲宽度动力学信息丢失问题，实现了在响应函数失效情况下对物理可观测量（如散射率、等离子体频率等）的亚脉冲宽度分辨率反演。
papers.method_zh: 采用全波形反演框架，灵感来源于频率分辨光学门控（FROG）的多维反演思路；利用自动微分（AD）技术（通过 JAX 实现）和梯度优化算法（Adam + L-BFGS）求解逆问题；通过自洽数值模拟和真实超快太赫兹光谱实验数据进行验证。

papers.title: Spin-flip optical excitations in van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS$_4$
papers.abstract: We investigate the near-infrared optical response of the semiconducting van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS$_4$ and identify previously unreported spin-entangled optical resonances. The strong and anisotropic magnetic-field dependence of these resonances reflects the underlying magnetic order and confirms the biaxial antiferromagnetic nature of CrPS$_4$. From the magnetic field evolution of the optical transition, we extract key magnetic parameters, including the spin-flop ($\approx0.9$~T) and spin-saturation ($\approx8$~T) fields. These results demonstrate a potential pathway for all-optical probing of spin states in van der Waals antiferromagnets, with relevance for spin-sensitive optoelectronic and magneto-optical devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate the optical response”、“extract key magnetic parameters”表明是实验研究。；研究对象：范德华反铁磁半导体材料CrPS₄，具体研究其近红外光学响应及自旋相关的光学激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CrPS₄中发现了此前未报道的自旋纠缠光学共振，其强各向异性磁场依赖性反映了双轴反铁磁序，并提取了自旋翻转场（≈0.9 T）和自旋饱和场（≈8 T）等关键磁参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CrPS₄中发现了此前未报道的自旋纠缠光学共振，其强各向异性磁场依赖性反映了双轴反铁磁序，并提取了自旋翻转场（≈0.9 T）和自旋饱和场（≈8 T）等关键磁参数。；创新点：首次在CrPS₄中识别出自旋纠缠的光学共振，并展示了全光学探测范德华反铁磁体中自旋态的潜在途径，对自旋敏感光电器件和磁光器件具有意义。
papers.method_zh: 近红外光学响应测量（光谱学），结合外加磁场下的各向异性光学表征，通过光学跃迁的磁场演化提取磁参数。

papers.title: Suppression of Active Super-Diffusion: Impact of String Defects and Canted Multi-Domains
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport dynamics of an active Brownian particle (ABP) traversing a complex, non-Newtonian liquid crystal (LC) matrix. Employing the Generalized Lebwohl-Lasher (GLL) model, we systematically vary higher-order orientational interactions to stabilize three distinct host environments: isotropic, uniform nematic, and structurally frustrated canted phases. Modeling the coupled system via off-lattice over-damped Langevin dynamics, the resulting trajectories are characterized by evaluating their step-size distributions (SSDs), mean-square displacements (MSDs), and Hurst exponents. In the uniform nematic phase, the anisotropic matrix elastically channels the ABP, producing a left-skewed exponential SSD and persistent ballistic motion parallel to the director $\hat{\mathbf{n}}$. Similarly, transverse transport obeys a Rayleigh distribution and acquires a prominent $t \ln t$ super-diffusive correction-an explicit signature of the particle coupling to the host's gapless transverse Goldstone modes, as predicted by Toner et al. [Phys. Rev. E {\bf 93}, 062610 (2016)]. Crucially, we reveal that this active super-diffusion is systematically suppressed when the long-range Goldstone fluctuations are disrupted by topological defects. This breakdown manifests both macroscopically within the fractured, multi-domain canted phase due to a structural mass gap, and locally in the unfrustrated nematic phase through scattering by vortex disclination lines. Consequently, while the local SSDs qualitatively mirror the ideal nematic state, the transverse $t \ln t$ scaling vanishes in the presence of these structural constraints. Our findings demonstrate that tuning the background defect architecture of a complex fluid can fundamentally alter the transport universality class of active matter, offering a novel paradigm for controlling microscopic mobility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Generalized Lebwohl-Lasher (GLL) model、off-lattice over-damped Langevin dynamics、数值模拟。；研究对象：活性布朗粒子（ABP）在复杂非牛顿液晶（LC）基质中的输运动力学，具体包括各向同性相、均匀向列相以及结构受挫的倾斜多畴相三种宿主环境。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了活性超扩散（横向t ln t标度行为）在长程Goldstone涨落被拓扑缺陷破坏时会被系统性抑制，这种抑制既发生在宏观的多畴倾斜相（结构质量隙导致），也发生在均匀向列相中由涡旋向错线散射引起的局域尺度上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了活性超扩散（横向t ln t标度行为）在长程Goldstone涨落被拓扑缺陷破坏时会被系统性抑制，这种抑制既发生在宏观的多畴倾斜相（结构质量隙导致），也发生在均匀向列相中由涡旋向错线散射引起的局域尺度上。；创新点：首次证明通过调控复杂流体的背景缺陷结构（拓扑缺陷与多畴），可以根本性地改变活性物质的输运普适类，为控制微观迁移率提供了新范式。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义Lebwohl-Lasher（GLL）模型通过改变高阶取向相互作用来稳定不同宿主相；使用离格过阻尼朗之万动力学模拟耦合系统；通过步长分布（SSD）、均方位移（MSD）和Hurst指数表征轨迹。

papers.title: Emergence of Quasi-two-dimensional Superconductivity in W-doped Bulk Noncentrosymmetric 3$R$-TaSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Noncentrosymmetric transition-metal dichalcogenides offer a rich environment for the study of unconventional superconducting phenomena. Here, we present a comprehensive analysis of single-crystalline W-doped 3$R$-TaSe$_2$, revealing weakly coupled anisotropic unconventional superconductivity at $T_c$ = 2.82(2) K, with an in-plane upper critical field exceeding the Pauli limit by 1.7 times. The angular dependence of the upper critical field, along with the observation of a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition, reveals quasi-two-dimensional superconductivity. Crucially, magnetotransport reveals a distinct two-fold rotational symmetry within the superconducting state under in-plane fields, breaking the underlying three-fold lattice symmetry. These findings establish W-doped $3R\text{-TaSe}_2$ as a bulk model system for exploring intrinsic low-dimensional superconductivity and broken rotational symmetry, thus opening new directions for future quantum technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“单晶样品”、“磁输运”、“上临界场角度依赖”等实验关键词。；研究对象：W掺杂的非中心对称3R-TaSe₂单晶，具体研究其超导电性及准二维特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在W掺杂的3R-TaSe₂中发现了准二维非常规超导电性，其面内上临界场超过Pauli极限1.7倍，且在超导态下观察到面内磁场引起的二重旋转对称性，打破了晶格原有的三重对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在W掺杂的3R-TaSe₂中发现了准二维非常规超导电性，其面内上临界场超过Pauli极限1.7倍，且在超导态下观察到面内磁场引起的二重旋转对称性，打破了晶格原有的三重对称性。；创新点：在块体非中心对称过渡金属硫族化合物中实现了准二维超导电性，并首次在该体系中观察到超导态下旋转对称性破缺（二重对称性），为研究本征低维超导和对称性破缺提供了块体模型体系。
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长、磁输运测量（包括上临界场的角度依赖）、Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）转变分析。

papers.title: Spin-imbalanced fermion on a dynamic lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetic order of a one-dimensional spin-1/2 fermion dynamical lattice, where itinerant fermions are coupled to bond-centered localized spins via an Ising-like spin dependent hopping. The model provides an anisotropic dynamical extension of conventional spin-1/2 fermion systems, in which the motion of itinerant fermions is directly modulated by the configuration of localized spins. Using density matrix renormalization group simulations, we map out the ground state phase diagram in various parameter spaces. Depending on the interplay among the hopping dependent on localized spins, the longitudinal field, and the external Zeeman field, two distinct phases are obtained: a paramagnetic phase and a spin-density-wave phase. Most notably, in the partially spin-polarized fermion phase, the spin-density wave ordering wave vector exhibits two distinct phenomena, corresponding respectively to the nesting vectors $2k_{F\uparrow}$ and $2k_{F\downarrow}$ of the spin-resolved Fermi surfaces. We further demonstrate that the two spin-density wave phases are robust against the repulsive Hubbard interaction between itinerant fermions. Our results reveal a novel route for tuning magnetic modulations in one-dimensional correlated systems and enrich the microscopic understanding of dynamical lattice magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：density matrix renormalization group simulations、ground state phase diagram、数值模拟）；研究对象：一维自旋-1/2费米子动态晶格模型，其中巡游费米子通过类伊辛自旋依赖跳跃与键中心局域自旋耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在部分自旋极化的费米子相中，自旋密度波的序波矢分别对应自旋分辨费米面的嵌套矢量 \(2k_{F\uparrow}\) 和 \(2k_{F\downarrow}\)，且这两种自旋密度波相对巡游费米子间的排斥性哈伯德相互作用具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在部分自旋极化的费米子相中，自旋密度波的序波矢分别对应自旋分辨费米面的嵌套矢量 \(2k_{F\uparrow}\) 和 \(2k_{F\downarrow}\)，且这两种自旋密度波相对巡游费米子间的排斥性哈伯德相互作用具有鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）模拟，绘制基态相图，分析局域自旋依赖跳跃、纵向场和外塞曼场之间的相互作用。

papers.title: Intrinsic Defect Energetics and Fluorine Doping Effects in Li2CO3 and Li2O2: A First-Principles Study
papers.abstract: Lithium carbonate, Li2CO3, is a thermodynamically stable carbonate phase whose defect energetics are closely related to its stability and decomposition behavior in various lithium-based electrochemical systems. These properties of Li2CO3 are particularly important in lithium-oxygen battery environments. In these systems, Li2CO3 can form as a parasitic discharge product alongside Li2O2, the primary discharge product, leading to performance degradation. However, compared with Li2O2, the intrinsic defect thermodynamics of Li2CO3 and how chemical doping modifies its defect energetics remain insufficiently understood. In this study, first-principles calculations were performed to systematically analyze the intrinsic point-defect energetics of Li2CO3 and to evaluate the effects of fluorine doping on vacancy formation energies in Li2CO3 and Li2O2. Intrinsic defect analysis reveals that defect behavior is predominantly governed by lithium-related defects. Upon fluorine doping, lithium and carbon vacancy formation energies decrease selectively in Li2CO3, partially destabilizing the carbonate framework, while a reduction in lithium vacancy formation energy is also observed in Li2O2. These results suggest that fluorine doping modulates the defect energetics of both discharge products, potentially providing a thermodynamic basis for controlling the stability of Li2CO3 and Li2O2 under thermodynamic conditions representative of lithium-oxygen batteries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“systematically analyze”（系统分析）、“evaluate”（评估）。；研究对象：锂基电化学体系中的两种放电产物：碳酸锂（Li₂CO₃）和过氧化锂（Li₂O₂），重点研究其本征点缺陷热力学以及氟掺杂对缺陷形成能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Li₂CO₃的缺陷行为主要由锂相关缺陷主导；氟掺杂可选择性地降低Li₂CO₃中锂和碳空位的形成能，部分破坏碳酸盐骨架，同时也会降低Li₂O₂中锂空位的形成能，表明氟掺杂可调控两种放电产物的缺陷热力学，为控制锂-氧电池中Li₂CO₃和Li₂O₂的稳定性提供热力学基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Li₂CO₃的缺陷行为主要由锂相关缺陷主导；氟掺杂可选择性地降低Li₂CO₃中锂和碳空位的形成能，部分破坏碳酸盐骨架，同时也会降低Li₂O₂中锂空位的形成能，表明氟掺杂可调控两种放电产物的缺陷热力学，为控制锂-氧电池中Li₂CO₃和Li₂O₂的稳定性提供热力学基础。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体用于系统分析Li₂CO₃的本征点缺陷热力学，并评估氟掺杂对Li₂CO₃和Li₂O₂中空位形成能的影响。

papers.title: Kohn anomaly in a topological phase transition
papers.abstract: Topological crystalline insulators extend the concept of topological insulators by hosting surface states protected by crystallographic symmetry. Their topological phase transitions arise from spin-orbit-driven band inversion in the bulk electronic structure, reshaping the low-energy electronic environment and its coupling to lattice excitations. While the electronic aspects of band topology are well established, the corresponding dynamics of lattice and electron-phonon interactions remain largely unexplored. Here, we report a pronounced softening of a low-energy surface phonon mode across the topological phase transition in Pb0.77Sn0.23Se, revealed by temperature-dependent time-domain terahertz spectroscopy. Unlike the well-known phonon softening in ferroelectrics, this effect does not signal a structural instability but instead reflects electronic reconstruction. We attribute the softening to the Kohn anomaly, indicating a strong coupling between lattice vibrations and Dirac-like surface electrons in the topological phase. Consistently, the phonon linewidth deviates from the standard anharmonic temperature dependence, further evidencing enhanced electron-phonon coupling. Our results establish phonon softening as a spectroscopic signature of topological phase transitions and provide a route to distinguish topological and trivial phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“temperature-dependent time-domain terahertz spectroscopy”（温度依赖的时域太赫兹光谱）作为主要实验手段。；研究对象：拓扑晶体绝缘体Pb₀.₇₇Sn₀.₂₃Se中的拓扑相变，以及该相变过程中表面声子模式与电子-声子耦合的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Pb₀.₇₇Sn₀.₂₃Se的拓扑相变过程中，观测到一个低能表面声子模式的显著软化。该软化并非源于结构不稳定性，而是由电子结构重构引起的Kohn反常，标志着拓扑相变的光谱学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Pb₀.₇₇Sn₀.₂₃Se的拓扑相变过程中，观测到一个低能表面声子模式的显著软化。该软化并非源于结构不稳定性，而是由电子结构重构引起的Kohn反常，标志着拓扑相变的光谱学特征。；创新点：首次在拓扑相变中观测到由Kohn反常导致的声子软化，并将其确立为区分拓扑相与平庸相的光谱学标志，揭示了拓扑相变中晶格动力学与电子-声子耦合的关联。
papers.method_zh: 温度依赖的时域太赫兹光谱（time-domain terahertz spectroscopy），用于探测表面声子模式的频率和线宽随温度的变化。

papers.title: A Unified Josephson Dynamics Perspective for Single-Cavity BECs: From Self-Trapping to Dynamical Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: We investigate a two-component Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) strongly coupled to a single optical cavity, effectively described by a mean-field Dicke model supplemented with interatomic nonlinearities. Here, we propose a unified theoretical framework demonstrating that macroscopic quantum self-trapping (MQST) natively emerges between two internal atomic energy levels within a single cavity. By deriving the dimensionless semiclassical Josephson equations (SJE) governing this purely internal-state architecture, we analytically determine the critical nonlinear threshold and intrinsic phase shift mechanism for the phase transition. Based on this framework, we present two approaches for manipulating quantum phase transitions: dynamic in-situ tuning via photon pumping and inducing non-equilibrium dynamical phase transitions (DPT) via real-time parameter quenches. Furthermore, we rigorously prove that the effective charging energy driving this system scales exactly as one-quarter of the effective spin-dependent interaction energy -- the precise parameter governing recent spin-orbit coupled (SOC) BEC experiments. Incorporating realistic $^{87}$Rb atomic parameters, we substantiate that these single-cavity MQST and transition dynamics are highly feasible for observation under current state-of-the-art cold-atom technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mean-field Dicke model、semiclassical Josephson equations、analytically determine、rigorously prove。；研究对象：单腔中双组分玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的约瑟夫森动力学，具体涉及宏观量子自囚禁（MQST）和动力学相变（DPT）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单腔双组分BEC体系中，宏观量子自囚禁（MQST）天然存在于两个内态能级之间；该体系的等效充电能量精确等于自旋依赖相互作用能量的四分之一，这一参数与近期自旋-轨道耦合BEC实验中的关键参数一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单腔双组分BEC体系中，宏观量子自囚禁（MQST）天然存在于两个内态能级之间；该体系的等效充电能量精确等于自旋依赖相互作用能量的四分之一，这一参数与近期自旋-轨道耦合BEC实验中的关键参数一致。；创新点：提出了一个统一的理论框架，证明单腔BEC中内态之间的MQST是天然存在的，并建立了其与自旋-轨道耦合BEC实验参数之间的精确标度关系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于平均场Dicke模型并补充原子间非线性相互作用，推导无量纲半经典约瑟夫森方程（SJE），通过解析方法确定相变的临界非线性阈值和本征相移机制。采用光子泵浦实现动态原位调控，以及实时参数淬火诱导非平衡动力学相变。

papers.title: Fractionalized Vortices Drive Kosterlitz-Thouless Transitions in Dipole-Conserving Systems
papers.abstract: Finite-temperature dipole-conserving superfluids in two dimensions pose a direct challenge to the usual Kosterlitz-Thouless (KT) paradigm: the primary phase field lacks quasi-long-range order, and the conventional vortex has only finite self-energy. We show that KT criticality nevertheless survives through a fractionalization of the vortex sector. In the dipole-conserving XY model, a minimal classical lattice realization of a fractonic superfluid, the conventional vortex is a finite-energy composite of two unconventional vortices in compact dipole fields. These fractionalized constituents have logarithmically divergent self-energies and are the defects that unbind at the transition; correspondingly, the ordinary helicity modulus remains nonsingular. Using Metropolis Monte Carlo supplemented by parallel tempering, generalized helicity moduli, and direct vortex-density measurements, we establish a phase diagram controlled by the deconfinement of these two vortex species. In the isotropic model, they deconfine simultaneously, producing a single KT transition. Coupling anisotropy splits the transition into two, separated by a phase with partial dipole quasi-long-range order, whereas removing the mixed-derivative coupling recombines the transitions even for anisotropic stiffnesses. Our theoretical and numerical results identify a fractionalized-defect mechanism for finite-temperature criticality in higher-moment-conserving matter and point to a hierarchy of KT transitions in multipole-conserving systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。关键词：理论分析、Metropolis Monte Carlo、parallel tempering、数值模拟。；研究对象：偶极守恒超流体的有限温度相变，具体为偶极守恒XY模型（一种分形超流体的经典晶格实现）中的Kosterlitz-Thouless（KT）相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在偶极守恒系统中，传统涡旋是有限能量的复合体，而分数化的涡旋组分具有对数发散的自能，这些分数化涡旋的解禁闭驱动了KT相变；各向同性模型中发生单一KT相变，各向异性可将相变分裂为两个，中间存在部分偶极准长程序相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在偶极守恒系统中，传统涡旋是有限能量的复合体，而分数化的涡旋组分具有对数发散的自能，这些分数化涡旋的解禁闭驱动了KT相变；各向同性模型中发生单一KT相变，各向异性可将相变分裂为两个，中间存在部分偶极准长程序相。；创新点：首次提出分数化涡旋（fractionalized vortices）作为驱动偶极守恒系统有限温度KT相变的机制，揭示了高阶矩守恒物质中分数化缺陷驱动的临界行为，并预言了多极守恒系统中KT相变的层级结构。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合Metropolis Monte Carlo模拟，辅以并行回火（parallel tempering）、广义螺旋模量（generalized helicity moduli）测量以及直接涡旋密度测量。

papers.title: Universal behavior of the condensation energy of Superconducting BCS Bose gases
papers.abstract: Using the Boson-Fermion formalism of superconductivity we calculate the condensation energy for several superconductors ranging from conventional to unconventional, or high temperature superconductors. It is calculated as the difference between the Helmholtz free energies of the superconducting and the normal state, which is a gas of N attractive electron gas, while the superconducting state is formed by the condensed Cooper pairs taken as composite bosons, coming from a fraction of the electrons inside the Debye shell, plus those electrons inside and outside the Debye shell that are unable to pair. After giving the analytic expressions for the internal energy U and the entropy S we obtain the Helmholtz free energy F = U -TS for both the superconducting and the normal states as functions of temperature. In the search for universalities, we calculate the ratio of the condensation energy at T=0 to the Sommerfeld constant (the normal state electronic specific heat over the temperature when T it's almost zero) using two different methods: the Boson-Fermion formalism developed here, as well as an analytical expression deduced from a combination of the BCS and Ginzburg-Landau theories. We find for the Boson-Fermion formalism $E_{cond}/γ_0= 0.252\,T_{c}^{1.997}$, which is the same behavior described by the experimental fit of Kim et al $E_{cond}/γ_0= 0.2\,T_{c}^{2.06}$ and by the one recently reported by Tallon et al for overdoped cuprate superconductors; while for the Ginzburg-Landau-BCS we get the expression $E_{cond}/γ_0= 0.236\,T_{c}^{2}$, also in very good agreement with the partifirst method.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Boson-Fermion formalism”“BCS and Ginzburg-Landau theories”等理论框架进行计算，未提及实验或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：超导体的凝聚能，涵盖从传统超导体到非常规（高温）超导体的多种体系，重点研究凝聚能随临界温度 \( T_c \) 的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在玻色子-费米子形式下，零温凝聚能与索末菲常数的比值满足 \( E_{\text{cond}}/\gamma_0 = 0.252\,T_c^{1.997} \)，与实验拟合结果 \( 0.2\,T_c^{2.06} \) 及过掺杂铜氧化物超导体的近期报道高度一致；Ginzburg-Landau-BCS 组合理论给出 \( E_{\text{cond}}/\gamma_0 = 0.236\,T_c^{2} \)，与前者吻合良好，表明该标度行为具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在玻色子-费米子形式下，零温凝聚能与索末菲常数的比值满足 \( E_{\text{cond}}/\gamma_0 = 0.252\,T_c^{1.997} \)，与实验拟合结果 \( 0.2\,T_c^{2.06} \) 及过掺杂铜氧化物超导体的近期报道高度一致；Ginzburg-Landau-BCS 组合理论给出 \( E_{\text{cond}}/\gamma_0 = 0.236\,T_c^{2} \)，与前者吻合良好，表明该标度行为具有普适性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用玻色子-费米子超导形式论，计算超导态和正常态（N个吸引电子气）的亥姆霍兹自由能差，得到凝聚能；同时结合BCS与Ginzburg-Landau理论推导解析表达式。具体计算了内能U和熵S，进而得到自由能F=U-TS。

papers.title: NMR evidence for a loop-current state with broken $C_6$ symmetry in the charge-ordered CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: Loop-current (LC) order and the associated time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) are pivotal for understanding hidden magnetism and unconventional superconductivity in strongly correlated quantum materials. The recently discovered kagome metal CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ provides a unique platform for exploring these intertwined phenomena. In this study, we utilize $^{121}$Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) and $^{51}$V nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) measurements to investigate the possible existence of the LC order in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$. Below $T^\ast \approx 45$ K, we observe a field-independent NMR linewidth broadening at the V site in a high-quality single crystal, which indicates an internal magnetic field of 3.6 Oe at the V position. We show that this internal field arises from a static LC state that produces orbital magnetic moments $μ_{\rm orb}$ ranging from 0.002 to 0.01 $μ_B$. Detailed analysis suggests that the observed LC state breaks $C_6$ rotational symmetry to possess a low symmetry of $C_2$. Our results provide microscopic evidence for LC order in the charge density wave (CDW) phase of CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ and show that TRSB is intertwined with electronic nematicity, imposing stringent constraints on microscopic descriptions of the kagome CDW and its relation to superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：NMR evidence、NQR、measurements、observed。；研究对象：具体材料为kagome金属CsV₃Sb₅，研究其电荷密度波（CDW）相中可能存在的环电流（loop-current）序及时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CsV₃Sb₅中低于约45 K时观测到静态环电流序，该序产生轨道磁矩（0.002至0.01 μ_B），并打破C₆旋转对称性，形成C₂对称性。这为CDW相中的环电流序提供了微观证据，并表明TRSB与电子向列性相互交织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CsV₃Sb₅中低于约45 K时观测到静态环电流序，该序产生轨道磁矩（0.002至0.01 μ_B），并打破C₆旋转对称性，形成C₂对称性。这为CDW相中的环电流序提供了微观证据，并表明TRSB与电子向列性相互交织。；创新点：首次通过NMR/NQR提供微观证据，证明CsV₃Sb₅的CDW相中存在静态环电流序，并明确该序同时打破时间反演对称性和C₆旋转对称性，揭示了TRSB与电子向列性的关联。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用¹²¹Sb核四极共振（NQR）和⁵¹V核磁共振（NMR）测量，对高质量单晶样品进行场无关的NMR线宽展宽分析，并提取内磁场大小及轨道磁矩。

papers.title: Intrinsic Magnetic Excitations and Heavy-Fermion Formation in the Frustrated Mn Pyrochlore System YMn$_{2+δ}$Zn$_{20-x}X_x$ ($X$ = In and Al) Revealed by Nuclear Magnetic Resonance and Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance Measurements
papers.abstract: We performed nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements to investigate the microscopic electronic states of the $d$-electron heavy-fermion candidates $\mathrm{YMn_{2+δ}Zn_{20-x}In_x}$ and $\mathrm{YMn_{2+δ}Zn_{20-x}Al_x}$. In these compounds, magnetic fluctuations of the Mn pyrochlore lattice are expected to play an important role in heavy-fermion formation; however, excess Mn atoms complicate the interpretation of the physical properties. Our spectral analysis reveals that In substitution exhibits much higher site selectivity and introduces significantly less disorder in local structure than Al substitution. The temperature dependence of the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate divided by temperature $1/T_1T$ measured by $^{55}$Mn-NQR shows a clear enhancement at low temperatures, indicating the development of low-energy excitations associated with heavy-fermion formation. However, its absolute magnitude is approximately 20 times smaller than that in the related compound YMn$_2$, which hosts stronger antiferromagnetic correlations, indicating that the magnetic interactions are substantially weakened by the enlarged Mn-Mn distance. These results demonstrate that the heavy-fermion state in this system arises from the Mn pyrochlore network and is more closely associated with frustration-induced magnetic excitations with low energy than with conventional antiferromagnetic quantum-critical fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR)、Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance (NQR) measurements、spectral analysis。；研究对象：d电子重费米子候选材料YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓInₓ和YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓAlₓ，特别是其中Mn烧绿石晶格的本征磁激发及其与重费米子形成的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过NMR/NQR测量发现，该体系中重费米子态源于Mn烧绿石网络，与阻挫诱导的低能磁激发密切相关，而非传统的反铁磁量子临界涨落；且In替代比Al替代引入更少的局域结构无序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过NMR/NQR测量发现，该体系中重费米子态源于Mn烧绿石网络，与阻挫诱导的低能磁激发密切相关，而非传统的反铁磁量子临界涨落；且In替代比Al替代引入更少的局域结构无序。；创新点：通过高选择性的In替代有效抑制了过量Mn原子带来的复杂性，首次明确揭示了该体系中重费米子形成与阻挫诱导的低能磁激发的关联，而非传统反铁磁量子临界涨落。摘要未突出说明与已有理论模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 核磁共振（NMR）和核四极共振（NQR）测量，包括⁵⁵Mn-NQR的核自旋-晶格弛豫率（1/T₁T）的温度依赖性分析。

papers.title: The SU(N) Holstein Model
papers.abstract: From the condensed matter physics perspective, the most natural single orbital tight-binding Hamiltonians, and hence the most widely studied, contain two fermionic species, corresponding to spin up and spin down electrons. In cold atom systems, however, SU(N) symmetry, in which $N > 2$ fermionic species reside within a single band, also occurs. In order to understand such experiments, the SU(N) Hubbard model has been increasingly studied. Here we present determinant Quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the SU(N) {\it Holstein} Hamiltonian, in which $N$ fermionic species couple to a single local phonon mode. We show that at half filling it has an insulating charge density wave phase (CDW) at low temperatures, in which empty sites alternate with sites with $N$ particles. We determine the $N=3$ CDW phase diagram in the temperature, $T$, versus electron-phonon coupling, $α$, plane at fixed phonon frequency $ω_0$ and half-filling $ρ=1.5$. The critical temperature $T_c$ for $N=3$ can be as high as twice the maximum attainable for $N=2$. We also obtain the $N$ dependence of $T_c$ for a representative, fixed, $ω_0$ and $α$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：determinant Quantum Monte Carlo simulations（行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：SU(N) Holstein 模型，即N种费米子（N > 2）与单个局域声子模式耦合的晶格系统，特别关注半填充条件下的电荷密度波（CDW）相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半填充时，SU(N) Holstein 模型在低温下存在绝缘的电荷密度波相，其中空位与占据N个粒子的位点交替排列。对于N=3，其临界温度Tc最高可达N=2情况下的两倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半填充时，SU(N) Holstein 模型在低温下存在绝缘的电荷密度波相，其中空位与占据N个粒子的位点交替排列。对于N=3，其临界温度Tc最高可达N=2情况下的两倍。；创新点：将通常针对N=2（自旋上/下）的Holstein模型推广到具有SU(N)对称性（N>2）的冷原子体系，并首次通过数值模拟给出了N=3情况下的CDW相图以及Tc随N的依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 使用行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinant Quantum Monte Carlo, DQMC）方法进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Defect Engineered 2D MoS2 Materials for ML-enabled Neurotransmitter SERS Detection
papers.abstract: An attachment of catechol-containing neurotransmitter molecules is demonstrated on defect-engineered two-dimensional MoS2 platform, leading to activation of SERS due to molecular charge transfer. Mechanisms of neurotransmitters' bio-detection are discussed and Machine Learning methods are applied to distinguish spectra of structurally similar analytes. The SERS effect and selective docking of biomolecules are achieved through an optimized approach for defect engineering: namely, introducing the sulfur vacancies in MoS2 monolayer films via soft plasma etching led to molecular attachment driven by catechol functional groups. The quality of the sensor material was controlled by Raman, photoluminescence, and XPS characterization, thus allowing for optimization of the process of defect formation and achieving sensing selectivity. The sensor material showed no response to serotonin, confirming the specificity of attachment/SERS due to S-vacancies that regulate the strength of catechol-specific molecular adsorption. Defect-engineered MoS2 has enabled SERS detection of dopamine and epinephrine down to the sub-nanomolar range ($5\times10^{-10}$ M), with strong calibration reliability ($R^2$ = 0.95 and 0.99 for pure samples). PCA-LDA achieved 100$\%$ accuracy in distinguishing dopamine and epinephrine, which establishes defect-engineered MoS2 as a tunable, low-cost SERS platform for future sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验过程（软等离子体刻蚀）、材料表征（拉曼、光致发光、XPS）和传感性能测试（SERS检测、机器学习分类）。；研究对象：缺陷工程化的二维二硫化钼（MoS2）单层薄膜，用于检测含有儿茶酚基团的神经递质分子（多巴胺和肾上腺素）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过软等离子体刻蚀在MoS2单层中引入硫空位，实现了对儿茶酚类神经递质分子的特异性吸附和亚纳摩尔级SERS检测，并结合机器学习方法（PCA-LDA）实现了对结构相似分析物（多巴胺和肾上腺素）的100%准确区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过软等离子体刻蚀在MoS2单层中引入硫空位，实现了对儿茶酚类神经递质分子的特异性吸附和亚纳摩尔级SERS检测，并结合机器学习方法（PCA-LDA）实现了对结构相似分析物（多巴胺和肾上腺素）的100%准确区分。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：利用缺陷工程（硫空位）而非传统贵金属纳米结构来实现SERS活性，并通过调控硫空位实现了对特定官能团（儿茶酚）分子的选择性吸附和超灵敏检测，同时结合机器学习解决了结构相似分子的区分难题。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **材料制备与缺陷工程**：采用软等离子体刻蚀在MoS2单层薄膜中引入硫空位。

papers.title: Accelerating Chemical Potential Calculations with Minimal Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract: Chemical potentials are among the most important properties that can be obtained from a molecular simulation since they define many technologically relevant collective properties. The chemical potential of a species in solution is obtained by computing the free energy change of adding that species into a bulk system, a calculation typically very expensive for systems such as electrolytes, due to the lack of phase space overlap between "not-inserted" and "inserted" states. Recently, normalizing flows have been introduced as a way to accelerate free energy computations by learning a bijective function, constructed to be as expressive as possible, that maps the configuration space of one Boltzmann distribution onto another. This expressivity makes them difficult to train, limiting their ability to be generated "on-the-fly" for any new system, and in practice these mappings have shown only modest sampling improvements for liquids. We address these issues by introducing a "minimal" normalizing flow (MNF). This is a trainable bijective mapping that is intentionally limited in expressivity, and instead applies low-dimensional, physically informed transformations. Useful MNFs can be trained in 1 minute of GPU time due to their simplicity and our introduction of a novel training strategy. We show how calculations of chemical potentials of Lennard-Jones particle systems can be accelerated by at least 10 times with a simple radial mapping. We also apply a radial and orientational mapping to ion solvation in water, showing that MNFs can increase the effective sample size by 3 times for charging free energy calculations and 8 times for calculating free energy changes due to force field perturbations. This provides the foundation for the development of physically-informed mappings that can accelerate complex free energy calculations while retaining low training costs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：molecular simulation, free energy calculations, normalizing flows, GPU training。；研究对象：溶液中的化学势计算，具体包括Lennard-Jones粒子系统以及水溶液中离子溶剂化的自由能变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种“最小化归一化流”（MNF）方法，通过低维、物理信息驱动的可逆映射，可在1分钟GPU训练时间内将化学势计算加速至少10倍（Lennard-Jones系统），并将离子溶剂化自由能计算的有效样本量提升3-8倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种“最小化归一化流”（MNF）方法，通过低维、物理信息驱动的可逆映射，可在1分钟GPU训练时间内将化学势计算加速至少10倍（Lennard-Jones系统），并将离子溶剂化自由能计算的有效样本量提升3-8倍。；创新点：与以往追求高表达能力的归一化流不同，本文故意限制映射的表达能力，转而使用物理信息驱动的低维变换，从而大幅降低训练成本（1分钟GPU时间），同时仍能显著加速化学势计算。
papers.method_zh: 采用最小化归一化流（MNF）——一种刻意限制表达能力的可训练双射映射，结合低维物理信息变换（径向映射、径向与取向映射），并引入新型训练策略。用于加速自由能计算中的“插入/未插入”态相空间重叠问题。

papers.title: Operando spectro-ptychography reveals dynamical charge-storage and degradation pathways in redox-active electrodes
papers.abstract: Electrochemical reactions at buried electrode-electrolyte interfaces govern how redox-active materials store and release energy. However, these reactions are difficult to visualize because chemical and morphological changes occur simultaneously over distinct length and time scales. Existing operando microscopies often require trade-offs among chemical sensitivity, spatial resolution and temporal resolution. Direct nanoscale tracking of such processes throughout extended timescale has therefore remained out of reach. Here, we develop a fast and robust operando soft X-ray spectro-ptychography platform that delivers chemical-state-resolved spatiotemporal movies of redox-active electrodes over the full battery lifetime. Applied to an alkaline Fe anode, the method reveals that reversible charge storage gives way to degradation through two competing processes: rapid hydroxide insertion that drives early reversible cycling, and slower dissolution-redeposition that redistributes Fe, enlarges FeOOH particles, and ultimately causes capacity loss. By separating fast charge-storage chemistry from slower degradation chemistry in operando and at both single-particle and particle ensemble level, this work establishes spectro-ptychography as a general approach for studying dynamic redox transformations in batteries, electrocatalysts, and other electrochemical materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：operando（原位）、spectro-ptychography（谱学叠层成像）、实验平台开发。；研究对象：碱性铁（Fe）阳极在氧化还原反应中的电荷存储与降解过程，具体涉及Fe/FeOOH电极体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了碱性Fe阳极中两种竞争过程：快速的氢氧化物插入驱动早期可逆循环，而缓慢的溶解-再沉积过程导致Fe重新分布、FeOOH颗粒粗化并最终造成容量衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了碱性Fe阳极中两种竞争过程：快速的氢氧化物插入驱动早期可逆循环，而缓慢的溶解-再沉积过程导致Fe重新分布、FeOOH颗粒粗化并最终造成容量衰减。；创新点：首次实现了在完整电池寿命尺度上，以纳米级空间分辨率同时追踪快速电荷存储化学与缓慢降解化学，并在单颗粒和颗粒集合体两个层次上进行区分。
papers.method_zh: 开发了快速、稳健的原位软X射线谱学叠层成像（operando soft X-ray spectro-ptychography）平台，能够实现全电池寿命周期内化学态分辨的时空动态成像。

papers.title: Layer-tunable Hubbard bands probed via moiré excitons in MoSe$_2$/WS$_2$ heterostructures
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices in transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures provide a highly tunable platform for engineering strongly interacting states at the nanoscale. However, quantitatively determining and in-situ tuning of the underlying Hubbard parameters remains experimentally challenging. Here, we report electric-field-driven reordering of layer-specific Hubbard bands by performing optical spectroscopy on a dual-gated, 60°-aligned MoSe$_2$/WS$_2$ heterobilayer. Using two spatially distinct moiré excitons as local optical probes and tracking them as a function of carrier filling and vertical electric field, we quantitatively extract the layer-dependent on-site Coulomb repulsions, U$_M$~60 meV in MoSe$_2$ and U$_W$~30 meV in WS$_2$. Furthermore, we stabilize generalized Wigner crystal and stripe phases by electrostatically tuning the system to a type-II band alignment, shifting the ground state into the WS$_2$ layer where reduced on-site repulsion allows inter-site Coulomb interactions to dominate. Our results establish vertical electric fields as a deterministic tuning knob for layer-selective Hubbard physics, enabling device-level control of complex many-body phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：optical spectroscopy、dual-gated、electrostatic tuning。；研究对象：MoSe₂/WS₂ 异质双层中的莫尔超晶格，以及层分辨的哈伯德带（Hubbard bands）和强关联电子相（如广义维格纳晶体和条纹相）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过垂直电场实现了层选择性的哈伯德带重排，定量提取了 MoSe₂ 层（U_M ~60 meV）和 WS₂ 层（U_W ~30 meV）的层依赖在位库仑排斥能，并利用电场将基态调控至 WS₂ 层，使层间库仑相互作用主导，从而稳定了广义维格纳晶体和条纹相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过垂直电场实现了层选择性的哈伯德带重排，定量提取了 MoSe₂ 层（U_M ~60 meV）和 WS₂ 层（U_W ~30 meV）的层依赖在位库仑排斥能，并利用电场将基态调控至 WS₂ 层，使层间库仑相互作用主导，从而稳定了广义维格纳晶体和条纹相。；创新点：利用垂直电场作为确定性调控手段，实现了层分辨的哈伯德物理调控，并定量提取了不同层的在位库仑排斥能，从而在器件层面控制复杂多体相。
papers.method_zh: 对 60° 对齐的双栅 MoSe₂/WS₂ 异质双层进行光学光谱测量，利用两种空间上不同的莫尔激子作为局域光学探针，跟踪其随载流子填充和垂直电场的变化。

papers.title: Quantum Geometry in the Continuum: Solitons in Shallow Lattices
papers.abstract: The quantum geometry of electronic, photonic, and atomic lattice systems quantifies the distance in Hilbert space between Bloch states at neighboring lattice momenta. This quantity has profound implications for flat-band systems especially, characterizing surprising behavior such as superfluidity and superconductivity when the group velocity is zero and no transport would be expected for non-interacting particles. However, when the band is not flat, the effects of quantum geometry are often intertwined with and partly masked by the band dispersion. Here, we show that in weakly interacting bosonic systems in the critical dimension (i.e., two dimensions for Kerr nonlinearity), the deviation from critical behavior due to the presence of the lattice is governed by the quantum geometry, which is directly proportional to the fourth-order dispersion. Furthermore, we identify the family of continuous lattice potentials that saturates the bound on the quantum metric for a given effective mass tensor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we show that”“we identify”等理论推导和模型分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：连续晶格势阱中的弱相互作用玻色子系统，特别是浅晶格（shallow lattices）中的孤子（solitons）现象，以及量子几何（quantum metric）与色散的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界维度（二维）的弱相互作用玻色子系统中，晶格导致的临界行为偏离由量子几何直接决定，且该偏离与四阶色散成正比。此外，论文识别出了一类连续晶格势，其在给定有效质量张量下饱和量子度规的边界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界维度（二维）的弱相互作用玻色子系统中，晶格导致的临界行为偏离由量子几何直接决定，且该偏离与四阶色散成正比。此外，论文识别出了一类连续晶格势，其在给定有效质量张量下饱和量子度规的边界。；创新点：揭示了在非平带系统中量子几何效应如何通过四阶色散影响临界行为，并找到了饱和量子度规边界的连续晶格势族。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于量子几何（quantum geometry）框架，结合弱相互作用玻色系统的临界行为分析，以及连续晶格势的变分或极值方法。

papers.title: Exactly solvable pair-density wave in topological flat bands from magnetic translation symmetries
papers.abstract: Pair-density wave (PDW) superconductors are exotic phases in which Cooper pairs carry finite center-of-mass momentum. Despite a variety of theoretical and experimental reports on PDW states, exact PDW ground states in topological bands have remained elusive. Here we construct exactly solvable models with PDW ground states in topological flat bands using a generalized version of the recently proposed quantum geometric nesting (QGN) framework. Our construction broadly applies to systems with non-commuting magnetic translation symmetries (MTS) and time-reversal symmetry, exemplified by the time-reversal invariant version of the Kapit-Mueller model with two ideal flat Chern bands with opposite Chern number. Our construction thus provides a platform for further studies of band topology and quantum geometry in PDW superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exactly solvable models、theoretical framework、construction。；研究对象：拓扑平带中的配对密度波（PDW）超导态，具体以具有相反陈数的两个理想平带的时间反演不变Kapit-Mueller模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用广义的量子几何嵌套（QGN）框架，在具有非对易磁平移对称性和时间反演对称性的拓扑平带系统中，构建了具有PDW基态的精确可解模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用广义的量子几何嵌套（QGN）框架，在具有非对易磁平移对称性和时间反演对称性的拓扑平带系统中，构建了具有PDW基态的精确可解模型。；创新点：首次在拓扑能带中实现了具有PDW基态的精确可解模型，为研究PDW超导体中的能带拓扑和量子几何提供了明确的理论平台。摘要未突出说明与先前非拓扑PDW精确解模型的具体区别。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建与解析求解。采用广义量子几何嵌套（QGN）框架，结合非对易磁平移对称性（MTS）和时间反演对称性，在拓扑平带中构造精确可解的PDW模型。

papers.title: Real-space Imaging of Quantum Hall Quasiparticles
papers.abstract: Quantum Hall systems host emergent quasiparticles with unusual charge, spin, and statistics, such as fractionally charged anyons. Although transport measurements have revealed many of their collective properties, identifying and visualizing individual quasiparticles remain elusive. Here we use scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) to image quantum Hall quasiparticles in graphene. Within incompressible quantum Hall states, we observe spatial variation of Landau level energies originating from electrostatic potentials created by charged defects in graphene and the underlying hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). For surface and near-surface defects, the Coulomb potential lifts the degeneracy of Landau orbitals, producing discrete energy splittings that reveal Landau orbital wavefunctions. In quantum Hall ferromagnetic states, quasiparticles bound to defect potentials produce distinct spatial and spectroscopic signatures that serve as hallmarks of the presence and number of localized excitations. In the fractional quantum Hall regime at one-third filling, our theoretical calculations predict discrete spectroscopic changes associated with the sequential addition of localized anyons, with a three-anyon bound state quantitatively reproducing our experimental data at $ν= 5/3$. These observations establish spectroscopic fingerprints of quantum Hall quasiparticles and provide a pathway toward imaging and manipulating individual anyons in real space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含理论计算支持）。判断依据：使用扫描隧道谱（STS）进行实验成像，同时结合理论计算预测光谱变化。；研究对象：石墨烯中量子霍尔准粒子的实空间成像，包括整数和分数量子霍尔态中的准粒子（如任意子）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过扫描隧道谱在石墨烯中实现了量子霍尔准粒子的实空间成像，观察到缺陷势束缚的准粒子在量子霍尔铁磁态和分数量子霍尔态（ν=5/3）中产生独特的光谱特征，并首次在实验上定量复现了三任意子束缚态的光谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过扫描隧道谱在石墨烯中实现了量子霍尔准粒子的实空间成像，观察到缺陷势束缚的准粒子在量子霍尔铁磁态和分数量子霍尔态（ν=5/3）中产生独特的光谱特征，并首次在实验上定量复现了三任意子束缚态的光谱。；创新点：首次在实空间直接成像并识别单个量子霍尔准粒子，特别是通过光谱指纹区分局域激发的存在和数量，并在分数量子霍尔态中实现了任意子束缚态的定量光谱复现。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道谱（STS）实验，结合理论计算（预测分数量子霍尔态中局域任意子顺序添加引起的光谱变化）。

papers.title: Local spectroscopy of anyons bound to charge traps
papers.abstract: Fractional quantum Hall states host anyons, emergent quasiparticles with fractional charge and nontrivial exchange statistics. Controlling, trapping, and braiding anyons are central goals for both fundamental physics and topological quantum computation. A key step toward such control is understanding how anyons behave when confined in local potentials, where their internal structure can become relevant. Here, we use the scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/STS) to study the excitation spectrum in integer and fractional quantum Hall states of monolayer graphene near individual charged impurities. In the integer quantum Hall states, the STS spectra show lifting of orbital degeneracy near defects, appearing as a band of discrete energy levels. In fractional states, (v=1/3 and 2/5), however, we observe an additional energy splitting of the lowest-energy spectral feature that occurs only when the chemical potential lies within a fractional gap and is absent in compressible or integer regimes. We attribute this to many-body configurations of anyons trapped by an impurity potential. Strikingly, numerical calculations show that the splitting requires an anisotropic confining potential, vanishing for a rotationally symmetric trap. The competing multi-anyon states carry nearly identical charge within the core of the potential but differ in how that charge is redistributed at larger radius. Our results establish local tunneling spectroscopy as a direct probe of anyon bound states, providing a key step toward understanding and controlling their behavior in confined geometries relevant for braiding and fusion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/STS)、local spectroscopy、monolayer graphene）；研究对象：单层石墨烯中整数和分数量子霍尔态（ν=1/3和2/5）中，由单个带电杂质束缚的任意子（anyon）的局域激发谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在分数量子霍尔态（ν=1/3和2/5）中，当化学势位于分数量子霍尔能隙内时，最低能谱特征出现额外的能量劈裂，该劈裂仅存在于各向异性束缚势中，且源于杂质势阱中任意子的多体组态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在分数量子霍尔态（ν=1/3和2/5）中，当化学势位于分数量子霍尔能隙内时，最低能谱特征出现额外的能量劈裂，该劈裂仅存在于各向异性束缚势中，且源于杂质势阱中任意子的多体组态。；创新点：首次利用局域隧穿谱直接探测任意子束缚态，揭示了束缚势各向异性对任意子多体态能量劈裂的关键作用，并指出不同多任意子态在势阱核心携带几乎相同的电荷，但在更大半径处电荷分布不同。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜/扫描隧道谱（STM/STS）实验，并结合数值计算（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，如精确对角化或DMRG等）。

papers.title: Curvature-induced smectic-C order of tangentially anchored hard spherocylinders on a sphere with a rigidly locked director field
papers.abstract: We study the strict locked-orientation limit of hard spherocylinders on a sphere, in which the rod axes are rigidly locked to a prescribed tangential director field and cannot reorient. Because the bulk hard-rod phase diagram contains no smectic-C phase, any coherent tilt isolates a geometric curvature mechanism rather than a finite-stiffness equilibrium effect. A ratio-symmetric recognition cost fixes the layer spacing at the bulk close-contact value and yields a hierarchy of geometric statements: the lower edge of the smectic-area window at $45^\circ$ follows from reciprocal symmetry; the upper edge at $58.3^\circ$ is a falsifiable channel-saturation hypothesis; the smectic-A to smectic-C boundary is a closed-form prediction; and the rod tilt angle is set by the rod-to-radius ratio, modulated by a chirality envelope peaking near $24^\circ$. Locked-orientation Monte Carlo across fifteen geometries confirms these predictions with no fitted elastic constants: the smectic area peaks at $55^\circ$, and a coherent smectic-C window is detected.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（辅以计算验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“严格锁定取向极限”、“几何曲率机制”、“封闭形式预测”等理论推导，并辅以“锁定取向蒙特卡洛模拟”进行验证。；研究对象：球面上切向锚定的硬质棒状分子（硬球柱体）在刚性锁定取向场下的液晶相行为，特别是由曲率诱导的近晶C相（smectic-C）的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在硬棒体系中，由于体相不存在近晶C相，球面上观察到的相干倾斜完全由几何曲率机制驱动，而非有限刚度平衡效应。该倾斜角由棒长与球半径之比决定，并受手性包络调制，在约24°附近达到峰值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在硬棒体系中，由于体相不存在近晶C相，球面上观察到的相干倾斜完全由几何曲率机制驱动，而非有限刚度平衡效应。该倾斜角由棒长与球半径之比决定，并受手性包络调制，在约24°附近达到峰值。；创新点：首次在硬棒体系中证明，相干近晶C相序可完全由球面几何曲率诱导产生，而非依赖于传统液晶理论中的弹性自由能或分子间相互作用各向异性。摘要未突出说明与实验或其它理论模型的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于比率对称识别代价（ratio-symmetric recognition cost）设定层间距为体相紧密接触值，推导出近晶面积窗口下界（45°）、上界（58.3°）及近晶A-C相边界等几何关系。计算验证：采用锁定取向蒙特卡洛（Locked-orientation Monte Carlo）模拟，在十五种几何构型下验证预测，无需拟合弹性常数。

papers.title: Non-Abelian Anyon Braiding with Quantum-Antidot Interferometry
papers.abstract: Conventional Fabry--Perot interferometry accesses only full braids of anyons and therefore cannot directly probe the elementary \(π\)-rotation exchange. Motivated by the recent quantum-antidot proposal for the Abelian anyons, we propose an interferometry for probing the elementary exchanges of non-abelian anyons using two gate-controlled quantum antidots. By tuning two antidots independently, the device realizes distinct cooperative tunnelling processes, which correspond to different braids of non-abelian anyons. For the unresolved local fusion channels, the difference between the interference signals of the single and double cooperative processes allows us to measure the elementary exchange of the non-abelian anyons, providing a direct probe of their non-abelian statistics and topological spins. For the resolved local fusion channels, the double-cooperative process is further distinguished by a reduced interference amplitude. Our work provides a promising and practical route for manipulating and detecting non-abelian braiding with the fundamental fractional statistics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“propose”（提出）、“realizes”（实现）、“allows us to measure”（使我们能测量）等理论设计性表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：非阿贝尔任意子的基本交换（π旋转交换）及其非阿贝尔统计与拓扑自旋的探测，具体体系为基于两个门控量子反点的干涉仪。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两个独立调控的量子反点实现不同的协同隧穿过程，对应非阿贝尔任意子的不同编织操作；在未分辨的局域融合通道中，通过比较单次与双次协同过程的干涉信号差异，可直接测量非阿贝尔任意子的基本交换，从而直接探测其非阿贝尔统计和拓扑自旋；在分辨的局域融合通道中，双次协同过程可通过减小的干涉振幅进一步区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两个独立调控的量子反点实现不同的协同隧穿过程，对应非阿贝尔任意子的不同编织操作；在未分辨的局域融合通道中，通过比较单次与双次协同过程的干涉信号差异，可直接测量非阿贝尔任意子的基本交换，从而直接探测其非阿贝尔统计和拓扑自旋；在分辨的局域融合通道中，双次协同过程可通过减小的干涉振幅进一步区分。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论提出了一种基于两个门控量子反点的干涉测量方案，通过独立调控两个反点实现不同的协同隧穿过程，从而对应非阿贝尔任意子的不同编织操作。分析基于干涉信号（单次与双次协同过程）的差异来提取基本交换信息。

papers.title: A Minimal Active-Particle Realization of Non-Hermitian Chern Bulk-Boundary Correspondence
papers.abstract: We show that a minimal frustrated Vicsek--Kuramoto active-particle model realizes a non-Hermitian Chern bulk-boundary correspondence. A Sakaguchi-type phase lag in the local heading alignment generates finite-wavenumber bulk instabilities and, under collision boundaries, robust one-way boundary flow. The organizing principle is a nonlinear saturation ansatz: the linearized hydrodynamic operator selects the unstable wavelength and spectral topology, while nonlinear particle dynamics saturates the selected mode. The isotropic continuum spectrum compactifies the wave-number plane and supports spectral projectors with Chern numbers $C=\pm2$, fixed by the spin structure of the dispersion matrix. Strip spectral flow then predicts chiral edge propagation, in agreement with particle simulations in the nontrivial sectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：non-Hermitian Chern bulk-boundary correspondence、linearized hydrodynamic operator、spectral projectors、Chern numbers）；研究对象：一种最小化的受挫Vicsek–Kuramoto活性粒子模型，以及其中实现的非厄米陈数体-边界对应现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该活性粒子模型在碰撞边界条件下产生稳健的单向边界流，其组织原理是非线性饱和假设：线性化流体动力学算子选择不稳定波长和谱拓扑，而非线性粒子动力学饱和所选模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该活性粒子模型在碰撞边界条件下产生稳健的单向边界流，其组织原理是非线性饱和假设：线性化流体动力学算子选择不稳定波长和谱拓扑，而非线性粒子动力学饱和所选模式。；创新点：首次在活性粒子模型中实现了非厄米陈数体-边界对应，并通过最小化模型揭示了非线性饱和机制如何将线性拓扑性质与非线性动力学行为联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合粒子模拟。具体包括：引入Sakaguchi型相位滞后实现有限波数体不稳定性；通过连续谱紧致化波数平面并计算谱投影子的陈数（C=±2）；利用条带谱流预测手性边缘传播，并与非平庸扇区的粒子模拟结果对比。

papers.title: A Gauge-Theoretic Formulation of Nambu Non-equilibrium Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: We present a gauge-theoretic formulation of Nambu non-equilibrium thermodynamics (NNET). In this framework, the thermodynamic potential $A_{i}=\partial_{i}S$ plays the role of a gauge field: the reversible thermodynamics corresponds to the pure-gauge condition $F=dA=0$, while the irreversible entropy production arises from the emergence of curvature $F\neq0$. The gauge-fixing term, $A_{0}=\frac{1}{2}L^{ij}A_{i}A_{j}$ leads to Onsager's variational principle, whereas the Chern--Simons--like term $A\wedge B\wedge dt,\ B=dH_{1}\wedge dH_{2},$ naturally yields the framework of NNET. This formulation provides a unified geometric foundation for both reversible and irreversible processes in thermodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：gauge-theoretic formulation（规范理论表述）、geometric foundation（几何基础）。；研究对象：非平衡热力学，具体为Nambu非平衡热力学（NNET）的几何与规范理论框架。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热力学势 \(A_i = \partial_i S\) 扮演规范场的角色：可逆热力学对应纯规范条件（曲率 \(F=0\)），而不可逆熵产生源于曲率 \(F \neq 0\) 的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热力学势 \(A_i = \partial_i S\) 扮演规范场的角色：可逆热力学对应纯规范条件（曲率 \(F=0\)），而不可逆熵产生源于曲率 \(F \neq 0\) 的出现。；创新点：为可逆与不可逆热力学过程提供了统一的几何基础，将熵产生与规范场的曲率直接对应。
papers.method_zh: 采用规范场论框架，通过引入规范固定项 \(A_0 = \frac{1}{2} L^{ij} A_i A_j\) 导出Onsager变分原理，并通过类似Chern-Simons项 \(A \wedge B \wedge dt\) 自然导出Nambu非平衡热力学的结构。

papers.title: Real-Space Mapping of Electronic Conductivity in Complex Materials
papers.abstract: We introduce KuboMap, a real-space representation of electronic conductivity derived from the Kubo-Greenwood formula. KuboMap defines a nonnegative conductivity density whose spatial integral recovers the total conductivity and whose form is guided by Mott's picture of transport through spatially overlapping electronic states. This construction provides a direct map of the transport-active regions of a material. Applied to aluminum, KuboMap recovers an extended metallic conduction network. Applied to amorphous silicon, it distinguishes an insulating defect-free network from a defective structure in which localized near-Fermi states form connected hopping-like pathways. In silicon-oxides, it captures the loss of conduction as increasing oxygen content disrupts Silicon-rich transport networks. KuboMap provides a physically transparent route from Kubo--Greenwood conductivity to real-space transport pathways in complex materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“KuboMap”、“Kubo-Greenwood formula”、“real-space representation”、“applied to aluminum / amorphous silicon / silicon-oxides”。；研究对象：复杂材料（如铝、非晶硅、硅氧化物）中的电子电导率及其实空间输运路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为KuboMap的实空间电导率表示方法，能够直接映射材料中参与输运的区域，并区分金属性导电网络、绝缘性无缺陷网络以及由局域态形成的跳跃式导电通路。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为KuboMap的实空间电导率表示方法，能够直接映射材料中参与输运的区域，并区分金属性导电网络、绝缘性无缺陷网络以及由局域态形成的跳跃式导电通路。；创新点：将传统的Kubo-Greenwood电导率从动量/频率空间映射到实空间，提供了一种物理直观的方法来识别复杂材料中输运活跃区域和导电通路。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kubo-Greenwood公式推导出非负的电导率密度（KuboMap），其空间积分等于总电导率，并通过在铝、非晶硅（含缺陷与无缺陷结构）及硅氧化物中的计算应用来验证其有效性。

papers.title: Spectral Leakage and Masking Effects in the Measurement of Hyperuniformity
papers.abstract: The detection of hyperuniformity relies critically on accurate characterization of the small-wavenumber behavior of the static structure factor of the system. In practice, however, measurements are performed on finite subsystems or through incomplete observations that effectively mask portions of the underlying configuration. Inspired by a recent numerical study [Y. Liu, X. Li, J. Tian, X. Yan, G. Zhang, {\it J. Chem. Phys.} {\bf 164}, 094102 (2026)], we develop a unified theoretical framework that quantifies how finite windows and spatially correlated binary masks modify the observed structure factor. We show that the measured structure factor $S_{obs}(k)$ is the convolution of the intrinsic structure factor with the spectral density of the observation function, whether it is a compact window or an extended random mask. For generic hyperuniform systems with small-$k$ scaling $S(k)\sim k^α$, finite observation window induces a universal quadratic leakage term at sufficiently small wavenumbers (i.e., $k \lesssim 1/L$), leading to an apparent $k^{2}$ scaling independent of the true exponent. The true hyperuniform exponent $α$ can only be measured in the intermediate regime $1/L \ll k \ll q_c$. In stealthy hyperuniform systems, where the intrinsic structure factor possesses a spectral gap, all observed small-$k$ power arises entirely from this convolution mechanism. For spatially correlated masks, we derive the corresponding convolution relation in terms of the mask spectral density and identify conditions under which hyperuniform signatures are suppressed, preserved, or distorted. Our results establish quantitative criteria for reliably extracting intrinsic scaling exponents and distinguishing genuine hyperuniform order from measurement-induced artifacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a unified theoretical framework”、“derive the corresponding convolution relation”、“establish quantitative criteria”。；研究对象：超均匀性（hyperuniformity）的测量，具体研究有限观测窗口和空间相关掩膜对静态结构因子小波数行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限观测窗口会在极小波数（k ≲ 1/L）处引入一个普适的二次泄漏项，导致观测到的结构因子呈现k²标度，掩盖真实的超均匀性指数α；真实的α只能在中间波数区间（1/L ≪ k ≪ q_c）被可靠测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限观测窗口会在极小波数（k ≲ 1/L）处引入一个普适的二次泄漏项，导致观测到的结构因子呈现k²标度，掩盖真实的超均匀性指数α；真实的α只能在中间波数区间（1/L ≪ k ≪ q_c）被可靠测量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：通过将观测结构因子S_obs(k)表示为固有结构因子与观测函数（紧凑窗口或随机掩膜）谱密度的卷积，推导出泄漏效应的定量表达式，并分析不同超均匀系统（包括一般超均匀系统和隐形超均匀系统）中的标度行为。

papers.title: On the Renormalization Group Flow of Active Flocks
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study the statistical field-theoretic renormalization of active flocks via the MSRDJ action formulation for stochastic systems, focusing on the Toner-Tu theory of `Malthusian flocks', or polar-ordered, momentum non-conserving active fluids where relaxation times for density fluctuations are so short that they can be eliminated as a hydrodynamic variable. Working in the limit of isotropic diffusion in two spatial dimensions, we compute the renormalization of the couplings and their anomalous dimensions to all orders, facilitated by the Ward identities associated with the non-linear realization of a diagonal rotation/ shift symmetry, and a non-local field-dependent redundancy specific to the MSRDJ representation of this model. We find a range of behavior depending on the parameters of the theory. If $κ$ is the diffusion coefficient and $Δ$ is the variance of the noise, we find a line of fixed points and a marginal vertex instability at $Δ/κ= 2π$. This instability separates Gaussian, and symmetry-protected strongly interacting gapless phases, realizing non-equilibrium critical behavior beyond standard Wilson--Fisher criticality, and implies the persistence of long range order when $Δ/κ$ is below the critical value. We revisit and contextualize various claims and counter-claims in the literature in light of our findings, and discuss extensions of our analysis to flocks with anisotropic diffusion, and where density fluctuations are reintroduced.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：statistical field-theoretic renormalization、MSRDJ action formulation、Ward identities。；研究对象：活性凝聚体（active flocks），具体为Toner-Tu理论中的“马尔萨斯群”（Malthusian flocks），即极性有序、动量不守恒的活性流体，其中密度涨落的弛豫时间极短，可作为流体力学变量被消去。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维各向同性扩散极限下，发现一条固定点线和一个位于Δ/κ=2π处的边缘顶点不稳定性。该不稳定性将高斯相与对称性保护的强相互作用无能隙相分开，实现超越标准Wilson-Fisher临界点的非平衡临界行为；当Δ/κ低于临界值时，长程有序得以持续。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维各向同性扩散极限下，发现一条固定点线和一个位于Δ/κ=2π处的边缘顶点不稳定性。该不稳定性将高斯相与对称性保护的强相互作用无能隙相分开，实现超越标准Wilson-Fisher临界点的非平衡临界行为；当Δ/κ低于临界值时，长程有序得以持续。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但指出其发现有助于重新审视和语境化文献中的各种主张与反主张，并讨论了向各向异性扩散及重新引入密度涨落的扩展方向。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机系统的MSRDJ作用量表述，结合与对角旋转/平移对称性的非线性实现相关的Ward恒等式，以及该模型MSRDJ表示特有的非局域场依赖冗余，对所有阶的耦合重整化和反常维度进行了计算。

papers.title: Many-Body Second Order Green's Function Theory for Ab Initio Molecular Quantum Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: In this work, we develop two many-body quantum electrodynamic methods to calculate the ground-state energies of strongly coupled light-matter molecular systems. Specifically, we extend the second-order many-body Green's function theory (GF2) for electronic systems to incorporate electron-boson couplings. We employ two ansätze to treat the bosonic part of the system, namely the coherent-state (CS) and Lang-Firsov (LF) transformed vacuum state. These are combined with the GF2 method to construct two new approaches, which we refer to as CS-GF2 and LF-GF2. We benchmark CS- and LF-GF2 by studying various molecular systems inside an optical cavity. We investigate $\mathrm{H}_2$ and $\mathrm{LiH}$ potential energy surfaces, keto-eneol tautomerization energy barrier, van-der Waals interactions between two $\mathrm{H_2}$ molecules and the torsional potential energy surface of the ethylene molecule, $\mathrm{C_2H_4}$. Both methods provide highly accurate energies, with only modest additional improvement observed in LF-GF2.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop two many-body quantum electrodynamic methods”、“extend the second-order many-body Green's function theory”、“employ two ansätze”等关键词，属于理论方法发展。；研究对象：强耦合光-物质分子系统，具体包括光学腔内的H₂、LiH分子势能面、酮-烯醇互变异构能垒、两个H₂分子间的范德华相互作用以及乙烯分子（C₂H₄）的扭转势能面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所发展的CS-GF2和LF-GF2两种方法均能提供高精度的基态能量，其中LF-GF2方法在精度上仅有适度提升。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所发展的CS-GF2和LF-GF2两种方法均能提供高精度的基态能量，其中LF-GF2方法在精度上仅有适度提升。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 发展了两种多体量子电动力学方法：将电子系统的二阶多体格林函数理论（GF2）扩展至包含电子-玻色子耦合；分别采用相干态（CS）和Lang-Firsov（LF）变换真空态两种ansätze处理玻色子部分，构建了CS-GF2和LF-GF2两种新方法。

papers.title: Natural Ungrokking: Asymmetric Control of Which Rules Survive Pretraining
papers.abstract: Midway through an ordinary pretraining run, a small language model learns the pronoun-gender rule: cued with a girl's name ("Sue cried because"), it resolves the next pronoun to she, generalizing to held-out probes (0.94 by step 925). By step 3,500 the same model scores near zero on the same probes, although the rule's evidence is still in the training data. We call this within-run reversal natural ungrokking: the corpus decides, with no trace in the loss curve, which learned rules a model keeps. Which rules survive is predictable from one corpus statistic: how often the training stream shows the rule winning. Across un-intervened runs (two corpora, three budgets, three seeds), support frequency decides a rule's fate; the data-to-parameter ratio only modulates how deeply a doomed rule falls. The same emerge-then-collapse dynamics appear in public Pythia checkpoints, collapse depth ordered by model scale as predicted. The forgetting is a displacement: a competing surface pattern out-competes the rule, and the log-probability margin between them crosses zero within 100 training steps of the behavioral collapse. Control over this fate is asymmetric: the same edit that destroys a rule on demand cannot restore it. Flipping support to counter-evidence in place kills the rule with monotone dose-response in two unrelated rules; but injecting support back, even to 450 times the level that naturally sustains it, buys no recovery. Every confirmatory threshold and prediction was pre-registered before the data it governed was read.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：small language model, pretraining, corpus statistic, log-probability margin）；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是小型语言模型（small language model）在预训练（pretraining）过程中，对特定语法规则（代词-性别规则，pronoun-gender rule）的学习与遗忘现象。这是一个机器学习模型行为，而非传统凝聚态物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现了一种名为“自然去突现”（natural ungrokking）的现象：在预训练过程中，模型会先学会一个规则，随后又自发地遗忘该规则，即使训练数据中该规则的证据依然存在。决定规则存亡的关键因素是训练流中该规则“获胜”（即被正确预测）的频率（support frequency），而非损失曲线的变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现了一种名为“自然去突现”（natural ungrokking）的现象：在预训练过程中，模型会先学会一个规则，随后又自发地遗忘该规则，即使训练数据中该规则的证据依然存在。决定规则存亡的关键因素是训练流中该规则“获胜”（即被正确预测）的频率（support frequency），而非损失曲线的变化。；创新点：首次系统性地描述并命名了“自然去突现”（natural ungrokking）现象，并揭示了其与训练数据统计特性（支持频率）的定量关系，而非通常认为的过拟合或损失函数变化。此外，发现对规则存亡的控制具有不对称性：可以轻易破坏一个规则，但无法通过增加支持数据来恢复它。
papers.method_zh: 通过控制语言模型的预训练过程（不同语料库、预算、随机种子），分析模型在特定语法规则上的表现（如代词预测准确率）。使用了“支持频率”（support frequency）这一语料库统计量来预测规则存亡，并分析了“数据-参数比”（data-to-parameter ratio）对遗忘深度的影响。还利用了公开的Pythia模型检查点进行验证，并研究了“对数概率边际”（log-probability margin）在行为崩溃前后的变化。

papers.title: Exact modes, hybridization and polarization rotation of electromagnetic fields propagating in topological insulating slab
papers.abstract: We study electromagnetic waves in slab waveguides with a topological insulator core characterized by a topological magnetoelectric parameter (ME). TIs are electrically insulating in the bulk with robust conducting states at their boundaries. Their electromagnetic response is described by an axion-like $Θ$ term that modifies Maxwell's electrodynamics, leading to rich and unconventional phenomena, as the topological ME effect. All supported modes are exact hybrid modes with nonvanishing longitudinal field components. This hybridization is a consequence of the boundary conditions produced by the $Θ$ term and is absent in topologically trivial, reciprocal and non-chiral slab waveguides. Modifications to the propagation condition and modes are shown for the asymmetric slab. The detailed solution of the exact modes, coupling of modes and the dispersion relations is made for the symmetric slab. By solving the full $Θ$-electrodynamics nonperturbatively, we derive the modal dispersion relations and explore polarization rotation and power transfer between modes. Our approach reveals qualitative and quantitative deviations from standard coupled-mode theory and captures new signatures of the topological ME response. Due to the smallness of the $Θ$-effects, we perform a perturbative analysis of mode propagation, based on writing a general solution as a superposition of exact modes of $Θ$-ED but expanding to first non-vanishing order. Also, we apply coupled-mode theory, that is predicated on building solutions as superpositions of modes of ordinary electrodynamics that fail to satisfy the boundary conditions imposed by the $Θ$-term but compensate at the expense of modifying the field profiles. These findings provide a comprehensive framework for light control in topological photonics and potential routes to experimentally probe the ME effect in guided settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study（研究）、derive（推导）、perturbative analysis（微扰分析）、coupled-mode theory（耦合模理论）。；研究对象：拓扑绝缘体平板波导中传播的电磁波，具体研究由拓扑磁电参数（Θ项）引起的模式杂化、偏振旋转和功率转移等电磁响应现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑绝缘体平板波导中所有支持的模式都是具有非零纵向场分量的精确杂化模式，这种杂化源于Θ项产生的边界条件，在拓扑平庸的波导中不存在。通过非微扰求解完整的Θ-电动力学，推导了模式色散关系，并揭示了与标准耦合模理论的定性和定量偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑绝缘体平板波导中所有支持的模式都是具有非零纵向场分量的精确杂化模式，这种杂化源于Θ项产生的边界条件，在拓扑平庸的波导中不存在。通过非微扰求解完整的Θ-电动力学，推导了模式色散关系，并揭示了与标准耦合模理论的定性和定量偏差。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用非微扰方法完整求解Θ-电动力学（Θ-electrodynamics），推导精确模式色散关系；同时进行微扰分析，将一般解写为Θ-电动力学精确模式的叠加并展开至首个非零阶；还应用了耦合模理论，将解构建为普通电动力学模式的叠加（这些模式不满足Θ项边界条件，但通过修改场分布来补偿）。

papers.title: Benchmarking Dark Matter Search using a Parity-Check Protocol with Machine-Learning Optimized Pulses
papers.abstract: We report on an improved microwave detection protocol for dark matter candidates such as the axion and the dark photon. We employ a superconducting transmon qubit dispersively coupled to a double-cavity system, enabling quantum non-demolition measurements of the photon occupation in a relatively short-lived storage cavity. To reduce the experimental cycle time and enhance sensitivity for axion and dark-photon searches, we operate this detector in a regime of increased qubit-cavity coupling, resulting in Stark shifts of 4.6 MHz. In this regime, conventional control pulses suffer from strong frequency-detuning sensitivity and photon-number-dependent errors. We address this limitation by implementing frequency-detuning-robust $π/2$ pulses (obtained by machine-learning optimization) that preserve high-fidelity qubit control over a bandwidth of approximately 20 MHz. We experimentally validate this protocol and demonstrate single-photon detection performance comparable to previous implementations, despite significantly reduced qubit coherence times and storage-cavity lifetimes. Using parity-based measurement sequences combined with a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) analysis, we achieve background rates on the order of $\mathcal{O}(20)$ Hz. In the absence of a magnetic field, we derive exclusion limits on the dark photon model for dark matter, reaching a sensitivity to the kinetic mixing angle of $ε_{95\%} \sim 1\times10^{-14}$ at 5.051 GHz. These results establish machine-learning robust control as a key enabler for faster, more scalable microwave quantum sensors for dark-matter searches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：report on an improved microwave detection protocol, experimentally validate, demonstrate single-photon detection performance）；研究对象：暗物质候选粒子（轴子、暗光子）的微波探测，具体采用超导transmon量子比特与双腔系统耦合的量子传感器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习优化的频率失谐鲁棒π/2脉冲，在强耦合（Stark位移4.6 MHz）和短寿命腔体条件下，实现了与先前工作相当的单光子探测性能，并在无磁场下将暗光子动力学混合角排除限提升至ε_95% ~ 1×10^{-14}（5.051 GHz）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习优化的频率失谐鲁棒π/2脉冲，在强耦合（Stark位移4.6 MHz）和短寿命腔体条件下，实现了与先前工作相当的单光子探测性能，并在无磁场下将暗光子动力学混合角排除限提升至ε_95% ~ 1×10^{-14}（5.051 GHz）。；创新点：利用机器学习优化控制脉冲克服强耦合下频率失谐敏感性和光子数依赖误差，从而在显著缩短的量子比特相干时间和腔寿命条件下维持高灵敏度，为更快、更可扩展的微波量子暗物质传感器奠定基础。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用超导transmon量子比特色散耦合至双腔系统，实现存储腔光子数的量子非破坏测量；采用机器学习优化的π/2脉冲实现约20 MHz带宽内的高保真度量子控制；结合基于宇称的测量序列与隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）分析来降低背景计数率（~20 Hz量级）。

papers.title: Sp(2N, R) interferometry in multi-mode Gaussian bosonic systems for optimal metrology and quantum control
papers.abstract: Multi-mode interferometers for bosons in Gaussian states are important systems for quantum metrology with precision beyond the standard quantum limit and for bosonic quantum computing. However, there is a lack of theoretical foundation for generic $N$-mode Gaussian interferometry. In this work, we study quantum metrology and quantum control in multi-mode bosonic systems with quadratic Hamiltonians, exploiting the fundamental Sp$(2N,R)$ symmetry of such interferometers. We show that the optimal quantum control to maximize sensitivity requires aligning squeezing and displacement in the same direction. We propose Sp$(2N,R)$ echo, a multi-mode generalization of the SU$(1,1)$ interferometry, to achieve the sensitivity of phase estimation set by the quantum Fisher information. In addition, we introduce a geometrical means for reversing many-body dynamics with Sp$(2N,R)$ dynamical symmetry, such as dynamics of the bosonic Kitaev chain. Our schemes are readily realizable in optical, atomic, and mechanical platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、propose、introduce（无实验或计算细节描述）。；研究对象：多模玻色子高斯态干涉仪，具体为具有二次哈密顿量的多模玻色子系统中的量子计量与量子控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优量子控制需要将压缩与位移对齐在同一方向；提出了Sp(2N,R)回波技术，作为SU(1,1)干涉仪的多模推广，可实现由量子Fisher信息设定的相位估计灵敏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优量子控制需要将压缩与位移对齐在同一方向；提出了Sp(2N,R)回波技术，作为SU(1,1)干涉仪的多模推广，可实现由量子Fisher信息设定的相位估计灵敏度。；创新点：为通用的N模高斯干涉仪建立了理论基础，并提出了多模Sp(2N,R)回波方案，将此前仅适用于单模或双模的SU(1,1)干涉仪推广到任意多模情形。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用Sp(2N,R)对称性作为理论框架，分析多模高斯干涉仪的量子计量与量子控制问题；提出几何方法用于逆转具有Sp(2N,R)动力学对称性的多体动力学（如玻色子Kitaev链）。

papers.title: Exact Leg-Cut Influence Functional and Emergence of Gaussian Entanglement Theory in a Statistical-Dressing Ladder Model
papers.abstract: The emergence of Gaussian effective field theories in low-dimensional quantum systems is traditionally understood through top-down frameworks such as bosonization and Luttinger-liquid theory. However, these approaches typically focus on the long-wavelength degrees of freedom in ways that do not directly track how non-Gaussian lattice-scale correlations are progressively discarded under coarse-graining. In this work, we present an exact lattice formulation from which this phenomenon emerges analytically. We analyze a two-leg hard-core ladder under a leg bipartition, where non-local statistical strings cross the entanglement cut. We construct an exact lattice influence-functional representation showing that the reduced state factorizes strictly into a product-state amplitude and a full-counting-statistics functional. By introducing a commuting linked-cluster superoperator hierarchy that bypasses Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff ordering ambiguities, we prove that the first mixedness-generating sector is strictly density-density in character. Under a specific systematic coarse-graining procedure, we analytically derive the suppression of higher-order corrections, providing a controlled, closed-form framework showing how highly non-Gaussian lattice states evolve toward their quadratic continuum form under coarse-graining. We corroborate these analytical predictions through finite-size exact diagonalization and entanglement-spectrum diagnostics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact lattice formulation、analytically derive、analytical predictions。；研究对象：一个两腿硬核玻色子梯子模型（two-leg hard-core ladder）在腿二分（leg bipartition）下的量子纠缠与粗粒化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确构造晶格影响泛函（influence functional），证明该模型的约化态严格分解为乘积态振幅与全计数统计泛函的乘积；在特定粗粒化方案下，高阶非高斯修正被解析地抑制，从而展示了非高斯晶格态如何演化为二次型连续场论形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确构造晶格影响泛函（influence functional），证明该模型的约化态严格分解为乘积态振幅与全计数统计泛函的乘积；在特定粗粒化方案下，高阶非高斯修正被解析地抑制，从而展示了非高斯晶格态如何演化为二次型连续场论形式。；创新点：首次在晶格尺度上解析地展示了非高斯关联如何在粗粒化过程中被逐步丢弃，并严格证明了高斯纠缠理论从该模型中的涌现，避免了传统玻色化方法中Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff排序歧义问题。
papers.method_zh: 精确晶格影响泛函表示、可交换的链接团簇超算子层次结构（commuting linked-cluster superoperator hierarchy）、有限尺寸精确对角化、纠缠谱诊断。

papers.title: Long-lasting Topological Entanglement in a Monitored Rashba Nanowire
papers.abstract: We study the topological properties of a monitored Rashba chain along quantum-jump trajectories, investigating the persistence of the initial topological value of the disconnected entanglement entropy (DEE). We find that the DEE persists in its topological value for a time linear in the system size, even if the dissipation acts on the boundary and affects the topological Majorana modes. The reason for this phenomenon lies in the absence of particle conservation and in the degeneracy of the topological manifold, allowing the monitoring to let the system switch between different topological states -- alternatively creating and annihilating a Majorana mode -- while producing a poisoning of finite-energy ballistically propagating quasiparticles that eventually destroy the topological entanglement structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：monitored（监测）、quantum-jump trajectories（量子跳跃轨迹）、topological properties（拓扑性质）。；研究对象：受监测的Rashba纳米线（monitored Rashba nanowire）中的拓扑纠缠结构及其持久性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子跳跃轨迹下，即使耗散作用于边界并影响拓扑马约拉纳模，断开纠缠熵（DEE）的拓扑值仍能持续系统尺寸量级的时间。这一现象源于粒子数不守恒和拓扑流形的简并性，监测使系统在不同拓扑态间切换，同时产生有限能量弹道传播的准粒子毒化，最终破坏拓扑纠缠结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子跳跃轨迹下，即使耗散作用于边界并影响拓扑马约拉纳模，断开纠缠熵（DEE）的拓扑值仍能持续系统尺寸量级的时间。这一现象源于粒子数不守恒和拓扑流形的简并性，监测使系统在不同拓扑态间切换，同时产生有限能量弹道传播的准粒子毒化，最终破坏拓扑纠缠结构。；创新点：揭示了在非厄米监测（monitoring）下，拓扑纠缠（DEE）可以抵抗边界耗散而长时间保持其拓扑值，并阐明了其物理机制——粒子数不守恒与拓扑简并导致的态切换及准粒子毒化过程。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析量子跳跃轨迹（quantum-jump trajectories）下的断开纠缠熵（DEE）演化，研究受监测Rashba链的拓扑性质。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如张量网络、蒙特卡洛等）。

papers.title: Two-dimensional Hyperbolic RNN Neural Quantum State
papers.abstract: In the first part of this work, we construct the first type of two-dimensional (2D) hyperbolic neural quantum state (NQS) in the form of the Lorentz 2DRNN (Recurrent Neural Network) and benchmark its performance against the Euclidean 2DRNN in the paradigmatic $N\times N$ 2D Transverse Field Ising Model (2DTFIM) setting with different lattice sizes up to $N=12$ and at different transverse magnetic field strengths. We find that hyperbolic Lorentz 2DRNN NQS definitively outperform Euclidean 2DRNN NQS when the system is at the phase transition point when the physics can be described by a conformal field theory (CFT), which is known to be dual to an Anti-de-Sitter (AdS) space whose spatial geometry is hyperbolic. In the second part of this work, we benchmark the performances of the recently introduced one-dimensional (1D) hyperbolic NQS including Poincaré RNN/GRU and Lorentz RNN/GRU against their Euclidean NQS versions in $N\times N$ 2DTFIM, which has to be converted to a one-dimensional setting to allow for the use of 1D NQS. The findings in this case extend our previous results that 1D hyperbolic NQS definitively outperform 1D Euclidean NQS, thanks to the combined effects of the hierarchical structure comprising the first and $N^{th}$ neighbor interactions present in the 1D system arising from the 2D lattice and the CFT physics at the critical point. While more studies with larger system sizes are required, our work serves as a proof-of-concept for the utility, effectiveness as well as the superior performances of one- and two-dimensional hyperbolic NQS ansatzes compared to the existing Euclidean NQS in many-body quantum physics systems, especially when these systems exhibit structural hierarchy or when they are at criticality, or a combination of both.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural quantum state (NQS)、Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)、benchmark、conformal field theory (CFT)。；研究对象：二维横向场伊辛模型（2D Transverse Field Ising Model, 2DTFIM），以及该模型在临界点附近由共形场论（CFT）描述的量子多体系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维横向场伊辛模型的相变临界点（可由共形场论描述，其对偶于空间几何为双曲型的AdS时空）处，双曲型Lorentz 2DRNN神经量子态的性能明确优于欧几里得2DRNN神经量子态。此外，将二维模型转换为一维后，一维双曲型RNN/GRU神经量子态也优于其一维欧几里得版本，这得益于一维系统中由二维晶格映射产生的层级结构（包含最近邻和第N近邻相互作用）与临界点CFT物理的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维横向场伊辛模型的相变临界点（可由共形场论描述，其对偶于空间几何为双曲型的AdS时空）处，双曲型Lorentz 2DRNN神经量子态的性能明确优于欧几里得2DRNN神经量子态。此外，将二维模型转换为一维后，一维双曲型RNN/GRU神经量子态也优于其一维欧几里得版本，这得益于一维系统中由二维晶格映射产生的层级结构（包含最近邻和第N近邻相互作用）与临界点CFT物理的共同作用。；创新点：首次构建了二维双曲型神经量子态（Lorentz 2DRNN形式），并系统证明了在临界点（CFT/AdS对偶相关）及存在结构层级性的系统中，双曲型NQS相比传统欧几里得NQS具有明确优势。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 构建了双曲型Lorentz 2DRNN神经量子态（NQS），并将其与欧几里得2DRNN NQS在N×N二维横向场伊辛模型（晶格尺寸N最大为12，不同横向磁场强度）上进行性能基准测试。同时，将一维双曲型NQS（包括Poincaré RNN/GRU和Lorentz RNN/GRU）与一维欧几里得NQS在转换为一维后的同一模型上进行对比。

papers.title: Preparing two-mode magnonic Schrödinger cat states in a cavity-magnon-qubit system
papers.abstract: The cavity-magnon-qubit system has recently been demonstrated as a new platform for preparing macroscopic quantum states in magnonic systems. Here, we propose to prepare a two-mode magnonic cat state, which is also a non-Gaussian entangled state, based on this practical system involving two yttrium-iron-garnet (YIG) spheres and a superconducting qubit coupled to a common microwave cavity. By adiabatically eliminating the cavity and resonantly driving the qubit, an effective magnon-qubit conditional-displacement interaction is achieved. Further working in the magnon-magnon strong-coupling regime and considering two identical magnon frequencies and coupling strengths to the cavity, two hybridized magnon modes are formed, of which the bright mode is prepared in a cat state after a projective measurement on the qubit, while the dark mode remains in its initial vacuum state. Such a state corresponds to a two-mode cat state of two original magnon modes, which share strong non-Gaussian entanglement. We also discuss practical dissipation and dephasing effects on the cat state. The results indicate that strong nonclassicality and non-Gaussian entanglement are present in the two-mode cat state using fully feasible parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、adiabatically eliminating、projective measurement、discuss effects。；研究对象：腔-磁振子-量子比特系统中的双模磁振子薛定谔猫态（非高斯纠缠态），具体涉及两个钇铁石榴石（YIG）球体和一个超导量子比特耦合到同一微波腔。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出在腔-磁振子-量子比特系统中，通过绝热消除腔场并共振驱动量子比特，结合磁振子-磁振子强耦合，可在对量子比特进行投影测量后，将杂化亮模制备成猫态，从而获得两个原始磁振子模式的双模猫态，该态具有强非高斯纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出在腔-磁振子-量子比特系统中，通过绝热消除腔场并共振驱动量子比特，结合磁振子-磁振子强耦合，可在对量子比特进行投影测量后，将杂化亮模制备成猫态，从而获得两个原始磁振子模式的双模猫态，该态具有强非高斯纠缠。；创新点：在腔-磁振子-量子比特这一新平台上，提出制备双模磁振子猫态（非高斯纠缠态）的方案，并利用完全可行的实验参数验证了强非经典性和非高斯纠缠的存在。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过绝热消除腔场和共振驱动量子比特，实现有效磁振子-量子比特条件位移相互作用；利用磁振子-磁振子强耦合形成杂化模式；采用投影测量制备亮模猫态；并讨论了实际耗散和退相干效应的影响。

papers.title: Wide-field NV magnetometry under simultaneous high-pressure and high-temperature conditions
papers.abstract: We demonstrate wide-field optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) under simultaneous high-pressure and high-temperature conditions using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers.
