Although NV-center magnetometry has been widely used for spatially resolved magnetic-field imaging, its application to extreme environments combining pressure and temperature remains challenging. In this work, we show that ODMR can be observed at 5 GPa and 500 K, demonstrating the feasibility of NV spin readout under such combined extreme conditions. We further perform wide-field ODMR of iron at 7 GPa and 500 K, where the stray magnetic field from the sample is spatially visualized through the pressure cell. These results establish NV-center magnetometry as a promising platform for imaging magnetic phenomena in materials under high-pressure and high-temperature environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、wide-field ODMR、performed、spatially visualized。；研究对象：氮空位（NV）中心在同时高压（5-7 GPa）和高温（500 K）极端条件下的宽场磁成像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在5 GPa和500 K的联合极端条件下成功观测到ODMR信号，并在7 GPa和500 K下实现了对铁样品杂散磁场的宽场空间成像，证明了NV中心磁测量在高压高温环境中的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在5 GPa和500 K的联合极端条件下成功观测到ODMR信号，并在7 GPa和500 K下实现了对铁样品杂散磁场的宽场空间成像，证明了NV中心磁测量在高压高温环境中的可行性。；创新点：首次在同时施加高压（GPa级）和高温（500 K）的联合极端条件下实现宽场NV磁成像，突破了此前NV磁测量仅适用于单一极端条件的限制。
papers.method_zh: 宽场光探测磁共振（wide-field ODMR）技术，结合金刚石对顶砧（pressure cell）实现高压与高温条件。

papers.title: A convolutional neural network surrogate for hierarchical homogenization: fast elastic moduli prediction of digital rocks
papers.abstract: Digital rock physics (DRP) aims to estimate effective rock properties (e.g., elastic moduli) directly from 3D micro-CT images. However, direct numerical simulations (DNS) on high-resolution large 3D scans are often computationally prohibitive and severely limit the application of DRP. To address this bottleneck, we combine a lightweight 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) with hierarchical homogenization (HHM) and apply it to determine effective elastic moduli. In this scheme, a large rock image is divided into subcubes. The CNN replaces costly DNS by directly predicting subcube elastic moduli, while HHM upscales subcube-level predictions to the full rock. Using a shared convolutional backbone, we systematically compare three training targets: (i) full anisotropic $6\times6$ stiffness tensors, (ii) isotropic bulk and shear moduli $(K, G)$, and (iii) Hashin--Shtrikman (HS)-normalized factors. Across multiple rock types, all three models agree well with DNS results while substantially reducing the computational cost. Moreover, training from scratch on each rock type is fast enough that transfer learning is unnecessary. Across all three targets, the accuracy is comparable. In our comparative study, the HS-normalized factor offers the best overall speed--accuracy trade-off while guaranteeing physical consistency, making it a convenient default. The isotropic $(K, G)$ target is a slightly more accurate alternative.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：convolutional neural network、hierarchical homogenization、direct numerical simulations、predicting elastic moduli。；研究对象：数字岩石（digital rocks）的有效弹性模量（elastic moduli），具体通过3D微CT图像（micro-CT images）进行预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结合轻量级3D卷积神经网络（CNN）与层次均匀化方法（HHM），能够以极低计算成本准确预测数字岩石的有效弹性模量，且三种训练目标（全各向异性刚度张量、各向同性模量、Hashin-Shtrikman归一化因子）的预测精度相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结合轻量级3D卷积神经网络（CNN）与层次均匀化方法（HHM），能够以极低计算成本准确预测数字岩石的有效弹性模量，且三种训练目标（全各向异性刚度张量、各向同性模量、Hashin-Shtrikman归一化因子）的预测精度相当。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用轻量级3D卷积神经网络（CNN）替代直接数值模拟（DNS），预测岩石子立方体的弹性模量；再通过层次均匀化方法（HHM）将子立方体级别的预测结果上尺度（upscaling）至整块岩石。系统比较了三种训练目标：全各向异性6×6刚度张量、各向同性体积模量与剪切模量(K, G)、Hashin-Shtrikman归一化因子。

papers.title: Nonlocal Quantum Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Phase transitions are paradigmatic examples of emergent phenomena, in which symmetries present at the microscopic level can be spontaneously broken in the thermodynamic limit. Two primary physical mechanisms can drive this symmetry breaking: thermal fluctuations in classical phase transitions and quantum fluctuations in quantum critical phenomena. Here, we introduce $nonlocal$ $quantum$ $fluctuations$ as a new fundamental mechanism to drive phase transitions. We show that entanglement shared between environmental modes can induce a correlated symmetry breaking in remote systems, independent of their spatial separation. Using the framework of driven-dissipative phase transitions, we theoretically investigate a system composed of two nonlinear quantum resonators placed at arbitrarily large spatial separations, each coupled to independent local Markovian baths. We consider the regime in which remote environmental modes are prepared in broadband entangled states. We show that near the critical point, where the susceptibility to weak perturbations diverges, quantum correlations in the environments govern the system critical behavior. While these correlations manifest locally only as effective thermal fluctuations, at the global level they give rise to an emergent nonlocal phase transition, marked by the spontaneous symmetry breaking of a collective mode shared by the two remote systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、framework of driven-dissipative phase transitions。；研究对象：非局域量子相变，具体体系为两个空间上任意远、各自耦合到独立局域马尔可夫浴的非线性量子谐振子，且远程环境模式制备在宽带纠缠态中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出非局域量子涨落作为驱动相变的新机制：环境模式之间共享的纠缠可以在远程系统中诱导出关联的对称性破缺，形成非局域相变，表现为两个远程系统集体模的自发对称性破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出非局域量子涨落作为驱动相变的新机制：环境模式之间共享的纠缠可以在远程系统中诱导出关联的对称性破缺，形成非局域相变，表现为两个远程系统集体模的自发对称性破缺。；创新点：引入非局域量子涨落作为驱动相变的新基本机制，区别于传统的热涨落和量子涨落；揭示了环境纠缠在空间分离系统间诱导非局域对称性破缺的可能性。

papers.title: A Contactless Heat Engine Driven by Nonreciprocal Fluctuation-Induced Torques
papers.abstract: We describe a contactless heat engine in which quantum and thermal electromagnetic fluctuations act as the working medium. The setup consists of two concentric cylinders held at different temperatures. The inner cylinder stably levitates within the outer one due to repulsive nonequilibrium Casimir forces. The chirality of the setup is broken by using nonreciprocal dielectric materials, akin to application of a magnetic field along the common cylinder axis. Using Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics, we show that heat transfer and torque can be expressed in terms of an angular-momentum-resolved heat flux density, $Φ_n(ω)$: each exchanged photon carries energy $\hbar ω$ and angular momentum $\hbar n$. In reciprocal media contributions from modes $n$ and $-n$ cancel and there is no net torque; nonreciprocity breaks this symmetry and powers rotation of the inner cylinder. Even in the absence of contact, electromagnetic fluctuations produce a frictional torque opposing rotation that we compute. This enables computation of characteristic steady state rotations, and estimation of the engine efficiency (which remains bounded by the Carnot limit). The cylindrical setup provides a natural realization of fluctuation-induced angular-momentum transfer and a possible route toward nanoscale contactless engines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：描述（describe）、基于Rytov涨落电动力学（using Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics）、计算（compute）、估算（estimation）。；研究对象：一种非接触式热机，其工作介质为量子与热电磁涨落，具体体系为两个同心圆柱（内圆柱悬浮于外圆柱内），并采用非互易介电材料打破手性对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非互易介质中，不同角动量模式（n与-n）的光子所携带的角动量不再相互抵消，从而产生净扭矩驱动内圆柱旋转；同时，电磁涨落还会产生阻碍旋转的摩擦力矩，两者共同决定稳态转速，且该热机效率受卡诺极限约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非互易介质中，不同角动量模式（n与-n）的光子所携带的角动量不再相互抵消，从而产生净扭矩驱动内圆柱旋转；同时，电磁涨落还会产生阻碍旋转的摩擦力矩，两者共同决定稳态转速，且该热机效率受卡诺极限约束。；创新点：首次提出利用非互易电磁涨落（而非直接接触或机械耦合）实现非接触式热机，通过圆柱几何结构自然实现涨落诱导的角动量传递，为纳米尺度非接触引擎提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用Rytov涨落电动力学理论框架，将热传递和扭矩表达为角动量分辨的热流密度Φ_n(ω)，分析每个交换光子携带的能量ħω和角动量ħn，并计算非平衡卡西米尔力、扭矩及摩擦效应。

papers.title: Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes and duality webs of fermionic topological phases
papers.abstract: Stabilizer codes provide exact lattice realizations of bosonic topological orders. In contrast, systematic stabilizer descriptions of intrinsically fermionic topological phases remain much less developed. In this work, we introduce Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes, a class of exactly solvable fermionic lattice models whose stabilizers are built from both generalized Pauli operators and Majorana operators. As a main example, we construct an exactly solvable stabilizer realization of the fermionic toric code: an intrinsically fermionic $\mathbb Z_2$ topological order in $(2{+}1)$ dimensions, using $\mathbb Z_8$ Pauli operators coupled to Majorana modes. Within this stabilizer framework, the anyons, string operators, fusion rules, and braiding statistics all follow naturally from the stabilizer algebra. More broadly, we show that the fermionic toric code belongs to a duality web generated by anyon condensation and by gauging bosonic or fermion-parity symmetries. This web connects bosonic topological orders, symmetry-enriched topological phases, and both bosonic and fermionic symmetry-protected topological phases, all within a common stabilizer description. We further show that the construction extends to all Abelian fermionic topological orders with gapped boundaries and to all supercohomology fermionic SPT phases in $(2{+}1)$ dimensions. Going beyond Majorana operators, we introduce fermionic versions of the clock and shift operators and use them to construct an exact bosonization map for $\mathbb Z_D^F$ symmetries for $D$ even. Using this, we realize a stabilizer model for a nontrivial $\mathbb Z_8^F$ fermionic SPT phase with no free-fermion analog. Altogether, these results extend the stabilizer-code paradigm to a broad class of intrinsically fermionic phases bridging fermionic quantum many-body physics to quantum error correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：stabilizer codes、exactly solvable models、duality webs、bosonization map。；研究对象：本征费米子拓扑相，特别是(2+1)维费米子toric code（一种本征费米子Z₂拓扑序），以及更广泛的阿贝尔费米子拓扑序和超上同调费米子SPT相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes，首次实现了本征费米子拓扑相（如费米子toric code）的精确可解稳定子晶格模型，并揭示了其与玻色子拓扑序、对称性富集拓扑相及SPT相之间的对偶网络。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入Majorana-Pauli stabilizer codes，首次实现了本征费米子拓扑相（如费米子toric code）的精确可解稳定子晶格模型，并揭示了其与玻色子拓扑序、对称性富集拓扑相及SPT相之间的对偶网络。；创新点：将稳定子码范式系统性地扩展到本征费米子拓扑相，提供了费米子toric code的精确可解稳定子实现（使用Z₈ Pauli算符耦合Majorana模），并证明该构造可推广至所有具有能隙边界的阿贝尔费米子拓扑序及(2+1)维超上同调费米子SPT相，包括一个无自由费米子类比的不平凡Z₈^F费米子SPT相。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Majorana-Pauli稳定子码（将广义Pauli算符与Majorana算符结合构建稳定子）；通过任意子凝聚和规范玻色子/费米子奇偶对称性生成对偶网络；引入费米子版本的clock and shift算符，构建Z_D^F对称性的精确玻色化映射。

papers.title: Localization region detection with directionality estimation in a two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattice model
papers.abstract: This work is devoted to data-driven identification of discrete breathers in numerical simulations of a two-dimensional crystal lattice using locally sampled wave data. Different lattice wave datasets are considered, with data collected from regions of different shapes and sizes defined by the lattice particles in mechanical equilibrium. Specifically, in addition to regions with a regular hexagonal shape, one- and quasi-one-dimensional regions reflecting the quasi-one-dimensionality of discrete breathers in two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattices are proposed. To improve numerical efficiency, dataset dimensionality is reduced using Principal Component Analysis, and highly accurate Support Vector Machine classifiers are trained to distinguish between linear and nonlinear wave data. The obtained classifiers, together with the sliding window method, are applied to detect localization regions in two-dimensional hexagonal crystal lattice numerical simulations. High-precision algorithms for detected localization region segmentation and localized wave directionality estimation within the detected regions are further proposed, and their performance is evaluated. The presented methods are successfully applied to detect localized waves and their collision regions, as well as their directionality, performing a numerical study of stationary and traveling two-dimensional discrete breather interactions. Qualitatively better results are obtained when considering wave-data collection regions respecting the quasi-one-dimensional nature of two-dimensional discrete breathers in the hexagonal crystal lattice model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“data-driven identification”、“numerical simulations”、“Support Vector Machine classifiers”、“Principal Component Analysis”。；研究对象：二维六角晶格模型中的离散呼吸子（discrete breathers）及其局域化区域检测与方向性估计。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于局部采样波数据、结合主成分分析与支持向量机分类器的数据驱动方法，能够高精度地检测二维六角晶格数值模拟中的离散呼吸子局域化区域，并估计其方向性；采用反映离散呼吸子准一维特性的数据采集区域可获得更优的检测结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。

papers.title: Constraint-Aware Quantum Optimization of Defect Configurations in Doped ZrO2: XY-Mixer QAOA and Grover Adaptive Search
papers.abstract: Quantum optimization offers a route to searching the large defect-configuration spaces that arise in materials design. We develop an end-to-end, constraint-aware quantum optimization workflow for composition-defect search in a doped ZrO2 thermal-barrier-coating (TBC) material system, using a MACE-MPA-0 energy dataset to fit a 24-variable QUBO over 8 cation-occupation and 16 oxygen-vacancy variables with exactly two rare-earth substitutions and one oxygen vacancy, yielding 448 feasible configurations. The QUBO surrogate reproduces the MACE energies with held-out R2 = 0.997 (full-data R2 = 0.999, RMSE = 17 meV). We validate two complementary quantum pathways against exact enumeration: a constraint-preserving XY-mixer QAOA that confines sampling to the feasible subspace and places 86% of probability mass within 1 meV of the MACE optimum at depth p = 3, and a fault-tolerant constrained Grover Adaptive Search oracle with explicit fixed-point arithmetic, branch-safe comparison, feasibility checking, and phase kickback. Across threshold cases, the validated oracle uses 324 high-level logical qubits, or 352 to 358 with conservative clean-ancilla v-chain accounting, and requires 3.6 to 4.3 x 104 Toffoli gates per Grover (GAS) iteration. An idealized feasible-space amplification estimate suggests up to a 240x reduction in total Toffoli cost relative to the full 224 occupation space, providing a resource-estimation bridge between materials-informed QUBO modeling, constraint-aware QAOA, and fault-tolerant threshold search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum optimization、QUBO、QAOA、Grover Adaptive Search、resource estimation。；研究对象：掺杂ZrO₂热障涂层材料体系中的缺陷构型，具体为8个阳离子占位和16个氧空位变量，包含恰好两个稀土元素取代和一个氧空位的组合空间。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过约束感知的量子优化流程，在掺杂ZrO₂体系中实现了对448种可行缺陷构型的高效搜索：XY-mixer QAOA在深度p=3时可将86%的概率质量集中在MACE最优能量1 meV范围内；容错Grover自适应搜索的量子线路资源估计表明，相对于全空间搜索，可行空间放大可带来最高240倍的Toffoli门成本降低。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1）使用MACE-MPA-0能量数据集拟合24变量QUBO模型（8个阳离子占位+16个氧空位变量），QUBO代理模型在保留测试集上R²=0.997（全数据R²=0.999，RMSE=17 meV）；2）约束保持的XY-mixer QAOA方法，将采样限制在可行子空间；3）容错Grover自适应搜索（GAS）量子线路，包含显式定点算术、分支安全比较、可行性检查和相位反冲，使用324个高级逻辑量子比特（保守估计352-358个），每次Grover迭代需3.6-4.3×10⁴个Toffoli门。

papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“驱动”和“重费米子”等理论概念，且作者单位及行文风格指向理论建模，未提及实验或计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯异质结中的莫尔超晶格（MSL），特别是其中f电子体系的重费米子行为，以及平带驱动的近藤击穿（Kondo breakdown）和重入效应（reentrant effects）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在重费米子莫尔超晶格中，平带结构可以驱动近藤效应的击穿，并导致非单调的重入行为，从而产生不同于传统块材重费米子体系的新奇电子态。

papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化方法求解一维Hubbard模型的基态，并通过含时密度矩阵传播模拟激光驱动下的超快动力学过程。
